01a0752f.text:
Tarrel my beloved,

Not a day goes by that I don't lose myself thinking of those bronze braids, that bellowing laugh, or those rippling forearms.

You must come to me in Auberdine on the next ship. We belong together--you know it to be true if you search your heart!

Yours if you'll have me,

Hollee
01a0752f.title: Hollee's Note

06fc3ba9.text:
"The skyseer elders among the Windshapers, by contrast, place implicit trust in the wind spirits and regard any questioning of their designs as an affront to our benefactors. They hold that our patrons in Skywall have already sacrificed much to bring us here and sustain us. They assert that if any further knowledge was vital to our survival, they would surely reveal it in due course. This difference in belief has given rise to no small measure of tension between the two orders.

Whatever the truth may be, it is plain that we are not alone in this realm, and that many mysteries yet remain beyond our present understanding."
06fc3ba9.title: On The Windlord

083ea102.text:
It pains us to mention that we at Snuff Inc. have received reports that some greedy tuber hunters care little for the safety of their lovable pets and send them into dark, dangerous nooks and cranies in search of tubers.

We do not condone such irresponsible behavior, but in the efforts of customer satisfaction we have included a warranty with every gopher sold, allowing new owners to return to their point of purchase and replace lost pets.

Happy Hunting!
083ea102.title: Snufflenose Owner's Manual

0938d1f1.text:
Where once I thought it preposterous that a human would come to our lands and learn our ways, this wizard, this evil man, came here and not only survived, but also gained some of our knowledge. I'm still uncertain how...

I never discovered his goals during my investigation, but his plan seemed simple: using druidic magic, he wanted to befriend and then control the furbolg. If it was in an attempt to harm my kin, or for some other malicious purpose, I hope to find out before my path ends.
0938d1f1.title: Teronis' Journal

0abdf1b9.text:
"Much of the flora and fauna of the $R Isles has been shaped by the elemental forces that reign here in the realm of Skywall. Many creatures once bound to the earth now bear avian traits such as beaks, talons, and feathers. Others have gained the power of flight, though such transformations remain less common than other outward changes.

Among the shen'dorei, the elemental plane's influence upon the body has been gradual and subtle. Yet in recent generations its effects have grown increasingly dramatic. Consider, for instance, the phenomenon now commonly called the "Sky-Touched Blessing."
0abdf1b9.title: The Sky-Touched Mystery

0afcd341.text:
$N, below are the items needed to create your armor:

Smokey iron ingots from the Windshear kobolds in the Windshear mine in the Stonetalon Mountains.

Powdered azurite from the Hillsbrad miners in Hillsbrad.

Iron bars from miners, or from iron deposits if you are a miner.

Vial of phlogiston, from a quilboar named Roogug in Razorfen Kraul.
0afcd341.title: Thun'grim's Instructions

138f14fe.text: Thrall took up Doomhammer's legendary warhammer and donned his black plate-armor to become the new warchief of the Horde. During the following months, Thrall's small but volatile Horde laid waste to the internment camps and stymied the Alliance's best efforts to counter his clever strategies. Encouraged by his best friend and mentor, Grom Hellscream, Thrall worked to ensure that his people would never be slaves again.
138f14fe.title: The New Horde

1903befb.text: After the Scythe was freed, They came at us from everywhere, clawing from hidden holes at our feet and dropping upon us from silent perches above.  Half our men fell in those first panicked minutes.  The rest, including myself, tried to flee.  As I ran I saw so many of my brothers taken by tooth and claw, heard so many screams cut short or gurgle to silence.
1903befb.title: Book from Sven's Farm

1aca9f8f.text:
The samophlange control console can be used to autmoatically regulate the flow of fuels, gasses, liquids, and related machinery. Once initial configuration has been completed, it should run worry free with minor maintenance.

Brief listing of control console components (from left to right)

I. Main Power Lever

The engaged position enables the samophlange. The control mechanism will not automatically disengage when the lever is put in the off position. This will merely
1aca9f8f.title: Control Console Operating Manual

1b0e607c.text:
Hello William,

It's been years since we've spoken, but I trust you and your brother are well, and that your apothecary thrives.

I must ask a favor of you, William.  In short, my grandson Tommy Joe has lost his heart to young Maybell Maclure.  And although they adore each other... our families, well our families have been feuding for years.
1b0e607c.title: Gramma Stonefield's Note

1b6e7de9.text:
Brother Neals,

My grapes are saved!  $N, the bearer of this manifest, braved my thug-infested vineyard and gathered the grapes that I could not.  Although the Defias still roam across the river, nearly my entire crop has been salvaged.

You may add a full load of grape bushels to your stores.

May the Light protect us,
-Milly Osworth
1b6e7de9.title: Grape Manifest

1cbf64a2.text:
Within just a few days of my visit I found myself tutoring the local children from the nearby farmlands.  The lessons went so well that the town mayor commissioned me to run a school and construction has begun on a brand new schoolhouse!  From Silverpine to Stormwind and now Moonbrook -- who would have guessed I would see so much of Azeroth!

Warm regards,

Stalvan Mistmantle
1cbf64a2.title: A Dusty Unsent Letter

1e5e787e.text:
the next day. He was quickly buried, without ceremony, in a hastily dug grave on the outskirts of the cemetary. Because Morgan committed murder against innocents, something that went completely against his beliefs and his nature, and because of the grief that he held in being unable to save his family, Morgan could not die a peaceful death, and lived on as one of the restless dead.

Only days later, his grave was disturbed, and his body could not be found. The being that was Morgan now
1e5e787e.title: The Story of Morgan Ladimore

1ed64c09.text: <The rest of the book is blank>
1ed64c09.title: Book from Sven's Farm

1f91b566.text:
<You touch the small white crystal and you can hear faint sounds on the wind. This is an audio recording of some sort.>

"On The Windlord."
1f91b566.title: On The Windlord

2677e79a.text:
Lady Cassandra Valor, Loving mother and wife

Not much is known about Cassandra other than her love for her family. She nurtured brave children and a powerful husband, leading some to muse that the family's greatness was all her doing. A flattery she would always decline with grace.

If she is remembered for nothing else, let it be known that everything she did was for her family.
2677e79a.title: Memories of Valor

286e198d.text: there, he decided, against his better judgement, to stop by the Raven Hill cemetary. Morgan spent hours walking amongst the gravestones. He recognized many names of people that he knew and became more and more distraught. Then he saw them: a small, untended plot amongst the many with three small gravestones. A feeling of dread washed over him as he approached. Morgan brushed off the dust of the most prominent gravestone to reveal the name on it. Simply carved upon the grave, letters spelled out
286e198d.title: The Story of Morgan Ladimore

28e3ad3b.text:
his worst fear:

Lys Ladimore
Beloved Wife and Mother

Morgan's apprehension turned to dismay and then to grief, and he fell to his knees weeping. For hours he stared at that one grave, begging the cold stone for forgiveness and sobbing apologies. Then, hours later, something in him snapped, and he began to lash out. He brought his sword out of its scabbard and began to rain blows on the gravestones, screaming in rage. Blind in his fury, he lashed out and swung wildly, catching the notice
28e3ad3b.title: The Story of Morgan Ladimore

28e9b855.text:
The Mauradine Centaur of Desolace.

When you use shamanism to empower your people, it demands harmony with nature. The wind answers your call because it chooses to. You are its champion, and it becomes the power that lets your people soar. However, the Mauradine have no respect for this balance.

This particular clan has only wielded this power for selfish gain. Hunting parties flying across the plains to stalk their foes, spellcasters channeling great storms to burn villages. And even this is not enough. They have created totems of hideous power, forcing the elements to bend to their will.

It is not for us to decide Azeroth's desires, but one thing is clear. The Mauradine are no friends to the elements.
28e9b855.title: The Walks of Shaman

2a4f8c01.text:
Master Delgren,

It is as you feared. Your theory about the Tower of Althalaxx has proven true. A cult has gathered at the tower with many warlocks amongst their number, including even a foul satyr. They call themselves the Cult of the Dark Strand. I cannot imagine what vile purpose brings them together, but it worries me.

Please forgive the terseness in which I have composed this missive, but danger lurks in the forest around me, and I can spare few words to describing the situation. I
2a4f8c01.title: Letter to Delgren

2c3af560.text:
Regardless, he was apparently more successful than naught in actualizing his plans. Did he want to attempt his machinations on the furbolg before trying on my people? Did the furbolg have something he coveted? Who knows?

Using an item he created (a rod or staff of some kind), he attempted to infiltrate the furbolg tribes of Ashenvale. At some point, and this is where many of the details are still unclear, he was discovered by the furbolg while trying to manipulate them into acting against
2c3af560.title: Teronis' Journal

2d0045b9.text:
A Report on the State of the Frostmane Trolls in the General Area of Dun Morogh

Prepared by Senir Whitebeard, Senate Special Envoy

The trolls situated in Dun Morogh are largely centralized in Frostmane Hold, a mountain cave on the western border. They have sufficient numbers to cause some concern, however, they seem more than content to stay in their cave. This is, no doubt, because they do not wish to incur the wrath of the dwarves again, and risk total extermination. Their actions can be considered territorial, if anything, and it is
2d0045b9.title: Senir's Report

2de336e4.text:
Blacknails--

The Sea awaits us.  We need your supplies from the North.  Strip everything: every railroad pike, every waterbucket.  We need metal.  A shipment is due from BB but long overdue.  Come through for me, Blacknails.  Send your supplies directly to the "barn" this time.  No time to squander.

--VanCleef
2de336e4.title: A Mysterious Message

32b33362.text:
Missing: Corporal Keeshan

Last seen during the bloody battle at Stonewatch Keep, Corporal Keeshan was reported to have been dragged away by Blackrock Orcs.

It is believed that Corporal Keeshan is being held as a prisoner of war at the Blackrock encampment north of Lakeshire, just west of the pass leading to the Burning Steppes.

By mandate of Magistrate Solomon, anyone who aids in the recovery of Corporal Keeshan shall be rewarded by Marshal Marris.
32b33362.title: Missing: Corporal Keeshan

331a87a2.text:
Anu thera dal'dieb do anu alah'ni ishnu ni anu shari'fal ethala diel thoribas ash asto're. Anu man'ar ash u'phol ethala do anu alah ash shari'fal su Dal'dieb ash anu ishnu dorini su anu d'ana'no su anu talah diel aman'ni ri anu aman'ni dorini. Shano nor nor shano, aman'ni diel ni anu fandu'talah, ni anu terro shar nor anu aman'ni. Anu shari'fal nor asto're do'rah diel anu shari'fal su terro, diel anu isera'duna shar shar'adore ri rini anu balah al'shar.

Alah'ni do'rah alah'ni. Dorini do'rah
331a87a2.title: The Fall of Ameth'Aran

33f57b36.text:
I started this journal so I could keep notes on my quest to help Ashenvale. There is a mystery to some of the events that occurred not too long ago, and hopefully I will be able to unravel some of it in order to help my people.

Let me start by putting down facts so they don't slip my mind at a later date.

I've recently found truth to the rumors of the wizard Dartol's efforts.
33f57b36.title: Teronis' Journal

35a4a4e3.text: The terror of these past few weeks is almost more than I can bear; yet, I feel that by writing down that which I've seen I will somehow be comforted.  So I do it, and it is the only comfort I have these bleak days.
35a4a4e3.title: Book from Sven's Farm

3728af3c.text:
Ira Valor, Forest Stalker

When Ira's father grew ill, she took it upon herself to gather food and supplies from the nearby forests. While resources were not in short supply, you were as likely to find food as you were to become it.

Over the years, she adapted to the forests, preferring to spend her time within the dark woods rather than in Raven Hill. Travelers who got lost in the trees would tell stories of a shadow seemingly opening the way for them back to the road. There was no confirmations of who it was, but rumors spread quickly.

It's said that Ira is still in the woods offering a guiding hand to those who fall prey to the beasts within.
3728af3c.title: Memories of Valor

38d59472.text:
headed towards the village to find answers, and, he hoped, his wife and children.

Morgan inquired about his family, but could not find any answers. A priest in Darkshire, as it was now called, said that he might search the cemetary at Raven Hill for a gravestone. Morgan refused to believe that his family was dead, and continued to search every farm and house in Duskwood, but to no avail.

Morgan rode from Darkshire to nearby Lakeshire, thinking that perhaps his family had fled. On his way
38d59472.title: The Story of Morgan Ladimore

3e8f2af5.text:
"On the eve of the planned summoning ritual, the Shal'nan and his forces struck. Seeing this as their final opportunity to thwart Prince Tortheldrin's reckless plan, they made a daring raid on the Prince's sanctum, intent on stopping the ritual.

Just as the Shal'nan and the rebels feared, the poorly considered spell spiraled out of control and threatened to destroy the entire city center. 

As the battle raged, wild magics tore through the streets, opening portals to the Nether itself and manifesting malevolent arcane monstrosities that preyed mercilessly upon the defenseless citizens of Eldre'Thalas."
3e8f2af5.title: The Rebellion In Eldre'Thalas, Part 4

3f63fb0c.text:
Lord Ebonlocke--

The Township of Lakeshire humbly requests the aid of the Night Watch.  We are under siege from both the Blackrock orcs and Morganth's Shadowhide gnolls.  I would not send bidding if our situation was not severe.  We await aid from Stormwind but until such help arrives, I beg of you to lend support.  Once the kingdom is breached, all of humanity is in peril.

Magistrate Solomon
3f63fb0c.title: Solomon's Plea to Darkshire

42d36bd4.text:
To the Honorable Headmaster Crillian,

My former Master, I write to you so that you might know what your apprentice has been doing of late.  Paying heed to your advice, I sought to build my knowledge and wisdom through travel outside the gates of our beloved Stormwind.  My journeys took me to many places but I have decided to take up residence here in the lovely town of Moonbrook.  The surrounding fields of Westfall are most beautiful as the harvest approaches.
42d36bd4.title: A Dusty Unsent Letter

44973cc4.text:
After surviving the flight from Roland's Doom, I hid within a barn owned by a man named Sven.  I spent a few days in the barn, and such horror lingered with me that I never once made myself known to Sven or his family.  But from what I saw from my hiding place, I knew these farmers were quite decent folk.  Had I stepped from my concealment I think they would have taken me in, but trust is hard for me.  Harder still after that shock in the mine.

So I remained hidden.
44973cc4.title: Book from Sven's Farm

4509354d.text:
Lordaeron. Morgan was called to the side of the legendary paladin Uther the Lightbringer to fight against the orcs and the undead. Leaving his wife and children in the safety of his home, Morgan left for war.

The years passed and the war dragged on, and Morgan would witness many horrific events, including the disbanding of the Paladins of the Silver Hand, the death of Uther and the spread of the plague. The only thing that kept him from the brink of madness was the knowledge that he would
4509354d.title: The Story of Morgan Ladimore

47e4bf81.text:
You already felt the call of something greater than yourself, and that's the call of the elements. We dwarves have a strong connection to earth, but with the right training, you can learn to speak to all of the elements. The elementals can be demanding and challenging, but I'm here to guide you in learning how to communicate with them. Come find me in Anvilmar and I'll teach you how to listen to the elements, and how to get them to listen to you.

- Teo Hammerstorm, $C Trainer
47e4bf81.title: Archaic Rune

49795015.text: "Of late, the magisters of the High Order have grown increasingly wary of the wind spirits' motives, insisting that all powers and perils native to this realm must be better understood. Even if such dangers lie far from us now, the magisters maintain that such knowledge will better prepare us to face whatever may yet come."
49795015.title: On The Windlord

4a431345.text: The resourceful yet inexperienced Thrall decided to escape from Blackmoore's fortress and set off to find others of his kind. During his journeys Thrall visited the internment camps and found his once-mighty race to be strangely cowed and lethargic. Having not found the proud warriors he hoped to discover, Thrall set out to find the last undefeated orc chieftain, Grom Hellscream.
4a431345.title: The New Horde

56e0f1f5.text: The chief warden of the internment camps, Aedelas Blackmoore, watched over the captive orcs from his prison-stronghold, Durnholde. One orc in particular had always held his interest: the orphaned infant he had found nearly eighteen years before. Blackmoore had raised the young male as a favored slave and named him Thrall. Blackmoore taught the orc about tactics, philosophy, and combat. Thrall was even trained as a gladiator. All the while, the corrupt warden sought to mold the orc into a weapon.
56e0f1f5.title: The New Horde

57d4e03b.text:
The Mirefin Murlocs of Dustwallow Marsh.

Murlocs have an innate connection to water as any seafolk, but in a curious way. Many species can recognize the elements in nature without tapping directly into it. The murlocs, however, not only can call upon water, but wield it with surprising intelligence.

Their oracles have a curious affinity for restorative magic. Water is a source of healing for all creatures, from hydration to medicine, but the murlocs managed to tap into its even deeper sources of power. What takes some adepts decades to master, some murlocs seem to be born with this gift.

If this were any other $c, one would think this to be a blessing. But they are murlocs, after all. Their healing magic is as much a weapon as any other, keeping their hunters sharp and their shores battle-ready. Using totems is curious for a species like this, but make no mistake. They are as corrupt as their masters.
57d4e03b.title: The Walks of Shaman

5a4d394b.text:
He tells me he's been throughout all of Dor'danil, and he's never seen a chest or any container that may hold the pommel. 

He also tells me that rotting slimes have inhabited the area, and they devour almost anything smaller than them. He's seen them "eat" tables, sculptures, bears, and even gnomes!

The slimes seem to gain a great deal of sustenance from things magical. If the chest holding the pommel was enchanted at all, the slimes might have eaten it.
5a4d394b.title: Teronis' Journal

5c3b2fb2.text: Satisfied that the small world had been ordered and that their work was done, the Titans prepared to leave Azeroth. However, before they departed, they charged the greatest species of the world with the task of watching over Kalimdor, lest any force should threaten its perfect tranquility. In that age, there were many dragonflights.
5c3b2fb2.title: Charge of the Dragonflights

5ed600b2.text:
Hello there again.  I'm Gubber Blump.

I hope you are doing real well.  I hope you are still fishing too.  I love fishing.  The Blump family is known for fishing.  Here is a bauble, so that you can fish a little better.  I love using them when I fish.  Good luck, and thank you again for helping me catch them groupers from before.

Keep on fishing!

Gubber Blump
5ed600b2.title: Plain Letter

5ff2f298.text: . . .Giles, the boy, seems a bit rambunctious and will be a challenge to educate.  However the elder daughter, Tilloa, seems exceptionally smart.  I couldn't help but to notice her captivating beauty as well.  She is on the cusp of womanhood now.  Supposedly the Lord has arranged her marriage for next year.  But I digress.  This week I will accompany the family to their summer cottage near the Eastvale Logging Camp in Elwynn, close to the Red Ridge Mountains.  I hope to write more while there.
5ff2f298.title: A Torn Journal Page

698a58c2.text: The Highborne's reckless use of magic sent ripples of energy spiraling out from the Well of Eternity and into the Great Dark Beyond. The streaming ripples of energy were felt by terrible alien minds. Sargeras - the Great Enemy of all life, the Destroyer of Worlds - felt the potent ripples and was drawn to their distant point of origin.
698a58c2.title: The War of the Ancients

6b4cef3c.text:
"The message of resistance spread by the Shal'nan began to gain traction within Eldre'Thalas, due in no small part to the very public embarrassment the Prince suffered nearly daily at the hands of rebel operations.

Awareness of an alternative, more naturalistic way of life also spread quickly in the kingdom at this time. This was heavily influenced by the example set by the Cenarion druids, who had taken control of the greater kaldorei empire in the northern part of the continent. There were even rumors that the rebels were secretly supported by covert agents sent by the new de facto leader of the night elves: the Archdruid Malfurion Stormrage."
6b4cef3c.title: The Rebellion In Eldre'Thalas, Part 3

6b67c9a7.text:
someday be reunited with his wife and children.

Morgan would eventually return to his homeland, but find it nothing like how he remembered it. The once verdant forest was corrupted and teemed with the undead and other dark forces. Destroyed houses and farms could be found everywhere, and the cemetary near Raven's Hill now dominated much of the area. A shocked and bewildered Morgan eventually made his way to his home, only to find it in ruins. Not knowing what had befallen his homeland, he
6b67c9a7.title: The Story of Morgan Ladimore

6bb719a7.text:
WALKING YOUR GOPHER

The snufflenose gopher likes small, dark places.  And it is very shy.

If you wish to walk your gopher, then you must take it to a place that feels like home.  And you MUST take it to where your gopher can smell its favorite food: blueleaf tubers!

The closest such place is the "trench" area of Razorfen Kraul.  If you open your crate near the trench, and your gopher can smell any nearby tubers, then he will venture out and follow you.
6bb719a7.title: Snufflenose Owner's Manual

6e5e9a85.text:
Hillsbrad Town Registry

We the people of Hillsbrad do solemny swear our faith and devotion to the Alliance maintained by the great monarchs, King Magni Bronzebeard of Ironforge and King Anduin Wrynn of Stormwind.

Herein lies the town registry for purposes of governing this fair city in the foothills of the great Alterac Mountains as well as serving as a record of those who have paid their taxes to their Kings and to the great almighty Alliance.
6e5e9a85.title: Hillsbrad Town Registry

706c83e3.text:
"In the end, the worst of the destruction was narrowly avoided due to the rebels' intervention, but the price was steep. The battle claimed many lives on all sides, but the rebels suffered the greatest losses. 

The Shal'nan himself was the only one to survive the final confrontation within Tortheldrin's sanctum. Those closest to the Shal'nan have widely documented that whatever injury he suffered in that last battle left him forever changed. In the centuries since those dark days, the Shal'nan has never spoken of what occurred, and he becomes withdrawn and wistful when asked."
706c83e3.title: The Rebellion In Eldre'Thalas, Part 4

70e09613.text: Constantly hunted by the humans, Hellscream nevertheless held onto the Horde's unquenchable will to fight. Aided only by his own devoted Warsong clan, Hellscream continued to wage an underground war against the oppression of his beleaguered people. Unfortunately, Hellscream could never find a way to rouse the captured orcs from their stupor. The impressionable Thrall, inspired by Hellscream's idealism, developed a strong empathy for the Horde and its warrior traditions.
70e09613.title: The New Horde

751d6228.text: Despite his harsh upbringing, young Thrall grew into a strong, quick-witted orc, and he knew in his heart that a slave's life was not for him. As he grew to maturity, he learned about his people, the orcs, whom he had never met: after their defeat, most of them had been placed in internment camps. Rumor had it that Doomhammer, the orc leader, had escaped from Lordaeron and gone into hiding. Only one rogue clan still operated in secret, trying to evade the watchful eyes of the Alliance.
751d6228.title: The New Horde

77ff4de3.text:
A note is attached to the crate.  It reads:

"Verner - sorry to hear Redridge is having such trouble.  Here are the shoes you need.  Please pay me 100 silver at your earliest convenience."

"Or if you like, you can pay me in underbelly scales from black dragon whelps (I hear Dragon Whelps are common in the Redridge Mountains).  Because we're friends... 4 scales will be enough.  Thanks --Argus"
77ff4de3.title: Crate of Horseshoes

78d3fd0c.text:
Azeroth is home to a host of brilliant creatures. It shows no favoritism. If you learn to listen to her, feel her presence and answer her call, it is simple to wield her strengths.

With time and patience anyone can hear the elements, but our totems lend us a conduit with which to channel this power. More civilized cultures only bestow a totem on those who have proven themselves worthy, but a suitably powerful $c can create one at will.

We have seen such creatures wield the elements for evil. With enough corruption in the land, Azeroth cries out for protectors against these twisted totems. With enough of the corrupted conduits, one can even call upon the tainted elements and banish them back to the planes.
78d3fd0c.title: The Walks of Shaman

7cd4e35a.text:
Meanwhile, I am sending Lieutenant Alverold on an exploratory mission around the continent of Kalimdor. His forces are to complete their mission and then join our forces at Tiragarde Keep.

It is anticipated that Lieutenant Alverold's mission will last quite some time. The new land seems vast and dangerous. But should any misfortune befall myself or Benedict, Alverold's troops will retake the Keep.

We will send wave after wave until that stronghold is ours!

--Admiral Proudmoore
7cd4e35a.title: Admiral Proudmoore's Orders

7de002ed.text:
"I will continue to serve our people here on Zephras, and I will devote much of my time to furthering our relationship with the wind spirits to whom we owe so much. The elemental spirits are wondrous and wise, and we still have so much to learn from one another.

I am devoted to seeing the shen'dorei persevere in this beautiful and strange realm--and to seeing that we do so freely, justly, and unshackled by tyranny."
7de002ed.title: The Shal'nan's Abdication

7e23fcfc.text:
"The young Prince Tortheldrin intended to build a network of crystalline foci and use them to siphon and shape a new font of power for our people to draw upon. The point of contention for many was that he intended to use the very power that nearly destroyed our world to accomplish this. He meant to siphon this power from a demon world within the Twisting Nether itself. 

Many rightly feared this could open a new door through which demonic entities might gain once again access to our world."
7e23fcfc.title: The Rebellion In Eldre'Thalas, Part 1

80ccd26b.text:
All of our gophers are highly trained, and merely waving your command stick will send a nearby gopher into "search mode."  The gopher will then sniff for a tuber and if he smells one, he'll move toward it and dig it up.

If you wave the command stick again while the gopher is searching for a tuber, then it will stop its search and happily return to your side.

We are confident that you'll find our gophers well trained, useful and squeezably soft additions to your party!
80ccd26b.title: Snufflenose Owner's Manual

85302983.text:
The Stonevault Troggs and Dustbelcher Ogres of the Badlands.

The element of fire is often misunderstood as a source of destruction. While uncontrolled fire is indeed the mark of an uncontrolled spirit, a focused flame lights homes and staves off the bitter cold. A people who learn to master this element are sure to be prosperous--both in battle and at home.

Troggs are rather simple creatures. They aren't known for great demonstrations of power or even particularly cohesive aggression. It wasn't until their discovery of fire that they were even considered a culture worth investigating. But the elements show no favoritism.

Ogres, on the other hand, are known for their strength, cruelty, and even cunning. They forge alliances, and fight in organized groups. They can be quick to turn on their allies and each other, embodying fire's spread and fury.

The element of fire may respect keeping these cultures alive, but certainly not how their totems have been used for blind cruelty.
85302983.title: The Walks of Shaman

863e0183.text:
To face Frostmaw, you must entice him with the meat of his favorite prey.

Go to the Alterac Mountains in Azeroth and hunt a hulking mountain lion.  Kill it, and then take its carcass to the Growless Cave, a place held sacred by the bestial wendigo.

Place the carcass on the Flame of Uzel and the scent from burning meat will drift from the cave.

And then, in time, Frostmaw will come.
863e0183.title: Kodo Skin Scroll

86e6ff83.text:
FEEDING AND CARE:

We are committed to providing you with everything needed to care for your pet.  Our customers have come to expect this level of service from Snuff Inc, and we agree!

To that end, we have designed sturdy gopher crates with small holes, perfect for keeping your pet safe, secure and out of the light.

For your convenience, inside every crate is a food pellet receptacle, infused with the alluring scent of blueleaf tubers (the snufflenose gopher's favorite treat)!
86e6ff83.title: Snufflenose Owner's Manual

87089dfc.text:
Magistrate Rutherford Burnside
All debts settled.

Blacksmith Avery Verringtan
All debts settled.

Clerk Horrace Whitesteed
All debts settled.

All debts settled.

Councilman Hooks

All debts settled.

87089dfc.title: Hillsbrad Town Registry

8a3468e3.text: "Whatever the truth may be, our benefactors clearly have no wish to speak of Al'Akir or his servants, and they are quick to dismiss all rumors of the Windlord's presence as idle fancy, unworthy of serious heed. They assure us that we need not trouble ourselves with such matters here, safe upon our $R Isles. While this offers solemn comfort to many, it also raises a troubling question: what, precisely, are the wind spirits concealing from us?"
8a3468e3.title: On The Windlord

8b00bc0d.text:
If I can't find the gem hidden in the shrine, it might be in the possession of one of the murlocs.

The shaft portion
This part of the rod was given to the treants near what is now called Felwood. Neither the furbolg nor my kind could have suspected that such magnificent creatures could ever fall to the corruption that's overtaken the land.

My research tells me that the guardians kept the piece in a small glade locked within a chest. To find out any more, I'll have to speak to Shael'dryn.
8b00bc0d.title: Teronis' Journal

909666a3.text: The cult hit us by surprise. Raani never saw it coming and Arvensus took a sword to the gut. For my part, I took a lightning bolt to the chest and blacked out. They never bothered to finish me off... I guess they assumed my wounds would do me in. When it's all said and done, I suspect they might.
909666a3.title: Bloody Note

914ded86.text:
<You touch the small white crystal and you can hear faint sounds on the wind. This is an audio recording of some sort.>

"The Sky-Touched Mystery"
914ded86.title: The Sky-Touched Mystery

9368d9b6.text:
Shael'dryn is a dryad who protects the moonwell northeast of Lake Iris. She refuses to leave the forest or forsake it to the corruption. I know she has the power and knowledge to repair the rod, or to at least tell me how I can do it on my own.

The pommel
The pommel of the rod was given to the druids of Dor'danil. There is one major problem with this though: the druids are dead.

Their spirits now inhabit the area and are no longer hospitable.
9368d9b6.title: Teronis' Journal

96213f45.text:
"It's well documented since our ascent to Skywall that our people have adopted more lithe, slender forms, but this occurred over the course of many millennia. In contrast, the first recorded case of the Sky-Touched Blessing--which causes shen'dorei children to be born with vivid cerulean skin--was noted fewer than five generations ago.

Within a single generation of its first appearance, one child in twenty born among the $R bore this curious alteration. Two generations later, that rate had doubled."
96213f45.title: The Sky-Touched Mystery

97070260.text: Seeking the truth of his own origins, Thrall traveled north to find the legendary Frostwolf clan. Thrall learned that Gul'dan had exiled the Frostwolves during the early days of the First War. He also discovered that he was the son and heir of the orc hero Durotan, the true chieftain of the Frostwolves who had been murdered in the wilds nearly twenty years before.
97070260.title: The New Horde

9990e024.text:
one another. As I'm sure the elves would be, the furbolg were angered, but they reacted much more strongly and killed Dartol.

The furbolg, at least at this time, weren't the same corrupted creatures they've become. They were still rational and intelligent--their relationship with our people amicable.

I'm hoping that if I can recreate the rod with the help of a dryad named Shael'dryn, I can use its power to help our people... and the furbolg.
9990e024.title: Teronis' Journal

9ae5e874.text:
It's a gamble, but I have no other clues at this time...

As I find out more I'll put the details here; but until then, I shall work on finding the parts of the rod and helping Ashenvale.
9ae5e874.title: Teronis' Journal

9bec0de2.text:
Mighty warriors defend our home. Our shamans guide our spirits and show us our ancestors' past. And our druids help us discover the Earthmother's will.

But you are one of our hunters, and our hunters learn many aspects of those roles and blend them together. You will find you represent the heart of our people--some of our tribe will look to you for guidance, some for protection. It is my duty to ensure you are prepared for that. Seek me out in Camp Narache.

-Lanka Farshot, Hunter Trainer
9bec0de2.title: Etched Note

9c463c84.text:
Official Orders For The Kul Tiras Fleet

I, Admiral Proudmoore, shall lead the first landing upon the shores of Kalimdor.

Lieutenant Benedict will be second in command in my absence. All domestic Kul Tiras military matters will be handled by him. If I do not send word from Tiragarde Keep within 12 months time, Lieutenant Benedict will lead the second wave to hold the location.
9c463c84.title: Admiral Proudmoore's Orders

9d3d799e.text:
Farmer Kalaba

9d3d799e.title: Hillsbrad Town Registry

9d55873f.text:
"With the founding of our new home here in the clouds, we embark on a new age of peace and prosperity for our people.

You have all endured so much to make it here. I have watched our people grow into a hardy, self-reliant society, which fills me with a pride I cannot hope to describe in full.

The greatest part of that pride, however, is that it has become clear to me that I no longer have any need to act as our singular ruler."
9d55873f.title: The Shal'nan's Abdication

9f033b7c.text:
Your Honor--

All of Westfall mourns for your loss,  but we are plagued with our own war in Westfall.  The farmers have been run off by thieves and mechanical golems.  Stormwind withdrew its troops, leaving the people defenseless.  I mustered the People's Militia in the wake of Stormwind's abandonment to save what remains of this land.  To take the Militia to Redridge would mean certain doom for Westfall.

My regrets,
Gryan Stoutmantle
9f033b7c.title: Stoutmantle's Response to Solomon

a25c18ad.text: Under the tutelage of the venerable shaman Drek'Thar, Thrall studied his people's ancient shamanistic culture, which had been forgotten under Gul'dan's evil rule. Over time, Thrall became a powerful shaman and took his rightful place as chieftain of the exiled Frostwolves. Empowered by the elements themselves and driven to find his destiny, Thrall set off to free the captive clans and heal his race of demonic corruption.
a25c18ad.title: The New Horde

a3f989c8.text:
"Today, three in ten children born on the $R Isles have the striking complexion of the Sky-Touched. In recent centuries, the acceleration of our physical alterations has increased, and many scholars believe that the last vestiges of our kaldorei heritage may vanish entirely within two to three more generations.

The cause of this transformation may never be fully understood. Yet it is plain that, in making our lives within the elemental plane, we as a people are being changed by it in turn. Skywall is a realm of wonders, but this serves as a sober reminder that we still know perilously little of what such a place may work upon those not born to it."
a3f989c8.title: The Sky-Touched Mystery

a46637da.text:
I know how this letter will find you, and I am truly sorry about that, elder.

Without a doubt, I will send any able-bodied adventurers I can through your fine town. I hope their impact will make up for the lack of other support I can bring at this time.

Our lands are pressured by a great many enemies. I'm sure you are no stranger to that world yourself, but it has painfully drained what resources we have.

Should that change, I would love to help, but even then there are many projects close to home that will demand priority.

Hold strong. We're all in this together.

-- Baros Alexston
City Architect, Stormwind
a46637da.title: Alexston's Reply

a8169b64.text:
