ta golg
gar thon- kha z'ta gor weard-hald

<The map is in too poor of condition to make out any other writing.>
a8169b64.title: Bloody Map

ac4eb085.text: "Thank you for everything you've sacrificed, everything you've built, and everything you've taught me about how to be a better person. You all represent the unshakable resolve of the shen'dorei people. We will thrive in this beautiful new world and reach new heights together."
ac4eb085.title: The Shal'nan's Abdication

accca090.text:
<You touch the small white crystal and you can hear faint sounds on the wind. This is an audio recording of some sort.>

"An excerpt from the Shal'nan's speech at the groundbreaking ceremony for the Shrine of the Four Winds, Zephras Isle."
accca090.title: The Shal'nan's Abdication

ad70f374.text:
"Prince Tortheldrin grew frustrated, fearing that delays and debate would lead to the further deterioration of his kingdom. 

As a result, his response to this resistance was swift and brutal. Over the course of a single bloody night, a purge was carried out that saw the complete destruction of dozens of noble houses. All who publicly opposed Tortheldrin were abruptly silenced, and entire lineages were destroyed overnight."
ad70f374.title: The Rebellion In Eldre'Thalas, Part 2

ae49717f.text:
CONGRATULATIONS!

You are the proud new owner of the amazing snufflenose gopher!  Although a shy creature, we are positive you'll find your new pet's fuzzy cuteness and incredible olfactory capabilities endearing.

In the following pages, you'll find information on your gopher's:

1. Feeding and care
2. Eccentric (and adorable) behavior
3. Use of the patented Snufflenose Command Stick(tm)

Again, congratulations.  You won't be disappounted,

-Marwig Rustbolt
Owner, Snuff Inc.
ae49717f.title: Snufflenose Owner's Manual

ae8a06fd.text:
Along with killing Dartol, the furbolg split up the rod into three parts so it couldn't be used against them again. It has been difficult, but I've a good idea where all three parts were placed.

The Gem
The first part of the rod, a glowing gem, was hidden in a shrine in Northwestern Ashenvale. I believe now this shrine is the ruins at the center of Lake Falathim. The Sentinels tell me that it's been inhabited by murlocs now.
ae8a06fd.title: Teronis' Journal

b0897304.text:
Merrick Valor, Watcher of Darkshire

Merrick was the youngest son of the Valor family. As he witnessed the corruption coming to his homeland, he chose to join The Watch in a desperate bid to protect his loved ones.

While he was the most inexperienced member of his family, he quickly made a name for himself amongst the ranks of The Watchers. He had a knack for archery, and soon became one of the most staunch defenders of Darkshire.

His personal mission was to keep the roads safe, wary of the ever more hostile creatures coming to the forests.
b0897304.title: Memories of Valor

b1f65f40.text:
of a trio of the cemetary's attendants. As they tried to restrain him, he turned his focus to them, hurling accusations of guilt upon the innocent attendants, then killed them all.

Later, when the rage had passed, realization crept into Morgan's mind, and he saw his bloody sword driven into the chests of one of the attendants. Driven to the brink by his emotions, he removed his belt knife and plunged it into his heart.

Morgan Ladimore's body and the three bodies of his victims were found
b1f65f40.title: The Story of Morgan Ladimore

b310a79d.text:
"When the beleaguered rebel army arrived at the port city of Eldre'narr, the magisters in control of the city had already heard of Tortheldrin's mighty rage--and of his standing order to kill any rebel found on sight. In an act of miraculous mercy, the magisters made no move to hinder the rebels' progress, allowing them to commandeer a number of ships without resistance.

The Shal'nan understood that this act of mercy would likely expose many in Eldre'narr to Tortheldrin's wrath. Even so, he accepted this unexpected gift with grace and, with a heavy heart, sailed his people west into the unknown."
b310a79d.title: The Rebellion In Eldre'Thalas, Part 4

b38214e6.text:
Lord Grant Valor, Sire of the Valor Family

Lord Grant, may he rest in peace, was the pinnacle of Alliance exceptionalism. A natural leader, his guiding hand helped lead the denizens of Raven Hill to prosperity. When darkness began to creep into the woods, he was the first to rally our people.

There was no more foul a foe than the undead to Lord Grant. He personally patrolled the cemeteries of Duskwood to keep the shambling hordes in check. The day he took a grievous blow from the monsters, everyone in town shared his pain.

With his family's care, he returned to his duties, but there was a lingering malady that seemed to follow him for the rest of his days.
b38214e6.title: Memories of Valor

b7902375.text: To symbolize his people's rebirth, Thrall returned to Blackmoore's fortress of Durnholde and put a decisive end to his former master's plans by laying siege to the internment camps. This victory was not without its price: during the liberation of one camp, Doomhammer fell in battle.
b7902375.title: The New Horde

b8e7b7dc.text:
Alah tur anu d'ana'no su anu talah asto're fulo anu thera su anu thero'shan man'ar su anu Aman'ni Diel. Ri ash nor shano shar Terro, turus su anu aman'ni il'amare, do'rah ash asto're su anu dath, balah do'rah tur man'ar al rini rini shar tur man'ar alah ano adore. Fulo anu u'phol su anu Diel ash anu d'ana'no su anu talah, aman'ni su Terro, bandu balah bandu, diel do balah shar nor alah'ni alah asto're, fulo anu al'shar balah.

Do'rah shano diel alah turus ash u'phol su shar'adore fandu'talah
b8e7b7dc.title: The Lay of Ameth'Aran

b9c35edd.text:
Your Honor--

I regret to inform you that the Night Watch is unable to leave its post in Darkshire at this time.  Perhaps you were unaware that Stormwind no longer provides military support in this region.  The Night Watch has been formed and trained entirely by the people of the forest in order to defend Darkshire in Stormwind's absence.  Without the Watch, the town would fall.  I wish you luck with your plight.

--Lord Ello Ebonlocke
b9c35edd.title: Ebonlocke's Response to Solomon

bbc330d4.text:
I can only guess why I survived that night.  I have always been cautious, always quick to flinch from jabs and leap free of pitfalls.  My nickname comes from this trait.  So perhaps it was just that knack for caution that saved me...

Or maybe it was the Scythe I pulled from the rubble.  It cannot be the Scythe itself, for I lost it during my frantic flight.  But if it was I who brought the Worgen to Duskwood, then perhaps the Worgen afforded me a rare courtesy.  Curse them.
bbc330d4.title: Book from Sven's Farm

bc13bd7f.text:
The Lost Ones of the Swamp of Sorrows.

Earth is the element of fortitude and steadiness. A $c capable of harnessing the earth's power can guarantee their people sturdy homes and durable warriors. What could otherwise flatten another combatant can be shrugged off by one gifted by the powers of earth.

It can also be used to crumble others.

When left to their devices, the Lost Ones rarely interfere with the goings on of other cultures. They stalk about in a mindless fugue state as if they don't truly belong anywhere. The only thing that offers them grounding is the elements.

Unlike the others mentioned, it is not necessarily believed that the Lost Ones have a genuine desire for harm. Earth offers them solace in their aimless wandering. However, with this comes their dependence.

Calling on the elements for aid is one thing, but demanding their presence is another. They are our guides, not our crutches. Now their totems are just as twisted as the Lost Ones themselves.
bc13bd7f.title: The Walks of Shaman

be4b2da4.text: . . .most strange and uncontrollable feeling.  Never have I felt the way I did today.  Whilst assisting Giles with his history lesson, Tilloa was outside tending to the flower garden.  After a few minutes she came inside and placed a scarlet begonia in my open palm and smiled at me in such a way that my heart felt as though it was trembling within my chest. . . .
be4b2da4.title: A Faded Journal Page

c24bab30.text:
"The Prince railed against the idea of an alternative path to combat his people's dependence on magic. He claimed that calls to embrace naturalistic magic were propaganda spread by illegitimate usurpers to Queen Azshara's vacant throne. 

He and his supporters dismissed druidic magic as base and barbaric--utterly beneath the proud, ancient traditions of the highborne. Yet the practice of druidism began to take hold on the fringes of Eldre'Thalas society, and with it, the rebellion continued to grow."
c24bab30.title: The Rebellion In Eldre'Thalas, Part 3

c441d492.text: During his travels, Thrall found the aged warchief, Orgrim Doomhammer, who had been living as a hermit for many years. Doomhammer, who had been a close friend of Thrall's father, decided to follow the young, visionary orc and help him free the captive clans. Supported by many of the veteran chieftains, Thrall ultimately succeeded in revitalizing the Horde and giving his people a new spiritual identity.
c441d492.title: The New Horde

c562b99e.text:
REPORT: Kobolds

The activity of kobolds has increased in the vicinity of Northshire Valley.  They camp north of the abbey and within the Echo Ridge Mine in alarming numbers.  I have marshalled paladins, warriors and other local folk to aid me in ridding us of the vermin.

This progresses well.  And I will update as needed.
c562b99e.title: Marshal McBride's Documents

cb9a9530.text:
"The terror of such brazen suppression caused a shocked silence to fall over the people of Eldre'Thalas. All discourse around Prince Tortheldrin's plan abruptly ceased... for a time, at least. Unfortunately for the Prince, the harder tyrants squeeze their people, the brighter the flames of resistance burn.

There were those who resolved to ensure our people did not repeat Queen Azshara's mistakes. A group of scholars formerly of the order of the Shen'dralar met in secret and formed a pact. Swearing to stop the Prince by any means necessary, they began to plant the seeds of rebellion."
cb9a9530.title: The Rebellion In Eldre'Thalas, Part 2

cdac24ff.text:
A Report on the State of the Frostmane Trolls in the General Area of Coldridge Valley

Prepared by Grelin Whitebeard, Senate Special Envoy

From the time that I have spent observing the movement of the Frostmane trolls in the Coldridge Valley area, I have determined that they pose no large threat to dwarven settlements in the area. Moreover, they are a threat that can be eliminated with little additional support from the army. Through the assistance of Mountaineers already stationed in
cdac24ff.title: Grelin's Report

d1948154.text:
Greetings, $N,

Since the elemental wind spirits vanished, Zephras has been on a deadly precipice. The birds, the beasts, and even the roots beneath our feet call to us for aid.

Seek me out on the ground floor of the great tree here in Thendal Village. I will counsel and train you in the druidic arts.

-Xyton Silverwind, $C Trainer
d1948154.title: Folded Parchment

d353ee0a.text:
Not all the furbolg have been corrupted. Some still live and try to protect the forest. During their corruption, some of the furbolg fled, many were killed, and others were forced out of their tribes.

I found a venerable furbolg of the Foulweald tribe living above Lake Mystral--his name is Krolg.

I've watched him for days, and I think if I were to approach him in the guise of a furbolg, I could help him and discover a way to re-establish a bond between our people.
d353ee0a.title: Teronis' Journal

d557c053.text:
Memories of Valor
A Recount of the Valor Family and Their Service to Raven Hill

There was no greater family in all of the Eastern Kingdoms than the Valor family. Their deeds to the people they swore to protect were nothing short of miracles, and their loss is a loss for all of Raven Hill.

I write this account to set the record straight, detailing the marvels that were Grant, Ira, Silvia, and Merrick. May these writings be a small consolation for how sorry I am for their absence.
d557c053.title: Memories of Valor

d6c64d69.text:
This may require more investigation. I'm not sure I'm powerful enough to fight the spirits of my dead kin...let alone delve into the depths of Dor'danil and find the pommel.

(Note: During my preparations in Astranaar, I've recently met a dwarf hunter who has spent a good portion of his time in Ashenvale trying to help my people. He came from a place called Stormwind.

We spoke over a few ales one night, and his tales have given me new hope of finding the pommel...
d6c64d69.title: Teronis' Journal

d877283f.text: "In the immediate aftermath of the battle, Tortheldrin's forces were scattered and disorganized. Most were occupied with securing the city once more, and this distraction allowed the remaining rebels to escape and regroup. With nowhere else to go, the Shal'nan marched what was left of his exhausted forces west, toward the coast."
d877283f.title: The Rebellion In Eldre'Thalas, Part 4

d991212d.text:
It began with the finding of that cursed scythe in Roland's Doom.  Before the Scythe, the terrors of this place seemed as tame as Northshire Valley.

But ever since I found the haft of the Scythe jutting from that pile of rubble in the mine and, curse me, pulled it free, Roland's Doom became a place of vile death!
d991212d.title: Book from Sven's Farm

dd60b3b4.text:
THE SNUFFLENOSE COMMAND STICK(tm)

The snufflenose gopher is an amazing animal.  Not only does it inspire love and affection from even the most ornery plainstrider, it can smell a buried blueleaf tuber from up to fifty yards away!

If you wish to send your gopher to find a tuber, then you may use our (separately sold) patented snufflenose  command stick.  

Direction following on next page...
dd60b3b4.title: Snufflenose Owner's Manual

e02ca2f0.text:
"Who is Al'Akir the Windlord? The priests of the radical Al'Aketh would have us believe him to be the true ruler of Skywall, the realm we now call home. In their telling, we are but interlopers here, and one day Al'Akir shall appear before us to reckon with our trespass into his dominion within the elemental plane.

Though such claims may at first seem the ravings of the misguided or the mad, there may yet be some measure of truth in them. When asked of Al'Akir's nature, the wind spirits grow evasive and agitated. Indeed, even the mere speaking of the so-called "Windlord's" name appears to cause them profound unease, perhaps even fear."
e02ca2f0.title: On The Windlord

e772416c.text: wanders Duskwood, consumed by his grief over the loss of his wife and children and his own self-hatred. Mor'Ladim, as he now calls himself, roams Duskwood with mindless vengeance and hatred, and has been known to commit murder indiscriminately.
e772416c.title: The Story of Morgan Ladimore

e772d22d.text:
Morgan Ladimore was a great and noble knight who fought in defense of the innocent, the poor, and the afflicted. For many years, he worked diligently throughout the outlying areas of Azeroth, bringing relief to the suffering and swift justice to evildoers.

He was married to a young girl named Lys in the summer of his eighteenth year. They were much in love with each other and would eventually produce three children, a son and two daughters.

Morgan was thirty-two when war broke out in
e772d22d.title: The Story of Morgan Ladimore

ec82091a.text:
Silvia Valor, Raven Hill Guard

Silvia Valor had already been a local hero by the time she was offered to join the Guard. If there was one thing she could not stand to suffer more than anything, it was opportunists who took advantage of those who were struggling.

Bandits, con artists, rabble-rousers, it didn't matter. Silvia put each to the sword for trying to sow chaos in her beloved home. It was only natural she would be put in a position of real authority to act out her vision of justice.

It's said that, until she drew her last breath, she would never abandon the farmsteads and homes of Duskwood. And perhaps not even then.
ec82091a.title: Memories of Valor

ed4434f9.text:
Greetings,

As a guest of the Alliance, you have been given leave to travel freely throughout Alliance lands. 

This document will serve as a guide to help you reach the other member cities of our alliance.
ed4434f9.title: Advisor Emerson's Instructions

ee1ac06e.text:
"The leader of the rebels was a mysterious figure known only as the 'Shal'nan' or, 'The Veiled One.' He wore a featureless golden mask intended to conceal his identity and protect those close to him. This man quickly became a symbol for ordinary citizens who would stand up against oppression, and the word Shal'nan became a battle cry synonymous with rebellion.

Through sabotage, coercion, and--according to some rumors--assassination, the rebels quickly became a thorn in the side of Prince Tortheldrin's efforts to construct his network of crystalline foci."
ee1ac06e.title: The Rebellion In Eldre'Thalas, Part 3

f0de76e9.text: "There were those who loudly opposed the Prince's plan to channel a font of demonic energy to power his network of crystalline foci. Many of the detractors were members of outspoken noble families who attempted to use their influence to turn public sentiment against House Tortheldrin and the Prince's plan."
f0de76e9.title: The Rebellion In Eldre'Thalas, Part 2

f2713b07.text:
"Thus, I am abdicating my position as your leader and handing over governance of our $R Isles to a carefully chosen council of provincial elders. After the transition period is over, you will have the opportunity to choose your own leaders, and your voices will determine the direction we take from here on. 

You have demonstrated the ability to lead yourselves better than any king, queen, prince, or other individual sovereign ever could--and that fills me with profound pride."
f2713b07.title: The Shal'nan's Abdication

f3ab30b0.text:
Agasham,

Our plans must be kept secret at all costs! It will be disasterous if the other tauren tribes discover our affiliation.

Signed,

Harbinger Elm
f3ab30b0.title: Secret Note #1

f581396b.text:
Brother Haalien,

It is time to prove your worth to the Al'Aketh! Go into Shadowgale to find the pylon. You have conveyed your concerns about the druids and the highest in our order have heard you.

Take these faithful soldiers with you in your righteous mission. Kill the druids swiftly lest they interfere with our plans. We have eyes and ears in Valanaar that will confirm when you have been successful.

The time of reckoning is at hand! None shall be able to stop the ushering!

-N
f581396b.title: Mysterious Orders

fa484bc7.text: "After the climax of the war and the Great Sundering of Kalimdor, the new reality of a world bereft of the sustaining magic on which our people depended quickly became apparent. The ruling house of Eldre'Thalas--House Tortheldrin--rapidly set plans in motion to ensure stability and continuity of our way of life. However, the methods they intended to employ left many deeply concerned."
fa484bc7.title: The Rebellion In Eldre'Thalas, Part 1

ff2a2345.text: "In the days immediately following the turmoil at the Well of Eternity, there was much unrest in Eldre'Thalas. The demonic forces that poured from the Well nearly overwhelmed the beleaguered elvish kingdoms, ravaging the land and killing indiscriminately. If not for the intervention of the demigod Goldrinn and the sacrifice of countless kaldorei heroes, the kingdom of Eldre'Thalas would surely have been overrun and destroyed."
ff2a2345.title: The Rebellion In Eldre'Thalas, Part 1

10086|0e051c59.name: Hesuwa Thunderhorn
10086|0e051c59.text: You've come for training in order to pass it on to your pets?

10088|0e051c59.name: Xao'tsu
10088|0e051c59.text: You've come for training in order to pass it on to your pets?

10088|d56cf43b.name: Xao'tsu
10088|d56cf43b.text:
You can't teach an old dog new tricks.  At least that's what someone once told me.  Lucky for you, I've discovered it to be untrue.

However, pets do tend to get resistant to the technique, and I need more food each time to keep them happy.  What that means is that you'll owe me more money the more times I untrain the same pet.

Now then, would you like me to start untraining?

10089|0e051c59.name: Silvaria
10089|0e051c59.text: You've come for training in order to pass it on to your pets?

10090|0e051c59.name: Belia Thundergranite
10090|0e051c59.text: You've come for training in order to pass it on to your pets?

10118|c6fbc16f.name: Nessa Shadowsong
10118|c6fbc16f.text: The fish off the coast of Teldrassil are quite large and robust.  Rumors say it is the speedy growth of our new world tree that is the cause.

10136|b4b53bc1.name: Chemist Fuely
10136|b4b53bc1.text:
My brother and I have dedicated ourselves to Sylvanas. She is our beacon of light when times were darkest. We sacrifice ourselves day in and day out to ensure our kind overcome the destiny that's chosen us.

We will not remain weak. We will take that which is owed to us. We will return tenfold, the pain that was done to us. And we shall do so with smiles on our faces.

10181|6887b693.name: Lady Sylvanas Windrunner
10181|6887b693.text:
I've heard of you. Windshapers. Wayward children of ancient Eldre'Thalas.

I once would have called you kin--albeit distant kin. Now I have no more in common with elfkind than I have with any of the other living races. All I value from any creature that draws breath is how well they may further the goals of the Forsaken. Make yourself useful to my people, and you will be welcome in our lands.

Go. Explore the Undercity as you like and enjoy its comforts, such as they are. Just remember, nothing escapes my notice within my own domain.

10182|264b8b9f.name: Rexxar
10182|264b8b9f.text: Greetings, $c. I am Rexxar, champion of the Horde, servant of Thrall, master to the beasts of the wilds.

10216|1147bc15.name: Gubber Blump
10216|1147bc15.text: ...pan fried, deep fried, and stir fried...

10219|572db4df.name: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde
10219|572db4df.text: May Elune walk with you, $c.  The Temple of the Moon has come to help the troubled citizens of Auberdine.

10266|3852bbda.name: Ug'thok
10266|3852bbda.text: Snarl calls me simple because I am too slow. I just want to do the job right, and that takes time.

10266|6e63d362.name: Ug'thok
10266|6e63d362.text: You learn quickly, that is not a bad thing. Just be sure to do the job right, as long as it takes to do so. Now, I fear I must send you to Snarl to learn more. Learn what he can teach, but do not listen to his angry words. He gets that way when Saru's daughters laugh at him.

10266|b17b8494.name: Ug'thok
10266|b17b8494.text: I can show you what you wish to know, but you must be patient. Take your time to work the steel and feel the way it shapes beneath your hammer. When you become one with the steel, then you will understand.

10276|2846a7fb.name: Rotgath Stonebeard
10276|2846a7fb.text: A fast learner is what ye are, and a good smith to boot. I would sign off on yer work any day of the week. But I sense ye still have some learnin in ye. Go talk to Bengus Deepforge, he's a hard taskmaster but he's also one of the best.

10276|d6f17c90.name: Rotgath Stonebeard
10276|d6f17c90.text: Aye, I would love ta teach ye a thing or two about smithing. Grab an apron and a hammer and let's see what we can accomplish shall we?

10277|a14963d0.name: Groum Stonebeard
10277|a14963d0.text: Ye've got a little skill on ye. Enough to learn ye a few things I wager. Let's see what I can teach ye, shall we?

10277|de38fa19.name: Groum Stonebeard
10277|de38fa19.text: Ye know more than I do, that's a certainty. Tell ye what though, go talk with me da'. He'll want ye ta prove yerself, but he is a fine teacher indeed. His name's Rotgath, and ye'll find him near the anvils workin steel for ol' Bengus.

10278|46a7802e.name: Thrag Stonehoof
10278|46a7802e.text: Karn says we need to listen to the spirits of the forge and of the steel, that they will guide us. I hear nothing but a ringing in my ears. Here, take a hammer and let us try to hear the spirits together.

10278|af34ad47.name: Thrag Stonehoof
10278|af34ad47.text: I guess the spirits like you better than me, I still have not heard their call but you seem to have gathered their lessons well. Go speak to Karn, he will be excited to see one who hears them as he does.

10278|b24d3eb1.name: Thrag Stonehoof
10278|b24d3eb1.text: I listen and I listen but I don't hear these spirits that Karn speaks of.

10360|54d735c8.name: Kergul Bloodaxe
10360|54d735c8.text: $N, the Silverwing Sentinels must be crushed!  Are you ready for Warsong Gulch?

10378|4fa5b9c3.name: Omusa Thunderhorn
10378|4fa5b9c3.text: Where can I send you today $c?

10378|5d1f9ab4.name: Omusa Thunderhorn
10378|5d1f9ab4.text: Treat the wind rider well as it takes you to your destination.  May your ancestors watch over you $N.

10378|6bdb24d7.name: Omusa Thunderhorn
10378|6bdb24d7.text: Many are the paths of the Earth Mother.  Wherever you decide to travel, may she watch over you.

10378|8b4f80e7.name: Omusa Thunderhorn
10378|8b4f80e7.text: Though the Crossroads seems to be the center of activity in The Barrens, I prefer the quietude of Camp Taurajo.  Where shall I send you?

10428|74518b5c.name: Motega Firemane
10428|74518b5c.text:
Whitereach Post started off as a small hunting camp... Now, everyone wants to set up shop and call this home.

<Motega shrugs his shoulder>

10537|c27b3101.name: Cliffwatcher Longhorn
10537|c27b3101.text: We cannot take care of all the threats in this area alone. We could use another fighting hand, $N.

10540|5004ab66.name: Vol'jin
10540|5004ab66.text:
Ah yes, I heard of the Windshapers. It be good to be meetin' you now.

You know, my people been fighting elves for thousands of years. If you be half as fierce as your cousins from Darnassus or Quel'Thalas, the Darkspear would be glad to call you friend.

I be wishin' you well in your travels, $c. We Darkspear know all too well what it's like to have no home, so I hope you be finding what your people need to save yours.

10540|7c6995ef.name: Vol'jin
10540|7c6995ef.text: I am Vol'jin, of the Darkspear. Do you be friend, or enemy?

10578|4ad7f83c.name: Bom'bay
10578|4ad7f83c.text: Ya mon, I be Gadrin's assistant.  Dis here volunteer work be my way of gettin through Witch Doctor School.  Since you help him, I help ya for free.  Whatcha need fixin?

10666|43217733.name: Gordo
10666|43217733.text: Us is busy with important things!

10666|5f4181c7.name: Gordo
10666|5f4181c7.text: Oh yeah. Us gots it right here.

10666|f346152a.name: Gordo
10666|f346152a.text: Oh yeah. Us gots $n right here.

10668|19e45338.name: Beaten Corpse
10668|19e45338.text:
The body is that of a female orc warrior.

It is clear that she died in battle, probably against the quilboar in the area.

10668|36aec325.name: Beaten Corpse
10668|36aec325.text:
You turn the body over and see the marks from blades and spells upon the deceased orc--her armor all but destroyed, her hair matted to her face.

Based on Mankrik's description of her, there is no doubt in your mind that this was his wife.

He will be upset by the news, but you are sure he should know the truth.

10668|8ac74c94.name: Beaten Corpse
10668|8ac74c94.text:
The body is that of a female orc warrior.

It is clear that she died in battle, probably against the quilboar in the area.

10668|aa4f9f41.name: Beaten Corpse
10668|aa4f9f41.text:
You turn the body over and see the marks from blades and spells upon the deceased orc--her armor all but destroyed, her hair matted to her face.

Based on Mankrik's description of her, there is no doubt in your mind that this was his wife.

He will be upset by the news, but you are sure he should know the truth.

1070|8a3dd721.name: Deputy Feldon
1070|8a3dd721.text: You'll find the town of Lakeshire yonder, across the bridge. But you'll not find it a peaceful place. If you're here for adventure, lass, then mark me--you've found it!

1070|bd6c9aff.name: Deputy Feldon
1070|bd6c9aff.text: You'll find the town of Lakeshire yonder, across the bridge. But you'll not find it a peaceful place. If you're here for adventure, lad, then mark me--you've found it!

10721|738b752e.name: Novice Warrior
10721|738b752e.text: Are you here to prove yourself as well?

10721|a05588c0.name: Novice Warrior
10721|a05588c0.text:
<Novice Warrior gulps.>

I can do this.

1073|3a43ea84.name: Ashlan Stonesmirk
1073|3a43ea84.text: What did ya say, sonny?  You're going to have to speak up if ya want me to hear a blasted word you're saying!  All those years in the artillery have left my ears ringing!

1077|75241b9c.name: Prospector Whelgar
1077|75241b9c.text: Oh my, this is quite historical.  A monumental find.  But these wretched beasts!  Merrin seems to be handling the situation quite well.  Now if I could just piece together this complicated puzzle. . . .

10781|cb1093ae.name: Royal Overseer Bauhaus
10781|cb1093ae.text: I am an officer of the city, working in the capacity of the Undercity's census.  Since our liberation from the Scourge, we have tried to keep an accurate track of our city's populace.  Through arcane methods and sharpened mental discipline, I am able to access these records.  If you have business with me accordingly, please proceed.  You should know if you do, at any rate.

10878|6c0228ac.name: Herald Moonstalker
10878|6c0228ac.text: Your legacy precedes you, $c. If you wish, I can allow you to rewrite that legacy into something new.

10879|6c0228ac.name: Harbinger Balthazad
10879|6c0228ac.text: Your legacy precedes you, $c. If you wish, I can allow you to rewrite that legacy into something new.

10880|6c0228ac.name: Warcaller Gorlach
10880|6c0228ac.text: Your legacy precedes you, $c. If you wish, I can allow you to rewrite that legacy into something new.

10880|dc8290dc.name: Warcaller Gorlach
10880|dc8290dc.text: Greetings and salutations, hero!  I have the latest news from both continents and points beyond for your consideration.

10881|6c0228ac.name: Bluff Runner Windstrider
10881|6c0228ac.text: Your legacy precedes you, $c. If you wish, I can allow you to rewrite that legacy into something new.

10881|dc8290dc.name: Bluff Runner Windstrider
10881|dc8290dc.text: Greetings and salutations, hero!  I have the latest news from both continents and points beyond for your consideration.

10897|c5ceacbe.name: Sindrayl
10897|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

1092|fc807fb6.name: Captain Rugelfuss
1092|fc807fb6.text: At ease, $R.  This is no time for formalities.  With the Alliance forces under attack, the protection of the Dwarven territories becomes even more critical.  The recent Trogg uprising poses a dreadful threat to the King's land.

11017|788cf9fc.name: Roxxik
11017|788cf9fc.text: Nice try, but you'll need some more experience before training with me! Back to the trenches!

11017|8ad376c5.name: Roxxik
11017|8ad376c5.text: Nice going! I knew I was right about you, no matter what those other people said. Ha! I'm kidding! Okay, on with your lessons...

11019|b01379bc.name: Jessir Moonbow
11019|b01379bc.text:
Hello, $c. I am Jessir Moonbow. I have come from Darnassus seeking two friends who came looking for signs of the Shadow Council in Felwood.

It seems those vile creatures who claim responsibility for much of the orcish race's suffering seeks to regain some of its power.

My two friends went looking in Jaedenar to prove one way or the other what was happening.

I expected them to be here when I arrived, but now they are days late.

11025|8faa4e47.name: Mukdrak
11025|8faa4e47.text: I know a few things. You want me to show you?

11025|f03c89ad.name: Mukdrak
11025|f03c89ad.text: You know who can really show you some things? Nogg! You go find him in Orgrimmar.

11026|40d3ed3c.name: Sprite Jumpsprocket
11026|40d3ed3c.text: You need to start learning things that are beyond my expertise! Talk to Lilliam Sparkspindle in front of the tent there. He'll set you on the right course!

11026|766a64ec.name: Sprite Jumpsprocket
11026|766a64ec.text: Ah, what a beautiful day to blow something up!

11028|aa37b039.name: Jemma Quikswitch
11028|aa37b039.text: Well... I hate to admit it, but my sister's the one you'll have to talk to if you want to continue training. I don't know as much as she does... yet! She's standing over by the rocket car.

11028|dd2021b3.name: Jemma Quikswitch
11028|dd2021b3.text: I'd love to teach you! Show my sister she's not the only one who knows a thing or two about engineering...

11028|ea44f66d.name: Jemma Quikswitch
11028|ea44f66d.text: I heard the new Henweigh 6000 will be rolling off the assembly line soon. I can barely contain my excitement!

11029|28ea6aca.name: Trixie Quikswitch
11029|28ea6aca.text: You'll need to prove your worthiness before I go giving away my secrets! I've got just the test for you...

11029|afb5ab05.name: Trixie Quikswitch
11029|afb5ab05.text: Don't tell anyone else I said this, but even I don't know everything! If you want to keep learning, you should talk to the owner of the shop, Springspindle Fizzlegear.

11029|bbb4a5a5.name: Trixie Quikswitch
11029|bbb4a5a5.text: The plans for my twenty-foot tall turkey baster are nearly complete! Now all I need is a twenty-foot tall turkey...

11031|16aac61b.name: Franklin Lloyd
11031|16aac61b.text: This is a waste of time, mine and yours! Go see Graham Van Talen if you want to begin your instruction! He's standing to my left over there.

11031|7fb84865.name: Franklin Lloyd
11031|7fb84865.text: Let's see how competent you are, shall we? If you perform this task to my liking, I'll spend the time to teach you!

11031|826d285c.name: Franklin Lloyd
11031|826d285c.text: I don't have time for idle gossip, I'm a professional!

11037|9d22a5b8.name: Jenna Lemkenilli
11037|9d22a5b8.text: You want to train? With me? Fantastic! The only thing better than assembling bullets and explosive devices is to share that knowledge with someone else! Let's get started!

1103|b31c2daa.name: Eldrin
1103|b31c2daa.text: I can tell that your wardrobe is in dire need of care.

1103|ffa61dcd.name: Eldrin
1103|ffa61dcd.text: So you would like to learn a few things? I would be happy to get you started!

11044|0556ba58.name: Doctor Martin Felben
11044|0556ba58.text:
Have you now? This certainly doesn't look like something I had asked for.

This potion is clearly inert, meaning it will no longer create reactions. Hence it is of no use to my studies.

Take it back to Alessandro. Perhaps next time he sends me a potion he can find someone with faster feet.

<Doctor Felben waves a dismissive hand.>

11044|386a9ec7.name: Doctor Martin Felben
11044|386a9ec7.text: Once, it is true, I was human. What might otherwise be a shortcoming works to our advantage, $N, for I know human weaknesses intimately.

11044|9dbf29bd.name: Doctor Martin Felben
11044|9dbf29bd.text: Very well. Cut another lump of flesh from one of these specimens. Let us test what you've learned so far, and we can progress from there.

11044|eb81d9ad.name: Doctor Martin Felben
11044|eb81d9ad.text: Your knowledge of potions has exceeded mine, but you still have much to learn. Go up the stairs to the southeast and see Doctor Marsh. He will teach you true sufferi--ahem. He is a Forsaken who will train you further.

11046|28b8dee2.name: Whuut
11046|28b8dee2.text: Why should I pace myself if this is working?

11046|6253ba70.name: Whuut
11046|6253ba70.text: All the bottles on this table are potions I brewed today. And they say a watched pot never boils. Ha!

11046|90f63e56.name: Whuut
11046|90f63e56.text: Can't help you. You know more about potions than I do. Besides, I have pots to watch. Talk to Yelmak over there. He knows a lot about potions.

11046|ecccd281.name: Whuut
11046|ecccd281.text: They called me stupid, but I'll show them. I'm going to watch every pot I have and prove that they can all boil stuff anyway. Yeah, I'm on a roll! Who's stupid now, huh? Huh!?

11047|f018918d.name: Kray
11047|f018918d.text: Your capacity for learning has outstripped mine. You will need to talk to Bena Winterhoof over there for further instruction. Please don't take too much of her time, though. She needs her rest.

11048|2479a86b.name: Victor Ward
11048|2479a86b.text: Yes, I think you have potential. Maybe I can show you a thing or two.

11048|f49c9bcc.name: Victor Ward
11048|f49c9bcc.text: I'm just a student myself, really. Rhiannon's the expert. She's standing by the crates over there. You can learn a lot from her.

11049|041039a1.name: Rhiannon Davis
11049|041039a1.text: How can I share my secrets with a beginner? Try speaking with Victor Ward first.

11049|8b5e44c8.name: Rhiannon Davis
11049|8b5e44c8.text: Good, you've got some grit! I like that. Well then, let's get going!

11049|8c8d14d6.name: Rhiannon Davis
11049|8c8d14d6.text: Tailoring can come in very handy. I once had to sew my arm back on.

11050|8b982bde.name: Trianna
11050|8b982bde.text: You will not be disappointed, traveler. Tailoring is a joyous endeavor.

11050|e9e31cca.name: Trianna
11050|e9e31cca.text: There is no greater way to clear the mind than to weave.

11051|32f7eed3.name: Vhan
11051|32f7eed3.text: No part of the animals we hunt is wasted.

11065|03886821.name: Thonys Pillarstone
11065|03886821.text: Ah, ye're an inquisitive one, are ye'? Excellent! Pay close attention, this just might save yer skin when the goin' gets rough!

11065|9c1c73ea.name: Thonys Pillarstone
11065|9c1c73ea.text: There are ways to strengthen steel beyond the hammer and forge, young wanderer. Care to learn more?

11065|ad07ed45.name: Thonys Pillarstone
11065|ad07ed45.text: Ye're a fine enchanter indeed! Now it's time fer ye to move on. I want ye to talk to Gimble Thistlefuzz, upstairs. He's a bit of a character, but he'll steer ye in the right direction from here on out!

11066|01d948cc.name: Jhag
11066|01d948cc.text: Throm-ka! What you looking for, stranger?

11066|b615098a.name: Jhag
11066|b615098a.text: To die in battle is glorious! But, with what I teach you, maybe you not die so quickly, hm?

11066|f7f14434.name: Jhag
11066|f7f14434.text: You come to wrong place. Talk to the expert Godan over there. You learn more from him.

11067|d5b4ed51.name: Malcomb Wynn
11067|d5b4ed51.text: I do not have time to waste, stranger. State your business or be off!

11067|e8016bc8.name: Malcomb Wynn
11067|e8016bc8.text: You don't look like much to me, but who knows, maybe there's an enchanter hidden in there somewhere!

11068|327fd53e.name: Betty Quin
11068|327fd53e.text: I'm afraid I have nothing to teach to someone with your experience. But you haven't reached the end of the road yet. Speak to Lucan Cordell, behind the counter there. He'll guide you through the next phase of your journey.

11068|bf2f71d7.name: Betty Quin
11068|bf2f71d7.text: Hail, traveler! What brings you to my doorstep?

11068|fe5ba491.name: Betty Quin
11068|fe5ba491.text: Hmm... well you seem capable enough. If you truly desire to learn, then nothing will stand in your way! I will guide you through your first steps on what I hope will be a long and fulfilling path.

11070|0809aae8.name: Lalina Summermoon
11070|0809aae8.text: The Goddess has granted me wisdom, stranger. If it is her will, I shall pass it on to you.

11070|d1188d03.name: Lalina Summermoon
11070|d1188d03.text: I will teach you what I can. Each lesson is a gift from the Goddess herself. Use her gifts wisely, and you shall not falter.

11071|9e99182c.name: Mot Dawnstrider
11071|9e99182c.text: I cannot teach you anything you don't already know. However, the knowledge of my father far surpasses my own. Go inside and speak to him. Good luck!

11072|15d6b2ff.name: Kitta Firewind
11072|15d6b2ff.text: Your skills are truly becoming extraordinary. Now, let us continue your training...

11072|d52c209e.name: Kitta Firewind
11072|d52c209e.text: You are eager, that is good. However, you are not yet ready to train with the likes of me.

11072|e23ef030.name: Kitta Firewind
11072|e23ef030.text: What brings you to the Tower?

11074|650fd33a.name: Hgarth
11074|650fd33a.text: You have reached new heights in your path to mastery. Let us see if we can take you even further...

11074|ccedb517.name: Hgarth
11074|ccedb517.text: There is only one whose skills exceed my own. You are ready to receive her knowledge. She is Annora, and you may find her... in Uldaman.

11081|68d4b95d.name: Faldron
11081|68d4b95d.text: If you are here for further training, you have overestimated my abilities. Have a word with Telonis over there; he can help you.

11081|cb7eee8e.name: Faldron
11081|cb7eee8e.text: Many animals lost their lives so that we could gain these materials. Do not take their sacrifice lightly, $N. Handle the leather with the respect it deserves.

11083|53d41aed.name: Darianna
11083|53d41aed.text: It's so exciting to be here in Darnassus, surrounded by talented people! I just know I'm going to make my family proud. Maybe if I'm really lucky, the Sentinels will ask me to join their forces on the front!

11083|74fbc2b7.name: Darianna
11083|74fbc2b7.text: If you're interested in sewing with leather, you've certainly come to the right place. Faldron and Telonis are true artists, and I hope to learn much from them.

11083|9dd7b921.name: Darianna
11083|9dd7b921.text: Oh, I'm sorry, but you know more about leather than I do at this point. Talk to Faldron over there if you wish to learn more.

11084|541681c4.name: Tarn
11084|541681c4.text: My axe has seen many battles, and I like to keep it handy. Enemy forces have fought their way into our capital several times now, but have no fear: we have always driven them back.

11084|87a66ee0.name: Tarn
11084|87a66ee0.text: I cannot help you with further training: your skill at working with leather rivals my own. You should speak with Una, over there. I will vouch for your skill if need be.

11084|b9560714.name: Tarn
11084|b9560714.text: I am pleased with your progress so far. Surely the Earth Mother has inspired your hands.

11096|904d1c22.name: Randal Worth
11096|904d1c22.text: There's nothing I can teach you, other than maybe a better eye for color and detail. Talk to Simon Tanner over there; he knows a lot of advanced techniques for working with leather.

11106|e013de07.name: Innkeeper Sikewa
11106|e013de07.text: As the wind on the plains, you are always welcome here.

11116|e013de07.name: Innkeeper Abeqwa
11116|e013de07.text: As the wind on the plains, you are always welcome here.

11176|f7f357cc.name: Krathok Moltenfist
11176|f7f357cc.text: I am Krathok, overseer of these craftsmen.

11317|1bfc2caa.name: Jinar'Zillen
11317|1bfc2caa.text: Hey mon! You've ever been diving deep in the ocean? I'll let you in on a little secret, eh. Deep in the ocean you can find bubbly fissures; they'll allow you to breathe air while underwater.  Let's keep this secret between you and me though, eh. I don't need no competition for me shellfish traps elsewhere... if you get my drift!

1139|a75e2b6f.name: Magistrate Bluntnose
1139|a75e2b6f.text: Well hello there, citizen. The name's Bluntnose, Magistrate Bluntnose, to be precise. I'm charged with overseeing the well-being of Thelsamar, and believe you me, we could always use another strong set of arms around here!

11401|fed57ab8.name: Priestess Alathea
11401|fed57ab8.text: My wisdom is yours, as is my knowledge. What can I do for you, $N?

11406|5d01ce11.name: High Priest Rohan
11406|5d01ce11.text: I hope the Light is with you, $N. Is there anything I can do for you today?

11406|8fca8484.name: High Priest Rohan
11406|8fca8484.text: If you desire, in addition to training, I have it within my power to erase the knowledge of your talents from your mind.  Be warned that every time you undergo this procedure the more difficult it is to perform, and therefore the more expensive it becomes.

1154|3696a22b.name: Marek Ironheart
1154|3696a22b.text:
Though I hate to admit it, the bear did get the better of me. My oh my, that's one big ol' bear!

Nonetheless, if you can take that bear down, it'd be a feat to be proud of! It gave more than a few of our best hunters some trouble.

<He claps you on the back.>

Best the bear and we'll accept you as a regular member of the Farstrider Lodge.

1154|b7c42d9a.name: Marek Ironheart
1154|b7c42d9a.text:
Here at the Farstrider lodge, we prize hunting skills above all else. Wish to gain my approval? You'll have to earn it.

You look up to the challenge, lad!

11798|a2b097f2.name: Bunthen Plainswind
11798|a2b097f2.text: Would you like a flight to Thunder Bluff, courtesy of the Cenarion Circle?

11799|4c00ddd0.name: Tajarri
11799|4c00ddd0.text:
May Cenarius watch over you, brother.

I am Tajarri, and I am a sworn protector of this shrine.  It is my honor to serve Keeper Remulos as a warden of this sacred land.

11799|992f6a78.name: Tajarri
11799|992f6a78.text:
The Shrine of Remulos is a sacred place for us in the Cenarion Circle here in Moonglade... so please conduct yourself in a manner befitting a visitor.

A visitor who doesn't want my scimitar buried in them, that is.

11799|afaf02f4.name: Tajarri
11799|afaf02f4.text:
May Cenarius watch over you, sister.

I am Tajarri, and I am a sworn protector of this shrine.  It is my honor to serve Keeper Remulos as a warden of this sacred land.

11800|2051e10a.name: Silva Fil'naveth
11800|2051e10a.text: Would you like a flight to Rut'theran Village, courtesy of the Cenarion Circle?

11800|d5d73f6c.name: Silva Fil'naveth
11800|d5d73f6c.text:
In the northern part of Darkshore runs the Cliffspring River, flowing down from the lands now known as Felwood.  As the river flows out and empties out into the Mist's Edge, travel north to where the deepest parts of the ocean begin.  A stone formation that some call the Stone Claw due to its shape is where you may find what you seek.

Be warned - threshers gather by the Stone Claw, and will attack those who trespass on their territory.

11802|ef8483c2.name: Dendrite Starblaze
11802|ef8483c2.text:
Greetings, $c.  You are welcome in Nighthaven, as well as all of Moonglade.  The Cenarion Circle welcomes all beings who respect the authority and command of nature.

While you are here, please be sure to preserve the balance in all things.  Disturbances are not welcome here, and our wardens are trained to cease all hostilities without question.

11833|383e75cd.name: Rahauro
11833|383e75cd.text: Please, feel free to speak to me anytime, $N. You have served Magatha well. I am sure she will call upon you in the future.

11833|eb2e4319.name: Rahauro
11833|eb2e4319.text:
Well met, $c. You may speak to me unless you have direct business with my mistress Magatha.

I deal with most of her tasks for her so she can concentrate on more important matters. Perhaps there are some things we could discuss before you seek audience with her?

11860|ae16ea2b.name: Maggran Earthbinder
11860|ae16ea2b.text: I am afraid that I am no longer gentle or humble. Age and countless battles have hardened my skin and soul. Perhaps that is why Cairne assigned me to Sun Rock Retreat... the gentle winds and warm sun does ease the pain.

11861|2ff59fb5.name: Mor'rogal
11861|2ff59fb5.text:
Stonetalon Mountain has many perilous caves through out this region.  Exploring these caves can hold many adventures for those willing to risk life for glory.

$C, perhaps you seek riches that only following your heart and soul can garnish.

11865|7022eed4.name: Buliwyf Stonehand
11865|7022eed4.text: Ye want to be trained in the use of a weapon, do ye?  Well don't stand there slack-jawed, speak up laddie!

11865|702b6852.name: Buliwyf Stonehand
11865|702b6852.text: Ye want to be trained in the use of a weapon, do ye?  Well don't stand there slack-jawed, speak up lassie!

11866|f3b1497b.name: Ilyenia Moonfire
11866|f3b1497b.text: The grace with which I fight is not something I can teach you, but I can teach you the use of various weapons.

11867|3f5ede7c.name: Woo Ping
11867|3f5ede7c.text: Have you come seeking training in the ways of armed combat?

11867|d85affd4.name: Woo Ping
11867|d85affd4.text:
Buliwyf, the dwarven weapon master at the Timberline Arms in Ironforge, teaches fist weapons, guns, one and two-handed axes and one and two-handed maces.

Bixi Wobblebonk, the gnome weapon master at the Timberline Arms in Ironforge, teaches crossbow, daggers and throwing weapons.

Ilyenia Moonfire, the night elf weapon master, resides at the Warrior's Terrace in Darnassus where she teaches bow, daggers, fist weapons, staff and throwing weapons.

11868|48da0bbc.name: Sayoc
11868|48da0bbc.text: Here to learn how to wield a new weapon, or just to waste my time?

11869|49ff395c.name: Ansekhwa
11869|49ff395c.text: I would be honored to train you in the use of the weapons that I have mastered should you have the ability to learn within you.

11870|3a5c3d7e.name: Archibald
11870|3a5c3d7e.text: I suppose you are here to be trained in the use of a new weapon?  Make it fast, I'm very busy!

11870|a5868f28.name: Archibald
11870|a5868f28.text:
Sayoc is the orc weapon master.  He is located in Orgrimmar's Valley of Honor.  He can train the use of bows, daggers, fist weapons, one and two-handed axes and thrown weapons.

Hanashi, the troll weapon master in the Valley of Honor of Orgrimmar, can instruct in the use of bows, one and two-handed axes, staves and all thrown weapons.

Ansekhwa, the tauren weapon master, is on Thunder Bluff's lower rise.  He teaches the use of one and two-handed maces, staves and guns.

11899|c5ceacbe.name: Shardi
11899|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

11901|c5ceacbe.name: Andruk
11901|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

11956|0359e6b8.name: Great Bear Spirit
11956|0359e6b8.text:
Strength of the heart is what gives you the resolve to take action... action that is rooted in intents that are pure and forthright.  To keep the balance is not to be complacent or banal.

You must show resolve for that which you believe in, and you must be willing to fight for it.  The mother bear shows endless conviction in protecting her young, as does an elder bear protecting his den.  It is this resolve, this strength of heart, which you must come to know if you are to master the way of the Claw.

11956|59f9a1e9.name: Great Bear Spirit
11956|59f9a1e9.text:
It remains to be seen if you are ready, young one.  Even the wisest and oldest of druids are never truly ready when their ultimate time of testing comes.

You have heard my words, and now you must move on.  Heed what I have taught you.  There will be a time when you will have your strength tested.  You must face your foe as the bear would - with strength of body and with strength of heart.  Learn from the fight, young one.  Go... with my blessings.

11956|86efb831.name: Great Bear Spirit
11956|86efb831.text:
The bear spirit looks upon you with a calm and peaceful gaze.  You hear a voice speak to you as though it was coming from the bear, but the creature makes no indication that it is speaking.

"Greetings, my young friend.  If you have come to me seeking guidance, then perhaps I can help you find what you seek."

11956|bab3e0cd.name: Great Bear Spirit
11956|bab3e0cd.text:
I represent the strength which bolsters you as a young druid.  You have come to me to learn this strength, young one, and I will teach this to you.  I will teach you all that is the spirit bear, provided you will listen and understand.

In order to know what it means to draw upon my spirit, you need to understand the importance of the strength of the body, as well as the strength of the heart.

11956|d6a631ca.name: Great Bear Spirit
11956|d6a631ca.text:
Strength of the body is the power and swiftness of action.  You must keep yourself fit at all times, both physically and mentally.  The bear's girth highlights its strength, as it is a ferocious foe in combat.  The bear's girth, however, belies its lithe agility and sharp mind.  These are surprises you will use to your advantage.

You must rely on the strength of the bear's body in order to master the way of the Claw.

12031|eab06e19.name: Mai'Lahii
12031|eab06e19.text: I should find some hired help; I don't like sitting here all day selling fish supplies. I'd much rather go fishing, and then sell supplies.

12042|a2527c6f.name: Loganaar
12042|a2527c6f.text:
Welcome, my brother.  If you are here to train, then I would be delighted to train you.

There will be a time soon where the call of the Emerald Dream will take hold in you.  You will hibernate for many years and walk amongst the purest of forms.  It is there and then that your ultimate training will take place.

12042|cf843c85.name: Loganaar
12042|cf843c85.text: Even within cold, stone walls such as the ones that shelter this town, one may find tranquility and peace.  In fact, you may find them everywhere you are... simply look inside yourself for such balance.

12042|e653c173.name: Loganaar
12042|e653c173.text:
Welcome, my sister.  If you are here to train, then I would be delighted to train you.

There will be a time soon where the call of the Emerald Dream will take hold in you.  You will hibernate for many years and walk amongst the purest of forms.  It is there and then that your ultimate training will take place.

12136|838c9edd.name: Snurk Bucksquick
12136|838c9edd.text: Come, take a trip to the wonderful, gorgeous, tropical jungles of Stranglethorn. That's right, you too can be spending your time sunbathing by the crystal blue waters while I stand here in this unbearable heat with nothing to look at but my brother Frezza all day! Enjoy your trip!

12136|866b6683.name: Snurk Bucksquick
12136|866b6683.text: Hey there cutie, you looking for a ride to Grom'gol? I hear it gets mighty steamy down in those jungles, maybe I could join you for a short vacation, show you a real jungle cat.

12137|c087faab.name: Squibby Overspeck
12137|c087faab.text: Slip a little coin into the boss's hand and look what it gets ya. I love my job. Though, if I could find a way to get that little firecracker Snurk reassigned to this port....well, I can't imagine it any better. But I'm betting that you aren't here about my business practices. You're looking for the Zeppelin to Undercity, am I right? Well that's great, because it docks right here behind me. Oh and hey, if you see Snurk, put a good word in for me, would ya?

12144|8e6ce242.name: Lunaclaw Spirit
12144|8e6ce242.text:
The spirit looks intently into your eyes and grasps your hand.  You feel a warmth shoot through your body, almost knocking you to your knees.

As the warmth passes, you feel the slight presence of an ursine spirit within your being... bolstering your resolve.

12144|ac452739.name: Lunaclaw Spirit
12144|ac452739.text: The slain spirit of Lunaclaw stares at you intently, as though wanting something from you.

1215|2de92970.name: Alchemist Mallory
1215|2de92970.text: Good day, sir. I'd shake your hand, but as you see, I'm in the middle of something. May I be of assistance?

1217|980ce69c.name: Glorin Steelbrow
1217|980ce69c.text: Harumph!  As if I don't have enough to do out here in the muck, without all these distractions!

12196|7161de72.name: Innkeeper Kaylisk
12196|7161de72.text: If we are to make these new lands ours then we must have places to rest our battle weary bodies. Lay your axe by the fire and share the stories of your mighty battles.

12198|179c03d1.name: Martin Lindsey
12198|179c03d1.text: You think you have what it takes to destroy The League of Arathor, $c?  I hope so.  What is it that you want, or are you simply here to waste my time?

1228|544e5c2b.name: Magis Sparkmantle
1228|544e5c2b.text: Well met, $c.  My advice to you is this: as you travel the world, be wary of magic for it will burn the untrained.

1228|c2a278c1.name: Magis Sparkmantle
1228|c2a278c1.text: Greetings.  I'm a mage trainer, and you're a mage.

1229|617e9d53.name: Granis Swiftaxe
1229|617e9d53.text:
Yer no warrior... Why ye wouldn't even last a day under my training regimen!  

A $c who thinks he's a warrior.  Ha!

1229|b02b9fad.name: Granis Swiftaxe
1229|b02b9fad.text: The big wars might be over, for now, but we still have to keep our skills sharp!

1231|117e1541.name: Grif Wildheart
1231|117e1541.text: Before beginning a hunt, it is wise to ask someone what you are looking for before you begin looking for it.

1232|2583dfa7.name: Azar Stronghammer
1232|2583dfa7.text: The Light be with ya, $c. How can I help ya?

1232|455b81f2.name: Azar Stronghammer
1232|455b81f2.text: Ya may not follow the ways of the Light like a Knight of the Silver Hand, but ya can always ask us for aid.

1234|22acfbcb.name: Hogral Bakkan
1234|22acfbcb.text: What brings you to this part of the world, $N?

1234|ea9bf72c.name: Hogral Bakkan
1234|ea9bf72c.text: Can't help ya, $N. I only train rogues.

1239|c86281a7.name: First Mate Fitzsimmons
1239|c86281a7.text: If you're willing to endure tales that will shiver your timbers and sog your skivvies, then get yourself a drink and sit for a spell...

1241|4a926ca6.name: Tognus Flintfire
1241|4a926ca6.text: Good day to ye lad. Can I be of service?

1241|91b167bf.name: Tognus Flintfire
1241|91b167bf.text: Here for training eh? Just began my training meself, but I would be glad ta teach ye what I can.

1241|9a68c288.name: Tognus Flintfire
1241|9a68c288.text: Good day to ye lass. Can I be of service?

1244|245cbd71.name: Rethiel the Greenwarden
1244|245cbd71.text:
The roots and ferns speak well of you, small one. Although I have many names, I answer to few. But you may call me Rethiel.

And you must harken... for these lands weep from festered wounds, and I would charge you to heal them.

1244|e492be56.name: Rethiel the Greenwarden
1244|e492be56.text:
<Rethiel takes the Rotheap Innards from you.>

It is worse than I thought. The dark presence deep beneath us seethes with a malevolence that has seeped into the very fibers of life within the wetlands.

For now, I fear all we can do is combat its symptoms. Provide relief to the land and those who rely on it where we can.

Meanwhile, we must continue to look for the source. It roils... whispers just under the veil of the sounds of night.

Take this, as a token of my gratitude. May it help you further combat this madness.

1247|b63e4e81.name: Innkeeper Belm
1247|b63e4e81.text: Fill yer tankard and pull up a chair. We've stories to tell and kegs to empty.

1247|ed5e81b7.name: Innkeeper Belm
1247|ed5e81b7.text:
What can you do at an inn?

Well when you stay at an inn, you rest very comfortably.  Because of this, you will become "well rested" much more quickly than you would in the wilderness.  When you are well rested, you learn more from experience.

You may also speak with any innkeeper to get a hearthstone, and can later use the hearthstone in order to quickly return to that inn.

1252|83b3b21e.name: Senir Whitebeard
1252|83b3b21e.text: Greetings and salutations to you, good $r. P'rhaps you'd like to share a drink with me, help fight off the chill of the wind? Come, I've more than enough to share.

1253|a23f7e7e.name: Father Gavin
1253|a23f7e7e.text: Welcome, $c, to the Misty Pine. If you are weary from your travels, feel free to rest and warm yourself inside. And perhaps if you've some spare time, you could assist me in some tasks.

12577|c5ceacbe.name: Jarrodenus
12577|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

1257|ed056522.name: Keldric Boucher
1257|ed056522.text: Best deals in all of Stormwind my friend, won't find any better. Now, what can I help you with?

12616|c5ceacbe.name: Vhulgra
12616|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

1261|8ff1b0d7.name: Veron Amberstill
1261|8ff1b0d7.text: Ho, friend! I'd be happy to offer you a riding ram, but first you should train with Ultham over there. These stout beauties are not easily ridden, but once you know how to ride one you will not find a better companion.

12656|307aaccf.name: Thamarian
12656|307aaccf.text:
On the northern dock, you can board a ship that will carry you to Rut'theran Village and Darnassus. From the southern dock, you can find passage across the Great Sea to Menethil Harbor on Khaz Modan, and onwards to Southshore in Hillsbrad Foothills. If you head to the western dock, you can board a ship setting sail for Stormwind.

Safe journeys to you!

12657|6231de28.name: Don Pompa
12657|6231de28.text:
This dock here? Well, you can catch the ship that goes to Southshore, and then stops at that night elf place after. What's its name? Uhh... Auberdine, I think.

I don't really know for sure, I just load and unload stuff.

12657|fc20b897.name: Don Pompa
12657|fc20b897.text:
This dock here? Well, you can catch the ship that goes to Southshore, and then stops at that $r place after. What's its name? Uhh... Auberdine, I think.

I don't really know for sure, I just load and unload stuff.

12658|aaa34cd7.name: Adam Lind
12658|aaa34cd7.text: You can find passage to Theramore from this dock.  Heed my words, those lands are rarely safe to travel for people of the Alliance.  Watch your step and your back.

1265|a0959aba.name: Rudra Amberstill
1265|a0959aba.text: Welcome to the Amberstill Corral.  If you're interested in purchasing a mount, my husband Veron will be more than happy to help you choose just the right beast.  If you're looking for adventure, well we sure could use some help around here. . .

12696|1c7160cb.name: Senani Thunderheart
12696|1c7160cb.text:
The mightiest of all the beasts that make up the Ashenvale Hunt, Sharptalon is let to wander freely by the self-proclaimed guardians of this land, the night elves.  Sharptalon patrols for prey to the south of here, taking delight in rending the unsuspecting and unaware traveler limb from limb.

To bring down such a beast would be the mightiest of hauls, $N.  I wish you luck in the hunt for this creature!

12696|1ea95402.name: Senani Thunderheart
12696|1ea95402.text: This bear wanders a path close to where the Talondeep Path lies, due west of Mystral Lake and the Alliance outpost of Silverwind Refuge.  While he is the easiest of the three creatures you will face on the Ashenvale Hunt, he should not be trifled with.  His presence is a constant threat to travelers who sojourn between Ashenvale and the Stonetalon Mountains.

12696|7b9bcd54.name: Senani Thunderheart
12696|7b9bcd54.text: This nightsaber is rumored to be docile in the presence of night elves and their allies, which makes her an even more worthy opponent.  Shadumbra's hunting path takes her from the Raynewood Retreat to our west, ultimately to lands due west of there.  Her fur is the color of pitch, and her speed is not to be underestimated.

12696|f1d5ba87.name: Senani Thunderheart
12696|f1d5ba87.text: Do you hear the call of the hunt, $c?  You must listen closely, but the call comes from deep within you.  It comes from deep within all of us.

12716|2ba45c06.name: Decedra Willham
12716|2ba45c06.text: I do so enjoy sitting out here, listening to the sounds of the Great Sea.  Oh, what?  Yes, there is a ship that will take you to Menethil Harbor.  It docks here from time to time.

12724|39b67c2e.name: Pixel
12724|39b67c2e.text: This forest can be confusing! Be careful out there.

12736|e3f9a765.name: Je'neu Sancrea
12736|e3f9a765.text: The elements speak to us, $c.  They share knowledge that we must learn, and they share secrets that must be kept.

12737|65e006ab.name: Mastok Wrilehiss
12737|65e006ab.text:
If you want to know about the comings and goings of caravans and merchants here in Splintertree Post, then I am fortunately the orc you are looking for.  Unfortunately for you though, I don't like people.

If you want something, make it quick.

12737|aa838c4f.name: Mastok Wrilehiss
12737|aa838c4f.text:
If you want to know about the comings and goings of caravans and merchants here in Splintertree Post, then I am fortunately the orc you are looking for.  Unfortunately for you though, I don't like people.

If you want something, make it quick.

12757|9b4e17a6.name: Karang Amakkar
12757|9b4e17a6.text: Greeting $c - welcome to the front lines in our conquest of Ashenvale!  If you are looking for something to do, then you've come to the right place.  I'm always looking for able-bodied individuals to help bring glory to the Horde!

1275|ed056522.name: Kyra Boucher
1275|ed056522.text: Best deals in all of Stormwind my friend, won't find any better. Now, what can I help you with?

1275|fe52f4ea.name: Kyra Boucher
1275|fe52f4ea.text: Just browsing my wares or is there something specific I can help you find today?

1285|ed056522.name: Thurman Mullby
1285|ed056522.text: Best deals in all of Stormwind my friend, won't find any better. Now, what can I help you with?

1285|fe52f4ea.name: Thurman Mullby
1285|fe52f4ea.text: Just browsing my wares or is there something specific I can help you find today?

1286|ed056522.name: Edna Mullby
1286|ed056522.text: Best deals in all of Stormwind my friend, won't find any better. Now, what can I help you with?

1286|fe52f4ea.name: Edna Mullby
1286|fe52f4ea.text: Just browsing my wares or is there something specific I can help you find today?

1287|ed056522.name: Marda Weller
1287|ed056522.text: Best deals in all of Stormwind my friend, won't find any better. Now, what can I help you with?

1287|fe52f4ea.name: Marda Weller
1287|fe52f4ea.text: Just browsing my wares or is there something specific I can help you find today?

1289|ed056522.name: Gunther Weller
1289|ed056522.text: Best deals in all of Stormwind my friend, won't find any better. Now, what can I help you with?

1289|fe52f4ea.name: Gunther Weller
1289|fe52f4ea.text: Just browsing my wares or is there something specific I can help you find today?

1292|aebd25b1.name: Maris Granger
1292|aebd25b1.text: Do I look like I have the time or energy to coddle every tourist that wanders through my door? Tell me what you need, and make it quick.

1292|ec1a6e0b.name: Maris Granger
1292|ec1a6e0b.text: I don't get too many Skinners in here looking for training, but I guess I could teach you something if you're ready.

1294|fe52f4ea.name: Aldric Moore
1294|fe52f4ea.text: Just browsing my wares or is there something specific I can help you find today?

1295|ed056522.name: Lara Moore
1295|ed056522.text: Best deals in all of Stormwind my friend, won't find any better. Now, what can I help you with?

1295|fe52f4ea.name: Lara Moore
1295|fe52f4ea.text: Just browsing my wares or is there something specific I can help you find today?

1297|ed056522.name: Lina Stover
1297|ed056522.text: Best deals in all of Stormwind my friend, won't find any better. Now, what can I help you with?

1297|fe52f4ea.name: Lina Stover
1297|fe52f4ea.text: Just browsing my wares or is there something specific I can help you find today?

1298|ed056522.name: Frederick Stover
1298|ed056522.text: Best deals in all of Stormwind my friend, won't find any better. Now, what can I help you with?

1298|fe52f4ea.name: Frederick Stover
1298|fe52f4ea.text: Just browsing my wares or is there something specific I can help you find today?

12997|6ce695f2.name: Monty
12997|6ce695f2.text: Monty be me name an' rats be me game.

1299|ed056522.name: Lisbeth Schneider
1299|ed056522.text: Best deals in all of Stormwind my friend, won't find any better. Now, what can I help you with?

1300|3142c9a2.name: Lawrence Schneider
1300|3142c9a2.text: Very well, let your journey of tailoring begin.

1300|d1216699.name: Lawrence Schneider
1300|d1216699.text: Life is like a carefully woven tapestry.

1300|e17121fb.name: Lawrence Schneider
1300|e17121fb.text: Hmm... the things you need to learn are a little above my head. Have a talk with Sellandus over at Larson's Clothiers just up the path to the right. He taught me everything I know!

13018|0a2f0661.name: Nipsy
13018|0a2f0661.text: You'll find no finer rat kabob this side of Khaz Modan!

13018|46e9a0d3.name: Nipsy
13018|46e9a0d3.text: You look like you could use some work, lady. You should board the tram and visit my brother, Monty, at the Ironforge Deeprun Tram depot. I'm sure he has something you could do.

1301|fe52f4ea.name: Julia Gallina
1301|fe52f4ea.text: Just browsing my wares or is there something specific I can help you find today?

1302|e86e31c2.name: Bernard Gump
1302|e86e31c2.text: We are the only supplier of healthy flowers in all of Stormwind. We provide beautiful blooms for any occasion.

1303|e86e31c2.name: Felicia Gump
1303|e86e31c2.text: We are the only supplier of healthy flowers in all of Stormwind. We provide beautiful blooms for any occasion.

1305|9f005af4.name: Jarel Moor
1305|9f005af4.text: Take my advice, don't sit close to the shadows.

1307|23d8b931.name: Charys Yserian
1307|23d8b931.text: I sell only the finest arcane gear, made by the crafters and mages here in the city of Stormwind.

13084|554a4659.name: Bixi Wobblebonk
13084|554a4659.text: Well hi there!  Are you here to learn the proper technique of a new weapon?

1308|23d8b931.name: Owen Vaughn
1308|23d8b931.text: I sell only the finest arcane gear, made by the crafters and mages here in the city of Stormwind.

1309|0624ab70.name: Wynne Larson
1309|0624ab70.text: Since the fall of Dalaran and the destruction of Quel'Thalas, wares of this sort have been hard to come by. But Lucan Cordell and some of our other Tradesman have been doing a fine job of filling our orders with quality merchandise.

1309|23d8b931.name: Wynne Larson
1309|23d8b931.text: I sell only the finest arcane gear, made by the crafters and mages here in the city of Stormwind.

1310|0624ab70.name: Evan Larson
1310|0624ab70.text: Since the fall of Dalaran and the destruction of Quel'Thalas, wares of this sort have been hard to come by. But Lucan Cordell and some of our other Tradesman have been doing a fine job of filling our orders with quality merchandise.

1312|0624ab70.text: Since the fall of Dalaran and the destruction of Quel'Thalas, wares of this sort have been hard to come by. But Lucan Cordell and some of our other Tradesman have been doing a fine job of filling our orders with quality merchandise.

1313|0624ab70.text: Since the fall of Dalaran and the destruction of Quel'Thalas, wares of this sort have been hard to come by. But Lucan Cordell and some of our other Tradesman have been doing a fine job of filling our orders with quality merchandise.

1313|23d8b931.text: I sell only the finest arcane gear, made by the crafters and mages here in the city of Stormwind.

1314|0624ab70.name: Duncan Cullen
1314|0624ab70.text: Since the fall of Dalaran and the destruction of Quel'Thalas, wares of this sort have been hard to come by. But Lucan Cordell and some of our other Tradesman have been doing a fine job of filling our orders with quality merchandise.

1314|23d8b931.name: Duncan Cullen
1314|23d8b931.text: I sell only the finest arcane gear, made by the crafters and mages here in the city of Stormwind.

1315|23d8b931.name: Allan Hafgan
1315|23d8b931.text: I sell only the finest arcane gear, made by the crafters and mages here in the city of Stormwind.

1317|c3ea1f53.name: Lucan Cordell
1317|c3ea1f53.text: You seem confident. Surely you wouldn't mind a test of your skills?

1317|f472d1d3.name: Lucan Cordell
1317|f472d1d3.text: A true professional know his limitations, and I'm not ashamed to admit that your skills exceed mine. I want you to pay a visit to Kitta Firewind at the Tower of Azora. She is well-renowned, and with good reason.

1317|fcbd9346.name: Lucan Cordell
1317|fcbd9346.text: You are not ready. Speak to Betty Quinn, she's standing by the stairs over there. Return to me when you have achieved a higher enlightenment.

1318|0624ab70.name: Jessara Cordell
1318|0624ab70.text: Since the fall of Dalaran and the destruction of Quel'Thalas, wares of this sort have been hard to come by. But Lucan Cordell and some of our other Tradesman have been doing a fine job of filling our orders with quality merchandise.

1318|23d8b931.name: Jessara Cordell
1318|23d8b931.text: I sell only the finest arcane gear, made by the crafters and mages here in the city of Stormwind.

1319|877c4b1d.name: Bryan Cross
1319|877c4b1d.text: I sell only the best gear, tested and true. And the prices are set, so if you want to haggle then go find a Goblin.

1320|877c4b1d.name: Seoman Griffith
1320|877c4b1d.text: I sell only the best gear, tested and true. And the prices are set, so if you want to haggle then go find a Goblin.

1321|877c4b1d.name: Alyssa Griffith
1321|877c4b1d.text: I sell only the best gear, tested and true. And the prices are set, so if you want to haggle then go find a Goblin.

1323|877c4b1d.name: Osric Strang
1323|877c4b1d.text: I sell only the best gear, tested and true. And the prices are set, so if you want to haggle then go find a Goblin.

1325|e69bef2b.name: Jasper Fel
1325|e69bef2b.text: Speak quietly and with great care, the wrong word in these parts could get your throat cut. Now, what is it you need from me?

1326|e69bef2b.name: Sloan McCoy
1326|e69bef2b.text: Speak quietly and with great care, the wrong word in these parts could get your throat cut. Now, what is it you need from me?

1327|a381f669.name: Reese Langston
1327|a381f669.text: Welcome to the Pig and Whistle! Grab a drink my friend and pull up a seat, the more the merrier!

13283|a0b51800.name: Lord Tony Romano
13283|a0b51800.text: You look like the type I should watch my coin purse around. Something I can help you with?

1339|877c4b1d.name: Mayda Thane
1339|877c4b1d.text: I sell only the best gear, tested and true. And the prices are set, so if you want to haggle then go find a Goblin.

1340|76d04af9.name: Mountaineer Kadrell
1340|76d04af9.text:
Welcome to Thelsamar, your home away from home in Loch Modan!

Thelsamar is a nice place, but it's not all beer and salted meat for those who answer the call to duty!  If you're willing to face danger in the name of the Alliance, then read the poster outside the Thelsamar branch of the Explorers' League.

1340|e3153a3c.name: Mountaineer Kadrell
1340|e3153a3c.text: Hello, $N.  Welcome to Thelsamar, and while you're here don't forget to visit our local brewery!

13417|1605f087.name: Sagorne Creststrider
13417|1605f087.text: The spirits have guided you to me. How may I be of service?

13417|996eca9b.name: Sagorne Creststrider
13417|996eca9b.text: May the spirits be with you.

1341|877c4b1d.name: Wilhelm Strang
1341|877c4b1d.text: I sell only the best gear, tested and true. And the prices are set, so if you want to haggle then go find a Goblin.

1343|5751dde2.name: Mountaineer Stormpike
1343|5751dde2.text:
Well, if it isn't a young, bristling $c, no doubt drawn here by talk of my exploits in fields of battle!

No time for stories now, for there are great, important deeds that need doing!  So if you're looking for glory, then luck shines on you today...

1346|29243a62.name: Georgio Bolero
1346|29243a62.text: You'll need more training before I can share my knowledge with you, I'm afraid.

1346|77289fa3.name: Georgio Bolero
1346|77289fa3.text: Yes, I've been running this shop for some time now. Business has been pretty good lately. A lot of new adventurers coming through...

1346|ddcdeb42.name: Georgio Bolero
1346|ddcdeb42.text: Good! I can tell that my efforts will not be wasted!

1347|0624ab70.name: Alexandra Bolero
1347|0624ab70.text: Since the fall of Dalaran and the destruction of Quel'Thalas, wares of this sort have been hard to come by. But Lucan Cordell and some of our other Tradesman have been doing a fine job of filling our orders with quality merchandise.

1347|23d8b931.name: Alexandra Bolero
1347|23d8b931.text: I sell only the finest arcane gear, made by the crafters and mages here in the city of Stormwind.

1351|a96dc031.name: Brother Cassius
1351|a96dc031.text: May the light guide your path and aid you in your journies. If you need any assistance browsing, I will be right over here.

1355|0c543544.name: Cook Ghilm
1355|0c543544.text: Cooking is a life long pursuit and I see we share the same passion!

1374|61386298.name: Rejold Barleybrew
1374|61386298.text:
Curse that Brewers' League!  They have access to all the best ingredients, while we're stuck here grubbing for grain and hops!

I really would like to give them some bitter tasting justice...

1377|900ed517.name: Pilot Stonegear
1377|900ed517.text: Driving a Steam Tank isn't for everyone.  It takes an iron grip and nerves of steel...lucky I have both!  How about you?  How's your mettle?  Want to prove it to me?

1382|48c1c064.name: Mudduk
1382|48c1c064.text: Wulan in Shadowprey Village can sell you the "Expert Cookbook".  You will need that if you are to better yourself.

1383|2f7a1f8e.name: Snarl
1383|2f7a1f8e.text: Come to me again with such pathetic work and I will send you home in a small iron box that I tempered in goat urine. Now go see that idiot Ug'thok, he is better suited to your needs.

1383|38a0c930.name: Snarl
1383|38a0c930.text: There is nothing more that I can teach - now get out! And don't even think of approaching Saru, for one as unworthy as you he will use your blood to temper his steel.

1383|da72a588.name: Snarl
1383|da72a588.text: So you think you are good enough to learn from me? The great Snarl? You are no more than a lowly worm beneath my boot. However, taking on an underling might make me seem more appealing to Sumi and Tumi. Let's see what meager skills you possess.

1387|c5ceacbe.name: Thysta
1387|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

1416|c14f3f06.name: Grimand Elmore
1416|c14f3f06.text:
If you've come looking for the finest craftsmanship on this or any other continent in the world, then you've come to the right place!

Grimand Elmore, at your service!

1423|47f10f16.name: Stormwind Guard
1423|47f10f16.text: Brother Wilhelm often trains with Lyria Du Lac out in back of the smithy in Goldshire.  You could probably learn a thing or two about being a paladin from him.

1423|4e49ac21.name: Stormwind Guard
1423|4e49ac21.text: There are quite a few trainers available in Elwynn.  Which one are you looking for?

1430|0c543544.name: Tomas
1430|0c543544.text: Cooking is a life long pursuit and I see we share the same passion!

1430|52392408.name: Tomas
1430|52392408.text: Seek out Shandrina in Silverwind Refuge.  She can sell you the "Expert Cookbook".

1430|b48f927f.name: Tomas
1430|b48f927f.text: I can teach you how to cook!

1432|e214cf62.name: Renato Gallina
1432|e214cf62.text: Hey, mister.  You look like a $C with discerning tastes in wine.  I have a favor to ask, and I think I can make you an offer you can't refuse...forget about it!

1432|f33fbaea.name: Renato Gallina
1432|f33fbaea.text: Hey, miss.  You look like a $C with discerning tastes in wine.  I have a favor to ask, and I think I can make you an offer you can't refuse...forget about it!

14392|9edd139f.name: Overlord Runthak
14392|9edd139f.text: I am he that carries out the Warchief's commands without question. I am Horde.

14450|d3e1a5a0.name: Orphan Matron Nightingale
14450|d3e1a5a0.text:
There are costs with war, $c... ones often overlooked.  Those costs are the orphans - children who have lost their parents to the far-too-numerous conflicts that rage across Azeroth.  Those children who have no one else to turn to often come here to live until they are old enough to fend for themselves.

One week out of the year during the Spring, the Alliance takes time to give something back to these innocents.  This time is called Children's Week.

14542|525ec464.name: Great White Kodo
14542|525ec464.text:
