Do you know who else deals only in absolutes? The Al'Aketh. 

I for one do not intend to let blind adherence to dangerous beliefs doom our people. If it weren't for the threat of the cult, I'd march our mages over to the other side of Valanaar and wipe the Windshapers out.

252476|fcd03afb.name: Talaanis Shadowsong
252476|fcd03afb.text: It is vital that we learn more about what the cult is planning, and with the turncoat dead, the information may have died with him...

252477|08807185.name: Peacekeeper Elite
252477|08807185.text: The bank and auction house can be found on the western side of Valanaar, near the Windshapers' skycutter dock.

252477|37e215b2.name: Peacekeeper Elite
252477|37e215b2.text: Which class trainer are you looking for?

252477|456d7a09.name: Peacekeeper Elite
252477|456d7a09.text: The Windshapers' transport to Azeroth can be found at the western-most dock along Valanaar's southern edge.

252477|7fc1d917.name: Peacekeeper Elite
252477|7fc1d917.text: May I help you locate something, citizen?

252477|80396915.name: Peacekeeper Elite
252477|80396915.text: That trainer can be found in a house near the High Order dock, on the southeastern edge of town.

252477|8b1fd97e.name: Peacekeeper Elite
252477|8b1fd97e.text: What are you looking for, citizen?

252477|aa6ba0a9.name: Peacekeeper Elite
252477|aa6ba0a9.text: Is there something I can help you find?

252477|db018659.name: Peacekeeper Elite
252477|db018659.text: The town medic can be found inside the tower on the northeast edge of Valanaar.

252477|ff26e6d3.name: Peacekeeper Elite
252477|ff26e6d3.text: The $c trainer can be found over in the High Order's lodge, on the southeastern edge of town.

252478|1e95a038.name: Xy'aaria Streamrunner
252478|1e95a038.text: The skycutters and ferries haven't run in years at this point. For all we know, there are no other islands left for us to get imports from. Still though, I'm here... just in case.

252479|1a6886aa.name: Daeann Steelwind
252479|1a6886aa.text: Ah, hello. You look as though you have a question for me.

252479|35e66cbc.name: Daeann Steelwind
252479|35e66cbc.text: Y gol valesh dyrstigost dana E me, rogesh lon nuff. Skilde Ruff lars an lo ras lars valesh E vohl lars. Ras valesh ve majis nuff Rothas Gloinador. Lo valesh gol barad ras ruff, noth far.

252479|8622dd6f.name: Daeann Steelwind
252479|8622dd6f.text: You're not bad, but let me show you a few tricks you might find handy.

252479|a7a421b8.name: Daeann Steelwind
252479|a7a421b8.text: A far better blacksmith than I am, that's for sure. Though I'll deny it if you tell anyone I said that. You should go speak with Therum Deepforge. If anyone can teach you more, it's him.

252479|c65683ed.name: Daeann Steelwind
252479|c65683ed.text: Winds tidings. What can I help you with?

252479|d62b45b0.name: Daeann Steelwind
252479|d62b45b0.text: Gales greetings, friend. Is there something I can help you with?

252479|fb513610.name: Daeann Steelwind
252479|fb513610.text: I hope that your interruption is for a good cause, I was in the middle of some important work.

252800|d1a22753.name: Aamelia Windfield
252800|d1a22753.text: Thank you for your help. Make sure you let my husband know that the farm is safe.

252800|d3392a1d.name: Aamelia Windfield
252800|d3392a1d.text: The Windfield Orchard has seen better days...

253002|47b188db.name: Fillion Flamebreeze
253002|47b188db.text: <The Skyborne lying before you is unconscious.>

253004|1a6886aa.name: Iaadaria Bitterwind
253004|1a6886aa.text: Ah, hello. You look as though you have a question for me.

253004|a3b7de8e.name: Iaadaria Bitterwind
253004|a3b7de8e.text: Another Alchemist, hmm. I doubt your skill is as great as my own so perhaps I can train you in a few proper techniques.

253004|c65683ed.name: Iaadaria Bitterwind
253004|c65683ed.text: Winds tidings. What can I help you with?

253004|d62b45b0.name: Iaadaria Bitterwind
253004|d62b45b0.text: Gales greetings, friend. Is there something I can help you with?

253004|fb513610.name: Iaadaria Bitterwind
253004|fb513610.text: I hope that your interruption is for a good cause. I was in the middle of some important work.

253066|02560e06.name: Umarak
253066|02560e06.text:
An outsider approaches me?

I doubt we have much to discuss, unless you are here to aid an old Kolkar.

253092|e0247c5d.name: Alba Fairmoon
253092|e0247c5d.text:
I am told the farms of Westfall once supplied a bounty of crops for Stormwind. But now, the soil is barren and most of the farmers have fled.

On behalf of Darnassus I would like to offer my aid in replenishing this land. Will you assist me?

253136|4b1452fc.name: Orgrul
253136|4b1452fc.text: Why do you approach me, outsider?

253372|4b6a69db.name: Dead Cultist
253372|4b6a69db.text: <This cultist is dead. Upon close inspection, you notice that he seems to be clutching something to his chest, almost as if he was protecting it.>

253474|00bdfcec.name: Peacekeeper
253474|00bdfcec.text: That trainer can be found on the southeastern edge of town, near the High Order's dock.

253474|08807185.name: Peacekeeper
253474|08807185.text: The bank and auction house can be found on the western side of Valanaar, near the Windshapers' skycutter dock.

253474|0eb9c156.name: Peacekeeper
253474|0eb9c156.text: The High Order's transport to Azeroth can be found at the furthest dock on the southeastern edge of Valanaar.

253474|28030f47.name: Peacekeeper
253474|28030f47.text: You can find the cooking trainer in a small house on the north end of town.

253474|37e215b2.name: Peacekeeper
253474|37e215b2.text: Which class trainer are you looking for?

253474|404ff1f4.name: Peacekeeper
253474|404ff1f4.text: That trainer can be found in the Crafter's Hall, on the west side of Valanaar.

253474|456d7a09.name: Peacekeeper
253474|456d7a09.text: The Windshapers' transport to Azeroth can be found at the western-most dock along Valanaar's southern edge.

253474|4d63cc9b.name: Peacekeeper
253474|4d63cc9b.text: You'll want to head over to the Hall of Arms on the north side of Valanaar.

253474|7fc1d917.name: Peacekeeper
253474|7fc1d917.text: May I help you locate something, citizen?

253474|80396915.name: Peacekeeper
253474|80396915.text: That trainer can be found in a house near the High Order dock, on the southeastern edge of town.

253474|823817d9.name: Peacekeeper
253474|823817d9.text:
Engineer? What in Skywall is that?

Now that you mention it... I think I may have heard that drunk Sirrocas over at the inn talking about some sort of forest spirit that he claimed to have encountered that called itself an "engineer."

That was the first I'd ever heard of such a thing.

I believe he said that this particular spirit could be found somewhere in Shadowgale Forest, but I can't recommend you go to that cursed place!

253474|8957496f.name: Peacekeeper
253474|8957496f.text: Be on your guard here in the highlands, citizen. There are many dangers between the beasts roaming the wild, murderous bandits, and the looming threat of the Al'Aketh.

253474|8b1fd97e.name: Peacekeeper
253474|8b1fd97e.text: What are you looking for, citizen?

253474|96433e66.name: Peacekeeper
253474|96433e66.text: A mailbox can be located just outside of the Inn, near the road leading north out of town.

253474|9d79190e.name: Peacekeeper
253474|9d79190e.text: The Inn can be found on the east side of the road leading northward out of town.

253474|aa6ba0a9.name: Peacekeeper
253474|aa6ba0a9.text: Is there something I can help you find?

253474|ba9ef707.name: Peacekeeper
253474|ba9ef707.text: You'll find Lotheluum Starbreeze on a cliff overlooking the waterfall on the eastern edge of town.

253474|db018659.name: Peacekeeper
253474|db018659.text: The town medic can be found inside the tower on the northeast edge of Valanaar.

253474|e040148b.name: Peacekeeper
253474|e040148b.text: The $c trainer can be found near the Windshaper's standing stones, on the western edge of town.

253474|ff26e6d3.name: Peacekeeper
253474|ff26e6d3.text: The $c trainer can be found over in the High Order's lodge, on the southeastern edge of town.

253576|febbe4e4.name: Hyusaa Quickbreeze
253576|febbe4e4.text:
Most of the cultists at the Sanctum of Storms seem to have come out to respond to our attack. I never would have expected this to go so well. This was almost too easy...

I think that the Windshapers and High Order have made their push. Valennia should be with them. You should head inside and find her. We'll stay here and keep watch while Valennia and the others finish what they came here to do.

253590|2061ff16.name: Valennia Stormfist
253590|2061ff16.text: <Valennia is severely wounded and is barely holding on to consciousness.>

253847|6ace422f.name: Elaadrin Evengale
253847|6ace422f.text:
Lorthuna is performing some sort of ritual up there. She may be trying to bring down the wards!

The help we sent for has not yet arrived, but we'll just have to manage with what we have. When you are ready, let me know and we'll go confront her.

253849|6ace422f.name: Ayessa Dawnsinger
253849|6ace422f.text:
Lorthuna is performing some sort of ritual up there. She may be trying to bring down the wards!

The help we sent for has not yet arrived, but we'll just have to manage with what we have. When you are ready, let me know and we'll go confront her.

253|e8768bd6.name: William Pestle
253|e8768bd6.text: Aha!  Good day, good day, Master $C!  Come, sit down and have a drink.  You have an enterprising look in your eye, and I think you'll find speaking to me worth your time...

254081|86bf8d52.name: Naeluna Swiftmend
254081|86bf8d52.text: If you have the aptitude for the druidic arts, I can train you.

254082|70bfd38d.name: Aarnor Galestrike
254082|70bfd38d.text:
The spirits of the wind may have left us, but the power of the elements is not entirely out of reach for those with the patience to seek them out.

If you are initiated in the ways of the $c, I can help you grasp them.

254084|2becf397.name: Elayaa Easewind
254084|2becf397.text:
The hunters and rangers of Zephras have never been more needed. The winds grow ever harsher, and the magic that sustains our island is fading. The wilds have never been more wild and people like me are needed to keep our people safe.

If you have the proper aptitude as a $c, I can give you the tools to survive the wilds.

254086|ed4232c7.name: Shenaan Spellwind
254086|ed4232c7.text: The followers of the old Highborne ways have never been more hungry for knowledge and to reclaim what we've lost. If you would seek to wield the power of the arcane and have the aptitude, I can help you take your next steps.

254087|87ef59fc.name: Miriaan Mistblade
254087|87ef59fc.text:
Slay your enemies and swoon your paramours with this one weird trick.

If you follow the path of the rogue, I can teach you... for a cost, of course.

254087|a046a01a.name: Miriaan Mistblade
254087|a046a01a.text:
Slay your enemies and swoon your paramours with this one weird trick.

If you follow the path of the $c, I can teach you... for a cost, of course.

254088|caa7ddf7.name: Corsan Earthrazer
254088|caa7ddf7.text: The $c who flinches is the $c who dies. If you would look death in the face as a $c, I will teach you how not to flinch.

254088|fe3406a9.name: Corsan Earthrazer
254088|fe3406a9.text: The warrior who flinches is the warrior who dies. If you would look death in the face as a warrior, I will teach you how not to flinch.

254089|9cc50b7d.name: Coriella Calmbreeze
254089|9cc50b7d.text: Welcome to the Calmbreeze Inn, traveler. Would you like some refreshment?

254100|10e89f38.name: Zephras Citizen
254100|10e89f38.text: If the Al'Aketh cult isn't stopped soon, we'll all be press-ganged into joining those fanatics. I will NOT look good with a shaved head.

254100|157bb7b8.name: Zephras Citizen
254100|157bb7b8.text:
Have you seen them? The skycutters are running again! I've heard that we still have no contact with the other shen'dorei islands, though.

I hope we re-establish contact with Shen'dramar and Eldranaar soon... if they are even still out there.

254100|184ef800.name: Zephras Citizen
254100|184ef800.text:
Have you heard of what's become of Ban'aethal? The peacekeepers are warning people to stay away from the ruins and the Shadowgale Forest entirely.

I overheard someone at the inn talking about seeing malevolent wind spirits that seemed to be little more than a hazy outline, as if they were... hollowed out somehow.

Gives me the chills just thinking about such a thing.

254100|1ab538e5.name: Zephras Citizen
254100|1ab538e5.text:
The Al'Aketh cult is becoming a major problem and the peacekeepers seem powerless to stop them. We can only hope that the Windshapers and the High Order can put aside their bickering and work with the peacekeepers to protect us.

I certainly don't want to join a cult!

254100|609c70df.name: Zephras Citizen
254100|609c70df.text: The Windshapers and the High Order are up to something. There are rumors floating around that both groups plan to get the skycutters running again and use them to leave the Skywall. LEAVE SKYWALL? How ridiculous. Where would they even go?

254100|6be7d7dd.name: Zephras Citizen
254100|6be7d7dd.text:
The Al'Aketh cult claims that Al'Akir the "Windlord" will save us from our current woes here on Zephras. If Al'Akir is real and really is the ruler of Skywall, why did the wind spirits refuse to speak of him for so long?

Either he isn't real, or even worse, he's real and he's not as benevolent as the cult claims him to be. Either way, nothing about what the cult is doing is good for us normal folk.

254100|7446d030.name: Zephras Citizen
254100|7446d030.text:
I've seen the skycutters sailing through the sky more and more recently. It's good to know that they are running again. If only the elders would tell us what is going on. They only tell us that nothing has changed and we still have no contact with the other islands.

I can't help but wonder what this means...

254100|eae86ee8.name: Zephras Citizen
254100|eae86ee8.text:
Be wary of anyone you meet with grey robes and a shaved head. The Al'Aketh they call themselves, and they are a menace. 

I even heard that they've been doing things to the anchor pylons around the island.

If the Windshapers are to be believed, those pylons are the only thing keeping Zephras afloat here in the elemental plane. It would be madness to tamper with them!

254128|8cbd94ac.name: Wardrobe
254128|8cbd94ac.text: <The two cultists nearby are talking. You might be able to learn something if you hide behind this wardrobe and eavesdrop.>

254149|50d3b408.name: Sirocca "Swimmers" Starfeather
254149|50d3b408.text:
Shadowgale Forest!

It's haunted! Haunted as the sky is blue! Terrible forest spirits, terror birds with talons as big as yer arm! It's... a nightmare!

<Swimmers turns to Donaal and belches loudly.>

 IT'S NOT CRAZY TALK, DONAAL!

254149|f642f017.name: Sirocca "Swimmers" Starfeather
254149|f642f017.text:
<The $r before you sways unsteadily, clearly very inebriated.>

I used to be a sailor, you know? Before the trouble started. The skycutters used to run between the islands. Now it's unsafe or some such, or so they say.

I see the High Order and the Windshapers have their skycutters running again, but I'm stuck here, grounded!

What aren't we being told!

<He turns and yells loudly at the innkeeper.>

WHAT AREN'T WE BEING TOLD, DONAAL!?

254151|197a65c0.name: Vayn Moongaze
254151|197a65c0.text: The Nightclaw do not take kindly to reckless intruders. Tread carefully while in Shadowgale, $c.

254151|20a1483e.name: Vayn Moongaze
254151|20a1483e.text:
You've earned a degree of trust amongst the Nightclaw, $c. We don't have much to offer you as a reward, but we have managed to scavenge a number of crafting plans from the ruins of Ban'aethal.

The magesmiths of Ban'aethal were widely regarded to be the best artisans in all of the $R Isles. The Nightclaw are naturalists, not crafters, so these records are of little use to us.

Continue to prove yourself to be a valuable ally, and I would make these secrets available to you.

254345|1a6886aa.name: Syriel Nightrain
254345|1a6886aa.text: Ah, hello. You look as though you have a question for me.

254345|bb901712.name: Syriel Nightrain
254345|bb901712.text: Another Herbalist, hmm. I doubt your skill is as great as my own so perhaps I can train you in a few proper techniques.

254345|bedfc7be.name: Syriel Nightrain
254345|bedfc7be.text: Nostyec Regenthor, mod. E wirsh ador eynes re an tiras an lo vil va novaedi E gol melka ras re y bor rothas aelgestron.

254345|c65683ed.name: Syriel Nightrain
254345|c65683ed.text: Winds tidings. What can I help you with?

254345|fb513610.name: Syriel Nightrain
254345|fb513610.text: I hope that your interruption is for a good cause. I was in the middle of some important work.

2543|41cbc7e1.name: Archmage Ansirem Runeweaver
2543|41cbc7e1.text: Take care while in our city, $c. We are ever wary of strangers since the city was destroyed, and any untoward behavior while within this place will not be tolerated.

2543|912d8d1d.name: Archmage Ansirem Runeweaver
2543|912d8d1d.text:
As a member of the High Order of shen'dorei, you are most welcome here in our city, $c. 

Your leader, Elaadrin Evengale and I have had quite the correspondence these recent months. I feel that the Kirin Tor and the High Order are cut from the same cloth, always in search of answers to the greater mysteries of the world. Now more than ever, seeking said answers is vital to all of our survival.

Just as you have experienced an interruption in your way of life on Zephras, the flow of magic on Azeroth has been chaotic as well. Disturbed, somehow... as if a rock has been dropped into still water, causing ripples to surge across the surface.

Ah, but talk of such troubles can wait for another time. For now, welcome to Azeroth.

254411|0e051c59.name: Quel'dora Quickgale
254411|0e051c59.text: You've come for training in order to pass it on to your pets?

254411|4ef1d72e.name: Quel'dora Quickgale
254411|4ef1d72e.text: Ah friend, I only help hunters and their pets.

254411|d56cf43b.name: Quel'dora Quickgale
254411|d56cf43b.text:
You can't teach an old dog new tricks.  At least that's what someone once told me.  Lucky for you, I've discovered it to be untrue.

However, pets do tend to get resistant to the technique, and I need more food each time to keep them happy.  What that means is that you'll owe me more money the more times I untrain the same pet.

Now then, would you like me to start untraining?

255853|b64f61e0.name: Urs'endris
255853|b64f61e0.text: The spirit of strength does not always allude to physical strength. To face adversity both from within and without is what it means to take my shape.

255877|837eac47.name: Hunter Moore
255877|837eac47.text: You will need to find Nat Pagle in Dustwallow Marsh to get any better than you are currently.

255940|9cc50b7d.name: Donaal Downbreeze
255940|9cc50b7d.text: Welcome to the Calmbreeze Inn, traveler. Would you like some refreshment?

255993|91e62151.name: Grakna
255993|91e62151.text: As experienced as one might be, I urge you to travel with caution. These plains are home to ferocious beasts and others who seek to remove us from these lands. Even the skies have become too dangerous for our wyverns.

256076|f046599c.name: Damaged Construct
256076|f046599c.text: <A faint whirring sound can be heard coming from underneath the construct's metal armor plates. The wind powering this machine is present but is listless and only faintly churning. You don't need to know much about air constructs to know that this unit is clearly not in good repair.>

256083|35f76b60.name: Riaani Nightwind
256083|35f76b60.text: Have you found what we need yet?

256083|6571d699.name: Riaani Nightwind
256083|6571d699.text: <Riaani seems to be intently focused on his work on the wind construct.>

256247|c69f0372.name: Belathaan Brightwish
256247|c69f0372.text: What are you doing here? Quickly, leave this place now. You are going to ruin everything!

256252|6d79dea5.name: Whispering Winds
256252|6d79dea5.text: <The spinning column of wind before you seems to hum with contentment. It clearly cannot speak, but you have a clear sense of the sensations it feels. It seems... happy to provide you with the blessing of the winds.>

256306|909a42e8.name: Arcanist Laurain
256306|909a42e8.text:
Welcome to Dalaran, $c. 

Please pay no mind to some of the construction that is still underway. Oh, and should you encounter a rogue arcane anomaly, demon, or other malign entity, please feel free to seek the assistance from the nearest member of the Kirin Tor before fleeing--um... proceeding--to the nearest exit in an orderly fashion!

<Arcanist Laurain laughs nervously.>

Thank you for visiting!

256306|f652f067.name: Arcanist Laurain
256306|f652f067.text:
Welcome to Dalaran, $c. 

Please pay no mind to some of the construction that is still underway. Oh, and should you encounter a rogue arcane anomaly, demon, or other malign entity, please feel free to seek assistance from the nearest member of the Kirin Tor before fleeing--um... proceeding--to the nearest exit in an orderly fashion!

<Arcanist Laurain laughs nervously.>

Thank you for visiting!

256386|6a190ff9.name: Dokimi
256386|6a190ff9.text: We've had trouble with shipments going missing across Azeroth. If you find any, I'd appreciate if you could return them to me.

256388|13e9970d.name: Jornah
256388|13e9970d.text:
Greetings and well met, $N! Your arrival is timely, and we here at the Durotar Supply and Logistics company are always in need of new contractors.

If you are someone with a knack for gathering useful materials or the skills to craft something from scratch, you have a place here.

Please let me know if you have any questions.

256388|1ae640d8.name: Jornah
256388|1ae640d8.text:
I am glad you asked! We are far more than just a delivery service, $N. We employ and contract craftsmen across a variety of specialties and trades, and keep our ear to the ground for any new opportunities to keep their hands busy and goods flowing. We cannot possibly predict the emergent needs of any potential client, so we depend on their crafting orders to arrive to us.

You can imagine that this pipeline is... not as effective as we would hope. We encourage any crafters to satisfy these demands and deliver the goods directly to the customers, wherever they may be. Worry not, you will be fairly compensated for your troubles and earn respect among our organization.

256388|631ab615.name: Jornah
256388|631ab615.text:
Recently there has been a sharp rise in lost orders. We strive to ensure that each delivery is efficient and safe, but with a rise of bandits, rowdy creatures, and those damned Alliance, inevitably not every delivery goes according to plan.

Should you find these shipments, take a look over the label for what it should contain. It is not your responsibility to deal with our mistakes, but if you complete the shipment, you will be rewarded in kind. 

Dokimi over by the wagon can handle the logistics and your compensation. We will take it from there.

256388|6df3de7b.name: Jornah
256388|6df3de7b.text:
Yes! Well. Sort of.

Gold is the true universal currency, but we have our own system for trade amongst ourselves known as Merchant's Favor. It abstracts away the ever-fluctuating value of gold and silver, and ensures fair and equitable trade between members of the organization. It cannot be liquidated to gold, unless you're engaging in some shady activity, I suppose.

We still use gold for typical day-to-day needs such as materials needed for common crafts, but otherwise rely on Merchant's Favor for any kind of internal commerce.

If you assist us with recovering waylaid crates and ensuring swift fulfillment of craftsman's writs, you will earn plenty!

256390|6a190ff9.name: Marcy Baker
256390|6a190ff9.text: We've had trouble with shipments going missing across Azeroth. If you find any, I'd appreciate if you could return them to me.

256391|209fae46.name: Elaine Compton
256391|209fae46.text:
Not every order goes according to plan. While we strive to ensure that each delivery arrives intact and efficiently, a recent rise of beasts, bandits, and even Horde attacks, unfortunately cause some unavoidable loss of goods.

Should you find any lost shipments and are feeling particularly helpful, you can take a look over the label and identify its expected contents. It is not your responsibility to deal with our shortcomings of course, but if you completed the shipment, you will be rewarded in kind.

Ms. Baker near the crates will handle your compensation, and we will take care of the logistics from there.

256391|2130dab5.name: Elaine Compton
256391|2130dab5.text:
Not every order goes according to plan. While we strive to ensure that each delivery arrives intact and efficiently, a recent rise of beasts, bandits, and even Horde attacks, unfortunately causes some unavoidable loss of goods.

Should you find any lost shipments and are feeling particularly helpful, you can take a look over the label and identify its expected contents. It is not your responsibility to deal with our shortcomings of course, but if you complete the shipment, you will be rewarded in kind.

Ms. Baker near the crates will handle your compensation, and we will take care of the logistics from there.

256391|3090047f.name: Elaine Compton
256391|3090047f.text:
Oh goodness, you snuck up on me! Glad to see you, $N, the Azeroth Commerce Authority is always in need of new contractors.

If you are the sort to enjoy a stroll through the forest gathering useful materials or possess the skills to craft something from scratch, well, you have found yourself right at home!

Please let me know if you have any questions.

256391|4f7887c0.name: Elaine Compton
256391|4f7887c0.text:
Of course we trade in gold! It is a universal currency, after all.

However, we have our own system for exchanges made amongst ourselves. It is known as Merchant's Favor, and it effectively abstracts away the ever-fluctuating value of gold and silver. This ensures consistent, fair, and equitable trade between members of the Azeroth Commerce Authority. Before you ask, no, it cannot be liquidated into gold.

We still use gold for simple trades such as basic threads or alchemy vials, you know - everyday crafts. Otherwise we rely on Merchant's Favor.

The more you help with our lost shipments and influx of crafting orders, the more Favor you will earn!

256391|8595984c.name: Elaine Compton
256391|8595984c.text:
We have rapidly expanded our business in recent months, but we are still developing the means to ensure swift communication between clients across all corners of the world. As such, we have to keep our eyes out for opportunities to keep our craftsmen's hands busy. We depend on couriers or other brave souls to bring crafting orders directly to us.

You can probably imagine that business model brings about challenges. In the meantime, we strongly encourage our crafters to satisfy these orders and deliver the goods directly to the customers themselves, wherever they may currently be. Fret not friend, you will be fairly compensated for your troubles and earn our respect!

256514|4f344806.name: Contemplative Bandit
256514|4f344806.text: Anyway, I should probably get back to work. Speaking of, do you have any food or valuables that I could lift off of you? Maybe some windstones? Could always use more windstones?

256514|5198072d.name: Contemplative Bandit
256514|5198072d.text: Look around you. There's so much beauty here. The wind on your face, the blue skies overhead. It's so bright and alive, but yes, it's also quite dark. It feels like a prison. A prison where the guards have all left the prisoners in their cells to fend for themselves.

256514|6387fa8c.name: Contemplative Bandit
256514|6387fa8c.text: Just thinking. It's scary out here these days, you know? Any minute this section of the island could drop out from under me and I'd go tumbling... somewhere? Tell me, do you even know what happens to $r who fall off the island?

256514|64ae14a6.name: Contemplative Bandit
256514|64ae14a6.text: <A solitary bandit sits on the edge of the precipice, clearly deep in thought. If he notices you, he doesn't seem interested in attacking you.>

256514|8851d200.name: Contemplative Bandit
256514|8851d200.text: You don't look like much, but something tells me you are right. I think I'll just sit here a bit longer. Thanks for the chat, stranger.

256514|bde78361.name: Contemplative Bandit
256514|bde78361.text:
No one does. Because the only people who've done it have never come back. When the skycutters used to run between Valanaar and New Eldranaar or Shen'dramar, sometimes an accident or other misfortune would cause someone to go overboard. When it happened, they wouldn't even slow the ship down. No point.

For all we know, anyone who fell off is still out there... tumbling endlessly forever.

256635|824cc722.name: Peacekeeper
256635|824cc722.text: Adventurer! The wind bridge leading to the other spire is unstable. You may need to wait here with me until it returns.

256655|0c543544.name: Gorg
256655|0c543544.text: Cooking is a life long pursuit and I see we share the same passion!

256657|5ac8f650.name: Kreza Darkthorn
256657|5ac8f650.text: Orcs don't kill humans. Weapons do. And I make weapons.

256658|dab68b20.name: Gur'dok
256658|dab68b20.text: Crafting a battle-ready blade is the key to victory. I won't rest until I've mastered my craft.

256672|a1748e17.name: Kurvelk Shadowhoof
256672|a1748e17.text:
Ehh? You look a little too new to be doing business with me.

Come back once you're a bit more familiar with how they do things around here. Trust me.

256675|472c8799.name: Innkeeper Toka
256675|472c8799.text: You must be tired from your travels. Take rest while you can.

256675|4a0923b3.name: Innkeeper Toka
256675|4a0923b3.text: Are you interested in exploring one of these dungeons?

256675|886683cb.name: Innkeeper Toka
256675|886683cb.text: The old kingdom of Lordaeron is perilous. We urge caution for anyone who dares to venture into the now decaying lands of Tirisfal Glades. If you must, find the Undercity and the upper courtyards are what you seek.

256675|e0b9e88a.name: Innkeeper Toka
256675|e0b9e88a.text:
Our ancient lands in the north east of the Eastern Kingdom. Named after Lordain himself, it was once a proud and powerful kingdom. Its history is rich and serves as many lessons to upstart nobles and kings. One of its defining moments was assisting in the foundation of the Alliance that we know today.

Unfortunately its history is also dark, and its current inhabitants defile its lands day by day. There is still much of significance in the ruins that now rest above the Undercity but it is folly to attempt that journey and expect to return still among the living.

256729|06bc17cb.name: Nina Surefire
256729|06bc17cb.text:
I know what you're thinking, but don't worry, we keep our cooking and alchemy ingredients separate!

How can I help you?

256730|fb965f91.name: Stondry Darkhammer
256730|fb965f91.text: The ingots are for display only!

256732|9285f4a0.name: Alynsia
256732|9285f4a0.text: You look like you could use a few enchants. You have come to the right place!

256733|8265ab1b.name: Fritz Fizzle
256733|8265ab1b.text: Pleased to meet you! If you like to tinker, you have come to the right place!

256734|edaae191.name: Daniel Stitchsong
256734|edaae191.text: Hello there! I've got the finest leathers this side of Stormwind. Interested?

256735|8db10840.name: Mivin Shadowweave
256735|8db10840.text: <Mivin gestures toward his wares and back at you again with a smile, but says nothing.>

256742|424df33e.name: Dianne Softstep
256742|424df33e.text:
Ah, I am afraid you and I have no business at this time.

If you end up fulfilling some contracts with the trade authority, then perhaps we will have something to discuss later.

256930|341966bb.name: Captured Bandit
256930|341966bb.text:
Most of my outfit did. Displaced from the ground falling out from under our feet. Some came from other islands entirely. I came from the city of Shen'dramar, on the big island. Well, what used to be the big island, I suppose.

My family and I managed to get on one of the last skycutters out of there before the entire island broke apart. We thought that Zephras would save us. Well, it didn't. They are all long dead and now I'm here, awaiting execution.

256930|70ce7a83.name: Captured Bandit
256930|70ce7a83.text: Desperation? Hunger? I'm not exactly here doing this because I like robbing and murdering. I lost my home, had nowhere to go, and I don't much care to shave my head and worship some imaginary wind god, so I became a bandit. The rest is obvious.

256930|b893349b.name: Captured Bandit
256930|b893349b.text: Largely, yes. The thing we all have in common is that we have nowhere else to go and that we prefer thieving over enslaving ourselves to some insane cult.

256930|d07034d1.name: Captured Bandit
256930|d07034d1.text: Killed a peacekeeper and stole some windstones.

256930|dc9d79f6.name: Captured Bandit
256930|dc9d79f6.text: Why bother denying it, the constable already passed her judgement. No point lying.

257003|1a6886aa.name: Ishlee Breezewhisper
257003|1a6886aa.text: Ah, hello. You look as though you have a question for me.

257003|ec1a6e0b.name: Ishlee Breezewhisper
257003|ec1a6e0b.text: I don't get too many Skinners in here looking for training, but I guess I could teach you something if you're ready.

257003|fb513610.name: Ishlee Breezewhisper
257003|fb513610.text: I hope that your interruption is for a good cause, I was in the middle of some important work.

257004|1a6886aa.name: Eaysaa Brightgust
257004|1a6886aa.text: Ah, hello. You look as though you have a question for me.

257004|c65683ed.name: Eaysaa Brightgust
257004|c65683ed.text: Winds tidings. What can I help you with?

257004|d62b45b0.name: Eaysaa Brightgust
257004|d62b45b0.text: Gales greetings, friend. Is there something I can help you with?

257004|eb1639bf.name: Eaysaa Brightgust
257004|eb1639bf.text: Welcome to my shop; it's good to see another Enchanter here in Valanaar. Are you here for a lesson perhaps?

257004|fb513610.name: Eaysaa Brightgust
257004|fb513610.text: I hope that your interruption is for a good cause, I was in the middle of some important work.

257005|1a6886aa.name: Valiena Swiftgale
257005|1a6886aa.text: Ah, hello. You look as though you have a question for me.

257005|45c78ce3.name: Valiena Swiftgale
257005|45c78ce3.text: Nostyec Aetwinter, mod. E wirsh ador eynes re an tiras an lo vil va novaedi E gol melka ras re y bor rothas aelgestron.

257005|a3b7de8e.name: Valiena Swiftgale
257005|a3b7de8e.text: Another Alchemist, hmm. I doubt your skill is as great as my own so perhaps I can train you in a few proper techniques.

257005|c65683ed.name: Valiena Swiftgale
257005|c65683ed.text: Winds tidings. What can I help you with?

257005|d62b45b0.name: Valiena Swiftgale
257005|d62b45b0.text: Gales greetings, friend. Is there something I can help you with?

257005|fb513610.name: Valiena Swiftgale
257005|fb513610.text: I hope that your interruption is for a good cause. I was in the middle of some important work.

257006|53a09e6f.name: Nyalah Brightfire
257006|53a09e6f.text: Y garde bor hir uden algos me nuff nostyec lon aldonoth, far Y nagan Y borne eynes nud danagarde lo rothas melka.

257006|8cd6b7fd.name: Nyalah Brightfire
257006|8cd6b7fd.text: I don't get too many cooks in here looking for training, but I guess I could teach you something if you're ready.

257006|8fa53a5b.name: Nyalah Brightfire
257006|8fa53a5b.text:
Cooking on Zephras may seem difficult to the untrained eye, but I enjoy the creation of every dish. Even though our dwindling home is lacking many of our traditional kaldorei ingredients, it has been fun to create new variations of the recipes of our ancestors.

I hope that no matter where the winds take you, these recipes remind you of home.

257006|cc01e817.name: Nyalah Brightfire
257006|cc01e817.text: It appears the winds have brought you my way! I am happy to train you in the ways of cooking if you have the inclination to learn.

257006|d682c422.name: Nyalah Brightfire
257006|d682c422.text: E borne hir ash nuff garde re ruff vassild lon thorniss, far E regen E majis barad ras aetwinter lo ruftos ergin.

257007|1a6886aa.name: Melasa Fairmend
257007|1a6886aa.text: Ah, hello. You look as though you have a question for me.

257007|2957a3a0.name: Melasa Fairmend
257007|2957a3a0.text: Oh, a fellow Physician. I would be glad to teach you anything that would aid your journeys.

257007|5c5556b1.name: Melasa Fairmend
257007|5c5556b1.text: Va, y ealdor Gloinador. E majis ko dana ne barad ras thorniss lars majis gol ador endirvis.

257007|fb513610.name: Melasa Fairmend
257007|fb513610.text: I hope that your interruption is for a good cause, I was in the middle of some important work.

257008|1a6886aa.name: Baelann Swiftcurrent
257008|1a6886aa.text: Ah, hello. You look as though you have a question for me.

257008|2d37e4b8.name: Baelann Swiftcurrent
257008|2d37e4b8.text: Me, o ealdor Veldbarad. Bor nud faergas me thor se o daegil aldonoth? Majis Y gol nuff nud o algos se ash?

257008|358b7a1a.name: Baelann Swiftcurrent
257008|358b7a1a.text: Re, y ealdor Regenthor. Hir ras novaedi re uden va y vandar thorniss? Melka E gol ruff ras y garde va vil?

257008|c65683ed.name: Baelann Swiftcurrent
257008|c65683ed.text: Winds tidings. What can I help you with?

257008|d62b45b0.name: Baelann Swiftcurrent
257008|d62b45b0.text: Gales greetings, friend. Is there something I can help you with?

257008|e332eb6d.name: Baelann Swiftcurrent
257008|e332eb6d.text: Ah, a fellow Fisherman. Are you perhaps in need of a little training? Maybe I can show you a thing or two?

257008|fb513610.name: Baelann Swiftcurrent
257008|fb513610.text: I hope that your interruption is for a good cause, I was in the middle of some important work.

257018|1a6886aa.name: Naleeia Tattermend
257018|1a6886aa.text: Ah, hello. You look as though you have a question for me.

257018|2957a3a0.name: Naleeia Tattermend
257018|2957a3a0.text: Oh, a fellow Physician. I would be glad to teach you anything that would aid your journeys.

257018|5c5556b1.name: Naleeia Tattermend
257018|5c5556b1.text: Va, y ealdor Gloinador. E majis ko dana ne barad ras thorniss lars majis gol ador endirvis.

257019|45c78ce3.text: Nostyec Aetwinter, mod. E wirsh ador eynes re an tiras an lo vil va novaedi E gol melka ras re y bor rothas aelgestron.

257019|a3b7de8e.name: Nyassa Swiftdraught
257019|a3b7de8e.text: Another Alchemist, hmm. I doubt your skill is as great as my own so perhaps I can train you in a few proper techniques.

257019|c65683ed.name: Nyassa Swiftdraught
257019|c65683ed.text: Winds tidings. What can I help you with?

257019|fb513610.name: Nyassa Swiftdraught

257020|1a6886aa.name: Nasalanna Windsinger
257020|1a6886aa.text: Ah, hello. You look as though you have a question for me.

257020|7ce0aa5e.name: Nasalanna Windsinger
257020|7ce0aa5e.text: Welcome to my shop, it's good to see another Enchanter here in Shen'dar. Are you here for a lesson perhaps?

257020|d62b45b0.name: Nasalanna Windsinger
257020|d62b45b0.text: Gales greetings, friend. Is there something I can help you with?

257020|fb513610.name: Nasalanna Windsinger
257020|fb513610.text: I hope that your interruption is for a good cause$g ,:.; I was in the middle of some important work.

257021|bb901712.name: Halassa Fernbreeze
257021|bb901712.text: Another Herbalist, hmm. I doubt your skill is as great as my own so perhaps I can train you in a few proper techniques.

257021|bedfc7be.text: Nostyec Regenthor, mod. E wirsh ador eynes re an tiras an lo vil va novaedi E gol melka ras re y bor rothas aelgestron.

257021|c65683ed.name: Halassa Fernbreeze

257021|d62b45b0.name: Halassa Fernbreeze
257021|d62b45b0.text: Gales greetings, friend. Is there something I can help you with?

257021|fb513610.name: Halassa Fernbreeze
257021|fb513610.text: I hope that your interruption is for a good cause, I was in the middle of some important work.

257022|4fed1ed6.name: Messana Crestwind
257022|4fed1ed6.text:
You might think that just because we live on a floating island, there would be no need for miners like me. After so many thousands of years however, we still manage to dig up a lot of interesting things. 

It's almost like there's some invisible force, constantly creating new mineral deposits every so often. That's magic for you though, right?

Regardless, if you need training as a miner them I'm your shen'dorei.

257022|5c2244b7.name: Messana Crestwind
257022|5c2244b7.text:
You might think that just because we live on a floating island, there would be no need for miners like me. After so many thousands of years, however, we still manage to dig up a lot of interesting things.

It's almost like there's some invisible force, constantly creating new mineral deposits every so often. That's magic for you though, right?

Regardless, if you need training as a miner, then I'm your shen'dorei.

257024|c65683ed.name: Mendalass Tattermend
257024|c65683ed.text: Winds tidings. What can I help you with?

257024|d62b45b0.name: Mendalass Tattermend
257024|d62b45b0.text: Gales greetings, friend. Is there something I can help you with?

257024|ec1a6e0b.name: Mendalass Tattermend
257024|ec1a6e0b.text: I don't get too many Skinners in here looking for training, but I guess I could teach you something if you're ready.

257024|fb513610.name: Mendalass Tattermend
257024|fb513610.text: I hope that your interruption is for a good cause. I was in the middle of some important work.

257036|a6bb08a8.name: Baelann Favorbreeze
257036|a6bb08a8.text: Welcome to the Bank of Valanaar. We can secure your belongings and valuables here should you so desire. Do you wish to access your deposit box?

257065|819f44a1.name: Missionary Jasaan
257065|819f44a1.text: Do you seek the blessings of the Windlord?

257087|424bc3ca.name: Gretchen Mayberry
257087|424bc3ca.text: Need a lift? Our gryphons are always ready to take to the skies.

257446|1e35c538.name: Teo Hammerstorm
257446|1e35c538.text:
The stone an' soil speak truer than any tongue, if ye quiet the clatter in yer heart long enough to hear 'em. 

If ye've the makings of a $c, I'll teach ye.

257446|3123e450.name: Teo Hammerstorm
257446|3123e450.text:
The stone an' soil speak truer than any tongue, if ye quiet the clatter in yer heart long enough to hear 'em. 

If ye've the makings of a shaman, I'll teach ye.

257554|41088e5c.name: Halaan Hawk-Eye
257554|41088e5c.text: <The gaze of the ranger standing before you is fixed on the enormous anchor pylon in the distance.>

257558|f35dbc79.name: Demar Brant
257558|f35dbc79.text:
Ah, it's been some time since we've had adventurers roam these halls. Welcome to Farholde Keep. Enjoy these comforts while you can. I'm sure you've seen the conditions we're forced to keep.

It seems every day we lose more of our home to the ever-growing infestation of Horde mongrels and Light-forsaken Twilight's Hammer cultists. With those cowards in Stormwind hiding behind their walls, we are forced to bring order to these beasts ourselves.

Perhaps you'd like to put some of those $c talents to use?

257591|3e0f5f68.name: Ashe Amberhall
257591|3e0f5f68.text:
When these lands fell to the orcish Horde during the First War, the bulk of the Alliance military moved on to other concerns. They believed the land lost, and that the war efforts were better spent on the home front.

We agree. But the Riverglades are our home, $N. Without aid from the rest of the army, the cavalry men and women of Farholde mounted a bold campaign to retake our lands. Under the command of Demar, we know that someday these lands will belong to us once again. 

This is not just a battle for control, $N. This is a war for our birthright.

257591|a0cd4ece.name: Ashe Amberhall
257591|a0cd4ece.text: Greetings, $c. As advisor to Demar, I would be happy to answer any questions you have about Farholde Keep.

257595|4a0923b3.name: Barracks Master Harlan
257595|4a0923b3.text: Are you interested in exploring one of these dungeons?

257595|c80041d2.name: Barracks Master Harlan
257595|c80041d2.text: Welcome to my Inn, weary traveler. What can I do for you?

257597|32ab8342.name: Bruegs Kindleborn
257597|32ab8342.text: Out of the hottest fire comes the strongest steel.

257597|879e41ad.name: Bruegs Kindleborn
257597|879e41ad.text: To give light, one must burn.

257655|9f0fb116.name: Deathguard Billmuth
257655|9f0fb116.text: <Deathguard Billmuth absentmindedly fidgets as he looks around nervously. He is clearly very uncomfortable being here.>

257808|c24ef564.name: Braldir Ashmantle
257808|c24ef564.text: You have proven worthy of the sapta of fire and warrant the attention of the spirits. They will test you once you have sought them out. The only thing left for you to do is approach the mountain top.

257944|37940c1f.name: Elegael Thornpaw
257944|37940c1f.text: I cannot believe we were taken by surprise by the Al'Aketh. They have never been hostile to us before, but with their ambush they injured many of my kin. I swear I will get revenge for the fallen and wounded druids of my den. Mark my words, they will pay.

258043|c6710551.name: Norric Lochthane
258043|c6710551.text: Ye've come further than many, $N. Respect the elements around ye and ye shall fare far greater than most.

258098|1605f087.name: Eldrun Stormbreaker
258098|1605f087.text: The spirits have guided you to me. How may I be of service?

258098|8fca8484.name: Eldrun Stormbreaker
258098|8fca8484.text: If you desire, in addition to training, I have it within my power to erase the knowledge of your talents from your mind.  Be warned that every time you undergo this procedure the more difficult it is to perform, and therefore the more expensive it becomes.

258113|1605f087.name: Ingrid Dunwald
258113|1605f087.text: The spirits have guided you to me. How may I be of service?

258130|5a52f936.name: Jorel Windsinger
258130|5a52f936.text:
<Before you lies the corpse of Jorel Windsinger.

Deep lacerations are cut into his legs, and lightning burns scorch his fur.

It is clear he put up a fight before succumbing to his wounds.>

258130|c2f6629b.name: Jorel Windsinger
258130|c2f6629b.text:
<Before you lies the corpse Jorel Windsinger.

Deep lacerations are cut into his legs, and lightning burns scorch his fur.

It is clear he put up a fight before succombing to his wounds.>

258139|0e6687ea.name: Frothrik Saegrund
258139|0e6687ea.text: Water's gift is balance. It cools the burning, softens the hardened, quiets the rattling spirits. When ye can guide that balance in others... ye'll know yer on the true path.

258203|a955ba26.name: Hervdana Saegrund
258203|a955ba26.text: Welcome to our humble home. Rest by the fire if ye need to dry off.

258568|ed056522.name: Antonio Bolero
258568|ed056522.text: Best deals in all of Stormwind my friend, won't find any better. Now, what can I help you with?

258568|fe52f4ea.name: Antonio Bolero
258568|fe52f4ea.text: Just browsing my wares or is there something specific I can help you find today?

258572|cad23935.name: Dani'ill
258572|cad23935.text: Many of the supplies that tradesmen need can be found in the world. For those that cannot, I provide a limited selection for fair price.

258785|726390d0.name: High Priestess Mims
258785|726390d0.text: Surrender to the Light, $N. How can I help you serve today?

258785|8fca8484.name: High Priestess Mims
258785|8fca8484.text: If you desire, in addition to training, I have it within my power to erase the knowledge of your talents from your mind.  Be warned that every time you undergo this procedure the more difficult it is to perform, and therefore the more expensive it becomes.

258912|5774bb86.name: Elaren Stargrove
258912|5774bb86.text: You are welcome here in Moonglade. Take a seat beside me if you like, but please be mindful of the moonwater.

258930|0e051c59.name: Isaac Chan
258930|0e051c59.text: You've come for training in order to pass it on to your pets?

259012|517aef13.name: Ealaane Nimbuswalker
259012|517aef13.text: All of the $r islands became destabilized and began to move apart a few years ago. If that wasn't bad enough, now large pieces of Zephras are beginning to fall away. It's hard to imagine your home falling into the sky, but that is my reality now.

259013|6750d3f2.name: Resaan Nimbuswalker
259013|6750d3f2.text:
<Before you lies a $r; his body is mangled and bruised but still recognizable. It is clear he met a gruesome end while attempting to flee.

It appears that all of his belongings are still on his body, and a half-filled crate nearby lies spilled on the ground.>

259013|70e3f54c.name: Resaan Nimbuswalker
259013|70e3f54c.text:
<Before you lies an $r; his body is mangled and bruised but still recognizable. It is clear he met a gruesome end while attempting to flee.

It appears that all of his belongings are still on his body, and a half filled crate nearby lays spilled on the ground.>

259084|637067e7.name: Denaaris Stargale
259084|637067e7.text: Wind's greetings, friend. I've been authorized to offer fellow $R quick passage to the city of Stormwind. Please feel free to utilize this portal at your leisure.

259084|ca56b474.name: Denaaris Stargale
259084|ca56b474.text: Wind's greetings, friend. I've been authorized to offer fellow Skyborne quick passage to the city of Stormwind. Please feel free to utilize this portal at your leisure.

259118|b3bb7fbb.name: Muln Earthfury
259118|b3bb7fbb.text: I am Muln Earthfury of the Earthen Ring. What brings you before me today?

259585|f9b52015.name: Master Mycologist Shurome
259585|f9b52015.text: Interesting. I was just musing about how few distractions there are around here. $N, your timing is impeccable!

259620|334a03a9.name: Lumina Windsinger
259620|334a03a9.text:
When it was over I was stunned. He knew what would happen and he threw himself in front of that creature anyway to shield me.

We windshapers always pay our debts, and I owe him a debt. We've already avenged his death, but we can still avenge what was done to him by that monster, if you are still willing to lend me aid.

259620|5469c573.name: Lumina Windsinger
259620|5469c573.text: There are no words to describe what happened. Banon twisted and contorted horribly. It sounded like every bone in his body was breaking. His mouth filled with razors and his hands became deadly claws. It took twenty gnolls to fell him, and he killed half of them before it was done.

259620|a831a213.name: Lumina Windsinger
259620|a831a213.text:
As I said, the creature that attacked us fled when I singed its backside with lightning, but not before biting Banon. On our way back to town, the Gnolls surrounded us and took us captive. 

It wasn't until they started to pull us out of the boat on Fenris Isle that... the change started.

260080|5c5dcc2b.name: Ember Bladewhisper
260080|5c5dcc2b.text: Better to be prepared than to be dead.

260093|08830bac.name: Garen Largo
260093|08830bac.text: Through rigorous retraining I have had to break many students of all they had previously learned so that I might teach them anew.  The service I offer becomes increasingly difficult to perform each time it is done.  It is for that reason that it becomes increasingly expensive with each retraining.  Do you desire that I break you of the talents you have learned?

260093|58279558.name: Garen Largo
260093|58279558.text: Do you require training in the ways of the light?

260487|eebc7daf.name: Gritta Chumwater
260487|eebc7daf.text:
Hey hey hey! Watch where you're trackin' your shoes.

Tryin' to run a classy establishment here!

260558|837eac47.name: Krix
260558|837eac47.text: You will need to find Nat Pagle in Dustwallow Marsh to get any better than you are currently.

260562|54362962.name: Melbin Powderfuse
260562|54362962.text:
This town was a vacant lot before I showed up. Everything you see here was built by me. It belongs to ME!

Question is, what can YOU do for me?

260566|722af728.name: Fizzix Boomshot
260566|722af728.text: Ain't nothing ever gonna compare to the smell of freshly discharged gunpowder, friend.

260568|94d7fc8d.name: Jazzle Cheapshot
260568|94d7fc8d.text:
No fights goin' on today, pal. The Horde and the Alliance are too busy killin' each other out in the fields when there's perfectly good coin to be made doin' that in my arena! Go figure.

Come back when I get this place up and runnin'.

260628|e754d42e.name: Valennia Stormfist
260628|e754d42e.text:
<Valennia winces in pain as she shifts to look at you.>

Don't look at me like that. I'll be fine. Despite the best efforts of the High Elder's fretful healers, I'll be up and ready to fight again in no time.

Now be gone with you... don't let this old soldier hold you up. The winds will bring you good fortune on your journey, I know it.

261371|c0c247fc.name: Vrang Wildgore
261371|c0c247fc.text:
Those humans got what they deserved. 

<Vrang spits on the ground.>

261485|8137ab65.name: Theramore Guard
261485|8137ab65.text: <The Theramore Marine stands guard in stoic silence.>

261|04c00651.name: Guard Thomas
261|04c00651.text: Hello, citizen.  You look like a woman with a purpose - do you have business with the Stormwind Army?

261|a2b799cb.name: Guard Thomas
261|a2b799cb.text: Hello, citizen.  You look like a man with a purpose - do you have business with the Stormwind Army?

262492|ca9aee41.name: Rimblat Earthshatter
262492|ca9aee41.text:
I've been expec...

<Rimblat coughs.>

Excuse me, old habit. I am Rimblat of the Earthen Ring.

262502|3e8465bb.name: Brix Xizzix
262502|3e8465bb.text: When I heard that there was a whole new gaggle of elves literally fallin' from the sky, I said to myself "THAT'S where I need to be". A whole new society of impressionable, bright-eyed suckers... er--customers!

262502|a7fc18c4.name: Brix Xizzix
262502|a7fc18c4.text:
Another fresh face! Welcome to Azeroth, pal. Come back and see me if you need help setting yourself up for success.

Bring money.

262558|165bbe08.name: Palah Thunderhoof
262558|165bbe08.text: What has brought you to the Earthen Ring?

262558|996eca9b.name: Palah Thunderhoof
262558|996eca9b.text: May the spirits be with you.

262560|297f06b6.name: Hana Lighthoof
262560|297f06b6.text: Many serve the Earth Mother in different ways. The Earthen Ring and the Cenarion Circle share many similarities and are often aligned in goals, if not methods and customs.

263113|81449513.name: Myriaal Mistwake
263113|81449513.text: It can get boring up here, you know. I can only annoy that stuffy wretch Halaan so much before even that gets old.

263349|53fff4bc.name: James Battlewing
263349|53fff4bc.text: I am sorry, $c, but you are not experienced enough yet to enter Darkspear Islands.

263349|f9f7abf6.name: James Battlewing
263349|f9f7abf6.text: Greetings, $N.  Do you wish to enter a battle at Darkspear Islands?

263569|85179f46.name: Bryanna Embreeze
263569|85179f46.text: Greetings, traveler! I am Bryanna Embreeze. I am the main supplier for the Theramore Expeditionary Force. As you improve your standing with the Theramore Expeditionary Force, I can offer you an additional selection of goods that you can use inside Darkspear Islands.

263570|8ac1454b.name: Creeg Bothunk
263570|8ac1454b.text: Greetings, traveler! I am Creeg Bothunk, the main supplier for the Darkspear Raiders. As you improve your standing with the Darkspear Raiders, I will be able to provide a variety of goods that you can use inside Darkspear Islands. Should you find yourself in need of item repair, I also provide those services.

263570|954d4e6d.name: Creeg Bothunk
263570|954d4e6d.text: Greetings, traveler! I am Creeg Bothunk, the main supplier for the Darkspear Raiders.  As you improve your standing with the  Darkspear Raiders, I will be able to provide a selection of goods that you can use inside Darkspear Islands.  Should you find yourself in need of item repair, I also provide those services.

263643|f9f7abf6.name: Sean Guardoff
263643|f9f7abf6.text: Greetings, $N. Do you wish to enter a battle at Darkspear Islands?

263644|53fff4bc.name: Pherry Leftee
263644|53fff4bc.text: I am sorry, $c, but you are not experienced enough yet to enter Darkspear Islands.

263644|f9f7abf6.name: Pherry Leftee
263644|f9f7abf6.text: Greetings, $N.  Do you wish to enter a battle at Darkspear Islands?

263645|53fff4bc.name: Gruga Bloodblade
263645|53fff4bc.text: I am sorry, $c, but you are not experienced enough yet to enter Darkspear Islands.

263645|fb408f08.name: Gruga Bloodblade
263645|fb408f08.text: Well, well... are you ready to fight for the Horde in Darkspear Islands?

263646|53fff4bc.name: Rugbul Boomfirst
263646|53fff4bc.text: I am sorry, $c, but you are not experienced enough yet to enter Darkspear Islands.

263646|fb408f08.name: Rugbul Boomfirst
263646|fb408f08.text: Well, well...are you ready to fight for the Horde in Darkspear Islands?

263647|53fff4bc.name: Borook Gallfist
263647|53fff4bc.text: I am sorry, $c, but you are not experienced enough yet to enter Darkspear Islands.

263930|00bdfcec.name: Peacekeeper
263930|00bdfcec.text: That trainer can be found on the southeastern edge of town, near the High Order's dock.

263930|08807185.name: Peacekeeper
263930|08807185.text: The bank and auction house can be found on the western side of Valanaar, near the Windshapers' skycutter dock.

263930|7fc1d917.name: Peacekeeper
263930|7fc1d917.text: May I help you locate something, citizen?

263930|8b1fd97e.name: Peacekeeper
263930|8b1fd97e.text: What are you looking for, citizen?

263930|9d79190e.name: Peacekeeper
263930|9d79190e.text: The Inn can be found on the east side of the road leading northward out of town.

263930|aa6ba0a9.name: Peacekeeper
263930|aa6ba0a9.text: Is there something I can help you find?

263930|ca22bbdb.name: Peacekeeper
263930|ca22bbdb.text: The town medic can be found inside the tower on the northeast edge of town.

264078|adb68b1b.name: Sutara Plainstalker
264078|adb68b1b.text:
It is my honor to handle supply and provisioning for the Earthen Ring. 

My stock is limited at present, but check back with me often and I may have new equipment and supplies available for purchase.

264936|6ba63b30.name: Earthseer Farsen
264936|6ba63b30.text: On a clear day, you can even see Blackrock Mountain from here. It's both beautiful and terrifying at the same time.

264|b3b21323.name: Commander Althea Ebonlocke
264|b3b21323.text: At ease, $C.  If you are just passing though I suggest you stick to the roads and only travel by day. If your business is here in Darkshire, consider lending your abilities to The Night Watch.  Our skill is unquestionable but our numbers are small.

265654|32c7384b.name: Faladriaal Featherfall
265654|32c7384b.text: Welcome to the guild registrar of Valanaar. How may I assist you today?

265756|0cf2d0bd.name: Genn Fairweather
265756|0cf2d0bd.text:
Welcome to Fairweather Stables! I would love to provide you one of our fine galestriders, but it seems like you may not yet have enough experience to ride one.

They are temperamental at times and are prone to toss newer riders if not handled correctly. I would be more than happy to provide the training for you once you are a more seasoned adventurer and have enough coin!

265756|b66c2800.name: Genn Fairweather
265756|b66c2800.text: <The strider peers at you; its gaze is impatient and it almost seems to bounce with excitement.>

265756|eefee559.name: Genn Fairweather
265756|eefee559.text:
Welcome to Fairweather Stables! I would love to provide you with one of our fine galestriders, but it seems like you may not yet have enough experience to ride one.

They are temperamental at times and are prone to toss newer riders if not handled correctly. I would be more than happy to provide the training for you once you are a more seasoned adventurer and have enough coin!

265944|0c543544.name: William Pickman
265944|0c543544.text: Cooking is a life long pursuit and I see we share the same passion!

265944|b48f927f.name: William Pickman
265944|b48f927f.text: I can teach you how to cook!

265|94d9e780.name: Madame Eva
265|94d9e780.text: I have sensed your coming for quite some time, $N.  It was written in the pattern of the stars.

266484|e94c420f.name: Morbin Lightbane
266484|e94c420f.text:
We paladins must earn our place amongst our Forsaken kin each day, lest we be judged as fanatics like the Scarlet Crusade. The light is not simply a tool of our foes, but a conduit for our righteous fury! It is in our devotion to the Dark Lady and the love of our home that we may channel the light to bring justice to our enemies.

The Banshee Queen keeps a close eye on us. Let her. She will see that our resolve shall never waver. We are Forsaken!

266881|932ae4f0.name: Pa'zula
266881|932ae4f0.text: What business do you have in the Echo Isles, $c?

267007|31050836.name: Stormwind Harbor Guard
267007|31050836.text: Well, you can find Theridan or Maldryn by the moonwell in the Park.  Just head to the western area of Stormwind, north of the Mage District, but west of the Cathedral Square.

267007|37e215b2.name: Stormwind Harbor Guard
267007|37e215b2.text: Which class trainer are you looking for?

267007|7413cdc8.name: Stormwind Harbor Guard
267007|7413cdc8.text: All of a sudden you're a 'Defender of the Alliance' are you?! Well, I suppose you'll be wanting to head to the Champions' Hall now. It's over in Old Town, but they won't let you in unless you're an officer, so you might just have to settle for talking to Officer Areyn outside. Move along now.

267007|7d21b53a.name: Stormwind Harbor Guard
267007|7d21b53a.text:
You can find Stormwind Harbor if you head through the Canals, between the Cathedral District and the Park.

Were you looking for a specific destination?

267007|8e658029.name: Stormwind Harbor Guard
267007|8e658029.text: Shamanism? We don't do that here. Try Ironforge.

267007|94dfc58d.name: Stormwind Harbor Guard
267007|94dfc58d.text:
A $C is it?  Well, then you will want to speak with Thorfin Stoneshield over in the Dwarven District.  

Oh, and you be sure to tell him that if I step in his pet's business one more time, he's going to be training other hunters from behind bars in the Stockade!

267007|9c8811bb.name: Stormwind Harbor Guard
267007|9c8811bb.text: Thorfin Stoneshield came to us all the way from Ironforge to bring us his expertise in hunting.  If you don't mind breathing the smoke filled air of the Dwarven District then you'll find him at his house in the northeast area of the district.

267007|9e9bec9c.name: Stormwind Harbor Guard
267007|9e9bec9c.text: What do you need directions to?

267007|ac635421.name: Stormwind Harbor Guard
267007|ac635421.text: Master Woo Ping has mastered nearly every weapon known to man.  He is especially deadly with his sword techniques.  He spends a good deal of time over in the Weller's Arsenal waiting on new shipments of weapons to arrive if you need some training.

267007|d2caf5b2.name: Stormwind Harbor Guard
267007|d2caf5b2.text: You don't have the stomach for the gryphon ride, huh.  Well lucky for you, we have an alternative where you can keep your feet on the ground... more or less.  It's the gnomish mover of people, the Deeprun Tram.  Conveniently located in the back of the Dwarven District.

267007|dabedb39.name: Stormwind Harbor Guard
267007|dabedb39.text: Warlocks, eh.  Well, you didn't hear it from me, but I've heard rumors that those types gather at a bar called the Slaughtered Lamb in the Mage Quarter.

267007|deb32f0f.name: Stormwind Harbor Guard
267007|deb32f0f.text: That bum Leland... all he does is sit out on the dock outside the Trade District and fish all day.  I sure hope he's good at it for all the time he spends fishing.  If you want to learn, why don't you go talk to him?

267008|b4ea9d59.name: Leonid Barthalomew the Revered
267008|b4ea9d59.text: They named it Bandarion Keep. I wonder what Garek would make of that?

267009|6f316d7a.name: Hadric Harlson
267009|6f316d7a.text: Be careful, $c. There are cultists nearby.

267216|225cf7a5.name: White Riding Kodo
267216|225cf7a5.text: <This kodo watches you with sharp intelligent eyes.>

267226|9fad5d95.name: Grey Riding Kodo
267226|9fad5d95.text: <The kodo lets out a happy grunt as you approach.>

267227|67d5658a.name: Brown Riding Kodo
267227|67d5658a.text: <The kodo appears to be a bit nervous. It looks younger than the others.>

267279|466d697a.name: Cadoc Winterheart
267279|466d697a.text:
Professions are divided between two main categories: primary and secondary.

You are limited to a maximum of two primary professions at a time. You can abandon your skill in a primary profession at any time; however, the wealth of knowledge you gathered for it will be lost. If you choose to return to your original profession, you will need to train from the basics and seek out recipes you previously acquired to refamiliarize yourself with them.

Secondary professions do not have such a limit. These skills tend to err towards self-sufficiency with your basic survival needs. You are free to train any or all of these, but may find fewer opportunities to turn a profit.

267279|58cf691f.name: Cadoc Winterheart
267279|58cf691f.text:
I am glad you asked!

Professions are skills pertaining to crafting, gathering, and general survival. There are many to choose from, with each offering their own unique benefits and economic opportunities. Whether you seek wealth, an opportunity to stock your guild's warehouse with useful items, or simply enjoy the satisfaction of wearing equipment crafted by your own hand, there's a profession for that.

Crafting recipes can be learned from trainers, such as those around here, and numerous other sources across Azeroth. Once learned, you can craft as many of that item as you wish, provided you can acquire the necessary materials.

267279|83e0509a.name: Cadoc Winterheart
267279|83e0509a.text:
Hello, $N! Have you considered taking up a tradeskill?

I would be happy to answer any questions you might have, or point you toward the local trainers.

If this feels overwhelming, that's okay! You can always return here or visit trainers in capital cities to get started on your crafting journey at any time.

267279|b16c6ed9.name: Cadoc Winterheart
267279|b16c6ed9.text:

You are limited to a maximum of two primary professions at a time. You can abandon your skill in a primary profession at any time, however the wealth of knowledge you gathered for it will be lost. 267279|b3334d4d.name: Cadoc Winterheart
267279|b3334d4d.text:
Of course! Which profession would you like me to guide you towards?

I will mark your map with the location of a local trainer of your choice. Remember that you can visit trainers in capital cities for more thorough training.

267279|e9b56518.name: Cadoc Winterheart
267279|e9b56518.text: Great choice. I have marked that location on your map.

267306|b66c2800.text: <The strider peers at you; its gaze is impatient and it almost seems to bounce with excitement.>
