267324|d8b814ea.name: Margaret Weaver
267324|d8b814ea.text: Agol ne wirsh ver ne vandar novaedi veld algos nevren? Va se ras uden vrum bor garde?

267327|d8b814ea.name: Kagil
267327|d8b814ea.text: Agol ne wirsh ver ne vandar novaedi veld algos nevren? Va se ras uden vrum bor garde?

267328|3f01eec2.name: Norzsh
267328|3f01eec2.text: You think you got what it takes to mine ore?

267330|d8b814ea.name: Nawka Wildsong
267330|d8b814ea.text: Agol ne wirsh ver ne vandar novaedi veld algos nevren? Va se ras uden vrum bor garde?

267333|0371bf6f.name: Terunne Bearshaper
267333|0371bf6f.text: Care to learn how to gather leather from slain beasts? Or do you need some new tools?

267336|0371bf6f.name: Brighid Stormflayer
267336|0371bf6f.text: Care to learn how to gather leather from slain beasts? Or do you need some new tools?

267354|ac69d40c.name: Black Skeletal Horse
267354|ac69d40c.text: <It snaps its teeth together, chomping at its bit.>

267358|d73a6048.name: Blue Skeletal Horse
267358|d73a6048.text: <The fleshy ears perched atop its skull swivel slightly with atrophied muscles.>

267364|500f5208.name: Brown Skeletal Horse
267364|500f5208.text: <It paws at the ground with a chipped hoof.>

267475|6f681524.name: Gray Ram
267475|6f681524.text: <It gazes steadily at you for a long moment with a challenging snort.>

267674|1caffe50.name: Brown Horse
267674|1caffe50.text: <The horse paws at the ground with one hoof and watches you.>

267677|d741064d.name: Chestnut Mare
267677|d741064d.text: <The horse watches you calmly and swishes its long tail to shoo away some flies.>

267683|b4b21be5.name: Red Mechanostrider
267683|b4b21be5.text:
<The tag on the mechanostrider reads:

Crimson-Blastdasher XL 300. Now with extra terrain grips and a sleek new color!>

267684|e29d08b7.name: Green Mechanostrider
267684|e29d08b7.text:
<The tag on the mechanostrider reads:

Nitro-Green-Hyperlighter 2000, now with twice the bulb brightness and dynamic photo-sensors!>

267687|14707f63.name: Blue Mechanostrider
267687|14707f63.text:
<The tag on the mechanostrider reads:

Electric Blue Mecha-turbo Runner 5000, now with extra movement tracking and terrain damping for a smooth ride!>

267688|ad18a6ee.name: Unpainted Mechanostrider
267688|ad18a6ee.text:
<The tag on the mechanostrider reads:

The Chromo-Classic Mechanostrider! Now with hydraulic equilibrium enhancers and mithril tailpipe dampers.>

267806|6f7f9937.name: "Flipfin"
267806|6f7f9937.text:
Psst! Hey, you! Yeah, you! You caught one of those rare tournament fish, didn't you? Don't be shy, I can smell it from here!

Listen, I know what it's like to reel in your last line, thinking you're about to claim your prize... only to catch the most amazing, gorgeous, WORTHLESS lunker known to goblin kind! Yeah, been there, lost my shot at the title three weeks in a row to that! Learned pretty darn quick they taste better than the tastyfish, though.

Now, I just participate for fun. That means I've got a few tastyfish on hand... and I am willing to trade for the vastly superior rare fish.

Seems like a win-win for you, huh?

268047|53fff4bc.name: Theramore Emissary
268047|53fff4bc.text: I am sorry, $c, but you are not experienced enough yet to enter Darkspear Islands.

268047|c401ba80.name: Theramore Emissary
268047|c401ba80.text: $N, the Stormpike Guard is in need of your aid in the battle against the Frostwolf Clan in Alterac Valley, now more than ever.  The opportunities for honor and repute are greater than ever as well! Will you join the battle?

268048|53fff4bc.name: Darkspear Emissary
268048|53fff4bc.text: I am sorry, $c, but you are not experienced enough yet to enter Darkspear Islands.

268048|e1c9a6bd.name: Darkspear Emissary
268048|e1c9a6bd.text: Hail, $c.  There is a great need and even greater honor and renown to be had in Alterac Valley at this time. Will you join our fight against the Stormpike Guard?

268048|fb906211.name: Darkspear Emissary
268048|fb906211.text: $C, we could use more help out at Darkspear Islands against the Theramore Expeditionary Force. Are you willing to join in?

268511|ee845bad.name: Manifest Clerk Philmor
268511|ee845bad.text: Harbor work is open to everyone, but your personal safety is your own responsibility.

268568|f87f742d.name: Roy Lewells
268568|f87f742d.text: Literacy should be celebrated and shared.

268679|72aa6da2.name: Brazier of Eternal Flame
268679|72aa6da2.text: <The Braizer of Eternal Flame awaits your offering.>

268925|17da1992.name: Night Elf Courier
268925|17da1992.text: The night elf is motionless, with multiple wounds and discoloration emblematic of suffering from poison.

268|0fde333f.name: Sirra Von'Indi
268|0fde333f.text:
I don't currently know much more about the Valor family than what the book you brought me says.

Perhaps it could lend us some clues as to where we might look.

268|f1060a41.name: Sirra Von'Indi
268|f1060a41.text: Greetings, $c! I have but one goal: the cataloging and recording of all knowledge related to the history of Duskwood and Darkshire. Perhaps you could help me in my endeavor?

269152|3bad330d.name: Tylana Clawhoof
269152|3bad330d.text:
Greetings, $c. I am happy Anshe has guided you to me today. I would be proud to sell you one of our finest kodos once you have trained with Kar.

The kodo is a noble beast, but is prone to its own behaviors that make it different than most steeds. Once you learn from Kar you will have no issues traversing the world with one at your side.

269152|644ccfaa.name: Tylana Clawhoof
269152|644ccfaa.text: You are not known to my people.  A kodo is a mighty steed, and it is the product of love and care by my people; such is not given onto strangers.  Until the elders of Thunder Bluff consider you to be exalted, I cannot offer you the sale of a kodo.

269153|dab85bcc.name: Mountaineer Ylva
269153|dab85bcc.text: <The mountaineer clearly fought bravely before meeting her end at the weapons of the troggs.>

270459|35e7520b.name: Alfina Nightgaze
270459|35e7520b.text:
I was invited to visit Dalaran on behalf of the Cenarion Circle. I find this place equal parts wondrous... and unsettling.

As for you, young $C--If you have not yet done so, seek out Sheldras Moontree in Stormwind. He will teach you to reach the Cenarion Circle enclave at Moonglade.

270459|d7d8dd3e.name: Alfina Nightgaze
270459|d7d8dd3e.text: This city is a wondrous place, but I also find it unsettling. Concentrating as much magic in one place carries many dangers, as my own people well know.

2704|15da2919.name: Hanashi
2704|15da2919.text: Heya mon.  You come right place learn how ta wield a new weapon.

2704|f0975974.name: Hanashi
2704|f0975974.text:
Ansekhwa, da tauren weapon master, is on da Thunder Bluff lower rise.  He teach one and two-handed maces, staves and guns.

Archibald, da undead weapon master in da War Quarter of da Undercity, train good with crossbows, daggers, one and two-handed swords and polearms.

Sayoc, da ugly orc right here, can teach da ways of bows, daggers, fist weapons, one and two-handed axes and thrown weapons mon.

270513|e6b98502.name: Spellweaver Thaldris
270513|e6b98502.text:
Greetings, $c.

I can show you how to weave magic about yourself to change the appearance of your equipment, if you so desire. Do you wish to utilize my services?

270581|e6b98502.name: Fyrenz Vishonar
270581|e6b98502.text:
Greetings, $c.

I can show you how to weave magic about yourself to change the appearance of your equipment, if you so desire. Do you wish to utilize my services?

270582|e6b98502.name: Mon'ye
270582|e6b98502.text:
Greetings, $c.

I can show you how to weave magic about yourself to change the appearance of your equipment, if you so desire. Do you wish to utilize my services?

2705|e5331e82.name: Brewmeister Bilger
2705|e5331e82.text:
Brewmeister Bilger brews only the best brew!

Woohoo!

270637|3e0b4d08.name: Howin Kindfeather
270637|3e0b4d08.text: So many Wildhammer lives lost... whole families erased...

2706|368f0fed.name: Tor'gan
2706|368f0fed.text: Thanks to the Warchief, even here in the ruins of our former prison, some hope remains, and the Horde rises anew.

271465|92b9fbbb.name: Falfaan Halfwind
271465|92b9fbbb.text:
Greetings, $c. Are you in need of arms?

I was trained by Antarion of Ban'aethal, using secrets handed down from the ancient master magesmiths of Kalimdor.

You'll find no finer weapons on Zephras Isle than mine.

271546|7dbe534f.name: Mountaineer Gretchen
271546|7dbe534f.text:
Lookin' fer the courier? Just flew off like a wee bird.

Can't say I blame the poor sod. These wendigos are nasty business.

271613|0980e046.name: Unfinished Abomination
271613|0980e046.text: <The body looks incomplete and awaiting a head.>

271613|cd85d6bf.name: Unfinished Abomination
271613|cd85d6bf.text:
<Othmar's head looks at you from nearby.>

What... You... Want...

Filthy... $r...

271613|f87677dc.name: Unfinished Abomination
271613|f87677dc.text: <The body looks incomplete and appears to be awaiting a head.>

272045|5a3e1b84.name: Brother Zendraas
272045|5a3e1b84.text:
Why are you looking at me like that? Do you expect me to shoot bolts of lightning at you, or threaten you with the wrath of the Windlord?

It's fair enough if you do. However, not all of us are quite so... zealous.

272045|d5d1dc84.name: Brother Zendraas
272045|d5d1dc84.text:
Tailor, by trade. 

Here, stranger, I'll tell you what. Bring me any spare windstones you come across and I'll share my wares with you. I've got quite the stockpile of Al'Aketh garments here. Say what you will about the insanity of the cult, you've got to admit, they have some sense of style.

Or rather, I do, considering I designed most of their attire.

272045|fac7c2e1.name: Brother Zendraas
272045|fac7c2e1.text:
Not much story to tell. I lived in Falaath Village and when the cult moved in, I saw the winds turning. I shaved my head, donned the grey robes, and said the words they wanted to hear. 

Now I'm just trying to survive. Mostly I keep my head down and ply my trade for that crackpot, Lorthuna.

272101|aaa369e6.name: Deathguard Lizabetha
272101|aaa369e6.text: Our Alchemist's name is Carolai Anise.  You'll find her in a house at the northwest end of Brill.

272101|e7cb64ec.name: Deathguard Lizabetha
272101|e7cb64ec.text: There's a Bat Handler inside the Undercity.  Head south down the road out of Brill, then west at the T-intersection.  The Ruins of Lordaeron will be on your left.  Go into them and then down into the Undercity.  You can ask an Undercity Guardian there for further assistance.

272101|effe3a80.name: Deathguard Lizabetha
272101|effe3a80.text: What could you possibly need a bank for?  Very well, you'll need to go through the Ruins of Lordaeron to the south of Brill.  In the back are a set of elevators leading down into the Undercity.  When you get there stop any of those lumbering Abominations they like to call an Undercity Guardian and ask it for better directions.

272526|bf500b92.name: Glix Xizzix
272526|bf500b92.text:
Yes, I am the renowned trader who magnanimously fed the uh, starving... children...? ...of the Undercity during the recent war with the Scourge. Yes, I am the visionary businessgob and logistical genius who single-handedly armed the resistance and allowed our Dark Lady to found her nation of smelly corpses... um, I mean, "Forsaken."

Yep, I'm him. Glix Xizzix. I'd be happy to sign an autograph. For a small fee, of course.

What am I doing here running a barbershop, you ask? Well I got one word for you, bub--diversification. You've got to keep your revenue streams diversified!

272633|4a619efb.name: Nuara Tremorhoof
272633|4a619efb.text: The ebb and flow of magic has been disrupted, of late. I hear that even the mages of Dalaran are perplexed. Is this disturbance arcane in nature, or are the elements themselves in unrest?

272646|e1187d15.name: Miranda Turner
272646|e1187d15.text: Can I help you find something?

272|9722811b.name: Chef Grual
272|9722811b.text: Hello, hello!  Welcome to my kitchen, m'lady!  This is where all of the Scarlet Raven Tavern's finest delicacies are made.  Ah, just smell the wonderful aroma!

272|c8dcec52.name: Chef Grual
272|c8dcec52.text: Hello, hello!  Welcome to my kitchen, sir!  This is where all of the Scarlet Raven Tavern's finest delicacies are made.  Ah, just smell the wonderful aroma!

2733|10e876c3.name: Apothecary Jorell
2733|10e876c3.text:
Are you here to make a contribution to research? 

Do you have any limbs you're willing to part with?

273|1299e7cb.name: Tavernkeep Smitts
273|1299e7cb.text: Keep the door closed, $C.  Never know when the Dark Riders will be passing through again.

274757|21ab523d.name: Temple Highguard
274757|21ab523d.text: Here in Darnassus you will find skilled trainers who have perfected the skills of their chosen class through ages of training and dedication.  I will guide you to one who can become your mentor, you have but to name your chosen path.

274757|4979e51a.name: Temple Highguard
274757|4979e51a.text: Ever vigilant in their protection of the natural world, the druids are guided by Arch $C Fandral Staghelm who resides in the Cenarion Enclave.  You will find him and the other $C trainers in the northern section of Darnassus.

274757|a0975d94.name: Temple Highguard
274757|a0975d94.text: I received the majority of my weapons training from Ilyenia Moonfire in the Warrior's Terrace.  You would do well to seek her out if you desire to learn the use of a new weapon.

274757|ce424d00.name: Temple Highguard
274757|ce424d00.text: Of all the wondrous places within Darnassus, which would you have me direct you to?

274757|d3a25a4e.name: Temple Highguard
274757|d3a25a4e.text: Alegorn is a masterful chef who has had centuries with which to perfect his cooking.  You should consider yourself blessed should he decide to teach you.  If you believe you are worthy, you can find him in the Craftsmen's Terrace.

274757|e07232c6.name: Temple Highguard
274757|e07232c6.text: Here among the craftsmen of Darnassus, there is a millenium of knowledge for the benefit of your chosen craft.  Now tell me, which craft do you find the most intriguing?

274781|034389cd.name: Iron Kingsguard
274781|034389cd.text: Brandur Ironhammer would be the one ye'd want to see.  Ye can find him in the Hall of Mysteries north of the gates of Ironforge.

274781|1c500d9f.name: Iron Kingsguard
274781|1c500d9f.text: Skinning?  The only thing ye look like ye could skin is yer own knee!  Ha!  Now why don't you go see Balthus Stoneflayer so he can teach you how to properly skin some animals.  You'll find him in Finespindle's Leather Goods on the northern side of The Great Forge.

274781|21c84810.name: Iron Kingsguard
274781|21c84810.text: Where is the Auction House?  Why it's right by the gates of Ironforge as you enter our fine city.  Ye'll find it just across from The Vault.

274781|293fb776.name: Iron Kingsguard
274781|293fb776.text:
A $c, eh...  Well, if you've got a mind to be doing that sort of thing around here then ye best keep yer demons on a leash boyo.  I don't like demons, but I love putting mah axe to them.  Ye get me?  

Now you just leave me be and go get lost in The Forlorn Cavern.  That's where you'll find that $c, Thistleheart.

274781|329c6da9.name: Iron Kingsguard
274781|329c6da9.text: A valuable skill First Aid is.  Our resident trainer, Nissa Firestone, can show ye how it's done.  Look for her on the southern side of The Great Forge at the Ironforge Physician.

274781|3804779b.name: Iron Kingsguard
274781|3804779b.text: Which class trainer might ye be looking for?

274781|46dd318e.name: Iron Kingsguard
274781|46dd318e.text:
Do we have Mining trainers here?  Where do ye think ye are!?  

Why you'll find one o' the best miners in all Dun Morogh at the Deepmountain Mining Guild on the northern side of The Great Forge.  There, Geofram Bouldertoe will show ye the true art of mining.

274781|6e49a2d4.name: Iron Kingsguard
274781|6e49a2d4.text:
The Inn?  Ah, ye looking to toss back some of the best ales Ironforge has to offer?  The Stonefire Tavern is where ye'll want to go.  

Ye'll find it just to the left of the entrance to Ironforge if ye be coming, or to the right if ye be going.

274781|8f560eff.name: Iron Kingsguard
274781|8f560eff.text: Which profession trainer would ye be looking for?

274781|ab5dd850.name: Iron Kingsguard
274781|ab5dd850.text: Between Bixi and Buliwyf, there ain't many weapons they haven't had the pleasure of slashing or smashing an orc with.  You can find them hanging out at the Timberline Arms weapon shop if ye need some training.

274781|ac68ec99.name: Iron Kingsguard
274781|ac68ec99.text: Yer looking to learn how to use a new weapon are ye?  Well, ye should be talking to Bixi or Buliwyf over at the Timberline Arms weapon shop then lad.  They know their weapons from axes to... uh... zweihanders.

274781|ce6a7b9d.name: Iron Kingsguard
274781|ce6a7b9d.text: What do ye need directions to?

274781|e6c8b4c9.name: Iron Kingsguard
274781|e6c8b4c9.text: The seers of the old ways, aye I know 'em. The waters of The Forlorn Cavern are where ye can find Eldrun Stormbreaker, $C trainer fer the kin o' the elements.

274781|f3452b83.name: Iron Kingsguard
274781|f3452b83.text: Where better to look for a dark and brooding lot, than the dark section of Ironforge, aptly named The Forlorn Cavern.  Thistleheart is sure to be found there, likely summoning some manner of vile creature to do his bidding.

274942|7db6413a.name: Bob McNaught
274942|7db6413a.text: Used to have a shop in Strahnbrad. Good little place. Had customers. Had walls. Had a roof.

275210|9e7a54e0.name: Teller Rames
275210|9e7a54e0.text: I dreamed of joining the Kirin Tor ever since I was a little boy. But this is not what I had in mind!

275212|8443298b.name: Teller Hanners
275212|8443298b.text: I'm afraid we're not up and running just yet. Please do check back later!

275243|13191e97.name: Teller Gee
275243|13191e97.text: Apologies, madam. The bank isn't open yet. Please come back later, if you don't mind.

275243|a3886d45.name: Teller Gee
275243|a3886d45.text: Apologies, sir. The bank isn't open yet. Please come back later, if you don't mind.

275243|c50a1c3f.name: Teller Gee
275243|c50a1c3f.text: No matter how many times I tell them the bank isn't open yet, they continue to wait and complain. It's almost like that's what they came here to do.

275269|8059976c.name: High Order Dockmaster
275269|8059976c.text: The skycutter that arrives here will take you right to Dalaran City.

275269|d9943d35.name: High Order Dockmaster
275269|d9943d35.text: Board here for transport to Dalaran City, nestled in the Alterac Mountains.

275270|56f11671.name: Windshapers Dockmaster
275270|56f11671.text: This skycutter will take you right to the wondrous open plains of Mulgore.

275270|fb00a823.name: Windshapers Dockmaster
275270|fb00a823.text: All travelers bound for Mulgore should depart here.

275350|f33c9b0b.name: Timothy Jones
275350|f33c9b0b.text: Sorry, $c. I have nothing to teach you. I'm still learning myself!

275491|0edd6da8.name: Randal Emerson
275491|0edd6da8.text: Greetings, citizen. How may I help you today?

275491|9fd8120c.name: Randal Emerson
275491|9fd8120c.text:
Ah yes, he mentioned that an agent of the High Order would be arriving in Stormwind soon. He asked me to draft instructions for you.

<Randal hands you a neatly sealed note.>

This should give you all the information you need. You are in for quite the journey, $N. I wish you luck on behalf of Stormwind and the Alliance.

276067|2af62916.name: Angus Hammerhand
276067|2af62916.text:
It's my job to get the Paladins of Bandarion Keep set up with proper arms and armor. It's not much, but it's honest work.

I've got a thing or two for sale as well, should you need gear.

276110|2fc3ff64.name: Knight of Mourning
276110|2fc3ff64.text: My oath binds me to this place. What brings you here, to this light-forsaken place?

276170|e50e47b5.name: Belanaa Windveil
276170|e50e47b5.text: I am Belanaa Windveil and I am an agent of the High Order here on Azeroth. If you'd like to make a donation of cloth to our organization, we would be most grateful.

276171|1e85fa3a.name: Oura Stormspinner
276171|1e85fa3a.text: We shen'dorei have need of additional cloth to replenish our supplies. Any donations you make would be put to good use, and surely raise your esteem with the Windshapers.

276316|1b05d5c3.name: Raul Sweete
276316|1b05d5c3.text:
If ye want to see the elven port of Auberdine and all its mysterious mist, you've come to the right dock. If ye also want to see the beauty and glory of Menethil Harbor, even better--same ship'll take ye there, too!

It ain't a journey for the weak, but if you've got the spirit of adventure in yer gullet then yer in luck!

276316|2d041d67.name: Raul Sweete
276316|2d041d67.text:
Looking for adventure, are ye? Well, look no further!

This here dock serves the one an' only boat that'll take ye to the distant elven lands of Darkshore, and Menethil Harbor without even leaving yer stateroom! How's that for adventure?!

276318|6ecded70.name: Idrieth Mossgrove
276318|6ecded70.text: This dock connects Stormwind to the lands of the kaldorei via Auberdine, the port town of Darkshore. If you wish to travel there, the boat arrives frequently.

276318|71f5c09f.name: Idrieth Mossgrove
276318|71f5c09f.text: If you seek travel to Auberdine in Darkshore, you have come to the right place. Our people welcome any Alliance members who wish to trade, travel, or aid others in our lands.

276731|7627e1d7.name: Swift Mistsaber
276731|7627e1d7.text: <The great cat stretches its long nimble legs as you approach, making no sound with the motion.>

276732|f26348b8.name: Swift Frostsaber
276732|f26348b8.text: <The great cat lets out a small huff as you near it.>

276734|b56bba7c.name: Swift White Mechanostrider
276734|b56bba7c.text:
<The tag on the mechanostrider reads:

Mecha-Titanium Eco-strider 9000! Now with elongated wing shields and eco-friendly tailpipe dampers.>

276735|f9255134.name: Swift Yellow Mechanostrider
276735|f9255134.text:
<The tag on the mechanostrider reads:

H4z4rd Flashdasher 3X 4000. Now with new radiation sensors, and decontamination misters!>

276736|638ff7c2.name: Swift Green Mechanostrider
276736|638ff7c2.text:
<The tag on the mechanostrider reads:

Hyper-lite Veridian Fuseblazer 800, now faster and furiouser, with dynamic photo-sensors!>

276737|939f012f.name: Swift Gray Ram
276737|939f012f.text: <This ram watches you with interest before lowering its head.>

276779|e5b03b3b.name: Swift Brown Ram
276779|e5b03b3b.text: <The ram lets out a snort, its frosty breath visible in the chill Dun Morogh air.>

276785|f4872a90.name: Swift Brown Steed
276785|f4872a90.text: <The horse's ears swivel towards you and it looks alert.>

276786|8db232c3.name: Swift Palomino
276786|8db232c3.text: <The horse's calm demeanor and even-keeled temperament evident in its stance.>

276787|14e280f5.name: Swift White Steed
276787|14e280f5.text: <The steed eyes follow your movements from under its heavily armored helm.>

276793|157fd859.name: Ochre Skeletal Warhorse
276793|157fd859.text: <The $r warhorse cocks its head to the side, and chomps at its bridle as it regards you.>

276796|f52e5607.name: Green Skeletal Warhorse
276796|f52e5607.text: <The $r warhorse cranes it next in your direction to stare at you with two milky unblinking eyes.>

276797|866d28ab.name: Purple Skeletal Warhorse
276797|866d28ab.text: <The warhorse paws at the ground, causing the unholy flames around its chipped hoof to flicker with the motion.>

277024|589a8d2d.name: Jelinek Sharpshear
277024|589a8d2d.text:
Welcome, friend, to the barbershop! Come for a cut? A coloring? Something else, perhaps?

We can groom facial hair, perform piercings, ink night elf tattoos, anything you might need!

Have a seat and we'll get right to work. You're only moments away from a new, more attractive you...

277024|6f25fb7c.name: Jelinek Sharpshear
277024|6f25fb7c.text:
Welcome, friend, to the barbershop! Come for a cut? A coloring? Something else, perhaps?

We can groom facial hair, perform piercings, ink $r tattoos, anything you might need!

Have a seat and we'll get right to work. You're only moments away from a new, more attractive you...

277037|589a8d2d.name: Pella Brassbrush
277037|589a8d2d.text:
Welcome, friend, to the barbershop! Come for a cut? A coloring? Something else, perhaps?

We can groom facial hair, perform piercings, ink night elf tattoos, anything you might need!

Have a seat and we'll get right to work. You're only moments away from a new, more attractive you...

277042|589a8d2d.name: Bezza Shearshave
277042|589a8d2d.text:
Welcome, friend, to the barbershop! Come for a cut? A coloring? Something else, perhaps?

We can groom facial hair, perform piercings, ink night elf tattoos, anything you might need!

Have a seat and we'll get right to work. You're only moments away from a new, more attractive you...

277042|6f25fb7c.name: Bezza Shearshave
277042|6f25fb7c.text:
Welcome, friend, to the barbershop! Come for a cut? A coloring? Something else, perhaps?

We can groom facial hair, perform piercings, ink $r tattoos, anything you might need!

Have a seat and we'll get right to work. You're only moments away from a new, more attractive you...

277055|98eee030.name: Axle Smoothslice
277055|98eee030.text:
Welcome, friend, to the barbershop! Come for a cut? A coloring? Something else, perhaps?

We can groom facial hair, perform piercings, reshape tusks and horns, and even modify undead features!

Have a seat and we'll get right to work. You're only moments away from a new, more attractive you...

277|ed056522.name: Roberto Pupellyverbos
277|ed056522.text: Best deals in all of Stormwind my friend, won't find any better. Now, what can I help you with?

277|fe52f4ea.name: Roberto Pupellyverbos
277|fe52f4ea.text: Just browsing my wares or is there something specific I can help you find today?

2784|970770be.name: King Magni Bronzebeard
2784|970770be.text:
Ah, so you have. You are most welcome in Ironforge, $c. 

This city is the seat of the Bronzebeard Clan. We are an ancient and proud people and our craftsmen are second to none. You'll find no finer creations of metal or stonework than those of dwarven-make.

We are also amongst the boldest of explorers on Azeroth. If you have a taste for adventure, you will be in good company amongst our people.

Thank you for speaking with me, $N. Go now with the blessings of the Bronzebeard Clan. 

I wish you and your people well.

2784|a2f26445.name: King Magni Bronzebeard
2784|a2f26445.text:
Ah, so you have. You are most welcome in Ironforge, $c. 

This city is the seat of the Bronzebeard Clan. We are an ancient and proud people and our craftsmen are second to none. You'll find no finer creations of metal or stonework than dwarven-make.

We are also amongst boldest of explorers on Azeroth. If you have a taste for adventure, you will be in good company amongst our people.

Thank you for speaking with me, $N. Go now with the blessings of the Bronzebeard Clan. 

I wish you and your people well.

2786|c9907ea0.name: Gerrig Bonegrip
2786|c9907ea0.text:
Welcome to Bonegrip's Runes and Dooms, $c.  You may look, but do not touch.

Some of the knowledge here is not meant for the...uninitiated.

278|58ba323c.name: Sara Timberlain
278|58ba323c.text: Hello, good lady.  Have a seat, and a meal if you're hungry.  Don't fret if I look busy with my needlework - I'm listening to you...

278|a87776c0.name: Sara Timberlain
278|a87776c0.text: Hello, good sir.  Have a seat, and a meal if you're hungry.  Don't fret if I look busy with my needlework - I'm listening to you...

2798|43457c57.name: Pand Stonebinder
2798|43457c57.text: Balai Lok'Wein of Brackenwall Village in Dustwallow Marsh sells a manual that you will need to study in order to improve your skills!

2798|a28d29e1.name: Pand Stonebinder
2798|a28d29e1.text: I can train you in First Aid techniques.

2804|cda4c0c1.name: Kurden Bloodclaw
2804|cda4c0c1.text: Are you here to fight for us at Warsong Gulch?  Lok'tar Ogar $c!

2817|de8ac2c8.name: Rigglefuzz
2817|de8ac2c8.text:
You must be hard up to be wandering these Badlands, $c.  Hard up like me.

Or maybe you're here because you're crazy.  Crazy, like me.

2832|78a6229e.name: Nixxrax Fillamug
2832|78a6229e.text: First drink's on me! The coin to pay for it, that is. On my hand. From you.

2834|c2467ddc.name: Myizz Luckycatch
2834|c2467ddc.text: I can teach you fishing skills.

2835|c5ceacbe.name: Cedrik Prose
2835|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

2851|c5ceacbe.name: Urda
2851|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

2855|1c3f5d2d.name: Snang
2855|1c3f5d2d.text: We use many animal pelts and skins in our creations.

2855|774f3757.name: Snang
2855|774f3757.text: I will teach you what I can.

2857|31f4573e.name: Thund
2857|31f4573e.text: You know who's really smart? Nogg! Smarter than me, even. You go tell Nogg Thund sent you! You can find him by the control panel over there.

2857|6139c96a.name: Thund
2857|6139c96a.text: Who says Orcs aren't smart? It takes a lot of brains to be an engineer!

2857|829e343d.name: Thund
2857|829e343d.text: You think you're smart enough? You think you got what it takes? Let's find out!

2858|d37b59d0.name: Gringer
2858|d37b59d0.text: How may I be of service?

2859|2cc67a59.name: Gyll
2859|2cc67a59.text: Fastest gryphons this side of Aerie Peak. Want to take a ride?

2861|c5ceacbe.name: Gorrik
2861|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

2878|0e051c59.name: Peria Lamenur
2878|0e051c59.text: You've come for training in order to pass it on to your pets?

2878|4ef1d72e.name: Peria Lamenur
2878|4ef1d72e.text: Ah friend, I only help hunters and their pets.

2879|0e051c59.name: Karrina Mekenda
2879|0e051c59.text: You've come for training in order to pass it on to your pets?

288|07ae01e9.name: Jitters
288|07ae01e9.text: Huh?!?  Oh.  You don't look like a Defias thief...or a member of the Night Watch.  Take pity on a poor soul, will ya?

28989|0a03e13c.name: Aemara
28989|0a03e13c.text:
I'm hoping to open my very own shop soon! In the meantime, would you like to buy anything?

Every bit counts towards funding my dream!

29049|21fc3122.name: Arille Azuregaze
29049|21fc3122.text: You look like a $c who could use a drink and an ear.

2913|5112b624.name: Archaeologist Hollee
2913|5112b624.text: Who would have guessed the excavation would have uncovered such findings!

2913|fa848faf.name: Archaeologist Hollee
2913|fa848faf.text:
Oh, $N! It's you! I wasn't sure when you'd come back.

What did Tarrel say? Did he... say anything?

2916|427db4a9.name: Historian Karnik
2916|427db4a9.text: Welcome to the Explorer's League.  If you need information, and it is in book form, then I might be able to help you out.

2930|cd94cda6.name: Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea
2930|cd94cda6.text: Corruption sneaks into nature's grove.  The forest must be protected at all costs.

2934|2cd97b51.name: Keeper Bel'dugur
2934|2cd97b51.text: Knowledge is both tool and weapon to those with the will to use it.

294|3887a5a0.name: Marshal Haggard
294|3887a5a0.text: Hail, traveler.  My eyesight may be poor but I can sense the footsteps of a $c from a mile away.  For years I defended Stormwind with pride but once my eyes failed me, I was forced to retire.

295|c80041d2.name: Innkeeper Farley
295|c80041d2.text: Welcome to my Inn, weary traveler. What can I do for you?

2980|e775a01e.name: Grull Hawkwind
2980|e775a01e.text: Greetings, $N, and welcome to Camp Narache. News of your arrival spread quickly among the tribe.

2981|72360bcb.name: Chief Hawkwind
2981|72360bcb.text: Hail, $c. In my years I have seen many eager $r who wish to prove their worth to the tribe. It should not be forgotten that eagerness is no substitute for wisdom and experience.

2988|00c35128.name: Morin Cloudstalker
2988|00c35128.text: The Outrunners' duty is to ensure the safety of those who travel across the plains of Mulgore. Those that would threaten the safety of the $r homeland risk punishment at our hands.

2988|2e223ff7.name: Morin Cloudstalker
2988|2e223ff7.text: The Outrunners' duty is to ensure the safety of those who travel across the plains of Mulgore. Those that would threaten the safety of the tauren homeland risk punishment at our hands.

2993|f7a5deb4.name: Baine Bloodhoof
2993|f7a5deb4.text: The land has been good to our people, $c. We must be thankful for our good fortune.

2995|bfaf54b7.name: Tal
2995|bfaf54b7.text: When mounted on the back of a wind rider, one sees that its reputation for strength and speed is well earned.

2998|0b7fce91.name: Karn Stonehoof
2998|0b7fce91.text: You have the look of a woman who seeks knowledge. Perhaps you seek the teachings of the forge, and the hammer. Perhaps I can guide you down that path. But only once you have accepted the spirits, and listened to their calling.

2998|19ec09c0.name: Karn Stonehoof
2998|19ec09c0.text: Everything has a spirit, if you learn to listen to it you can get it to take any shape you want. Blacksmithing isn't about beating metal, forcing it to do your will. It's about listening to the spirit within the steel and guiding it to the shape you know it wants to take.

2998|d12d69b6.name: Karn Stonehoof
2998|d12d69b6.text: You have learned much, but I sense that there is more left for the spirits to teach you. I can place your foot on the path but cannot guide your steps. Go and find Saru Steelfury in Orgrimmar, the next stretch of your journey begins there.

2998|d71c40e9.name: Karn Stonehoof
2998|d71c40e9.text: You have great potential, but you must achieve understanding first, you must accept the spirits and listen to their calling. Only then will you be prepared for the path you must follow. Go speak with Thrag, I think perhaps you can learn a lot from one another.

3004|3236d362.name: Tepa
3004|3236d362.text: Aren't the patterns beautiful? Each one speaks with its own voice.

3004|a2273ec5.name: Tepa
3004|a2273ec5.text: My knowledge is limited, though I am still learning. It is time for you to move on, traveler. Find Josef Gregorian in Undercity and tell him you are ready.

3004|dfa12b04.name: Tepa
3004|dfa12b04.text: You are truly a determined student. I will be happy to provide you with instruction!

3007|501c3600.name: Una
3007|501c3600.text: Cairne has brought us to a land rich with possibilities for the future. We have been fortunate, and so in turn we pass on our good fortune to others. That is why I began teaching, $N.

3007|6f1fdfed.name: Una
3007|6f1fdfed.text: The needle is small, but the thread is strong, and the stitches are fine. Our pact with Thrall and the others will hold. The Horde will not be driven from these lands.

3007|b65785f5.name: Una
3007|b65785f5.text: It's been so long since I was a novice myself that I don't think I'd be the best teacher for you. Try talking to Tarn or Mak, right over there. One of them should be able to answer your questions.

3008|a1a91c02.name: Mak
3008|a1a91c02.text: Cairne himself lives here, they say. Once I have finished crafting a fitting gift, I will seek him out. Perhaps he will have words of wisdom for me.

3008|d055944a.name: Mak
3008|d055944a.text: Your talent is beyond my own, friend. Speak with Tarn here; his knowledge of leather is much greater than mine. I'm sure he would welcome another student.

3009|490d29e8.name: Bena Winterhoof
3009|490d29e8.text: Can you not sense the anguish of the Earth Mother for her lost children, the undead? Speak quickly, $N. Every second costs me dearly. We must help them find their way back to her!

3011|463ccfcd.name: Teg Dawnstrider
3011|463ccfcd.text: Enchanting has run in our family for generations. I learned at an early age, just as my son is doing now.

3011|dab22e8f.name: Teg Dawnstrider
3011|dab22e8f.text: I will teach you... soon. I require a demonstration of your loyalty, first.

3026|0c543544.name: Aska Mistrunner
3026|0c543544.text: Cooking is a life long pursuit and I see we share the same passion!

3026|3b48d638.name: Aska Mistrunner
3026|3b48d638.text: Dirge Quikcleave of Gadgetzan is a master of the culinary arts.  To better yourself you will need to seek him out.

3026|48c1c064.name: Aska Mistrunner
3026|48c1c064.text: Wulan in Shadowprey Village can sell you the "Expert Cookbook".  You will need that if you are to better yourself.

3028|c2467ddc.name: Kah Mistrunner
3028|c2467ddc.text: I can teach you fishing skills.

302|994abcf7.name: Blind Mary
302|994abcf7.text: The memory of my beauty makes its loss unbearable!

3030|1605f087.name: Siln Skychaser
3030|1605f087.text: The spirits have guided you to me. How may I be of service?

3030|8fca8484.name: Siln Skychaser
3030|8fca8484.text: If you desire, in addition to training, I have it within my power to erase the knowledge of your talents from your mind.  Be warned that every time you undergo this procedure the more difficult it is to perform, and therefore the more expensive it becomes.

3031|1605f087.name: Tigor Skychaser
3031|1605f087.text: The spirits have guided you to me. How may I be of service?

3033|8fca8484.name: Turak Runetotem
3033|8fca8484.text: If you desire, in addition to training, I have it within my power to erase the knowledge of your talents from your mind.  Be warned that every time you undergo this procedure the more difficult it is to perform, and therefore the more expensive it becomes.

3033|b554cff6.name: Turak Runetotem
3033|b554cff6.text:
Welcome, my brother.  If you are here to train, then I would be delighted to teach you.

It never hurts to reaffirm one's place within what I like to call the Great Balance.  As preservers of this balance, we must strive to continually keep our minds clear and our hearts strong.  Training helps us in this regard.

3033|febb65fa.name: Turak Runetotem
3033|febb65fa.text:
Welcome, my sister.  If you are here to train, then I would be delighted to teach you.

It never hurts to reaffirm one's place within what I like to call the Great Balance.  As preservers of this balance, we must strive to continually keep our minds clear and our hearts strong.  Training helps us in this regard.

3036|d1e27715.name: Kym Wildmane
3036|d1e27715.text: $N, how may I further your training in the eyes of the Earth Mother?

3039|43dfca45.name: Holt Thunderhorn
3039|43dfca45.text: Remember, all things are connected. If the beasts were gone from the land, our kind would die from a great loneliness of spirit, for whatever happens to the beasts also happens to the Tauren. Whatever befalls Azeroth befalls all those that inhabit it.

3040|3f898c12.name: Urek Thunderhorn
3040|3f898c12.text: Do you prefer guns or bows?

3042|4711dbab.name: Sark Ragetotem
3042|4711dbab.text: No matter how much one learns, there is always more to know.

3043|4711dbab.name: Ker Ragetotem
3043|4711dbab.text: No matter how much one learns, there is always more to know.

3045|8fca8484.name: Malakai Cross
3045|8fca8484.text: If you desire, in addition to training, I have it within my power to erase the knowledge of your talents from your mind.  Be warned that every time you undergo this procedure the more difficult it is to perform, and therefore the more expensive it becomes.

3048|544e5c2b.name: Ursyn Ghull
3048|544e5c2b.text: Well met, $c.  My advice to you is this: as you travel the world, be wary of magic for it will burn the untrained.

3049|8fca8484.name: Thurston Xane
3049|8fca8484.text: If you desire, in addition to training, I have it within my power to erase the knowledge of your talents from your mind.  Be warned that every time you undergo this procedure the more difficult it is to perform, and therefore the more expensive it becomes.

3049|a9a4b6a0.name: Thurston Xane
3049|a9a4b6a0.text: Greetings.  I'm an undead mage trainer, and you're a mage.

3050|57562eaa.name: Veren Tallstrider
3050|57562eaa.text: The tauren are sons and daughters of the Earthmother, and we show respect to all her children.  Even the beasts we slay are cherished, as their bodies give nourishment and their skins provide warmth.

3052|25d0fbd5.name: Skorn Whitecloud
3052|25d0fbd5.text: Come closer, young one.  In my time I could hear the flutter of a prey's beating heart, but now you must speak up if you want your words heard.

3057|114886ab.name: Cairne Bloodhoof
3057|114886ab.text:
Muln Earthfury has told me much of the Windshapers and I am proud to open the lands--and skies--of Mulgore to your people.

The Tauren and the $R are both children of this land. Kalimdor. 

I hope that your people are able to find what they are looking for here and that you are able to save your homeland. In the meantime, it is my hope that you are able to learn more of the land that your ancestors used to call home.

Please make yourself at home here in Thunder Bluff, and may the Earth Mother bless your journey.

3057|690a7170.name: Cairne Bloodhoof
3057|690a7170.text:
Greetings young one, and welcome to Thunder Bluff.  You'll find safe refuge from the burdens of the world here.  All denizens of the Horde are welcome here.

The spirits of the present and past come alive here in this sacred place, my friend.  Honor them, and in doing so honor yourself.

3059|4711dbab.name: Harutt Thunderhorn
3059|4711dbab.text: No matter how much one learns, there is always more to know.

3060|7b785024.name: Gart Mistrunner
3060|7b785024.text: Many are the paths of the Earth Mother.  May your ancestors watch over you $c.

3060|d1e27715.name: Gart Mistrunner
3060|d1e27715.text: $N, how may I further your training in the eyes of the Earth Mother?

3061|3f898c12.name: Lanka Farshot
3061|3f898c12.text: Do you prefer guns or bows?

3063|4711dbab.name: Krang Stonehoof
3063|4711dbab.text: No matter how much one learns, there is always more to know.

3064|400ae304.name: Gennia Runetotem
3064|400ae304.text: We work to preserve the balance as Cenarius teaches, $c.  His is the light of a beacon that shows the way for us, and we must do everything in our power to preserve that light.

3064|8223e188.name: Gennia Runetotem
3064|8223e188.text:
Welcome, my brother.  If you are here to train, then I would be delighted to train you.

We are the preservers of the balance, now and forever, as Cenarius has taught us.  Never forget this.

3065|2d23ed1c.name: Yaw Sharpmane
3065|2d23ed1c.text: I do not have the knowledge you seek.

3065|a8bfc941.name: Yaw Sharpmane
3065|a8bfc941.text: Tauren have a passion for hunting; it is something that runs deep with our kind.

3066|1605f087.name: Narm Skychaser
3066|1605f087.text: The spirits have guided you to me. How may I be of service?

3067|0c543544.name: Pyall Silentstride
3067|0c543544.text: Cooking is a life long pursuit and I see we share the same passion!

3067|b48f927f.name: Pyall Silentstride
3067|b48f927f.text: I can teach you how to cook!

3069|93940fbb.name: Chaw Stronghide
3069|93940fbb.text: Meat, skin, bones... a good hunter lets nothing go to waste. Every scrap of leather can be salvaged, perhaps to reinforce an ally's armor. Thus, each of us is strong alone, but together we become invincible.

3084|087a1e7e.name: Bluffwatcher
3084|087a1e7e.text: Then head over to Bena's Alchemy on the middle rise and talk to Bena herself.  She will be able to help you master the art of potion brewing.

3084|3f6c5bac.name: Bluffwatcher
3084|3f6c5bac.text: Komin Winterhoof at Holistic Herbalism is the one you want to talk to then.  He can be found on the middle rise.

3084|4d981406.name: Bluffwatcher
3084|4d981406.text: Go see Una at Thunder Bluff Armorers then.  It can be found on the middle rise.

3084|71ecabc9.name: Bluffwatcher
3084|71ecabc9.text: Kah Mistrunner at Mountaintop Bait & Tackle on the high rise will show you the way to find inner peace and serenity while fishing for your next meal.

3084|73a86360.name: Bluffwatcher
3084|73a86360.text: Brek Stonehoof can be found at Stonehoof Geology on the lower rise and can teach you the proper way to harvest precious ores and gems.

3084|80d64ce9.name: Bluffwatcher
3084|80d64ce9.text: The Wind Rider Roost is atop the totem stairway in the center of town.

3084|86e3802f.name: Bluffwatcher
3084|86e3802f.text: Strong of body and spirit.  There can be no stronger combination!  Find your destiny with Sark Ragetotem in the Hunter's Hall.

3084|8acb3829.name: Bluffwatcher
3084|8acb3829.text: It is the assistance of Bulrug that you need.  You will find him outside on the lower rise standing between the inn and the Thunder Bluff Bank.

3084|8c257f1a.name: Bluffwatcher
3084|8c257f1a.text: Aspiring to join our ranks one day?  Sark Ragetotem can help you on your way.  He's in the Hunter's Hall.

3084|8ecf23b9.name: Bluffwatcher
3084|8ecf23b9.text: None are as skilled in the use of weapons as Ansekhwa.  It is said that he is guided by the spirits of the finest warriors of our honored ancestors.  Seek him out on the lower rise and he will teach you what you want to know.

3084|93108744.name: Bluffwatcher
3084|93108744.text: Ahh, you will need to make your way over to the Hunter's Hall then. Several great hunters like Holt Thunderhorn can be found there on the Hunter Rise.

3084|a56de79f.name: Bluffwatcher
3084|a56de79f.text: First Aid is always a nice skill to have.  Many a time during battle has it saved my hide.  Visit Spiritual Healing on the Spirit Rise.  Pand Stonebinder can teach you all you need to know to save your hide as well.

3084|a66cdbb7.name: Bluffwatcher
3084|a66cdbb7.text: Your interests would be best served by Sir Alodan. He is with the other members of the Undercity near the Pools of Vision.

3084|a93675fd.name: Bluffwatcher
3084|a93675fd.text: Ah, you seek the wisdom of Ansekhwa.  Look for him on the lower rise at Thunder Bluff Weapons.

3084|c52e88b9.name: Bluffwatcher
3084|c52e88b9.text: Seek out Turak Runetotem in the Hall of Elders on the Elder Rise.

3084|de5042ab.name: Bluffwatcher
3084|de5042ab.text: Look on the lower rise opposite the auctioneers if you would like to get your mane trimmed.

3087|52392408.name: Crystal Boughman
3087|52392408.text: Seek out Shandrina in Silverwind Refuge.  She can sell you the "Expert Cookbook".

3136|2e231d45.name: Clarise Gnarltree
3136|2e231d45.text: Yeah, I've heard through the grapevine that I might be seeing you sooner or later. But I don't just take on anyone, I need to make sure you have what it takes first. You willing to take my little test and find out?

3136|b873f90f.name: Clarise Gnarltree
3136|b873f90f.text: Now I'm the one who feels rough around the edges, I honestly don't think there's anything left I can teach you. But you know who can? Bengus Deepforge in Ironforge, now there's a dwarf that knows his steel. Go look him up in The Great Forge of Ironforge, see if he's up to having a new trainee under him.

3136|e91b638d.name: Clarise Gnarltree
3136|e91b638d.text: Don't come out of the shadows like that. Next time give a girl some warning.

3139|82bfeb72.name: Gar'Thok
3139|82bfeb72.text: Throm'ka, $c. There is little time for talk and much work to be done.

313|be6b48f2.name: Theocritus
313|be6b48f2.text:
Welcome to the Tower of Azora, young $C.  I am Theocritus.

Do you have business with me?  Or...do I have business with you, perhaps?

3142|99ae9589.name: Orgnil Soulscar
3142|99ae9589.text: Hail.  Be brief, for we both have much to do.

3143|004c594f.name: Gornek
3143|004c594f.text: The Valley of Trials will temper even the weakest into a warrior worthy to join the Horde. Those who cannot rise to its tests will be left to bake in the scorching desert sun.

3143|e14f5e15.name: Gornek
3143|e14f5e15.text: The Valley of Trials will temper even the weakest into a warrior worthy to join the Horde. Those who cannot rise to its tests will be left to bake in the scorching desert sun.

3149|ae6d6ab0.name: Nez'raz
3149|ae6d6ab0.text: Why you would want to leave these sunny shores and crystal blue waters I have no idea. It's like paradise down here. But don't tell my brother Zapetta that, he's bitter enough already about getting stuck up there in Tirisfal all day long. This Zeppelin here drops off at Orgrimmar so you shouldn't have to worry about having to listen to him whine. But if you are in Tirisfal anytime soon, heed my warning and don't get him started.

3150|a266136f.name: Hin Denburg
3150|a266136f.text: This here is the finest, most state of the art mode of transportation money can build. What? Deeprun Tram? Gnomes? Listen pal, If you believe that garbage then I've got a statue down in Stranglethorn to sell ya. Now, are you walking to Grom'Gol or are you gonna ride in style in this fine flying machine? Your choice.

3153|640f312b.name: Frang
3153|640f312b.text: Are you here for training?  Or are you just here to waste a warrior's time.

3154|08e320c2.name: Jen'shan
3154|08e320c2.text: What kin I do for ya, mon?

3154|515c0157.name: Jen'shan
3154|515c0157.text: Hey mon, you be needin' to head on over to da $c trainer.

3155|0402cd55.name: Rwag
3155|0402cd55.text: The Shattered Hand will see the Horde to their former glory, unhindered by the timidness of the Warchief.

3156|031480cd.name: Nartok
3156|031480cd.text: You know enough to be dangerous, but you still look like you need training to me $N.

3157|1605f087.name: Shikrik
3157|1605f087.text: The spirits have guided you to me. How may I be of service?

3169|640f312b.name: Tarshaw Jaggedscar
3169|640f312b.text: Are you here for training?  Or are you just here to waste a warrior's time.

3170|0402cd55.name: Kaplak
3170|0402cd55.text: The Shattered Hand will see the Horde to their former glory, unhindered by the timidness of the Warchief.

3171|9d35dc4d.name: Thotar
3171|9d35dc4d.text: I train and guide young hunters in the traditions passed down many generations.

3172|031480cd.name: Dhugru Gorelust
3172|031480cd.text: You know enough to be dangerous, but you still look like you need training to me $N.

3173|1605f087.name: Swart
3173|1605f087.text: The spirits have guided you to me. How may I be of service?

3174|363380c0.name: Dwukk
3174|363380c0.text: Not bad. Go talk with Snarl, he just moved to Orgrimmar to study under Saru. Look for him in the $C district near Saru's smithy. Oh and he'll test you, so you better be as ready as you think you are.

3174|7befd912.name: Dwukk
3174|7befd912.text: I hear one comment about waterfowl, and you will be eating through a tube.

3174|b71a7466.name: Dwukk
3174|b71a7466.text: Not bad. Go talk with Snarl, he just moved to Orgrimmar to study under Saru. Look for him in the Warrior district near Saru's smithy. Oh and he'll test you, so you better be as ready as you think you are.

3174|cb2b8cd1.name: Dwukk
3174|cb2b8cd1.text: Just swinging a hammer at an anvil doesn't make you a smith. Give me that and let me teach you something before you embarrass us all.

3179|c2467ddc.name: Harold Riggs
3179|c2467ddc.text: I can teach you fishing skills.

3181|a28d29e1.name: Fremal Doohickey
3181|a28d29e1.text: I can train you in First Aid techniques.

3181|c2e96a28.name: Fremal Doohickey
3181|c2e96a28.text: The esteemed Doctor Gustaf VanHowzen can train you further.  He can be found in Theramore treating the wounded at the barracks.

3184|bf296072.name: Miao'zan
3184|bf296072.text: Ready for another lesson? All right, then. First, relax. You gotta stay loose to stir a potion just right.

3184|c7dd471a.name: Miao'zan
3184|c7dd471a.text: You got the look of someone wantin' adventure. Me, I had enough of that by the time we trolls came here. Now I take each day as it comes, an' I train other folks to handle adventures for me.

3188|366172e1.name: Master Gadrin
3188|366172e1.text: There is something you wish to discuss, $c... come, sit by me.

3191|0c543544.name: Cook Torka
3191|0c543544.text: Cooking is a life long pursuit and I see we share the same passion!

3191|b48f927f.name: Cook Torka
3191|b48f927f.text: I can teach you how to cook!

3194|57542108.name: Vel'rin Fang
3194|57542108.text: I make sure Sen'jin is supplied with materials from the local beasts. It is an honorable role.

3216|13f1d3f9.name: Neeru Fireblade
3216|13f1d3f9.text:
Listen closely to what you are told and do not quickly trust, or distrust.  For even friends serve their own ends, $c.

Our great Warchief knows this, and to prove that there are warlocks within the Horde who do not wish to destroy it from within or gain control over it, I have volunteered to aid our young leader in anyway I can.

3216|1672ee12.name: Neeru Fireblade
3216|1672ee12.text:
Naive fool. The Burning Blade IS the Shadow Council! There are many cults and organizations under the Council's rule, but all of them are just extensions of their will. I may lead the Burning Blade, but I am still just as much a pawn to the Council as you are to me!

Look at the Searing Blade--most of them think they are becoming the next rising group of powerful warlocks that they will replace the Shadow Council.

3216|2e9c14b6.name: Neeru Fireblade
3216|2e9c14b6.text: Haha! Save for their leaders--the satyr, Bazzalan, and the warlock Jergosh--yes, all of them. That is why I constantly send Thrall's worshippers at them. It gives Thrall the impression that I am weeding out the evil in the bowels of his great city. The victory is in reality two-fold: kill Thrall's faithful and test the strength of those in the Searing Blade to see if they are truly worthy of joining me.

3216|9353e287.name: Neeru Fireblade
3216|9353e287.text:
Ah, one of our own. It is good to see our numbers are growing so rapidly that I can no longer keep track of the faces of our members.

That fool Thrall thinks I am working hard to cleanse the image of warlocks and prove we are his servants. Idiot! The Burning Legion will make ash of this entire world after it drains it completely.

3216|ba03eca3.name: Neeru Fireblade
3216|ba03eca3.text: Haha! Save for their leaders--the satyr, Bazzalan, and the warlock Jergosh--yes, all of them. That is why I constantly send Thrall's worshippers at them. It gives Thrall the impression that I am weeding out the evil in the bowels of his great city. The victory is in reality two-fold: kill Thrall's faithful and test the strength of those in the Searing Blade to see if they are truly worthy of joining me.

3216|e0c203bc.name: Neeru Fireblade
3216|e0c203bc.text: I will make it known to you. You are obviously already proving yourself in our ranks to become a lieutenant so quickly. Perhaps you can return to me later and I will have tasks for you. The council adores those skilled in the arcane, but servants of all kinds are always welcome, no matter their profession.

3222|4dab2020.name: Brave Wildrunner
3222|4dab2020.text: While we have no Alchemy Trainer here in Bloodhoof Village, there is one in Thunder Bluff to the north.  Follow the road there and ask one of the Bluffwatchers for directions when you get to the top.

3222|b41a2ca2.name: Brave Wildrunner
3222|b41a2ca2.text: You are looking for Uthan Stillwater.  You will find him west of the village, fishing at Stonebull Lake.

32287|1d779665.name: Archmage Alvareaux
32287|1d779665.text:
Greetings, I am Archmage Alvereaux and I manage supply and logistics for the Kirin Tor.

Unfortunately, we have relatively few useful items available for disbursement to our friends and allies at present.

I suggest checking back often, as available stock may change from time to time.

3230|3b64a31f.name: Nazgrel
3230|3b64a31f.text:
<Nazgrel grunts as he sizes you up.>

High elves, here in Orgrimmar. I'd never bet on such a thing happening in my lifetime, but at this point nothing is surprising to me.

Yes, the Warchief instructed me to draft up instructions for you. Take this letter and follow the instructions within. Conduct yourself with honor and show due deference when you meet with our leaders, elf.

Once you've finished your journey, return to the Warchief.

3230|8d5031bd.name: Nazgrel
3230|8d5031bd.text: Mind yourself in the presence of the Warchief, $c. The Kor'kron will suffer no insolence or insult here.

32413|0f322cd8.name: Isirami Fairwind
32413|0f322cd8.text: The old kingdom of Lordaeron is perilous. We urge caution for anyone who dares to venture into the now decaying lands of Tirisfal Glades. If you must, find the Undercity; the upper courtyards are what you seek.

32413|4a0923b3.name: Isirami Fairwind
32413|4a0923b3.text: Are you interested in exploring one of these dungeons?

32413|c80041d2.name: Isirami Fairwind
32413|c80041d2.text: Welcome to my Inn, weary traveler. What can I do for you?

32748|53fff4bc.name: Bimble Sparkfingers
32748|53fff4bc.text: I am sorry, $c, but you are not experienced enough yet to enter Darkspear Islands.

328|9c6df40b.name: Zaldimar Wefhellt
328|9c6df40b.text: Greetings mage.  Shall I provide you with further insight into the world of magic?

3293|5bfb096f.name: Rezlak
3293|5bfb096f.text: I'm happy Gazlowe gave me the opportunity to be here and all, but this place is more dangerous than I thought it'd be. It's also really hot. And dusty. And it smells kinda weird. Ah, well! Hopefully it will be good for business.

3296|10e6748a.name: Orgrimmar Grunt
3296|10e6748a.text: Arnok makes good bandages.  Find him at the Survival of the Fittest hut on the shore of the lake next to Spirit Lodge in the Valley of Spirits.  It's above and to the west of the Valley of Strength.

3296|20a68ed9.name: Orgrimmar Grunt
3296|20a68ed9.text: Thuwd will show you how to skin your kills.  Look for him at Kodohide Leatherworkers in The Drag.

3296|2213d915.name: Orgrimmar Grunt
3296|2213d915.text: Talk to Saru Steelfury at The Burning Anvil.  Go to the Valley of Honor.  It's at the end of the path to the right of Red Canyon Mining.

3296|4b39ad06.name: Orgrimmar Grunt
3296|4b39ad06.text: Find Red Canyon Mining northeast of the lake in the Valley of Honor.  Speak to Makaru there.

3296|5516f117.name: Orgrimmar Grunt
3296|5516f117.text: In the cleft of shadow Kor'ghan is waiting with shears sharper than a guards sword.

3296|a30a3aff.name: Orgrimmar Grunt
3296|a30a3aff.text: Makaru can be found day and night at Red Canyon Mining in the Valley of Honor, just off the lake.

3296|adf2f562.name: Orgrimmar Grunt
3296|adf2f562.text: Looking to learn how to use a new weapon?  Find Sayoc and Hanashi inside Arms of Legend in the Valley of Honor.

3296|b5e5cb59.name: Orgrimmar Grunt
3296|b5e5cb59.text: Look for Sayoc and Hanashi at the Valley of Honor inside Arms of Legend.  Watch your tongue around them or Sayoc may decide to give a piece of you as a snack to Grinning Dog.

3296|bb16f568.name: Orgrimmar Grunt
3296|bb16f568.text: You want Zamja at Borstan's Firepit on the upper level of The Drag.  Go up the stairs on the left as you enter The Drag from the Valley of Strength.

3296|c0e82349.name: Orgrimmar Grunt
3296|c0e82349.text: Go to the cleft of shadow and seek out Spellweaver Mon'ye there, near the center of the district.

3296|c14d9b3a.name: Orgrimmar Grunt
3296|c14d9b3a.text: Your search is almost completed.  Seek your truth in the entrance room of Thrall's Fortress in the Valley of Wisdom.

3296|c407ea01.name: Orgrimmar Grunt
3296|c407ea01.text: Speak to Pephredo at the Darkbriar Lodge in the Valley of Spirits, up above and to the west of the Valley of Strength.

3296|ce1ceb20.name: Orgrimmar Grunt
3296|ce1ceb20.text: Speak to Grezz Ragefist in the Hall of the Brave, which is in the Valley of Honor.  Put in a good word for me!

3296|d2a519bc.name: Orgrimmar Grunt
3296|d2a519bc.text: One of those Light-loving Forsaken has posted up in Grommash Hold near the other ambassadors. Perhaps he can help you.

3296|d54dd1e8.name: Orgrimmar Grunt
3296|d54dd1e8.text: Go to Kodohide Leatherworkers in The Drag. Ask for Kamari.

3296|eb46eb15.name: Orgrimmar Grunt
3296|eb46eb15.text: Zayus and his priests are in the Spirit Lodge, which is in the Valley of Spirits.  Look for it on the lake up above and to west of the Valley of Strength.

3304|645294fc.name: Master Vornal
3304|645294fc.text: The sands of Durotar are tough and dry compared to the tropical and lush lands we're from, but we Darkspear persevere. Where chief Vol'jin leads, we will follow.

3306|0e051c59.name: Keldas
3306|0e051c59.text: You've come for training in order to pass it on to your pets?

3306|d56cf43b.name: Keldas
3306|d56cf43b.text:
You can't teach an old dog new tricks.  At least that's what someone once told me.  Lucky for you, I've discovered it to be untrue.

However, pets do tend to get resistant to the technique, and I need more food each time to keep them happy.  What that means is that you'll owe me more money the more times I untrain the same pet.

Now then, would you like me to start untraining?

3309|2f8d506f.name: Karus
3309|2f8d506f.text: Besides the Grunts outside, my brothers and I fought at the battle of Hyjal. Any who seek to steal from the bank must face us first.

3309|6b36598f.name: Karus
3309|6b36598f.text: I guarantee this bank's security with my own blood, is that good enough for you?

3309|ae78a458.name: Karus
3309|ae78a458.text: Would you rather trust your goods with a goblin?

3310|cc0cf280.name: Doras
3310|cc0cf280.text: You haven't lived until you've looked down on the world from the back of a wind rider.

3314|1676cade.name: Urtharo
3314|1676cade.text: Tell me what you want, and make it quick.

3314|8fd1ef50.name: Urtharo
3314|8fd1ef50.text: So many years of battle and slavery, it feels good to have a home again.

3318|2f8d506f.name: Koma
3318|2f8d506f.text: Besides the Grunts outside, my brothers and I fought at the battle of Hyjal. Any who seek to steal from the bank must face us first.

3318|6b36598f.name: Koma
3318|6b36598f.text: I guarantee this bank's security with my own blood, is that good enough for you?

3318|ae78a458.name: Koma
3318|ae78a458.text: Would you rather trust your goods with a goblin?

331|8fca8484.name: Maginor Dumas
331|8fca8484.text: If you desire, in addition to training, I have it within my power to erase the knowledge of your talents from your mind.  Be warned that every time you undergo this procedure the more difficult it is to perform, and therefore the more expensive it becomes.

331|9c6df40b.name: Maginor Dumas
331|9c6df40b.text: Greetings mage.  Shall I provide you with further insight into the world of magic?

3320|2f8d506f.name: Soran
3320|2f8d506f.text: Besides the Grunts outside, my brothers and I fought at the battle of Hyjal. Any who seek to steal from the bank must face us first.

3320|6b36598f.name: Soran
3320|6b36598f.text: I guarantee this bank's security with my own blood, is that good enough for you?

3320|ae78a458.name: Soran
3320|ae78a458.text: Would you rather trust your goods with a goblin?

3324|031480cd.name: Grol'dar
3324|031480cd.text: You know enough to be dangerous, but you still look like you need training to me $N.

3325|031480cd.name: Mirket
3325|031480cd.text: You know enough to be dangerous, but you still look like you need training to me $N.

3325|8fca8484.name: Mirket
3325|8fca8484.text: If you desire, in addition to training, I have it within my power to erase the knowledge of your talents from your mind.  Be warned that every time you undergo this procedure the more difficult it is to perform, and therefore the more expensive it becomes.

3326|86b6c1ef.name: Zevrost
3326|86b6c1ef.text: The arcane only corrupts those who are weak. Keep up on your training, or you may find a similar fate.

3326|8fca8484.name: Zevrost
3326|8fca8484.text: If you desire, in addition to training, I have it within my power to erase the knowledge of your talents from your mind.  Be warned that every time you undergo this procedure the more difficult it is to perform, and therefore the more expensive it becomes.

3327|0402cd55.name: Gest
3327|0402cd55.text: The Shattered Hand will see the Horde to their former glory, unhindered by the timidness of the Warchief.

332|795b2b49.name: Master Mathias Shaw
332|795b2b49.text: $N, this came for you this morning.

3332|51d936f4.name: Lumak
3332|51d936f4.text: Fish so delicious. You come learn fish? Eat fish? Mmmmm...

3338|e2ff6310.name: Sergra Darkthorn
3338|e2ff6310.text: The land, the water, and the sky are all as one. It is your eyes that deceive you with such separation. The Earthmother is all those things and more.

3341|bdd68929.name: Gann Stonespire
3341|bdd68929.text:
I walk this road alone, seeking ways to defend my honor and rid this land of our enemies.

What can I do for you, $N?

3344|1605f087.name: Kardris Dreamseeker
3344|1605f087.text: The spirits have guided you to me. How may I be of service?

3344|8fca8484.name: Kardris Dreamseeker
3344|8fca8484.text: If you desire, in addition to training, I have it within my power to erase the knowledge of your talents from your mind.  Be warned that every time you undergo this procedure the more difficult it is to perform, and therefore the more expensive it becomes.

3344|996eca9b.name: Kardris Dreamseeker
3344|996eca9b.text: May the spirits be with you.

3345|335c06e7.name: Godan
3345|335c06e7.text: You may have what it takes. Let's find out!

3345|75a71456.name: Godan
3345|75a71456.text: Your skills are out of my league, stranger.Talk to Hgarth at the Sun Rock Retreat in the Stonetalon Mountains. He will provide you with more knowledge than I can.

3347|2953edc2.name: Yelmak
3347|2953edc2.text: Another student, eh? All right. I'll see what I can do to help you out.

3347|9cc6e14a.name: Yelmak
3347|9cc6e14a.text: I'm busy, $N. Tell Whuut to handle whatever it is. That young pup has been stewing all day long. He spends much more time like that, and he's going to hurt something.

3347|f0e2667b.name: Yelmak
3347|f0e2667b.text: I'm honored to meet you, $N, but your skill at potions is greater than my own. Go see Doctor Herbert Halsey, an undead in the Apothecarium of the Undercity. He can help you from now on.

3352|08830bac.name: Ormak Grimshot
3352|08830bac.text: Through rigorous retraining I have had to break many students of all they had previously learned so that I might teach them anew.  The service I offer becomes increasingly difficult to perform each time it is done.  It is for that reason that it becomes increasingly expensive with each retraining.  Do you desire that I break you of the talents you have learned?

3352|fd7e1800.name: Ormak Grimshot
3352|fd7e1800.text: I have much knowledge to impress upon you, $c. You must learn to hunt with honor.

3353|640f312b.name: Grezz Ragefist
3353|640f312b.text: Are you here for training?  Or are you just here to waste a warrior's time.

3354|08830bac.name: Sorek
3354|08830bac.text: Through rigorous retraining I have had to break many students of all they had previously learned so that I might teach them anew.  The service I offer becomes increasingly difficult to perform each time it is done.  It is for that reason that it becomes increasingly expensive with each retraining.  Do you desire that I break you of the talents you have learned?

3354|640f312b.name: Sorek
3354|640f312b.text: Are you here for training?  Or are you just here to waste a warrior's time.

3355|8b1e2f29.name: Saru Steelfury
3355|8b1e2f29.text: What is it you seek at my forge? Is it training? Do you perhaps seek the secrets of steel? The mysteries of the forge? Speak up Grunt!

3355|9ce36f55.name: Saru Steelfury
3355|9ce36f55.text: This isn't a game you toy with youngling! Go, speak with Snarl outside. He may be a serpent in my lair but he does know his way around an anvil.

3355|e97bc5d7.name: Saru Steelfury
3355|e97bc5d7.text: Welcome to my forge, Blacksmith. Let me share with you a little secret. No one, no one in the world can you trust. Not men, not women, not beasts ... this you can trust, Steel.

3362|ae8e419b.name: Ogunaro Wolfrunner
3362|ae8e419b.text: I only make my mounts available to those who are considered exalted to Orgrimmar and the Orcish race.  Go prove yourself to us, and I'll make my mighty wolves available for your inspection.

3363|05c29513.name: Magar
3363|05c29513.text: About time you showed me some results! Now I'll show you results!

3363|7f111c90.name: Magar
3363|7f111c90.text: I made a lot of the things you see in the store. What do you think? Answer carefully, your life may depend on it.

3363|89f361ba.name: Magar
3363|89f361ba.text: What? Why are you bothering me? Why, I bet you can't even create a high quality robe! Go talk to Snang and come back when you're worthy of my talents!

3363|a2785f99.name: Magar
3363|a2785f99.text: You need to learn from someone who knows more than I do. Go talk to Josef Gregorian in Undercity. Well, what are you still doing here?

3365|0443423e.name: Karolek
3365|0443423e.text: The twists and turns of Orgrimmar are designed to thwart invaders. Can you imagine how quickly one of those puny gnomes would get lost in here? Ha! If it was lucky, I'd track it down and keep it as a pet.

3365|0b0697d2.name: Karolek
3365|0b0697d2.text: Am I busy? What's that supposed to mean? Do you think I just stand here all day, twiddling my thumbs? If you're here to buy something, talk to Handor.

3365|40134f65.name: Karolek
3365|40134f65.text: You won't learn anything new from me; you know too much already. If you want more training, talk to the tauren Una in the northwestern shops of Thunder Bluff's central plateau. Send her my regards, eh?

3365|b90e9588.name: Karolek
3365|b90e9588.text: You can't study my techniques until you've learned the basics. Speak with Kamari if you are interested in training.

3368|5a0b913d.name: Borstan
3368|5a0b913d.text: I have the finest meats in Orgrimmar.

3370|7e0ec160.name: Urtrun Clanbringer
3370|7e0ec160.text: Even in peace there is still war, and many clans still fight beneath the banner of the Warchief. Are you here to add your clan to those that fight for Orgrimmar?

3373|1355f2b7.name: Arnok
3373|1355f2b7.text: I am an orc of medicine, $r. If you have come here to learn, I shall do my best to teach.

3373|43457c57.name: Arnok
3373|43457c57.text: Balai Lok'Wein of Brackenwall Village in Dustwallow Marsh sells a manual that you will need to study in order to improve your skills!

3373|6043e59b.name: Arnok
3373|6043e59b.text: I am an orc of medicine, $r. If you have come here to learn, I shall do my best to teach.

3387|da8a5dad.name: Jorn Skyseer
3387|da8a5dad.text: Although we call this land the Barrens, to one who knows where to look this place teems with life.

3389|5612724d.name: Regthar Deathgate
3389|5612724d.text: We have our duties, $c.  Duties to the Horde.

3390|eb12150e.name: Apothecary Helbrim
3390|eb12150e.text: The Barrens holds a wealth of substances for which we, the apothecaries or Lordaeron, may find use.

3391|8f749700.name: Gazlowe
3391|8f749700.text: Thrall paid me and my boys well for helping out with the construction of Orgrimmar, so I decided to set up a port here. We do most of our business through Booty Bay and Baron Revilgaz.

3399|3b48d638.name: Zamja
3399|3b48d638.text: Dirge Quikcleave of Gadgetzan is a master of the culinary arts.  To better yourself you will need to seek him out.

3399|48c1c064.name: Zamja
3399|48c1c064.text: Wulan in Shadowprey Village can sell you the "Expert Cookbook".  You will need that if you are to better yourself.

3401|08830bac.name: Shenthul
3401|08830bac.text: Through rigorous retraining I have had to break many students of all they had previously learned so that I might teach them anew.  The service I offer becomes increasingly difficult to perform each time it is done.  It is for that reason that it becomes increasingly expensive with each retraining.  Do you desire that I break you of the talents you have learned?

3401|0e004941.name: Shenthul
3401|0e004941.text: The Venture Company based around Windshear Crag in Stonetalon keeps their supplies in locked boxes.

3401|20382774.name: Shenthul
3401|20382774.text: The Order of the Shattered Hand existed before Thrall and shall exist after Thrall.

3402|6cb63392.name: Zando'zan
3402|6cb63392.text: Zando'zan of the Shattered Hand. How can Zando'zan help you? He can't! He won't!

3403|8fca8484.name: Sian'tsu
3403|8fca8484.text: If you desire, in addition to training, I have it within my power to erase the knowledge of your talents from your mind.  Be warned that every time you undergo this procedure the more difficult it is to perform, and therefore the more expensive it becomes.

3403|c189082e.name: Sian'tsu
3403|c189082e.text: Da spirits be strong wit you, mon. What kin dis troll do for ya?

3403|d54272c7.name: Sian'tsu
3403|d54272c7.text: May da spirits protect you mon.

3406|08830bac.name: Xor'juul
3406|08830bac.text: Through rigorous retraining I have had to break many students of all they had previously learned so that I might teach them anew.  The service I offer becomes increasingly difficult to perform each time it is done.  It is for that reason that it becomes increasingly expensive with each retraining.  Do you desire that I break you of the talents you have learned?

3406|08e320c2.name: Xor'juul
3406|08e320c2.text: What kin I do for ya, mon?

3407|08830bac.name: Sian'dur
3407|08830bac.text: Through rigorous retraining I have had to break many students of all they had previously learned so that I might teach them anew.  The service I offer becomes increasingly difficult to perform each time it is done.  It is for that reason that it becomes increasingly expensive with each retraining.  Do you desire that I break you of the talents you have learned?

3407|2a1798f1.name: Sian'dur
3407|2a1798f1.text: Come learn the ways of the hunter. Pride, honor, and tradition.

3407|515c0157.name: Sian'dur
3407|515c0157.text: Hey mon, you be needin' to head on over to da $c trainer.

3412|d0fc10c2.name: Nogg
3412|d0fc10c2.text: If there were just a few more hours in a day...

3412|fe9433e2.name: Nogg
3412|fe9433e2.text: Every day is a test, and this day is no different. If you pass this test, I will share some of my knowledge...

3413|c879b3f9.name: Sovik
3413|c879b3f9.text: Hello, $N! If you don't see it in my shop, chances are good I can get it!

3419|dabc0513.name: Apothecary Zamah
3419|dabc0513.text: For our people to survive, we must study the ways of nature and learn its secrets.

341|04478bdc.name: Foreman Oslow
341|04478bdc.text: I don't have much time for idle talk, MINAAX.  I've got to get this bridge rebuilt before the rains come.  I've finished every project on-time and under budget and I'm not about to start slipping now.

341|10264aff.name: Foreman Oslow
341|10264aff.text: I don't have much time for idle talk, SNITCHES.  I've got to get this bridge rebuilt before the rains come.  I've finished every project on-time and under budget and I'm not about to start slipping now.

341|415489c9.name: Foreman Oslow
341|415489c9.text: I don't have much time for idle talk, MURIN.  I've got to get this bridge rebuilt before the rains come.  I've finished every project on-time and under budget and I'm not about to start slipping now.

341|5d781570.name: Foreman Oslow
341|5d781570.text: I don't have much time for idle talk, ANAKIN.  I've got to get this bridge rebuilt before the rains come.  I've finished every project on-time and under budget and I'm not about to start slipping now.

341|61263643.name: Foreman Oslow
341|61263643.text: I don't have much time for idle talk, HGUUL.  I've got to get this bridge rebuilt before the rains come.  I've finished every project on-time and under budget and I'm not about to start slipping now.

341|8dd007ae.text: I don't have much time for idle talk, CAL.  I've got to get this bridge rebuilt before the rains come.  I've finished every project on-time and under budget and I'm not about to start slipping now.

341|a80917b6.text: I don't have much time for idle talk, DJINNE.  I've got to get this bridge rebuilt before the rains come.  I've finished every project on-time and under budget and I'm not about to start slipping now.

341|f2cb4ae5.name: Foreman Oslow
341|f2cb4ae5.text: I don't have much time for idle talk, WAYLANDER.  I've got to get this bridge rebuilt before the rains come.  I've finished every project on-time and under budget and I'm not about to start slipping now.

3429|4e7d06f7.name: Thork
3429|4e7d06f7.text:
Welcome to the Crossroads, $c. My name is Thork--I lead the defenses here in the name of the Warchief.

Please, feel free to make yourself at home. As long as you mind your business, no one should have any problem with you taking up some space.

There are many threats to our safety here. If you've already become familiar with the lay of the land, speak to the others here--perhaps they have tasks for you to do.

342|076b3629.name: Martie Jainrose
342|076b3629.text: Hail, WILLA!  Welcome to my humble garden.  The weather has been perfect lately.  Let us hope it holds steady for a ripe harvest.

342|32aa88d4.name: Martie Jainrose
342|32aa88d4.text: Hail, THORVALD!  Welcome to my humble garden.  The weather has been perfect lately.  Let us hope it holds steady for a ripe harvest.

342|b06a17dd.name: Martie Jainrose
342|b06a17dd.text: Hail, HARUNO!  Welcome to my humble garden.  The weather has been perfect lately.  Let us hope it holds steady for a ripe harvest.

342|b3581ed7.name: Martie Jainrose
342|b3581ed7.text: Hail, FROSTY!  Welcome to my humble garden.  The weather has been perfect lately.  Let us hope it holds steady for a ripe harvest.

342|c3b776bb.name: Martie Jainrose
342|c3b776bb.text: Hail, SHOOTING!  Welcome to my humble garden.  The weather has been perfect lately.  Let us hope it holds steady for a ripe harvest.

342|e1667b79.name: Martie Jainrose
342|e1667b79.text: Hail, CITROUS!  Welcome to my humble garden.  The weather has been perfect lately.  Let us hope it holds steady for a ripe harvest.

342|e8fc6f6d.name: Martie Jainrose
342|e8fc6f6d.text: Hail, ISALARA!  Welcome to my humble garden.  The weather has been perfect lately.  Let us hope it holds steady for a ripe harvest.

3430|0e16a4d2.name: Mangletooth
3430|0e16a4d2.text:
You! $R! Come here. <snort>

Time is short, and my end <snort> is near. Mangletooth shall win; you will see. <snort>

My capture can still aid <snort> my people. The Razormane tribe is more powerful than the Bristlebacks!

The Horde looks to find out who leads the raids on their people. You <snort> shall aid Mangletooth in return for the information only I know. Mangletooth can help you! <snort> But you must help Mangletooth.

3430|71e13f0e.name: Mangletooth
3430|71e13f0e.text:
My hatred is strong <snort>, but the time is right to tell you a tale, $r.

Long ago a battle took place between gods. Agamaggan, our great boar god, fell to the earth after being defeated in the War of the Ancients, his blood raining down and his bones torn asunder. <snort>

Great thorns reached up out of the earth where his blood touched the ground, and his skull adorns one of the caverns to the south.

3432|c1a3099b.name: Mankrik
3432|c1a3099b.text:
I came to the Crossroads from the south seeking help, $c, but I find only cowards who turn their backs on me--even the mighty Thork insults me so. He is a good leader, but his dismissal of my plea causes me greater anger.

He claims my rage makes me hasty--that it clouds my judgement--but I will not rest until I have vengeance!

3432|f6d45601.name: Mankrik
3432|f6d45601.text:
I thank you, $N. Your dedication to my plea gives rest to my lost wife's spirit, and for that I could never repay you enough.

I cannot say that my hatred will ever cease for the quilboar, but it is satiated for now.

Now I must begin to rebuild my life.

3433|4ec00f6f.name: Tatternack Steelforge
3433|4ec00f6f.text:
