The Warchief has instructed me to study all kinds of weapons and armor. He has sent me here to the hub of both the tauren and orc cultures in the Barrens to meet as many travelers as possible, and to learn about the cultures of the Barrens.

He feels there's something to be learned from even the most pathetic of cultures... like the quilboar or centaur.

3433|9ecbac40.name: Tatternack Steelforge
3433|9ecbac40.text:
The Warchief has instructed me to study all kinds of weapons and armor. He has sent me here to the hub of both the tauren and orc cultures in the Barrens to meet as many travelers as possible, and to learn about the cultures of the Barrens.

He feels there's something to be learned from even the most pathetic of cultures... like the quilboar or centaur.

3433|ac5dfa0b.name: Tatternack Steelforge
3433|ac5dfa0b.text:
The Warchief has instructed me to study all kinds of weapons and armor. He has sent me here to the hub of both the tauren and orc cultures in the Barrens to meet as many travelers as possible, and to learn about the cultures of the Barrens.

He feels there's something to be learned from even the most pathetic of cultures... like the quilboar or centaur.

3442|6812c5a7.name: Sputtervalve
3442|6812c5a7.text:
Interesting, interesting... I know of a druid that lives atop the hill above the Wailing Caverns, $N. She might be able to tell you more about this shard you have found.

Now, I must get back to work!

3442|6ac7df7d.name: Sputtervalve
3442|6ac7df7d.text:
See, the Venture Company's new shredder is better than my latest, from the interchangeable hands to the control grips! My boss has given me a pretty strict deadline, but my boys and I couldn't come up with anything.

Nothing was working, so we decided to "borrow" one of their prototypes. I sent Wizzlecrank to the Sludge Fen to steal one, but he hasn't gotten back yet!

3442|c0ad1190.name: Sputtervalve
3442|c0ad1190.text: Lots to do, lots to do! The Union's given us deadlines and they're not the sort you want to miss!

3442|ef9d74c5.name: Sputtervalve
3442|ef9d74c5.text: Director Riddlevox put me in charge of the Union's shredder development program. Few months on the job and I'm already in hot water! I could use your help, $N!

3446|36457281.name: Mebok Mizzyrix
3446|36457281.text:
Yes yes yes!  You're just the $r I'm looking for!

Sit!  We have much to discuss!!

3448|dcea3712.name: Tonga Runetotem
3448|dcea3712.text: The times we live in are as fickle as the shifting winds, $c.  It is important to remember what is true and lasting in this world, and to preserve that.  Everything else is a waste.

344|d18fd3a5.name: Magistrate Solomon
344|d18fd3a5.text: Who is this $c who goes before the Court of Lakshire in the Kingdom of Stormwind?  State your business within this township, $R.  The orc threat to the Kingdom is far too great to squander time in idle conversation.

3453|48c11c0f.name: Wharfmaster Dizzywig
3453|48c11c0f.text: Something I can help you with, $N? There's a shipment I've got to see to otherwise.

3464|b28a0f9e.name: Gazrog
3464|b28a0f9e.text:
The Barrens is no place for the weak, or the long-winded.  I won't waste your time with unneeded words.

I expect the same from you.

3478|f205334f.name: Traugh
3478|f205334f.text: You need to heed the guidance of the spirits a little better young one. Your path lies with another, Thrag Stonehoof in Thunder Bluff. Perhaps you can learn something from one another.

3483|aa3c8600.name: Jahan Hawkwing
3483|aa3c8600.text: The Barrens, with its hot sun and hostile denizens, is the perfect place to test your strength and fortitude.

3484|6f0d2d99.name: Kil'hala
3484|6f0d2d99.text: Hey mon, what can I be doin' for you?

3484|b1b31af6.name: Kil'hala
3484|b1b31af6.text: Dat's da attitude! Grab a needle and thread and let's get jammin'!

3484|e50c189b.name: Kil'hala
3484|e50c189b.text: At dis point you know as much as I do, mon. Maybe you go see Magar in Orgrimmar. He not be da happiest tailor around, but he help you anyway.

3489|68d65f37.name: Zargh
3489|68d65f37.text: Have a look at my meats, friend.  You won't want to go out into the Barrens without a good stock of provisions.

3494|a323d91f.name: Tinkerwiz
3494|a323d91f.text: I got nothin' more to teach! Not for somebody who knows as much as you do, anyway! You Horde types need to talk to Nogg in Orgrimmar!

3516|cc6cb2bd.name: Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm
3516|cc6cb2bd.text: Make it quick, $c. Observing and guiding the growth of Teldrassil leaves me with little time to waste to idle banter.

3518|ed056522.name: Thomas Miller
3518|ed056522.text: Best deals in all of Stormwind my friend, won't find any better. Now, what can I help you with?

3518|fe52f4ea.name: Thomas Miller
3518|fe52f4ea.text: Just browsing my wares or is there something specific I can help you find today?

3519|f7f9ee95.name: Sentinel Arynia Cloudsbreak
3519|f7f9ee95.text: I, Arynia Cloudsbreak, have been tasked with protecting the sanctity of the Oracle Grove.

3523|02cc6c56.name: Bowen Brisboise
3523|02cc6c56.text: Pleased to make your acquaintance. May I help you?

3523|a670d938.name: Bowen Brisboise
3523|a670d938.text: So... you want to be a tailor? Very well, we'll see if you have what it takes.

352|035b100d.name: Dungar Longdrink
352|035b100d.text: Where is it ye would like to go lass? For just a few coin my Gryphons can get ye there faster than even the swiftest horse.

352|4946c28b.name: Dungar Longdrink
352|4946c28b.text: Where is it ye would like to go lad? For just a few coin my Gryphons can get ye there faster than even the swiftest horse.

352|c23f1156.name: Dungar Longdrink
352|c23f1156.text: These great beasts know paths that ye can't find on foot, they'll get ye there fast and maybe show ye something new at the same time.

3539|8259246a.name: Ott
3539|8259246a.text:
My blades don't glisten, glitter, or gleam, and they'll sing no epic songs about my creations when I'm gone. 

One thing you can be sure of though is that my weapons will cut down all the knights in Stormwind before losing their honed edge.

3549|2cec462d.name: Shelene Rhobart
3549|2cec462d.text: Skin, glorious skin. It holds your insides... in. You might've noticed my skin's not doing so well. To think I used to worry about my pores. Hardly any skin left to worry about these days. In a way, it's very freeing.

3549|d12ffcb8.name: Shelene Rhobart
3549|d12ffcb8.text: Before the plague came, I knew nothing about leather. Now I know enough to teach others. Death's left me with a lot of time on my hands.

3557|1f4f702f.name: Guillaume Sorouy
3557|1f4f702f.text: You have learned well my child. Go to the Undercity, find a smith named James Van Brunt. He will be able to teach you much that I cannot. I understand he spends his time near the Warriors training hall, forging their weapons and armor.

3557|a43ce262.name: Guillaume Sorouy
3557|a43ce262.text: Your interruption is costing me valuable time, this had better be good.

3557|cd618670.name: Guillaume Sorouy
3557|cd618670.text: Ah yes, another who will stoke the fires and forge the weapons of war. Of course I will teach you how.

3567|0cdab46e.name: Tallonkai Swiftroot
3567|0cdab46e.text: Well met, $N. It is good to see that warriors like yourself are taking an active part in protecting the groves.

3567|8f79505e.name: Tallonkai Swiftroot
3567|8f79505e.text: Well met, $N. It is good to see that hunters like yourself are taking an active part in protecting the groves.

3567|b367f6df.name: Tallonkai Swiftroot
3567|b367f6df.text: Well met, $N. It is good to see that priests like yourself are taking an active part in protecting the groves.

3571|2a249ced.name: Dolanaar Sentinel
3571|2a249ced.text: You will find numerous trainers around Dolanaar with ages of experience with which to tutor you.  Which would you have me point you to?

3571|2e951586.name: Dolanaar Sentinel
3571|2e951586.text: Nadyia has made quite the leatherworker in her years of practice.  Travel west on the road to Darnassus to pay her a visit and maybe she can bestow some of her knowledge upon you.

3571|3f08fa2f.name: Dolanaar Sentinel
3571|3f08fa2f.text: Dazalar is well known around Dolanaar for his hunting skill.  Why don't you talk to him and see what he can teach you?

3571|497f7ea2.name: Dolanaar Sentinel
3571|497f7ea2.text: There are many places that you might visit in Teldrassil.  Tell me what you seek.

3571|75932d8c.name: Dolanaar Sentinel
3571|75932d8c.text: The Timberlings have made it too difficult for the fishermen to catch anything around Dolanaar.  You best look for someone to train you in Darnassus.

3571|98d1ac80.name: Dolanaar Sentinel
3571|98d1ac80.text: Alanna Raveneye attributes part of her talent in enchanting to her communion with the spirits at the Oracle Glade.  You should be able to find her there now.

3571|f844e66a.name: Dolanaar Sentinel
3571|f844e66a.text: The path of those who undertake a profession is long and rewarding.  Which path do you choose to walk?

3595|fed57ab8.name: Shanda
3595|fed57ab8.text: My wisdom is yours, as is my knowledge. What can I do for you, $N?

3596|cf843c85.name: Ayanna Everstride
3596|cf843c85.text: Even within cold, stone walls such as the ones that shelter this town, one may find tranquility and peace.  In fact, you may find them everywhere you are... simply look inside yourself for such balance.

3597|e653c173.name: Mardant Strongoak
3597|e653c173.text:
Welcome, my sister.  If you are here to train, then I would be delighted to train you.

There will be a time soon where the call of the Emerald Dream will take hold in you.  You will hibernate for many years and walk amongst the purest of forms.  It is there and then that your ultimate training will take place.

3598|1c27b384.name: Kyra Windblade
3598|1c27b384.text: Greetings.  Do you seek instruction in art of war?

3598|c8e02354.name: Kyra Windblade
3598|c8e02354.text: I do not see the warrior's spirit within you, child.  I have no teachings which would benefit a $c such as yourself.

3600|fed57ab8.name: Laurna Morninglight
3600|fed57ab8.text: My wisdom is yours, as is my knowledge. What can I do for you, $N?

3601|497f7ea2.name: Dazalar
3601|497f7ea2.text: There are many places that you might visit in Teldrassil.  Tell me what you seek.

3602|61371b1a.name: Kal
3602|61371b1a.text:
Welcome, my sister.  If you are here to train, then I would be delighted to train you.

We are the preservers of the balance, now and forever, as Malfurion lies in the Dreaming.  Never forget this.

3605|08c2dba0.name: Nadyia Maneweaver
3605|08c2dba0.text: You need to make your stitches smaller, $N. Fewer items will slip out of your quivers and ammo pouches. Besides, no one likes a lumpy tunic.

3605|c7a4e3ad.name: Nadyia Maneweaver
3605|c7a4e3ad.text: Welcome to our home, $N. Radnaal and I have little to offer, but you are welcome to what hospitality we can provide.

3606|0ca1ed12.name: Alanna Raveneye
3606|0ca1ed12.text: Elune's secrets are many, but they are not to be shared with just anyone.

3607|279d82d3.name: Androl Oakhand
3607|279d82d3.text: Your skill exceeds mine, though  I've heard that Old Man Heming in Booty Bay has copies of "The Bass and You".  That is sure to help you increase your skill.

3607|c2467ddc.name: Androl Oakhand
3607|c2467ddc.text: I can teach you fishing skills.

3615|ddd7878b.name: Devrak
3615|ddd7878b.text: My wind riders are trained to fly quickly through the hot Barrens air.

3616|29aa26bd.name: Onu
3616|29aa26bd.text:
The wind whispers to those who listen...

Do you hear it?

3624|0e051c59.name: Zudd
3624|0e051c59.text: You've come for training in order to pass it on to your pets?

3649|17d06d6c.name: Thundris Windweaver
3649|17d06d6c.text: Dark forces encroach upon our borders, ancient taints resurface, and new evils emerge to topple the delicate balance of the land. In times of such darkness, we all must be vigilant.

3666|baf00edb.name: Wizbang Cranktoggle
3666|baf00edb.text: Hmm... I can plug this wire in here and that will power the fizzletan gear, but then the hydrophlange will need an alternate power source... Maybe I can... Oh, hello! Hey, want to help me try a new invention?

3682|960c6ca2.name: Vrang Wildgore
3682|960c6ca2.text: Are you in need of a weapon, traveler? You'll not find a finer blade anywhere, I assure you.

3685|3bad330d.name: Harb Clawhoof
3685|3bad330d.text:
Greetings, $c. I am happy Anshe has guided you to me today. I would be proud to sell you one of our finest kodos once you have trained with Kar.

The kodo is a noble beast, but is prone to it's own behaviors that make it different than most steeds. Once you learn from Kar you will have no issues traversing the world with one at your side.

3688|4ef1d72e.name: Reban Freerunner
3688|4ef1d72e.text: Ah friend, I only help hunters and their pets.

3691|3e6c050b.name: Raene Wolfrunner
3691|3e6c050b.text: I know these forests as if they were a part of me... But know that there is still much to be learned from them, and much danger still hidden.

3692|6e5dc9aa.name: Volcor
3692|6e5dc9aa.text:
Well, the way I see it, $N, we have two options to consider for leaving this cave.

We can make our way stealthfully--I use the cloak you've given me, and you'd be left to your own devices, or, and this may be a harder option considering my wounds, we fight our way out back to back.

I'll let you decide since you know your strengths better than I.

3692|966370fe.name: Volcor
3692|966370fe.text:
<Volcor doesn't look at you at all as you get close to him. He seems to be concentrating on keeping his bandages from falling off. After a moment, he looks up at you, a little startled.>

Oh, sorry, $c. Now's not a good time. I hope you understand.

3693|85fc41cc.name: Terenthis
3693|85fc41cc.text:
$N, I've come to find out how rampant the effects of Fel Moss are throughout Darkshore. The corruption of Teldrassil and our surrounding lands really concerns the druids of the Cenarian Circle, and all Night elves.

It is my goal to find out why this has happened and to put an end to it.

3698|0e051c59.name: Bolyun
3698|0e051c59.text: You've come for training in order to pass it on to your pets?

3701|3b2b54ce.name: Tharnariun Treetender
3701|3b2b54ce.text: Greetings High Order $N, I am Tharnariun Treetender.

3702|5ae56d71.name: Alanndarian Nightsong
3702|5ae56d71.text: Hello $r, it is a pleasure to make your acquaintance.

3703|a0a64f07.name: Krulmoo Fullmoon
3703|a0a64f07.text: This blue leather does draw the eye, I know. You see, we have a great many eager recruits running around here, hunting and slaying with more enthusiasm than wisdom. One must take precautions.

3703|b494792c.name: Krulmoo Fullmoon
3703|b494792c.text: I do not offer apprentice training. Look for the tauren Waldor in the Wailing Caverns, here in the Barrens. He can assist you with whatever you need.

3703|c3a4816f.name: Krulmoo Fullmoon
3703|c3a4816f.text: Have you come for further training? Shake the dust of the road from your garments, then, and let us get to work.

3704|f0b17ebd.name: Mahani
3704|f0b17ebd.text: You still have lessons to learn before I may begin your training. In the meantime, perhaps Vhan, in Thunder Bluff can help you.

3706|10137e12.name: Tai'jin
3706|10137e12.text: I do what me can to train you in the priestly ways, if that what you be here for.

3706|be30b49b.name: Tai'jin
3706|be30b49b.text: You be watchin' yerself, $c. Respect our ways, or a curse be on you and yours.

3707|10137e12.name: Ken'jai
3707|10137e12.text: I do what me can to train you in the priestly ways, if that what you be here for.

375|3df2cbb2.name: Priestess Anetta
375|3df2cbb2.text: Do not turn your back on the Light, $c, it may be the one thing that saves you some day.

375|bab8ec77.name: Priestess Anetta
375|bab8ec77.text: I trust the Light is with you, $N. Is there something that I can I help you with?

376|8fca8484.name: High Priestess Laurena
376|8fca8484.text: If you desire, in addition to training, I have it within my power to erase the knowledge of your talents from your mind.  Be warned that every time you undergo this procedure the more difficult it is to perform, and therefore the more expensive it becomes.

377|3df2cbb2.name: Priestess Josetta
377|3df2cbb2.text: Do not turn your back on the Light, $c, it may be the one thing that saves you some day.

377|bab8ec77.name: Priestess Josetta
377|bab8ec77.text: I trust the Light is with you, $N. Is there something that I can I help you with?

381|50146e32.name: Dockmaster Baren
381|50146e32.text: Well met, $C.  If you're here for business, then get yourself a brew and we'll have ourselves a talk.

382|04802d87.name: Marshal Marris
382|04802d87.text: I don't have time to chat, citizen, but if you're willing to give us a hand against the orcs, then I'll find a use for you.

3836|89b547f0.name: Mountaineer Pebblebitty
3836|89b547f0.text:
I don't care to hear it, $N. Nope, no way are you going to be let into the Searing Gorge. Impossible. Not going to happen. How many times do I have to tell you - I can't let you in! Do you not speak common? Are you an orc in disguise? N-O. NO!

If I let you in, then I have to let everybody in. Pretty soon your close friends will want in, then their distant relatives, then their friends, and so on and so forth. The last time that happened... well, we won't talk about the last time it happened.

3838|43c9021b.name: Vesprystus
3838|43c9021b.text: To maintain our link to the mainland, we have hippogryphs constantly flying between Rut'theran Village and Darkshore.

3841|ab4871bb.name: Caylais Moonfeather
3841|ab4871bb.text: The Hippogryph is a noble beast, proud and swift.  They are an honor to train, and can quickly take their rider a great distance.

3845|10ec66f1.name: Shindrell Swiftfire
3845|10ec66f1.text: We elves have a long history.  Let us hope this history does not return to haunt us.

3848|416c9861.name: Kayneth Stillwind
3848|416c9861.text: The balance of nature is a delicate one, and easily tipped.  Are you brave enough to make things right?

384|fccbd4ef.name: Katie Hunter
384|fccbd4ef.text:
Sorry, but I am not disposed to sell horses to any individual who is not considered to be at least exalted to the Kingdom of Stormwind.  These steeds are the finest you'll find anywhere, and we certainly wouldn't want them in the hands of our enemies.

Not saying you're an enemy, of course... just earn the trust of Stormwind and then we can do business.

3885|d83258b9.name: Sentinel Velene Starstrike
3885|d83258b9.text:
Have you seen the befouled water elementals in our lake, $N? It is a sorry sight, but I do not know where they are coming from.

Your name has been mentioned in conversations past, perhaps you could help me with this problem.

The first thing we must learn is who is in control of these elementals.

392|9183bb21.name: Captain Grayson
392|9183bb21.text: Do not be alarmed, $r.  I have long since passed from this land but I intend no harm to your kind.  I have witnessed too much death in my time.  My only wish now is for peace.  Perhaps you can help my cause.

3934|0f322cd8.name: Innkeeper Boorand Plainswind
3934|0f322cd8.text: The old kingdom of Lordaeron is perilous. We urge caution for anyone who dares to venture into the now decaying lands of Tirisfal Glades. If you must, find the Undercity; the upper courtyards are what you seek.

3934|886683cb.name: Innkeeper Boorand Plainswind
3934|886683cb.text: The old kingdom of Lordaeron is perilous. We urge caution for anyone who dares to venture into the now decaying lands of Tirisfal Glades. If you must, find the Undercity and the upper courtyards are what you seek.

3934|c3a29bdb.name: Innkeeper Boorand Plainswind
3934|c3a29bdb.text:
Our ancient lands are in the northeast of the Eastern Kingdom. Named after Lordain himself, it was once a proud and powerful kingdom. Its history is rich and offers many lessons to upstart nobles and kings. One of its defining moments was assisting in the foundation of the Alliance that we know today.

Unfortunately, its history is also dark, and its current inhabitants defile its lands day by day. There is still much of significance in the ruins that now rest above the Undercity, but it is folly to attempt that journey and expect to return still among the living.

3934|e013de07.name: Innkeeper Boorand Plainswind
3934|e013de07.text: As the wind on the plains, you are always welcome here.

3934|e0b9e88a.name: Innkeeper Boorand Plainswind
3934|e0b9e88a.text:
Our ancient lands in the north east of the Eastern Kingdom. Named after Lordain himself, it was once a proud and powerful kingdom. Its history is rich and serves as many lessons to upstart nobles and kings. One of its defining moments was assisting in the foundation of the Alliance that we know today.

Unfortunately its history is also dark, and its current inhabitants defile its lands day by day. There is still much of significance in the ruins that now rest above the Undercity but it is folly to attempt that journey and expect to return still among the living.

3963|c8a70fb5.name: Danlaar Nightstride
3963|c8a70fb5.text: What can I do for you my child?

3967|01c9a17b.name: Aayndia Floralwind
3967|01c9a17b.text: Always double-check your measurements before you begin to cut the leather. We cannot afford to waste materials.

4046|d98be16b.name: Magatha Grimtotem
4046|d98be16b.text: You must listen, young $c.  Listen to the whisperings in the darkness, for they offer guidance in these troubled times.

4049|65e1afb2.name: Seereth Stonebreak
4049|65e1afb2.text: The spirit of Stonetalon weeps.  It weeps from its mountain peaks, to its rivers, to its severed, dying trees.

4077|a1373701.name: Gaxim Rustfizzle
4077|a1373701.text:
If I can get the proper ingredients, we can create some explosives that will not only allow me to damage the Venture's Co.'s operations, but also cause a distraction.

I know you're impressed, but it gets better... I'll tell you more soon enough.

4078|8a5b6577.name: Collin Mauren
4078|8a5b6577.text: Hello, friend. What can I do for you?

4087|1c27b384.name: Arias'ta Bladesinger
4087|1c27b384.text: Greetings.  Do you seek instruction in art of war?

4088|c486e91d.name: Elanaria
4088|c486e91d.text: A $c's path is one of determination, sister.  It may begin with strength of arms, but it endures through force of will.

4091|fed57ab8.name: Jandria
4091|fed57ab8.text: My wisdom is yours, as is my knowledge. What can I do for you, $N?

4092|fed57ab8.name: Lariia
4092|fed57ab8.text: My wisdom is yours, as is my knowledge. What can I do for you, $N?

4146|08830bac.name: Jocaste
4146|08830bac.text: Through rigorous retraining I have had to break many students of all they had previously learned so that I might teach them anew.  The service I offer becomes increasingly difficult to perform each time it is done.  It is for that reason that it becomes increasingly expensive with each retraining.  Do you desire that I break you of the talents you have learned?

4155|c78f83ac.name: Idriana
4155|c78f83ac.text: Welcome to the Bank of Darnassus. We offer financial accounts and safety deposit boxes for valuable items. Do you already have an account with us ma'am?

4156|279d82d3.name: Astaia
4156|279d82d3.text: Your skill exceeds mine, though  I've heard that Old Man Heming in Booty Bay has copies of "The Bass and You".  That is sure to help you increase your skill.

4156|c2467ddc.name: Astaia
4156|c2467ddc.text: I can teach you fishing skills.

415|26f5a1f4.name: Verner Osgood
415|26f5a1f4.text: Hey ma'am, do you think you could give me a hand with something?  I'm really in dire straits here...

415|fca64b70.name: Verner Osgood
415|fca64b70.text: Hey buddy, do you think you could give me a hand with something?  I'm really in dire straits here...

4163|2ae1d72b.name: Syurna
4163|2ae1d72b.text: Greetings young rogue. What do you seek?

4165|1c7cd7a4.name: Elissa Dumas
4165|1c7cd7a4.text: I do not believe you possess the mental acuity to grasp the nature of portal magic.

4165|6e89a35a.name: Elissa Dumas
4165|6e89a35a.text: As a mage, you are one of a select group that can conjure a portal to transport you back to this very place.  I can teach you if you are ready.

4184|dd12f193.name: Geenia Sunshadow
4184|dd12f193.text:
Ishnu-alah, traveler, and welcome to Nighthaven.

Would you like to browse my selection of fine dresses?

4193|47d82412.name: Grondal Moonbreeze
4193|47d82412.text: I would be happy to take you under my wing. Let us begin.

4200|c2e88775.name: Laird
4200|c2e88775.text: Although the coast of Darkshore is more dangerous than that of Teldrassil, many fishers find profit here.

4210|0c543544.name: Alegorn
4210|0c543544.text: Cooking is a life long pursuit and I see we share the same passion!

4211|a28d29e1.name: Dannelor
4211|a28d29e1.text: I can train you in First Aid techniques.

4212|f099e750.name: Telonis
4212|f099e750.text: Do not try to force your will upon the leather. Rather, let its natural tendencies dictate what form and function it will take. This is not a battle to be won. Work with the leather, not against it.

4213|bbaf25e8.name: Taladan
4213|bbaf25e8.text: You have not yet learned the basics, wanderer. Have you spoken to my assistant, Lalina Summermoon? Perhaps you should.

4214|2ae1d72b.name: Erion Shadewhisper
4214|2ae1d72b.text: Greetings young rogue. What do you seek?

4217|34f0a84a.name: Mathrengyl Bearwalker
4217|34f0a84a.text:
Welcome, my sister.  If you are here to train, then I would be delighted to train you.

There are rumors of strife within the Cenarion Circle, but you should pay such loose talk no heed.  Our Arch Druid, Fandral Staghelm, leads us and all of Teldrassil to glory!

4217|54c391c0.name: Mathrengyl Bearwalker
4217|54c391c0.text: What brings you to the Cenarion Circle, $N?

4218|34f0a84a.name: Denatharion
4218|34f0a84a.text:
Welcome, my sister.  If you are here to train, then I would be delighted to train you.

There are rumors of strife within the Cenarion Circle, but you should pay such loose talk no heed.  Our Arch Druid, Fandral Staghelm, leads us and all of Teldrassil to glory!

4218|8fca8484.name: Denatharion
4218|8fca8484.text: If you desire, in addition to training, I have it within my power to erase the knowledge of your talents from your mind.  Be warned that every time you undergo this procedure the more difficult it is to perform, and therefore the more expensive it becomes.

4219|34f0a84a.name: Fylerian Nightwing
4219|34f0a84a.text:
Welcome, my sister.  If you are here to train, then I would be delighted to train you.

There are rumors of strife within the Cenarion Circle, but you should pay such loose talk no heed.  Our Arch Druid, Fandral Staghelm, leads us and all of Teldrassil to glory!

4219|8fca8484.name: Fylerian Nightwing
4219|8fca8484.text: If you desire, in addition to training, I have it within my power to erase the knowledge of your talents from your mind.  Be warned that every time you undergo this procedure the more difficult it is to perform, and therefore the more expensive it becomes.

4241|b0e0696e.name: Mydrannul
4241|b0e0696e.text: It is my honor to provide for adventurers, for they are heroes in the making.

4256|d1bed30c.name: Golnir Bouldertoe
4256|d1bed30c.text: If you ask me, there's no greater profession than a miner.  And if you ask me, there's no greater miner than a dwarf!

4256|ec4d19c0.name: Golnir Bouldertoe
4256|ec4d19c0.text: If you ask me, there's no greater profession than a miner.  And if you ask me, there's no greater miner than a dwarf!

4258|92cfadea.name: Bengus Deepforge
4258|92cfadea.text: I'm sorry lad but ye just don't have the foundation to learn what I have to teach. But don't fret, go speak with my student Rotgath, he'll help ye out.

4258|965533ff.name: Bengus Deepforge
4258|965533ff.text: Welcome to the Great Forge lad. It may be cold outside but we keep it nice and hot down 'ere. Grab a hammer, strike that anvil and show me ye've got what it takes to be a Blacksmith of the Great Forge!

4262|0b538a46.name: Darnassus Sentinel
4262|0b538a46.text: It is Vesprystus that you seek.  He watches over the hippogryphs that come and go from the base of Teldrassil.  You will find him through the portal in western Darnassus that will take you to Rut'theran Village.

4262|12086219.name: Darnassus Sentinel
4262|12086219.text: A time consuming, yet rewarding skill.  Speak with Astaia in the Tradesman's Terrace and maybe you'll learn something useful.

4262|1a4941ed.name: Darnassus Sentinel
4262|1a4941ed.text: I'm flattered, but really I'm not interested... What?  You want to know where to learn enchanting?  Oh, how embarrassing!  Well, you should...  I'm sure you could... go see, um...  Taladan!  Yes, see Taladan over in the Craftsmen's Terrace!

4262|20933114.name: Darnassus Sentinel
4262|20933114.text: Through the milennia, Ilyenia Moonfire has mastered numerous weapons and now offers to train others in their use.  You can find her at the Warrior's Terrace if you desire training.

4262|21ab523d.name: Darnassus Sentinel
4262|21ab523d.text: Here in Darnassus you will find skilled trainers who have perfected the skills of their chosen class through ages of training and dedication.  I will guide you to one who can become your mentor, you have but to name your chosen path.

4262|5a295268.name: Darnassus Sentinel
4262|5a295268.text: Another material girl are we?  Well, if you are obsessed with your precious items then you will probably want to store them at the Darnassus Bank in the center of our city.

4262|84b403e6.name: Darnassus Sentinel
4262|84b403e6.text: Astaia has fished up some curious treasures over the ages she has spent fishing.  Why don't you go see her over in the Tradesman's terrace and have her show you some of them.

4262|90df76a3.name: Darnassus Sentinel
4262|90df76a3.text:
Ah, are you looking perhaps to change your markings, or prepare for a hunt? There is no better place.

You will find the barber in the Tradesman's Terrace, near the auction house.

4262|96761fec.name: Darnassus Sentinel
4262|96761fec.text: In grizzly times a druid can be a dear friend to those around them.  Ask any of the druids in the Cenarion Enclave and they will tell you the same.

4262|9bd51f3f.name: Darnassus Sentinel
4262|9bd51f3f.text: Oh, the ever-present obsession with material wealth.  Well, fortune smiles on you, as you can find the auction house in the Tradesman's Terrace.

4262|ce424d00.name: Darnassus Sentinel
4262|ce424d00.text: Of all the wondrous places within Darnassus, which would you have me direct you to?

4262|d3a25a4e.name: Darnassus Sentinel
4262|d3a25a4e.text: Alegorn is a masterful chef who has had centuries with which to perfect his cooking.  You should consider yourself blessed should he decide to teach you.  If you believe you are worthy, you can find him in the Craftsmen's Terrace.

4262|d7aed8f7.name: Darnassus Sentinel
4262|d7aed8f7.text: Vesprystus' hippogryphs will bear you swiftly to your destination.  Seek him out in Rut'theran Village, through the portal which lies in the western section of Darnassus.

4262|e07232c6.name: Darnassus Sentinel
4262|e07232c6.text: Here among the craftsmen of Darnassus, there is a millenium of knowledge for the benefit of your chosen craft.  Now tell me, which craft do you find the most intriguing?

4262|e66389a6.name: Darnassus Sentinel
4262|e66389a6.text: One has opened up on the Tradesman's Terrace.  If you take the path leading Southeast from the bank, it should be easy to find.

4262|e74436e4.name: Darnassus Sentinel
4262|e74436e4.text: With the garments that Me'Lynn tailors, one might think that her needle was blessed by Elune herself.  Unless your needle is so blessed, you best pay her a visit and listen to her teachings.  You can find her in The Craftsmen's Terrace in northeastern Darnassus.

4262|f71d5637.name: Darnassus Sentinel
4262|f71d5637.text: The skill with which Telonis crafts armor is beyond compare.  You should be grateful that he does not charge more for the knowledge he passes to others.  Go now and seek him out in the Craftsmen's Terrace in the northeast section of Darnassus.

4267|c5ceacbe.name: Daelyshia
4267|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

4312|c5ceacbe.name: Tharm
4312|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

4319|c5ceacbe.name: Thyssiana
4319|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

4320|0e051c59.name: Caelyb
4320|0e051c59.text: You've come for training in order to pass it on to your pets?

4321|c5ceacbe.name: Baldruc
4321|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

4407|c5ceacbe.name: Teloren
4407|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

4452|a84fd61d.name: Kravel Koalbeard
4452|a84fd61d.text:
Come a little closer.  We have important matters to discuss, you and I.

And some of them we don't want everyone to hear...

4453|f1c43d2c.name: Wizzle Brassbolts
4453|f1c43d2c.text: Be careful where you put that foot of yours, mister. We're not all blessed with the lofty height of a $r.

4456|0be64368.name: Fiora Longears
4456|0be64368.text: No, Longears isn't my real name.  And I'm not going to tell you what it is, so don't ask.

4488|642d4f58.name: Parqual Fintallas
4488|642d4f58.text: It's always nice when someone wishes to speak to me. How are things with you, $c?

4489|d4f863ac.name: Braug Dimspirit
4489|d4f863ac.text: Greetings, $c. Is there something I can help you with?

4489|d9f65c9b.name: Braug Dimspirit
4489|d9f65c9b.text:
My question to you is this, $c:
Which of the Aspects created by the titans became the nefarious creature known as Deathwing?

4551|d37b59d0.name: Michael Garrett
4551|d37b59d0.text: How may I be of service?

4552|0c543544.name: Eunice Burch
4552|0c543544.text: Cooking is a life long pursuit and I see we share the same passion!

4552|48c1c064.name: Eunice Burch
4552|48c1c064.text: Wulan in Shadowprey Village can sell you the "Expert Cookbook".  You will need that if you are to better yourself.

4556|3dfe0528.name: Gordon Wendham
4556|3dfe0528.text: Greetings, and welcome.  I am not very good at smiling, but trust me; I am happy to serve you.

4563|031480cd.name: Kaal Soulreaper
4563|031480cd.text: You know enough to be dangerous, but you still look like you need training to me $N.

4563|8fca8484.name: Kaal Soulreaper
4563|8fca8484.text: If you desire, in addition to training, I have it within my power to erase the knowledge of your talents from your mind.  Be warned that every time you undergo this procedure the more difficult it is to perform, and therefore the more expensive it becomes.

4564|8fca8484.name: Luther Pickman
4564|8fca8484.text: If you desire, in addition to training, I have it within my power to erase the knowledge of your talents from your mind.  Be warned that every time you undergo this procedure the more difficult it is to perform, and therefore the more expensive it becomes.

4564|db7f8bbb.name: Luther Pickman
4564|db7f8bbb.text: It is wise that you humble yourself before me $N in your desire for more $c knowledge.

4565|8fca8484.name: Richard Kerwin
4565|8fca8484.text: If you desire, in addition to training, I have it within my power to erase the knowledge of your talents from your mind.  Be warned that every time you undergo this procedure the more difficult it is to perform, and therefore the more expensive it becomes.

4565|db7f8bbb.name: Richard Kerwin
4565|db7f8bbb.text: It is wise that you humble yourself before me $N in your desire for more $c knowledge.

4566|7d510daf.name: Kaelystia Hatebringer
4566|7d510daf.text: Greetings.  I'm an $r $c trainer, and you're a $c.

4567|7d510daf.name: Pierce Shackleton
4567|7d510daf.text: Greetings.  I'm an $r $c trainer, and you're a $c.

4568|7d510daf.name: Anastasia Hartwell
4568|7d510daf.text: Greetings.  I'm an $r $c trainer, and you're a $c.

4568|a9a4b6a0.name: Anastasia Hartwell
4568|a9a4b6a0.text: Greetings.  I'm an undead mage trainer, and you're a mage.

4573|c2467ddc.name: Armand Cromwell
4573|c2467ddc.text: I can teach you fishing skills.

4576|4eaf08fa.name: Josef Gregorian
4576|4eaf08fa.text: I will instruct you when the time is right... that time is not now. You have much more to learn first!

4576|9f6a1af5.name: Josef Gregorian
4576|9f6a1af5.text: Cloth is okay. Personally I prefer to work with human skin.

4578|fd111c9e.name: Josephine Lister
4578|fd111c9e.text: Between the light and the dark, there is shadow... and those shadows have powers you have yet to see.

4586|44242a57.name: Graham Van Talen
4586|44242a57.text: The Dark Lady has said that knowledge will be our greatest weapon in this war.

4586|522afbdc.name: Graham Van Talen
4586|522afbdc.text: Engineering will provide you with the skills and knowledge to dismantle your opponents! Let me show you how...

4586|98e8b89f.name: Graham Van Talen
4586|98e8b89f.text: You are ready for greater things! See Franklin Lloyd, to my right. He will guide you from now on.

4588|4d29b093.name: Arthur Moore
4588|4d29b093.text: I first set up shop in the Magic Quarter, but it was pretty noisy there. This is a definite improvement, barring a few persistent students who still track me down, despite the fact that I've relocated.

4591|34baaaf3.name: Mary Edras
4591|34baaaf3.text: Only the renowned Doctor Gregory Victor can improve your skill now.  He can be found in Arathi Highlands at Hammerfall.

4591|43457c57.name: Mary Edras
4591|43457c57.text: Balai Lok'Wein of Brackenwall Village in Dustwallow Marsh sells a manual that you will need to study in order to improve your skills!

4591|a28d29e1.name: Mary Edras
4591|a28d29e1.text: I can train you in First Aid techniques.

4593|ed01dd60.name: Christoph Walker
4593|ed01dd60.text: The warrior's role is one of protection.  Just as we protect our compatriots in battle, we must also protect the interests of the Forsaken.

4595|08830bac.name: Baltus Fowler
4595|08830bac.text: Through rigorous retraining I have had to break many students of all they had previously learned so that I might teach them anew.  The service I offer becomes increasingly difficult to perform each time it is done.  It is for that reason that it becomes increasingly expensive with each retraining.  Do you desire that I break you of the talents you have learned?

4595|ed01dd60.name: Baltus Fowler
4595|ed01dd60.text: The warrior's role is one of protection.  Just as we protect our compatriots in battle, we must also protect the interests of the Forsaken.

4596|256d7671.name: James Van Brunt
4596|256d7671.text: Very fine equipment you make, very fine indeed. Go to the Orc's home of Orgrimmar and seek out a smith named Saru Steelfury. One thing you must give the Orcs, they make beautiful instruments of death.

4596|60f0c131.name: James Van Brunt
4596|60f0c131.text: You waste my time, go talk with my student Basil.

4596|b22b0c37.name: James Van Brunt
4596|b22b0c37.text: How is the edge of your steel? Good enough to cut through the belly of your enemy? Let me show you some things to make it even sharper.

459|710d6c2c.name: Drusilla La Salle
459|710d6c2c.text: The arcane only corrupts those who are weak. Even if you do not follow the path of the warlock, you would do well to remember that.

4604|3a39b135.name: Abigail Sawyer
4604|3a39b135.text: Words are like arrows. Once loosed, you cannot call them back.

4605|1690954e.name: Basil Frye
4605|1690954e.text: I hope to one day forge weapons and armor from the bones of my enemies.

4605|3a5f002e.name: Basil Frye
4605|3a5f002e.text: You are not trying to kill the anvil with your hammer, you are trying to create a weapon to kill your foes with. Let me show you what you are doing wrong.

4605|e9a5758c.name: Basil Frye
4605|e9a5758c.text: You have learned much, more than I can teach. Go to James Van Brunt, he will teach you what I cannot.

4606|39920e92.name: Aelthalyste
4606|39920e92.text: What can this insignificant servant do for you, $N? Training perhaps?

4606|8fca8484.name: Aelthalyste
4606|8fca8484.text: If you desire, in addition to training, I have it within my power to erase the knowledge of your talents from your mind.  Be warned that every time you undergo this procedure the more difficult it is to perform, and therefore the more expensive it becomes.

4607|39920e92.name: Father Lankester
4607|39920e92.text: What can this insignificant servant do for you, $N? Training perhaps?

4608|39920e92.name: Father Lazarus
4608|39920e92.text: What can this insignificant servant do for you, $N? Training perhaps?

4608|8fca8484.name: Father Lazarus
4608|8fca8484.text: If you desire, in addition to training, I have it within my power to erase the knowledge of your talents from your mind.  Be warned that every time you undergo this procedure the more difficult it is to perform, and therefore the more expensive it becomes.

4609|513a5440.name: Doctor Marsh
4609|513a5440.text: Here to learn? Very well. I suppose you can't cause our allies much harm if I teach you. Just as long as you actually do manage to harm our enemies.

4609|eb5176e5.name: Doctor Marsh
4609|eb5176e5.text: I have no more knowledge to bestow upon you. Go through the archway and down the ramp to the southeast, and talk to Doctor Herbert Halsey. He is a Forsaken who can teach you more advanced techniques.

460|86b6c1ef.name: Alamar Grimm
460|86b6c1ef.text: The arcane only corrupts those who are weak. Keep up on your training, or you may find a similar fate.

460|d86378ed.name: Alamar Grimm
460|d86378ed.text: I'm afraid your darkness quotient isn't sufficient enough for me to bother talking to you any further.  Move along please.

4611|9599a03e.name: Doctor Herbert Halsey
4611|9599a03e.text: Incredible. Your potions display a knowledge that rivals my own. I cannot train you further, but talk to the orc Rogvar of Stonard in the Swamp of Sorrows. He's known for his cutting-edge experiments.

4611|a5e18acf.name: Doctor Herbert Halsey
4611|a5e18acf.text: Ready for training? Then try to keep up, $N. We've got a lot of ground to cover.

4611|caaefc10.name: Doctor Herbert Halsey
4611|caaefc10.text: My colleagues and I are gathering the deadliest substances we know and testing their effects on our enemies. Once I have everything I need, I shall brew such plagues as this world has never seen.

4611|ef68dfe2.name: Doctor Herbert Halsey
4611|ef68dfe2.text: You don't yet have the skill to study with me. Go talk to Doctor Martin Felben over there, or go up the ramp to the southeast and see Doctor Marsh. They are Forsaken who can give you the training you need.

4613|c46004b8.name: Christopher Drakul
4613|c46004b8.text: Welcome to the Undercity Guild Registry. What do you want?

4616|6d8c45cf.name: Lavinia Crowe
4616|6d8c45cf.text: If I wasn't stuck here day in and day out, I would have attained the mastery required to train the likes of you! Unfortunately that's not the case. Go talk to Hgarth at the Sun Rock Retreat in the Stonetalon Mountains.

4616|9948e984.name: Lavinia Crowe
4616|9948e984.text: No, no, you'll need FAR more training before you're ready to learn from me! Go talk to that uptight dabbler Malcomb Wynn. He's the one buried in books over there.

4616|ac0ef905.name: Lavinia Crowe
4616|ac0ef905.text: Hmm, you scratch my back, I'll scratch yours. If you do what I ask, and do it well, maybe we can discuss your training.

461|86b6c1ef.name: Demisette Cloyce
461|86b6c1ef.text: The arcane only corrupts those who are weak. Keep up on your training, or you may find a similar fate.

4631|66df9383.name: Wharfmaster Lozgil
4631|66df9383.text:
So you're here for the Warsong axes. Well, it's about time, $N. That crate has been sitting out there for days, now.

Feel free to haul it away whenever you are ready.

4631|73ea7c56.name: Wharfmaster Lozgil
4631|73ea7c56.text: I see some interesting characters come and go here at the port. Watch yourself, $N. It's never clear who to trust, what with all of the shady activity that goes on here...

464|8234ebcf.name: Guard Parker
464|8234ebcf.text: Hail, $C.  Ill times these are, my friend, for our town is besieged!  The Blackrock Orcs attack from Stonewatch Keep, the Shadowhides loom over the Tower of Ilgalar, and the Redridge Gnoll Pack gathers strength.  I hope you're not here for a holiday...

4730|aa0a0c2b.name: Lelanai
4730|aa0a0c2b.text: Alas $c, you are not considered to be exalted to Darnassus and the night elves of Teldrassil.  Only when you prove yourself to us through deeds - not just mere words - will I then make available my selection of mounts for your perusal.

4730|d1765a81.name: Lelanai
4730|d1765a81.text: Hello, friend! I would be happy to offer you a riding saber, but first you should train with Jartsam over there. These fearless creatures are not easily ridden, but once you know how to ride one you will not find a better companion.

4731|52a47c36.name: Zachariah Post
4731|52a47c36.text:
I have little time to sit and have idle banter with you. If you desire one of my steeds, seek Velma over there and she will teach you how to ride a skeletal steed.

I would not have you harming one of my beautiful horses with your ignorance.

4752|f60c8a5b.name: Kildar
4752|f60c8a5b.text: You need to be exalted with the orcs of Orgrimmar before I will teach you a riding skill, $c.

4753|b87a8862.name: Jartsam
4753|b87a8862.text: I can teach you the finer points of Tiger Riding, provided you have enough gold to cover the lesson!

4753|fd225a01.name: Jartsam
4753|fd225a01.text: You need to be exalted with the night elves of Darnassus before I will teach you a riding skill, $c.

4772|044f5b87.name: Ultham Ironhorn
4772|044f5b87.text: I can teach you the finer points of Ram Riding, provided you have enough gold to cover the lesson!

4773|0450da3d.name: Velma Warnam
4773|0450da3d.text: I can teach you the finer points of Skeletal Horse Riding, provided you have enough gold to cover the lesson!

483|ed056522.name: Elaine Trias
483|ed056522.text: Best deals in all of Stormwind my friend, won't find any better. Now, what can I help you with?

483|fe52f4ea.name: Elaine Trias
483|fe52f4ea.text: Just browsing my wares or is there something specific I can help you find today?

4877|fe134d60.name: Jandia
4877|fe134d60.text: Hail, friend. Can I interest you in any of my trade supplies?

4895|8ee6c481.name: Smiling Jim
4895|8ee6c481.text:
He'll bring you mead
He'll bring you beer
A grinning face from ear to ear
He's served us all from year to year
We call him Smiling Jim.

491|02f3f1d4.name: Quartermaster Lewis
491|02f3f1d4.text: I try to keep Sentinel Hill stocked, and that's not easy with all the action we see.

4944|dc13909f.name: Captain Garran Vimes
4944|dc13909f.text: The guards of Theramore are the finest group of Alliance soldiers based in Kalimdor. It is our duty to uphold the laws of the Alliance even so far away from our homes.

4949|9255c79c.name: Thrall
4949|9255c79c.text:
It would be wise to explain to you the depths at which our enemies will go to to hide themselves under our noses.

Know this first and foremost: our enemy is the Shadow Council. No matter what task I give you, or who I ask you to act against, know that one simple fact.

Many cults exist within the Council, but only to hide its actions against the foolish.

Groups like the Burning Blade, the Argus Wake, and the Searing Blade are all tools of the Council. Consider them one and the same.

4949|9a2b62b8.name: Thrall
4949|9a2b62b8.text:
All members of the Horde are equal in my eyes, $N. We have all suffered many burdens, and if it were not for wisdom and honor, then we would be no better than the Scourge or my people while our blood was tainted by the demon Mannoroth.

It is your duty to aid the Horde and to defend our way of life. But it is also your duty to know when quarter and compassion should be given to friend and foe alike.

Understand this well. This is the new Horde, not some demon-spawned army who lack freewill.

4974|e9a7b43b.name: Aldwin Laughlin
4974|e9a7b43b.text: Welcome to the Stormwind Guild Registry offices. What can I help you with today?

4981|ed056522.name: Ben Trias
4981|ed056522.text: Best deals in all of Stormwind my friend, won't find any better. Now, what can I help you with?

4981|fe52f4ea.name: Ben Trias
4981|fe52f4ea.text: Just browsing my wares or is there something specific I can help you find today?

5054|8118a9f0.name: Krumn
5054|8118a9f0.text: Our ancestors teach us that while the individual must be strong, there is safety in numbers.  Do you wish to defend the honor of Thunder Bluff by organizing a guild?

5111|b63e4e81.name: Innkeeper Firebrew
5111|b63e4e81.text: Fill yer tankard and pull up a chair. We've stories to tell and kegs to empty.

5113|b02b9fad.name: Kelv Sternhammer
5113|b02b9fad.text: The big wars might be over, for now, but we still have to keep our skills sharp!

5114|08830bac.name: Bilban Tosslespanner
5114|08830bac.text: Through rigorous retraining I have had to break many students of all they had previously learned so that I might teach them anew.  The service I offer becomes increasingly difficult to perform each time it is done.  It is for that reason that it becomes increasingly expensive with each retraining.  Do you desire that I break you of the talents you have learned?

5114|5e0897b4.name: Bilban Tosslespanner
5114|5e0897b4.text: Excellent! You meet the required parameters and specifications. What can I do for you?

5115|a665cdb8.name: Daera Brightspear
5115|a665cdb8.text: Wot kin I do fer ye?

5116|8329ccbb.name: Olmin Burningbeard
5116|8329ccbb.text: If you're here to be trained in the tactics and strategy of hunting, you've come to the right place!

5117|a665cdb8.name: Regnus Thundergranite
5117|a665cdb8.text: Wot kin I do fer ye?

5118|c1128f0f.name: Brogun Stoneshield
5118|c1128f0f.text: Aye lad are ye ready to head to Alterac Valley and give the Horde a taste o' what they been asking for?

5127|3211cb36.name: Fimble Finespindle
5127|3211cb36.text: Well, I declare! It's a new student! I'll gladly teach you everything I know once you have a little more skill. Go talk to Gretta Finespindle over there, would you? She'll have you up to speed in no time.

5127|62ce6712.name: Fimble Finespindle
5127|62ce6712.text: Lots to do! Haven't been this busy since my cousin accidentally vaporized all the cloth and leather in Gnomeregan. My, it was drafty for a while! Ah, $N, those were the days....

5127|dd957ca2.name: Fimble Finespindle
5127|dd957ca2.text: Your skills are coming along nicely. Soon you'll be running a leather shop of your own. I'll be glad for the help, $N. My hands are only so fast, you know? There's so much work to do!

5130|61be34c3.name: Jondor Steelbrow
5130|61be34c3.text: Aye, you look the type to be a leader.  Here to organize a guild to fight for the Alliance?

5144|c2a278c1.name: Bink
5144|c2a278c1.text: Greetings.  I'm a $r $c trainer, and you're a $c.

5145|c2a278c1.name: Juli Stormkettle
5145|c2a278c1.text: Greetings.  I'm a $r $c trainer, and you're a $c.

5147|2583dfa7.name: Valgar Highforge
5147|2583dfa7.text: The Light be with ya, $c. How can I help ya?

5149|837f02f9.name: Brandur Ironhammer
5149|837f02f9.text: May the Light protect you this day.

514|9b2500eb.name: Smith Argus
514|9b2500eb.text: Of course I can help you with training. I'm just a journeyman myself, but I'm sure there's something I can show you.

514|aa4da6d8.name: Smith Argus
514|aa4da6d8.text: If you'd like to learn how to blacksmith your own weapons and armor, I'd be happy to help.

514|ca5296f2.name: Smith Argus
514|ca5296f2.text: I don't admit this lightly, but you are a far better smith than I am. If you want to learn more than my meager teachings then I suggest you seek out a Dwarf named Therum Deepforge in Stormwind. You will find him in the Dwarven District.

5150|942980f4.name: Nissa Firestone
5150|942980f4.text: Are you a student of the medical sciences?

5150|c2e96a28.name: Nissa Firestone
5150|c2e96a28.text: The esteemed Doctor Gustaf VanHowzen can train you further.  He can be found in Theramore treating the wounded at the barracks.

5153|48757048.name: Jormund Stonebrow
5153|48757048.text: Well, aren't you the smarty-pants? Ye know more than I do, I can tell ye that! Don't go getting' a big head, but if ye want to keep learnin', have a chat with Georgio Bolero in Stormwind. They say he knows his tailorin'!

5153|4acd68fa.name: Jormund Stonebrow
5153|4acd68fa.text: Hmm... you show a little promise, I'll give you that. Okay then, where were we?

5153|65dd6697.name: Jormund Stonebrow
5153|65dd6697.text: Ah, this Darnassian fabric is the finest!

5153|ab3a58ee.name: Jormund Stonebrow
5153|ab3a58ee.text: I don't have time to babysit! Go talk to me assistant, Uthrar!

5157|2d217d8f.name: Gimble Thistlefuzz
5157|2d217d8f.text: What do I look like, the Grand Poobah of enchanters? Your skills require the guidance of an Artisan! Go find Kitta Firewind at the Tower of Azora.

5157|7805515d.name: Gimble Thistlefuzz
5157|7805515d.text: Great, let's get started... ha! Fooled you! Surely you didn't think it would be that simple. You'll need to prove your mettle just like everyone else!

5157|dfaa46dd.name: Gimble Thistlefuzz
5157|dfaa46dd.text: You're joking, right? I believe you're looking for the OTHER short fellow, Thonys Pillarstone. He's downstairs. Now skedaddle!

5159|9af6c3de.name: Daryl Riknussun
5159|9af6c3de.text: I keep 'em fed, kid. Yep, Daryl Riknussun, at yer service.

5161|6aaffb9a.name: Grimnur Stonebrand
5161|6aaffb9a.text: Yap, I can teach ye to fish.

5161|837eac47.name: Grimnur Stonebrand
5161|837eac47.text: You will need to find Nat Pagle in Dustwallow Marsh to get any better than you are currently.

5164|105bb6dd.name: Grumnus Steelshaper
5164|105bb6dd.text: Ye bothered me for that? Ye'd be better off strapping a dead rabbit to yer back and running through a Troll's den than wearing that piece of garbage.

5164|fe2e6e4c.name: Grumnus Steelshaper
5164|fe2e6e4c.text: What can I do for ye?

5165|55c4dbbd.name: Hulfdan Blackbeard
5165|55c4dbbd.text:
He grows fatter and more corrupt with each passing day. Ye can smell the stink comin' off o' his body. He be dirty, an' I dun just mean he be needin' a wash.

Enough babblin' from Hulfdan. Where did ye come from and how can me help ye, $c?

5165|e48ff5e5.name: Hulfdan Blackbeard
5165|e48ff5e5.text: I hope yer ready to work.

5167|fe2e6e48.name: Fenthwick
5167|fe2e6e48.text: What can I do for ya?

5171|86b6c1ef.name: Thistleheart
5171|86b6c1ef.text: The arcane only corrupts those who are weak. Keep up on your training, or you may find a similar fate.

5172|86b6c1ef.name: Briarthorn
5172|86b6c1ef.text: The arcane only corrupts those who are weak. Keep up on your training, or you may find a similar fate.

5174|3c00750a.name: Springspindle Fizzlegear
5174|3c00750a.text: The things I would teach you would turn your brain to jelly! Come back when you've learned sufficiently!

5174|71402677.name: Springspindle Fizzlegear
5174|71402677.text: If my calculations are correct, the wheel will soon be obsolete!

5174|cdf132dc.name: Springspindle Fizzlegear
5174|cdf132dc.text: Excellent, you have proven yourself worthy! Now for the next phase of your instruction...

5177|d9534e34.name: Tally Berryfizz
5177|d9534e34.text: Don't let the beady eyes and bushy beard fool you. Vosur's a talented apprentice and a good friend, even if I do get a crick in my neck when I talk to him.

5193|e9a7b43b.name: Rebecca Laughlin
5193|e9a7b43b.text: Welcome to the Stormwind Guild Registry offices. What can I help you with today?

523|d6469a91.name: Thor
523|d6469a91.text: Where are you going?  Well if you're looking to get there quickly, then look no further!

5398|87006095.name: Warug
5398|87006095.text: If you are here to fight, then good! You will see that the Magram are the strongest!

5412|84db224c.name: Gurda Wildmane
5412|84db224c.text: The centaur clans rule the wastes of Desolace. If united, they would be a terrible force. It is then good that the centaur clans are not united but instead bicker and war amongst themselves.

5479|7a171557.name: Wu Shen
5479|7a171557.text: Stormwind is the pillar of the human race, maintained through strength of will and the edge of a sturdy blade.

5480|7a171557.name: Ilsa Corbin
5480|7a171557.text: Stormwind is the pillar of the human race, maintained through strength of will and the edge of a sturdy blade.

5480|c3d2f0f0.name: Ilsa Corbin
5480|c3d2f0f0.text: Stormwind is the pillar of the human race, maintained through strength of will and the edge of a sturdy blade.

5482|3b48d638.name: Stephen Ryback
5482|3b48d638.text: Dirge Quikcleave of Gadgetzan is a master of the culinary arts.  To better yourself you will need to seek him out.

5482|52392408.name: Stephen Ryback
5482|52392408.text: Seek out Shandrina in Silverwind Refuge.  She can sell you the "Expert Cookbook".

5482|8cd6b7fd.name: Stephen Ryback
5482|8cd6b7fd.text: I don't get too many cooks in here looking for training, but I guess I could teach you something if you're ready.

5483|877c4b1d.name: Erika Tate
5483|877c4b1d.text: I sell only the best gear, tested and true. And the prices are set, so if you want to haggle then go find a Goblin.

5489|bab8ec77.name: Brother Joshua
5489|bab8ec77.text: I trust the Light is with you, $N. Is there something that I can I help you with?

5491|08830bac.name: Arthur the Faithful
5491|08830bac.text: Through rigorous retraining I have had to break many students of all they had previously learned so that I might teach them anew.  The service I offer becomes increasingly difficult to perform each time it is done.  It is for that reason that it becomes increasingly expensive with each retraining.  Do you desire that I break you of the talents you have learned?

5491|837f02f9.name: Arthur the Faithful
5491|837f02f9.text: May the Light protect you this day.

5492|837f02f9.name: Katherine the Pure
5492|837f02f9.text: May the Light protect you this day.

5493|e332eb6d.name: Arnold Leland
5493|e332eb6d.text: Ah, a fellow Fisherman. Are you perhaps in need of a little training? Maybe I can show you a thing or two?

5494|ed056522.name: Catherine Leland
5494|ed056522.text: Best deals in all of Stormwind my friend, won't find any better. Now, what can I help you with?

5494|fe52f4ea.name: Catherine Leland
5494|fe52f4ea.text: Just browsing my wares or is there something specific I can help you find today?

5495|86b6c1ef.name: Ursula Deline
5495|86b6c1ef.text: The arcane only corrupts those who are weak. Keep up on your training, or you may find a similar fate.

5495|8fca8484.name: Ursula Deline
5495|8fca8484.text: If you desire, in addition to training, I have it within my power to erase the knowledge of your talents from your mind.  Be warned that every time you undergo this procedure the more difficult it is to perform, and therefore the more expensive it becomes.

5496|86b6c1ef.name: Sandahl
5496|86b6c1ef.text: The arcane only corrupts those who are weak. Keep up on your training, or you may find a similar fate.

5496|8fca8484.name: Sandahl
5496|8fca8484.text: If you desire, in addition to training, I have it within my power to erase the knowledge of your talents from your mind.  Be warned that every time you undergo this procedure the more difficult it is to perform, and therefore the more expensive it becomes.

5497|8fca8484.name: Jennea Cannon
5497|8fca8484.text: If you desire, in addition to training, I have it within my power to erase the knowledge of your talents from your mind.  Be warned that every time you undergo this procedure the more difficult it is to perform, and therefore the more expensive it becomes.

5497|9c6df40b.name: Jennea Cannon
5497|9c6df40b.text: Greetings mage.  Shall I provide you with further insight into the world of magic?

5498|8fca8484.name: Elsharin
5498|8fca8484.text: If you desire, in addition to training, I have it within my power to erase the knowledge of your talents from your mind.  Be warned that every time you undergo this procedure the more difficult it is to perform, and therefore the more expensive it becomes.

5498|9c6df40b.name: Elsharin
5498|9c6df40b.text: Greetings mage.  Shall I provide you with further insight into the world of magic?

5499|8e3035a9.name: Lilyssia Nightbreeze
5499|8e3035a9.text: My teachings would be too advanced for you at this stage. If you wish to learn more of potions, speak with Tel'Athir here instead.

5500|0bcb7e4c.name: Tel'Athir
5500|0bcb7e4c.text: Ishnu-alah, brother. Have you any tidings from abroad? My heart yearns for news of Teldrassil.

5500|52c0a909.name: Tel'Athir
5500|52c0a909.text: I am honored to share my knowledge with you, $N. See that you use it well.

5500|ae60e9f0.name: Tel'Athir
5500|ae60e9f0.text: Ishnu-alah, sister. Have you any tidings from abroad? My heart yearns for news of Teldrassil.

5500|e64e6f5e.name: Tel'Athir
5500|e64e6f5e.text: You must choose a more experienced teacher, for you have surpassed my abilities. I advise you to speak with Lilyssia Nightbreeze here: she has much knowledge to offer.

5502|bb901712.name: Shylamiir
5502|bb901712.text: Another Herbalist, hmm. I doubt your skill is as great as my own so perhaps I can train you in a few proper techniques.

5503|01ed62ab.name: Eldraeith
5503|01ed62ab.text: Made by the finest craftsmen in all of Teldrassil, carried by hand from Kalimdor to Azeroth as a sign of the growing alliance between the people of the Great Tree and the humans of this land. If there is anything you require, you have but to ask.

5504|8fca8484.name: Sheldras Moontree
5504|8fca8484.text: If you desire, in addition to training, I have it within my power to erase the knowledge of your talents from your mind.  Be warned that every time you undergo this procedure the more difficult it is to perform, and therefore the more expensive it becomes.

5504|a2527c6f.name: Sheldras Moontree
5504|a2527c6f.text:
Welcome, my brother.  If you are here to train, then I would be delighted to train you.

There will be a time soon where the call of the Emerald Dream will take hold in you.  You will hibernate for many years and walk amongst the purest of forms.  It is there and then that your ultimate training will take place.

5504|e653c173.name: Sheldras Moontree
5504|e653c173.text:
Welcome, my sister.  If you are here to train, then I would be delighted to train you.

There will be a time soon where the call of the Emerald Dream will take hold in you.  You will hibernate for many years and walk amongst the purest of forms.  It is there and then that your ultimate training will take place.

5505|a2527c6f.name: Theridran
5505|a2527c6f.text:
Welcome, my brother.  If you are here to train, then I would be delighted to train you.

There will be a time soon where the call of the Emerald Dream will take hold in you.  You will hibernate for many years and walk amongst the purest of forms.  It is there and then that your ultimate training will take place.

5509|211be282.name: Kathrum Axehand
5509|211be282.text: Don't let the humans in the Bazaar fool ye lad, with the subway those gnomes built it's easier than ye might think to transport goods from Ironforge. If they try to tack on import fees just tell them yer gonna buy yer gear from me.

5510|211be282.name: Thulman Flintcrag
5510|211be282.text: Don't let the humans in the Bazaar fool ye lad, with the subway those gnomes built it's easier than ye might think to transport goods from Ironforge. If they try to tack on import fees just tell them yer gonna buy yer gear from me.

5511|5ca9cced.name: Therum Deepforge
5511|5ca9cced.text: Ye have the look of a Blacksmith to ye. Soot under the nails, steel in yer bones. Aye, very much the blood of a Blacksmith in yer veins. Which means ye've come to me looking to learn a thing or two, well lad grab a hammer. Let's see what I can teach ye.

5511|61592d6f.name: Therum Deepforge
5511|61592d6f.text: Ye have the look of a Blacksmith to ye. Soot under the nails, steel in yer bones. Aye, very much the blood of a Blacksmith in yer veins. Which means ye've come to me looking to learn a thing or two, well lass grab a hammer. Let's see what I can teach ye.

5511|706ad084.name: Therum Deepforge
5511|706ad084.text: Ye have some skill about ye with hammer and anvil, but not enough. Go speak to Dane Lindgren, he'll get ye ready to learn what I have to teach ye.

5511|ca01cc0f.name: Therum Deepforge
5511|ca01cc0f.text: So ye want to be a Blacksmith eh? Grab an apron and a hammer lad, let's see what ye've got.

5511|cbb91364.name: Therum Deepforge
5511|cbb91364.text: I said ye had the blood of a blacksmith in ye, and I was right. Go to Ironforge, to The Great Forge, and find yerself a Dwarven smith by the name of Bengus Deepforge. My teacher, and one of the greatest smiths I've ever known.

5512|211be282.name: Kaita Deepforge
5512|211be282.text: Don't let the humans in the Bazaar fool ye lad, with the subway those gnomes built it's easier than ye might think to transport goods from Ironforge. If they try to tack on import fees just tell them yer gonna buy yer gear from me.

5512|54ca4be4.name: Kaita Deepforge
5512|54ca4be4.text: Don't let the humans in the Bazaar fool ye lass, with the subway those gnomes built it's easier than ye might think to transport goods from Ironforge. If they try to tack on import fees just tell them yer gonna buy yer gear from me.

5513|451d1c98.name: Gelman Stonehand
5513|451d1c98.text: I came from Ironforge to help out with the rebuilding effort here. If I can teach enough of ye my skills then maybe I can leave it to ye and take myself back home.

5514|211be282.name: Brooke Stonebraid
5514|211be282.text: Don't let the humans in the Bazaar fool ye lad, with the subway those gnomes built it's easier than ye might think to transport goods from Ironforge. If they try to tack on import fees just tell them yer gonna buy yer gear from me.

5515|08830bac.name: Einris Brightspear
5515|08830bac.text: Through rigorous retraining I have had to break many students of all they had previously learned so that I might teach them anew.  The service I offer becomes increasingly difficult to perform each time it is done.  It is for that reason that it becomes increasingly expensive with each retraining.  Do you desire that I break you of the talents you have learned?

5515|4a5716a3.name: Einris Brightspear
5515|4a5716a3.text: Look at the wisdom and knowledge of the beast, and you will see yourself. Observe as the owl does, learn cleverness from the sabercat, embody the mighty spirit of the wolf.

5516|4a5716a3.name: Ulfir Ironbeard
5516|4a5716a3.text: Look at the wisdom and knowledge of the beast, and you will see yourself. Observe as the owl does, learn cleverness from the sabercat, embody the mighty spirit of the wolf.

5518|741f51fb.name: Lilliam Sparkspindle
5518|741f51fb.text: Quid pro quo! I'll teach you what I know, but first I want you to perform a small task...

5519|3d4f7092.name: Billibub Cogspinner
5519|3d4f7092.text: If you insert tab A into slot B then of course it's going to go BOOM! Here, let me show you what I have and then you can ask Lilliam about how to put it together so it doesn't blow up.

5520|721fd095.name: Spackle Thornberry
5520|721fd095.text: Want to make your demons more powerful?  It'll cost you, but you've come to the right place.

5564|30b7493c.name: Simon Tanner
5564|30b7493c.text: Sorry, but you've reached the limit of what I can teach. If you want to learn more, go see Telonis in the Craftsmen's Terrace of Darnassus. He's pretty talented, so I hear.

5564|568f7020.name: Simon Tanner
5564|568f7020.text: Hmm, I guess I can take on another student. Well, don't just stand there. Tell me what you're looking to learn.

5565|877c4b1d.name: Jillian Tanner
5565|877c4b1d.text: I sell only the best gear, tested and true. And the prices are set, so if you want to haggle then go find a Goblin.

5566|bb901712.name: Tannysa
5566|bb901712.text: Another Herbalist, hmm. I doubt your skill is as great as my own so perhaps I can train you in a few proper techniques.

5566|fb513610.name: Tannysa
5566|fb513610.text: I hope that your interruption is for a good cause, I was in the middle of some important work.

5567|3a20317a.name: Sellandus
5567|3a20317a.text: A fine display of worthiness. Your instruction may now continue.

5567|6a66ff59.name: Sellandus
5567|6a66ff59.text: You are beyond my level of expertise. Georgio Bolero, the master of Duncan's Textiles around the corner could help you advance your skills.

5595|00ef3512.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|00ef3512.text: Grimnur Stonebrand will tell ye some whoppers about the one that got away, but he's still one o' the best fishermen around.  He's got a shop set up in The Forlorn Cavern called the Traveling Fisherman.

5595|02e0b463.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|02e0b463.text:
Looking to take a ride on a gryphon, now are ye?  Gryth Thurden is the one ye'll want to be seeing about that.  

Ye can find him on the eastern side of The Great Forge in the middle of Ironforge.

5595|1dc5d6b9.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|1dc5d6b9.text:
A warlock, eh...  Well, if you've got a mind to be doing that sort of thing around here then ye best keep yer demons on a leash girlie.  I don't like demons, but I love putting mah axe to them.  Ye get me?  

Now you just leave me be and go get lost in The Forlorn Cavern.  That's where you'll find that warlock, Thistleheart.

5595|21c84810.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|21c84810.text: Where is the Auction House?  Why it's right by the gates of Ironforge as you enter our fine city.  Ye'll find it just across from The Vault.

5595|293fb776.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|293fb776.text:
A warlock, eh...  Well, if you've got a mind to be doing that sort of thing around here then ye best keep yer demons on a leash boyo.  I don't like demons, but I love putting mah axe to them.  Ye get me?  

Now you just leave me be and go get lost in The Forlorn Cavern.  That's where you'll find that warlock, Thistleheart.

5595|2d6411c2.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|2d6411c2.text: Fimble Finespindle has a shop set up on the northwest side of The Great Forge.  I wager he could show ye how to make some fine armor.

5595|329c6da9.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|329c6da9.text: A valuable skill First Aid is.  Our resident trainer, Nissa Firestone, can show ye how it's done.  Look for her on the southern side of The Great Forge at the Ironforge Physician.

5595|3804779b.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|3804779b.text: Which class trainer might ye be looking for?

5595|3b9d531b.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|3b9d531b.text:
Oh, you're looking for Springspindle Fizzlegear then.  Why that little gnome and his gadgets...  Let me tell you, if you're going to his shop in Tinker Town, keep your hands to yourself and don't pet any of his mechanical sheep!  

Exploding sheep... now why would you even make such a thing!?

5595|3e1ee680.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|3e1ee680.text:
Ye might not know it, but in addition to being a skilled tailor, Jormund is also a slayer of giants!  Why he must have overheard a few of us sharing stories when he shouted that he'd killed seven with one blow!  

Ye should pay him a visit at his store on the north side of The Great Forge an' see if he'll tell ye the tale!

5595|46dd318e.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|46dd318e.text:
Do we have Mining trainers here?  Where do ye think ye are!?  

Why you'll find one o' the best miners in all Dun Morogh at the Deepmountain Mining Guild on the northern side of The Great Forge.  There, Geofram Bouldertoe will show ye the true art of mining.

5595|61f33a42.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|61f33a42.text:
The tinkerer's craft for you is it?  No doubt ye'll want to go see Springspindle Fizzlegear in Tinker Town.  

Just head east from the gates of Ironforge, or follow the sound of the explosions.

5595|6286cd10.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|6286cd10.text: Well well!  You've come to the right place to learn Mining, girlie!  Geofram Bouldertoe himself resides at the Deepmountain Mining Guild.  Ye couldn't ask for a better instructor than him.

5595|632a21ad.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|632a21ad.text: Well well!  You've come to the right place to learn Mining, boyo!  Geofram Bouldertoe himself resides at the Deepmountain Mining Guild.  Ye couldn't ask for a better instructor than him.

5595|668273f0.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|668273f0.text: Flowers and seeds and such?  That would be Reyna Stonebranch's area of expertise.  Ye can find her tending to her plants over at the Ironforge Physician on the southern side of The Great Forge.

5595|787640ca.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|787640ca.text: Och!  That Daryl Riknussun is a brilliant cook!  He makes a chilli so hot ye could temper steel with it!  I don't think he'll teach ye the recipe, but he'll certainly help ye to become a good cook.  Ye'll find him at the Bronze Kettle o'er on the northeastern side of The Great Forge.

5595|7a20e7fe.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|7a20e7fe.text: That Jormund Stonebrow has a knack for the needle, he does.  Should you be needing some training, then you'll find him at Stonebrow's Clothier on the northern side of The Great Forge.

5595|8ba947c0.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|8ba947c0.text: I once heard ol' Grimnur say he fished up a sword.  Or was it a swordfish?  Damn that Grimnur, he's told so many fish tales I can't remember which is which.  Well, why don't you go see him over in The Forlorn Cavern and have him tell you what it was.

5595|8f560eff.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|8f560eff.text: Which profession trainer would ye be looking for?

5595|8f7146fb.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|8f7146fb.text:
Bah!  Mailboxes...  all I get is junk mail lately!  

Increase the size of this... decrease the size of that... act now for your free Sword of Dragonslaying.  I have to change my mailbox number every other month!  

Well, ye can't say I didn't warn ye.  If you're looking for the mailbox it's just outside the Stonefire Tavern.

5595|9224f587.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|9224f587.text:
Ah, need a wee trim do ye? It's been a bit fer me as well. I might head that way after my shift!

Ye can find the barber northwest from the entrance to Ironforge.

5595|9acb23a3.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|9acb23a3.text: First Aid?  Well ye don't look hurt to me.  If yer really interested in learning First Aid, then Nissa Firestone is the one to learn from.  Go see her over by The Great Forge in her shop, The Ironforge Physician.

5595|ab5dd850.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|ab5dd850.text: Between Bixi and Buliwyf, there ain't many weapons they haven't had the pleasure of slashing or smashing an orc with.  You can find them hanging out at the Timberline Arms weapon shop if ye need some training.

5595|ac68ec99.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|ac68ec99.text: Yer looking to learn how to use a new weapon are ye?  Well, ye should be talking to Bixi or Buliwyf over at the Timberline Arms weapon shop then lad.  They know their weapons from axes to... uh... zweihanders.

5595|b3938781.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|b3938781.text:
Och!  Ye should be careful what ye get enchanted lass.  I had me mug enchanted so it wouldn't spill a drop, but now I can't drink from it!  Such a tragedy.  

You be sure to heed me advice when ye see Gimble.  He'll be in his shop right by the Gryphon Master at The Great Forge.

5595|ce6a7b9d.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|ce6a7b9d.text: What do ye need directions to?

5595|d76057bd.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|d76057bd.text: A Cooking trainer is it?  Well then, get yerself over to the Bronze Kettle on the northeastern side of The Great Forge.  Daryl Riknussun will teach ye to make a mighty fine dish that's sure to put the life back in ye!

5595|e17c4c95.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|e17c4c95.text: Sure ye don't want to be a Blacksmith?  Well, if yer heart is set on Leatherworking, then you best talk to Fimble Finespindle over at his shop on the northwest side of The Great Forge.

5595|e6c8b4c9.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|e6c8b4c9.text: The seers of the old ways, aye I know 'em. The waters of The Forlorn Cavern are where ye can find Eldrun Stormbreaker, $C trainer fer the kin o' the elements.

5595|ec597f71.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|ec597f71.text: Ah, I believe Gimble Thistlefuzz is who ye'll be needing if yer looking to learn the Enchanter's profession.  Ye'll find Gimble in his shop, Thistlefuzz Arcanery, right by the Gryphon Master at The Great Forge.

5595|f3452b83.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|f3452b83.text: Where better to look for a dark and brooding lot, than the dark section of Ironforge, aptly named The Forlorn Cavern.  Thistleheart is sure to be found there, likely summoning some manner of vile creature to do his bidding.

5595|f8bba6b5.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|f8bba6b5.text: The bank?  Oh, ye mean The Vault!  No safer place to store yer valuables than The Vault. Ye'll find it just northeast of the entrance to Ironforge.

5595|fa24b7f4.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|fa24b7f4.text:
Not to worry, the barbershop just northwest from the entrance to Ironforge.

They'll have ye looking sharp in no time!

5612|86b6c1ef.name: Gimrizz Shadowcog
5612|86b6c1ef.text: The arcane only corrupts those who are weak. Keep up on your training, or you may find a similar fate.

5624|072251a6.name: Undercity Guardian
5624|072251a6.text: Graham Van Talen in Rogues' Quarter on outer ring of Undercity.

5624|0c7d0821.name: Undercity Guardian
5624|0c7d0821.text: Lady stitch us up and bandage when we get hit.  You find her in inner ring of Rogues' Quarter.

5624|40b6664c.name: Undercity Guardian
5624|40b6664c.text: We have auction house in central ring.

5624|41ebb2bb.name: Undercity Guardian
5624|41ebb2bb.text: Eunice Burch sell leftover parts.  You find her in Trade Quarter.

5624|4a49bce5.name: Undercity Guardian
5624|4a49bce5.text: Anya Maulray at inn on upper ring of Trade Quarter.

5624|4b4eb4b7.name: Undercity Guardian
5624|4b4eb4b7.text: You go to inner ring of The Apothecarium.  Lavinia Crowe is there.

5624|5c08a048.name: Undercity Guardian
5624|5c08a048.text: You not miss Armand Cromwell in Magic Quarter.  He stand on dock.

5624|75b6471d.name: Undercity Guardian
5624|75b6471d.text: You look for Martha Alliestar.  She on inner ring of The Apothecarium.

5624|794e83e3.name: Undercity Guardian
5624|794e83e3.text: Little forsaken know all weapons.  Him Archibald.  You find on inner ring of War Quarter.

5624|89fbd152.name: Undercity Guardian
5624|89fbd152.text: Archibald who you look for.  He outside weapon merchant shop on inner ring of War Quarter.

5624|ced3efd3.name: Undercity Guardian
5624|ced3efd3.text: You find goblin in upper ring of Trade Quarter, make you beautiful. Maybe help us get hair again. We become beautiful with big hair.

5624|da3deef3.name: Undercity Guardian
5624|da3deef3.text: Warlock trainers in Magic Quarter in building on outer ring with Mages.

5624|dd3eed63.name: Undercity Guardian
5624|dd3eed63.text: We not so sure paladins safe to touch, but they at War Quarter in big building.

5624|ddc32579.name: Undercity Guardian
5624|ddc32579.text: Go to inner ring of War Quarter.  Brom Killian there.

5624|de5818c9.name: Undercity Guardian
5624|de5818c9.text: Tiny goblin cut people in Trade Quarter on upper floor. Us no go there. Chair tiny like goblin.

5624|f161af66.name: Undercity Guardian
5624|f161af66.text: Paladins in War Quarter on outer ring. You find them at main building.

5624|f669426b.name: Undercity Guardian
5624|f669426b.text: Us know her good.  She Mary Edras at inner ring of Rogues' Quarter.

5624|ff7d48f0.name: Undercity Guardian
5624|ff7d48f0.text: Brom Killian teach you how dig up shiny for me.  Him on inner ring of War Quarter.

5638|9beb2c2f.name: Kreldig Ungor
5638|9beb2c2f.text:
I've got a lot going on out here in Desolace, DANKOS. Roetten wants us to pick up some reagents for one of our clients as well as fetch some of these lost items.

Seein' as you're here to help out, why don't we get started?

5641|c4db07ba.name: Takata Steelblade
