5641|c4db07ba.text: The main threat Thrall wishes dealt with is the Burning Blade--members of the Horde that have given their loyalty to the demons. They seek to practice their dark magic and care little for Thrall's vision of the Horde's future here in Kalimdor.

5688|fde1fb79.name: Innkeeper Renee
5688|fde1fb79.text: Rest your weary bones for a spell.

5690|c2467ddc.name: Clyde Kellen
5690|c2467ddc.text: I can teach you fishing skills.

5694|f9a7a324.name: High Sorcerer Andromath
5694|f9a7a324.text: The flow of magic is unpredictable and chaotic, of late. What, I wonder, could be the cause of this?

5695|0a25fc55.name: Vance Undergloom
5695|0a25fc55.text: Greetings, traveler! Care to delve into the mysteries of the arcane? Hm?

5695|e0fc4598.name: Vance Undergloom
5695|e0fc4598.text: Not bad... I suppose training you is not out of the question. Very well! Let's begin...

5749|721fd095.name: Kayla Smithe
5749|721fd095.text: Want to make your demons more powerful?  It'll cost you, but you've come to the right place.

5750|4bd37020.name: Gina Lang
5750|4bd37020.text: You're no warlock and I've no time for you.  Begone!

5753|721fd095.name: Martha Strain
5753|721fd095.text: Want to make your demons more powerful?  It'll cost you, but you've come to the right place.

5759|a28d29e1.name: Nurse Neela
5759|a28d29e1.text: I can train you in First Aid techniques.

5769|c9ae2675.name: Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem
5769|c9ae2675.text: The earth keeps many secrets, $c; it is our duty to ensure that those that must remain a secret for the good of all stays as such.

5784|1a4f8770.name: Waldor
5784|1a4f8770.text: Your understanding of leather is deeper than my own. Perhaps you should visit the tauren Krulmoo Fullmoon in Camp Taurajo of the Barrens. He has much knowledge to offer a student of your talents.

5784|3fc6ad9d.name: Waldor
5784|3fc6ad9d.text: The caverns below us are a source of strange and wondrous hides, but you must take care if you venture into their depths, $N. Remember that your own skin is far more valuable.

5784|8f9f7a5f.name: Waldor
5784|8f9f7a5f.text: Even here in the wilds, you seek out learning. Your drive for knowledge is an admirable trait.

5811|6fac1a00.name: Kamari
5811|6fac1a00.text: You like the rug? I killed and skinned the beast myself. May all the centaur fall as easily.

5811|aea93ec3.name: Kamari
5811|aea93ec3.text: Too bad we can't skin the humans and their allies. All that skin is just going to waste. Still, who'd want to wear the flimsy leather you could make out of it?

5811|e65e27ca.name: Kamari
5811|e65e27ca.text: I have nothing more to teach you. Talk to Karolek if you wish to further your leatherworking skills.

5815|721fd095.name: Kurgul
5815|721fd095.text: Want to make your demons more powerful?  It'll cost you, but you've come to the right place.

5819|88989ac8.name: Mirelle Tremayne
5819|88989ac8.text:
If you're looking for plate armor, mail armor or shields, I've got the finest in all of Undercity. Most of these pieces are made and repaired here locally, though some are scavenged.

Feel free to browse.

5882|f341dff7.name: Pephredo
5882|f341dff7.text: Greetings, $c.  Are you here to learn of the hidden arts?

5883|8fca8484.name: Enyo
5883|8fca8484.text: If you desire, in addition to training, I have it within my power to erase the knowledge of your talents from your mind.  Be warned that every time you undergo this procedure the more difficult it is to perform, and therefore the more expensive it becomes.

5883|f341dff7.name: Enyo

5884|e98c6c9e.name: Mai'ah
5884|e98c6c9e.text: Greetings, $c.  I pity your kind, for the secrets of true magic are beyond you...

5901|91558eae.text: You've come further than many, $N. Respect the elements around you and you shall fare far greater than most.

5909|08ad8d7f.name: Cazul
5909|08ad8d7f.text: Few have the ambition to seek true power. Fewer still have the resolve to do what is necessary to claim it. Power belongs to those who are willing to pay its price, $c.

5938|c2467ddc.name: Uthan Stillwater
5938|c2467ddc.text: I can teach you fishing skills.

5939|a28d29e1.name: Vira Younghoof

5953|1d18473a.text: Speak with Un'Thuwa to the south in Sen'jin Village.

5953|338baa5d.name: Razor Hill Grunt
5953|338baa5d.text: Dhugru Gorelust is hiding behind the barracks on the east side of town.  Don't let me find out that you're in league with the Burning Legion!

5958|6e89a35a.name: Thuul
5958|6e89a35a.text: As a mage, you are one of a select group that can conjure a portal to transport you back to this very place.  I can teach you if you are ready.

5958|aa6f2374.name: Thuul

5994|be30b49b.name: Zayus
5994|be30b49b.text: You be watchin' yerself, $c. Respect our ways, or a curse be on you and yours.

6014|be30b49b.name: X'yera
6014|be30b49b.text: You be watchin' yerself, $c. Respect our ways, or a curse be on you and yours.

6018|10137e12.text: I do what me can to train you in the priestly ways, if that what you be here for.

6027|721fd095.name: Kitha
6027|721fd095.text: Want to make your demons more powerful?  It'll cost you, but you've come to the right place.

6031|86adad20.name: Tormus Deepforge
6031|86adad20.text: Some can't stand the heat of the Great Forge, but I think the heat is just right.  And it's the best place to do some serious smithwork.

6089|122548b3.name: Harry Burlguard
6089|122548b3.text:
It takes more than a big arm and a mean look to be a $c.  You also need a clear head and a sharp eye if you want to stay alive.

And bad breath doesn't hurt either.

6094|a28d29e1.name: Byancie
6094|a28d29e1.text: I can train you in First Aid techniques.

6119|245d5c6e.name: Tog Rustsprocket
6119|245d5c6e.text: Stupid snow... Hey, you're, $N, aren't you? I've just received a message asking for you.

6119|258dbe24.name: Tog Rustsprocket
6119|258dbe24.text: You've been summoned by Lago Blackwrench, $c master of Ironforge. You'd do yourself well to report to him immediately. You'll find him in the Forlorn Cavern district of the city.

6171|8f2a6ec7.name: Duthorian Rall
6171|8f2a6ec7.text:
You will be tested many times by the darkness that surrounds our lands, SWATACUS. But to ensure you are always prepared, we will often ask tasks of you so you are at the height of your own power.

Go with the Light, and remain virtuous.

6171|aa22aeb4.name: Duthorian Rall
6171|aa22aeb4.text:

6179|bb05f662.name: Tiza Battleforge
6179|bb05f662.text: Many tests await a $c of the Light, KAHZ. Be assured, our paths will cross many times in the future if you remain passionate and hold to those virtues that we praise.

6179|ca1fce87.name: Tiza Battleforge
6179|ca1fce87.text: Many tests await a $c of the Light, MARGARET. Be assured, our paths will cross many times in the future if you remain passionate and hold to those virtues that we praise.

6251|86b6c1ef.name: Strahad Farsan
6251|86b6c1ef.text: The arcane only corrupts those who are weak. Keep up on your training, or you may find a similar fate.

6286|f842f7e5.name: Zarrin
6286|f842f7e5.text: Hello, $N. If you'd like to learn a thing or two about cooking, please visit me at any time.

6299|bb66b6f6.name: Delfrum Flintbeard
6299|bb66b6f6.text: I just can't seem to get comfortable without a sturdy ceiling of granite over my head. All these stars up there, enough to give ye the shivers.

6299|ec31d7b3.name: Delfrum Flintbeard
6299|ec31d7b3.text: Well my friend, ye have more skill than I do. Why don't ye go find me old friend Rotgath Stonebeard. He stayed in Ironforge when I left to join Jaina's army. I'm sure he'll be able ta teach ye somethin, or at least know someone who can. If he's still around, I'm sure he'll be at The Great Forge.

6300|0b719f6c.name: Elisa Steelhand
6300|0b719f6c.text: How can I help you, friend?

6301|021e8521.name: Gorbold Steelhand
6301|021e8521.text: Greetings lass, if you're looking for the best deals you'll find outside of Ironforge itself, then you've come to the right place.

6301|7a1efc7f.name: Gorbold Steelhand
6301|7a1efc7f.text: Greetings lad, if you're looking for the best deals you'll find outside of Ironforge itself, then you've come to the right place.

6328|721fd095.text: Want to make your demons more powerful?  It'll cost you, but you've come to the right place.

633|b8d58f51.name: Elaine Carevin
633|b8d58f51.text: It's dark times that have come, $c... All too soon will we lose everything... When the Light will forsake all but those who truly walk under the Light.

6491|22357dc5.text: It is not yet your time. I shall aid your journey back to the realm of the living... for a price.

6569|58cd03a1.name: Gnoarn
6569|58cd03a1.text:
Where Troggs and Leper Gnomes roam stands our home - Gnomeregan.

Our families lost, our homes displaced. Scattered.

Oh how I long for the days of carefree Gnomeregan life, but those days are no more. We must make our stand! We must save Gnomeregan!

656|eb6991e6.name: Wilder Thistlenettle
656|eb6991e6.text:
There were thieves everywhere! 

It was horrible.  The cave came down on us.  I think the mining company is all dead, including my brother, the Foreman.

658|003beda2.name: Sten Stoutarm
658|003beda2.text: Ah, well aren't you a sturdy-looking one? Perhaps you can assist me with a thing or two. Not much help around here except for green apprentices, and they've other things to worry about.

6669|7b33d2de.name: The Threshwackonator 4100
6669|7b33d2de.text:
The machine adjusts to face you.

On the back of the machine is an empty, oddly misshapen slot with an engraving that reads: "Propirtee o' Cap'n Gelkak Gyromast"

6669|a5e43d8e.name: The Threshwackonator 4100
6669|a5e43d8e.text: Gelkak's key slides into the vacant slot.

6706|c5ceacbe.name: Baritanas Skyriver
6706|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

6726|c5ceacbe.name: Thalon
6726|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

6727|0f322cd8.name: Innkeeper Brianna
6727|0f322cd8.text: The old kingdom of Lordaeron is perilous. We urge caution for anyone who dares to venture into the now decaying lands of Tirisfal Glades. If you must, find the Undercity; the upper courtyards are what you seek.

6727|29b91ff4.name: Innkeeper Brianna
6727|29b91ff4.text: The old Assembly of Thanes is a chamber below the great city of Ironforge, the ancestral home of the Bronzebeard clan. Its depths plunge to the deepest parts of the heart of Khaz Modan, and rumor has it immense geodes crown the chamber.

6727|a9b2021a.name: Innkeeper Brianna
6727|a9b2021a.text: The Hall of Thanes is sealed off. Those without audience to King Magni Bronzebeard must earn his trust and approval to venture into the depths of old Ironforge.

6727|c3a29bdb.name: Innkeeper Brianna
6727|c3a29bdb.text:
Our ancient lands are in the northeast of the Eastern Kingdom. Named after Lordain himself, it was once a proud and powerful kingdom. Its history is rich and offers many lessons to upstart nobles and kings. One of its defining moments was assisting in the foundation of the Alliance that we know today.

Unfortunately, its history is also dark, and its current inhabitants defile its lands day by day. There is still much of significance in the ruins that now rest above the Undercity, but it is folly to attempt that journey and expect to return still among the living.

6727|c80041d2.name: Innkeeper Brianna
6727|c80041d2.text: Welcome to my Inn, weary traveler. What can I do for you?

6734|b63e4e81.name: Innkeeper Hearthstove
6734|b63e4e81.text: Fill yer tankard and pull up a chair. We've stories to tell and kegs to empty.

6735|41276936.name: Innkeeper Saelienne
6735|41276936.text: Your body looks worn and your spirit weary. Rest yourself beneath our roof and allow Elune to guide your dreams.

6736|41276936.name: Innkeeper Keldamyr
6736|41276936.text: Your body looks worn and your spirit weary. Rest yourself beneath our roof and allow Elune to guide your dreams.

6736|ed5e81b7.name: Innkeeper Keldamyr
6736|ed5e81b7.text:
What can you do at an inn?

Well when you stay at an inn, you rest very comfortably.  Because of this, you will become "well rested" much more quickly than you would in the wilderness.  When you are well rested, you learn more from experience.

You may also speak with any innkeeper to get a hearthstone, and can later use the hearthstone in order to quickly return to that inn.

6741|174473b0.name: Innkeeper Norman
6741|174473b0.text: Recently, a night elf druid named Naralex discovered a network of underground caverns within the heart of the Barrens. Believing he could use the caverns' springs to restore lushness to the Barrens, the druid began siphoning the energies of the fabled Emerald Dream. His vision somehow became a nightmare, however, and soon the Wailing Caverns changed into a den of vicious, deadly predators. It is said that Naralex still resides somewhere inside the labyrinth, trapped beyond the edges of the Emerald Dream.

6741|4a0923b3.name: Innkeeper Norman
6741|4a0923b3.text: Are you interested in exploring one of these dungeons?

6741|864c5566.name: Innkeeper Norman
6741|864c5566.text: The Wailing Caverns has its entrance at the Lushwater Oasis southwest of Crossroads in the Barrens.

6746|e013de07.text: As the wind on the plains, you are always welcome here.

6746|f331e69a.name: Innkeeper Pala
6746|f331e69a.text: The entrance to Whelgar's Excavation Site can be found in the southern valley of the Wetlands. A cave along the western mountain ridge marks the passage.

6747|e013de07.name: Innkeeper Kauth
6747|e013de07.text: As the wind on the plains, you are always welcome here.

6790|c80041d2.name: Innkeeper Trelayne
6790|c80041d2.text: Welcome to my Inn, weary traveler. What can I do for you?

6791|60c5da07.name: Innkeeper Wiley
6791|60c5da07.text: Come in, come in. Just don't sit too close to the stove. It hasn't exploded yet today, but just to be safe I think you should sit elsewhere.

6807|60c5da07.name: Innkeeper Skindle
6807|60c5da07.text: Come in, come in. Just don't sit too close to the stove. It hasn't exploded yet today, but just to be safe I think you should sit elsewhere.

68|27751eb6.name: Stormwind City Guard
68|27751eb6.text: Go to the Mage Quarter and seek out Fyrenz Stargazer, just northwest of the mage tower.

68|2b59109b.name: Stormwind City Guard
68|2b59109b.text: A $c?  Hmmm... well, I've heard that Keryn Sylvius hangs around those shady types.  You might want to talk to her and see what you can learn.

68|331b73f2.name: Stormwind City Guard
68|331b73f2.text: The sharpest shears and most delicate hands are found at Curls and Furls here in the trade district. Take a gander if you have some spare time and are interested in taking a little off the top.

68|37e215b2.name: Stormwind City Guard
68|37e215b2.text: Which class trainer are you looking for?

68|49dd2419.name: Stormwind City Guard
68|49dd2419.text: Tucked away in the Mage Quarter, there is a little shop called Alchemy Needs.  You're bound to see all sort of strange shops on your way through the Mage Quarter, but if you stick to the outer rim you'll be sure to find it.

68|4e0ec384.name: Stormwind City Guard
68|4e0ec384.text: Which profession trainer are you looking for?

68|4fc5af49.name: Stormwind City Guard
68|4fc5af49.text: Ah, you're looking for Lucan Cordell.  He runs a shop on the outside of the Magic Quarter on your way to the Stockade.

68|8e658029.name: Stormwind City Guard
68|8e658029.text: Shamanism? We don't do that here. Try Ironforge.

68|94dfc58d.name: Stormwind City Guard
68|94dfc58d.text:
A Hunter is it?  Well, then you will want to speak with Thorfin Stoneshield over in the Dwarven District.  

Oh, and you be sure to tell him that if I step in his pet's business one more time, he's going to be training other hunters from behind bars in the Stockade!

68|9e9bec9c.name: Stormwind City Guard
68|9e9bec9c.text: What do you need directions to?

68|ac635421.name: Stormwind City Guard
68|ac635421.text: Master Woo Ping has mastered nearly every weapon known to man.  He is especially deadly with his sword techniques.  He spends a good deal of time over in the Weller's Arsenal waiting on new shipments of weapons to arrive if you need some training.

68|b925247f.name: Stormwind City Guard
68|b925247f.text: A child of nature are we? Then you need look no further then the moonwell in the Park.

68|c66ddc75.name: Stormwind City Guard
68|c66ddc75.text: Want to learn leatherworking, eh? Simon Tanner would be able to teach you. He can be found in Old Town at the Protective Hide.

68|e1cab2c5.name: Stormwind City Guard
68|e1cab2c5.text: There's a great cook who works at the Pig and Whistle Tavern in Old Town.  I've watched him use a knife when he cooks and just between you and me, I don't think he's always been a cook.  Don't get me wrong... if you still want to learn, he's the best we have.

68|fccc769b.name: Stormwind City Guard
68|fccc769b.text:
If you are looking to become a great cook, venture over to the Pig and Whistle Tavern in Old Town and talk to Stephen Ryback. That man knows how to cook up a rack of ribs like no other.

Man... now you got me hungry for some of his famous ribs. Don't count on him teaching you that recipe though!

6928|7161de72.name: Innkeeper Grosk
6928|7161de72.text: If we are to make these new lands ours then we must have places to rest our battle weary bodies. Lay your axe by the fire and share the stories of your mighty battles.

6929|7161de72.name: Innkeeper Gryshka
6929|7161de72.text: If we are to make these new lands ours then we must have places to rest our battle weary bodies. Lay your axe by the fire and share the stories of your mighty battles.

6946|baa58efa.name: Renzik "The Shiv"
6946|baa58efa.text: Mathias found me left for dead by the Venture Co. in the Barrens. Had it not been for him, I'd have been prowler fodder.

714|7dd450ba.name: Talin Keeneye
714|7dd450ba.text: Greetings, $c! Fine day for hunting, wouldn't you say? I've been having more than a little luck with boars, myself. Perhaps you'd like a shot?

715|6840716c.name: Hemet Nesingwary
715|6840716c.text: Another fine day in the jungle!  It's going to be quite a hunt, I can feel it.  Once Barnil is done cleaning the guns, I'm taking the hunting party deep into the twisting vines.  Not such a bad way for an old war vet to spend his retirement, eh?

7161|4df495bf.name: Wrenix the Wretched
7161|4df495bf.text: Pirates. I hate them. I don't just hate them; I despise them with every fiber of my being. What with all the 'ARRRRR!' and 'YARRR!' and those awful birds they keep as pets - how could anyone stand pirates, let alone be a pirate?

7166|912c996a.name: Wrenix's Gizmotronic Apparatus
7166|912c996a.text: The machine comes alive at your touch.

716|482d019a.name: Barnil Stonepot
716|482d019a.text: Master Nesingwary has a big hunt ahead of him.  I find helping him prepare for a day in the jungle is much more relaxing than helping him ready for combat.  Although I do miss some of those glorious moments on the battlefield.

7230|d65bcdb0.name: Shayis Steelfury
7230|d65bcdb0.text: I don't train smiths with no skill, come back when you have something decent to show me.

7231|248686cb.name: Kelgruk Bloodaxe
7231|248686cb.text: What is it? Can't you see I'm busy?

7232|2ebb471e.name: Borgus Steelhand
7232|2ebb471e.text: What are ye daft? That's not a weapon, that's a dinner knife. I don't train amateurs.

7232|e03d94ba.name: Borgus Steelhand
7232|e03d94ba.text: Can't ye see I'm busy? This had better be good.

7233|0c7ac5e1.name: Taskmaster Fizzule
7233|0c7ac5e1.text:
Something plagues this tower. I've fallen ill and the other Venture Co. employees that work near or in the tower have also become sick.

Just last week, two of our patrollers died, only to instantly come back to life as mindless drones!

The lifeforce is draining from my body. I can feel myself losing control. Urges taking over... Bad urges... *Fizzule slaps himself in the face* Not yet... Listen... Mine is a position of power. This position privies me to some sensitive information.

727|3d785b33.name: Ironforge Mountaineer
727|3d785b33.text: Ye won't find a gryphon master just anywhere around Dun Morogh, lad.  Ye're going to have to go to Ironforge if ye want to take a gryphon somewhere.

727|4e2f8f23.name: Ironforge Mountaineer
727|4e2f8f23.text: Ye should check over at Steelgrill's Depot for Bronk.  When he's not tinkering with some odd device, he's usually chatting up the pilots about their steam tanks.

727|815e101a.name: Ironforge Mountaineer
727|815e101a.text: Ah, Stonebrow doesn't leave Ironforge much these days so if ye're looking to learn the tailor's profession ye'll have to go to see him up in Ironforge.

727|8c12aae2.name: Ironforge Mountaineer
727|8c12aae2.text: With all the screws that Bronk has been tightening, I think he's let a few of his own go if ye get me.  All the same he's still got a good head for engineering the darndest devices.  Ye should go pay him a visit over at Steelgrill's Depot.

727|8f560eff.name: Ironforge Mountaineer
727|8f560eff.text: Which profession trainer would ye be looking for?

727|ce6a7b9d.name: Ironforge Mountaineer
727|ce6a7b9d.text: What do ye need directions to?

7311|f341dff7.name: Uthel'nay
7311|f341dff7.text: Greetings, $c.  Are you here to learn of the hidden arts?

7312|8fca8484.name: Dink
7312|8fca8484.text: If you desire, in addition to training, I have it within my power to erase the knowledge of your talents from your mind.  Be warned that every time you undergo this procedure the more difficult it is to perform, and therefore the more expensive it becomes.

7312|c2a278c1.name: Dink
7312|c2a278c1.text: Greetings.  I'm a $r $c trainer, and you're a $c.

7315|08830bac.name: Darnath Bladesinger
7315|08830bac.text: Through rigorous retraining I have had to break many students of all they had previously learned so that I might teach them anew.  The service I offer becomes increasingly difficult to perform each time it is done.  It is for that reason that it becomes increasingly expensive with each retraining.  Do you desire that I break you of the talents you have learned?

7315|4bb9e8d2.name: Darnath Bladesinger
7315|4bb9e8d2.text: Greetings.  You seek instruction in the art of war?

733|60b8c5ae.name: Sergeant Yohwa
733|60b8c5ae.text: You watch where you step around here, son.  You might not be a part of our outfit, but that doesn't mean I won't take a cane to you if you fall out of line!

738|00545e9d.name: Private Thorsen
738|00545e9d.text: This is a dangerous place, $N. Be careful around here.

7410|d72ca075.name: Thelman Slatefist
7410|d72ca075.text: I hope that you are here to go to Alterac Valley $N.  We can use all o' the help that we can get.

7683|21424dde.name: Alessandro Luca
7683|21424dde.text: Yes, I see that. I can't say I'm pleased yet another one of my brilliant concoctions has been wasted.

7683|70f4a6e4.name: Alessandro Luca
7683|70f4a6e4.text:
<Alessandro lets out a frustrated sigh and pinches the bridge of his nose with boney fingers.>

Fine. Yes, give it here. At least I can reuse the glass vial.

7683|a4ef73af.name: Alessandro Luca
7683|a4ef73af.text: Welcome to Blue Moon Odds and Ends, $c.  If you have any questions, please let me know.

7714|e013de07.name: Innkeeper Byula
7714|e013de07.text: As the wind on the plains, you are always welcome here.

7731|7161de72.name: Innkeeper Jayka
7731|7161de72.text: If we are to make these new lands ours then we must have places to rest our battle weary bodies. Lay your axe by the fire and share the stories of your mighty battles.

773|30546fd3.name: Krazek
773|30546fd3.text: $C, eh? I am Krazek, Baron Revilgaz's secretary. I know everything about the goings on in this jungle and beyond. Perhaps you'd be interested in knowing the going price on oil in Ratchet? No? Looking for work, maybe? I can help you there.

7766|2849f8e9.name: Tyrion
7766|2849f8e9.text:
You'll have to be patient with me, $N. I've got my Spybot inside working on a very delicate matter. I'll be with ya in a second.

Oh, and do me a favor, try not to let Lescovar see you... we're about to ambush him.

7766|e0ee2668.name: Tyrion
7766|e0ee2668.text: Oh, if I only had a tree branch to hold up in front of me. The guards would never see me then.

7823|c5ceacbe.name: Bera Stonehammer
7823|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

7853|967b8e4a.name: Scooty
7853|967b8e4a.text: Hello, $N! I am master engineer, Scooty.

786|b76e4f1a.name: Grelin Whitebeard
786|b76e4f1a.text: Greetings, lad. I'm Grelin Whitebeard. I'm here to examine the threat posed by the growing numbers of trolls in Coldridge Valley. What have I found? It's a bit troubling...

7870|975c76d8.name: Caryssia Moonhunter
7870|975c76d8.text: The forest told me of your presence, but not why you were here. So, speak and enlighten me.

7937|51417c16.name: High Tinker Mekkatorque
7937|51417c16.text: Hello there, $c. I am High Tinker Mekkatorque of the exiles of Gnomeregan.

7937|825d4590.name: High Tinker Mekkatorque
7937|825d4590.text:
Oh yes, how wonderful! I have been expecting an emissary from your people, and I am very happy to make your acquaintance.

I do wish I could receive you in our home city of Gnomeregan, but our people have recently fallen on hard times and our homeland is, at present, lost to us.

King Bronzebeard is ever a friend to us gnomes, however, and has graciously opened his city to us in this difficult time. 

I hope that your adventures on Azeroth treat you well, and I look forward to further opportunities to learn more of your people. 

Farewell, $N.

7937|98814444.name: High Tinker Mekkatorque
7937|98814444.text:
Oh yes, how wonderful! I have been expecting an emissary from your people, and I am very happy to make your acquaintance.

I do wish I could receive you in our home city of Gnomeregan, but our people have recently fallen on hard times and our homeland is, at present, lost to us.

King Bronzebeard is ever a friend to we gnomes however, and has graciously opened his city to us in this difficult time. 

I hope that your adventures on Azeroth treat you well, and I look forward to further opportunities to learn more of your people. 

Farewell, $N.

7944|9a62fac1.name: Tinkmaster Overspark
7944|9a62fac1.text:
I am Tinkmaster Overspark, and I am the chief architect for modern gnomish engineering principles in the world today.  It is my job to ensure that the power of invention continues to shine brightest from our arclight spanners than anywhere else!

Also, if you happen to know a good schematic for radiation elimination, we just so happen to be in the market for one right about now...

7953|088823f1.name: Xar'Ti
7953|088823f1.text:
Ey, friend! I be happy to offer you a riding raptor, but first you should be trainin' with Xar'Ti.

These fearless creatures aren't easily ridden, but once ya know how to ride one you will not find a better companion. Mind the claws though, just one swipe can take down a fully grown kodo.

7953|a3eec9a8.name: Xar'Ti
7953|a3eec9a8.text: You need to be exalted with the trolls of the Darkspear tribe before I will teach you a riding skill, $c.

7953|de02093f.name: Xar'Ti
7953|de02093f.text: I can teach you the finer points of Raptor Riding, provided you have enough gold to cover the lesson!

7954|471341e8.name: Binjy Featherwhistle
7954|471341e8.text: I can teach you the finer points of Mechanostrider Piloting, provided you have enough gold to cover the lesson!

7954|fd743840.name: Binjy Featherwhistle
7954|fd743840.text: You need to be exalted with the gnomes of the Gnomeregan Exiles before I will teach you how to pilot a Mechanostrider, $c.

7955|53cc47ec.name: Milli Featherwhistle
7955|53cc47ec.text: Erm... I really don't know you that well, sorry.  I mean, as an authorized Mechanostrider dealer, I really only can sell my mounts to those people who are considered exalted amongst the gnomes.  If you ever are recognized as exalted to Gnomeregan, I'd be happy to show you what I have to offer.

7955|84efac38.name: Milli Featherwhistle
7955|84efac38.text:
Salutations, friend! I would be happy to offer you a Mechanostrider, but first you should train with my brother Binjy, over there.

They are far more reliable than any beast but can be difficult to pilot for a first time rider, but once you know how to pilot one you will not find a better companion!

7999|3d397bbf.name: Tyrande Whisperwind
7999|3d397bbf.text: Greetings, $c. I am Tyrande Whisperwind, High Priestess of Elune.

7999|ccf70497.name: Tyrande Whisperwind
7999|ccf70497.text:
It pleases me greatly to at last meet one of your people. I've heard much of the shen'dorei and your long history, and I am glad to see our cousins return home to Kalimdor at long last.

I confess that our people have a... complicated relationship with the highborne. Some amongst the night elves are quick to distrust those of highborne descent such as those in your High Order. However, you have my assurance that you will be shown the utmost respect while a guest in our city.

Please, make yourself at home here. I'd encourage you to explore and familiarize yourself with our culture. It is, after all, your culture as well in a way.

8125|bfc13a0b.name: Dirge Quikcleave
8125|bfc13a0b.text: We may have been suffering a drought but there's no shortage of meat! Care to browse my goods?

823|b02f6a36.name: Deputy Willem
823|b02f6a36.text: Hello there, $c.  Normally I'd be out on the beat looking after the folk of Stormwind, but a lot of the Stormwind guards are fighting in other lands.  So here I am, deputized and offering bounties when I'd rather be on patrol...

8306|48c1c064.name: Duhng
8306|48c1c064.text: Wulan in Shadowprey Village can sell you the "Expert Cookbook".  You will need that if you are to better yourself.

8308|c8a70fb5.name: Alenndaar Lapidaar
8308|c8a70fb5.text: What can I do for you my child?

8359|6fec0ef7.name: Ahanu
8359|6fec0ef7.text: Greetings.  If you are here for leather goods, then you will find my wares well crafted.

836|b62f5856.name: Durnan Furcutter
836|b62f5856.text: I sell the finest cloth and leather garb this side of the valley!

8496|944c29ff.name: Liv Rizzlefix
8496|944c29ff.text:
Hiya! This workshop isn't mine, no! But one day after I finish training I am going to be an inventor, just like my hero, Marvon Rivetseeker.

You've never heard of him? Well it just so happens that he left quite some time ago to study some ancient troll ruins he kept talking about. He left in a zeppelin... not quite sure about where exactly he went...

Tanarasin? Tenkeris? Taneranisany?

<Liv shakes her head.>

No, that's not it...

8508|15b608c8.name: Gretta Ganter
8508|15b608c8.text: Lookin' to fish? Then you'll need the proper tools.

8659|b2489254.name: Jes'rimon
8659|b2489254.text:
I give you warm greetin's, $c, as does the Shattered Hand.

Do not look so surprised, $N. There be shadows even on the highest perches of Orgrimmar--somethin' must hide there. The Shattered Hand take that role willingly. Thrall, even in his good heart, acknowledge that the Hand be necessary to ensure orc and troll safety.

But you not here to talk 'bout my business, you here for somethin' else.

8738|f3c8f530.name: Vazario Linkgrease
8738|f3c8f530.text: Greetings!  If you are here to access goblin engineering schemata, please have your goblin engineer membership card ready for verification.

8931|29b91ff4.name: Innkeeper Heather
8931|29b91ff4.text: The old Assembly of Thanes is a chamber below the great city of Ironforge, the ancestral home of the Bronzebeard clan. Its depths plunge to the deepest parts of the heart of Khaz Modan, and rumor has it immense geodes crown the chamber.

8931|4a0923b3.name: Innkeeper Heather
8931|4a0923b3.text: Are you interested in exploring one of these dungeons?

8931|7b1bcef4.name: Innkeeper Heather
8931|7b1bcef4.text: The Deadmines can be found beneath Moonbrook in the south of Westfall.

8931|886683cb.name: Innkeeper Heather
8931|886683cb.text: The old kingdom of Lordaeron is perilous. We urge caution for anyone who dares to venture into the now decaying lands of Tirisfal Glades. If you must, find the Undercity and the upper courtyards are what you seek.

8931|a9b2021a.name: Innkeeper Heather
8931|a9b2021a.text: The Hall of Thanes is sealed off. Those without audience to king Magni Bronzebeard must earn his trust and approval to venture into the depths of old Ironforge.

8931|c80041d2.name: Innkeeper Heather
8931|c80041d2.text: Welcome to my Inn, weary traveler. What can I do for you?

8931|cfb4d237.name: Innkeeper Heather
8931|cfb4d237.text: Once the greatest gold production center in the human lands, the Dead Mines are now inhabited by the Defias Brotherhood, who have turned the dark tunnels into their private sanctum. It is rumored that the thieves have conscripted the clever goblins to help them build something terrible at the bottom of the mines - but what that may be is still uncertain. Rumor has it that the way into the Deadmines lies through the quiet, unassuming village of Moonbrook.

8931|e0b9e88a.name: Innkeeper Heather
8931|e0b9e88a.text:
Our ancient lands in the north east of the Eastern Kingdom. Named after Lordain himself, it was once a proud and powerful kingdom. Its history is rich and serves as many lessons to upstart nobles and kings. One of its defining moments was assisting in the foundation of the Alliance that we know today.

Unfortunately its history is also dark, and its current inhabitants defile its lands day by day. There is still much of significance in the ruins that now rest above the Undercity but it is folly to attempt that journey and expect to return still among the living.

895|a665cdb8.name: Thorgas Grimson
895|a665cdb8.text: Wot kin I do fer ye?

8962|0a5060df.name: Hilary
8962|0a5060df.text: I think my necklace fell in the lake.  My daddy got it for me, and he's gonna be mad now.

8965|5a359b3f.name: Shawn
8965|5a359b3f.text: Hello there mister... do you have a little time that you could help us out?  Please?

8965|bb0bc8e7.name: Shawn
8965|bb0bc8e7.text: Hello there ma'am... do you have a little time that you could help us out?  Please?

906|86b6c1ef.name: Maximillian Crowe
906|86b6c1ef.text: The arcane only corrupts those who are weak. Keep up on your training, or you may find a similar fate.

9087|e4fd33dd.name: Bashana Runetotem
9087|e4fd33dd.text: Greetings, noble $c.  This humble servant of the Cenarion Circle wishes blessings and bounties be given unto you and yours.

9099|07b284ab.name: Sraaz
9099|07b284ab.text: This cherry pie tastes so good, it could make a grown gnome cry.

9099|2b8e5d50.name: Sraaz
9099|2b8e5d50.text: Fresh cherry pie for sale, looks so good it will bring a tear to your eye.

9099|738476a6.name: Sraaz
9099|738476a6.text: Having a bad day? Try some cherry pie.

9099|c91575ec.name: Sraaz
9099|c91575ec.text: Nana always said there was no greater thing in the whole world than a warm, toasty slice of fresh, homemeade cherry pie.

9099|e8063847.name: Sraaz
9099|e8063847.text: Cherry pie is my favoritist food in all of Azeroth.

9116|252b454f.name: Eridan Bluewind
9116|252b454f.text: The Emerald Circle strives to heal the wounded land of Felwood. Although the land is named for the very thing that has corrupted it, we hope that one day we will be able to eradicate the corruption from this land.

911|c3d2f0f0.name: Llane Beshere
911|c3d2f0f0.text: Stormwind is the pillar of the human race, maintained through strength of will and the edge of a sturdy blade.

912|617e9d53.name: Thran Khorman
912|617e9d53.text:
Yer no warrior... Why ye wouldn't even last a day under my training regimen!  

A $c who thinks he's a warrior.  Ha!

912|b02b9fad.name: Thran Khorman
912|b02b9fad.text: The big wars might be over, for now, but we still have to keep our skills sharp!

913|c3d2f0f0.name: Lyria Du Lac
913|c3d2f0f0.text: Stormwind is the pillar of the human race, maintained through strength of will and the edge of a sturdy blade.

914|c3d2f0f0.name: Ander Germaine
914|c3d2f0f0.text: Stormwind is the pillar of the human race, maintained through strength of will and the edge of a sturdy blade.

915|a0b51800.name: Jorik Kerridan
915|a0b51800.text: You look like the type I should watch my coin purse around. Something I can help you with?

916|4968a15c.name: Solm Hargrin
916|4968a15c.text: What kin I do for ye, $N?

916|ea9bf72c.name: Solm Hargrin
916|ea9bf72c.text: Can't help ya, $N. I only train rogues.

917|1fc2052d.name: Keryn Sylvius
917|1fc2052d.text: Sorry, but I only train rogues.

917|df54d1a6.name: Keryn Sylvius
917|df54d1a6.text: Well, well... look what the cat brung in... and how can I help you, $c?

918|08830bac.name: Osborne the Night Man
918|08830bac.text: Through rigorous retraining I have had to break many students of all they had previously learned so that I might teach them anew.  The service I offer becomes increasingly difficult to perform each time it is done.  It is for that reason that it becomes increasingly expensive with each retraining.  Do you desire that I break you of the talents you have learned?

918|a0b51800.name: Osborne the Night Man
918|a0b51800.text: You look like the type I should watch my coin purse around. Something I can help you with?

918|b0da17d0.name: Osborne the Night Man
918|b0da17d0.text: I got something for you, $N. Looks important.

925|837f02f9.name: Brother Sammuel
925|837f02f9.text: May the Light protect you this day.

926|2583dfa7.name: Bromos Grummner
926|2583dfa7.text: The Light be with ya, $c. How can I help ya?

927|837f02f9.name: Brother Wilhelm
927|837f02f9.text: May the Light protect you this day.

928|08830bac.name: Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker
928|08830bac.text: Through rigorous retraining I have had to break many students of all they had previously learned so that I might teach them anew.  The service I offer becomes increasingly difficult to perform each time it is done.  It is for that reason that it becomes increasingly expensive with each retraining.  Do you desire that I break you of the talents you have learned?

928|837f02f9.name: Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker
928|837f02f9.text: May the Light protect you this day.

931|c5ceacbe.name: Ariena Stormfeather
931|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

944|391e3eaa.name: Marryk Nurribit
944|391e3eaa.text: Well met, $c.  You want some advice?  Befriend a mage!  We have a trick or two up our sleeves, we do...

9501|e013de07.name: Innkeeper Adegwa
9501|e013de07.text: As the wind on the plains, you are always welcome here.

9558|18531f4a.name: Grimble
9558|18531f4a.text: You look like you might be needing passage across the Great Sea. Well you have come to the right place, this here is the berth of the Maiden's Fancy, finest passenger ship to travel these waters. When she arrives, just climb aboard and the next thing you know you will find yourself basking on the sandy beaches of Stranglethorn or throwing back a drink in Booty Bay.

9559|c670fd35.name: Grizzlowe
9559|c670fd35.text: I must say, Booty Bay has the best Clam Chowder to be had anywhere in the South Seas. Oh, not interested in cuisine eh? Well then let me be the first to welcome you to the berth of the Maiden's Fancy, the finest passenger ship to travel between the Eastern Kingdoms and Kalimdor. She's due back for another trip to Ratchet in the Barrens soon, so make yourself comfortable till she arrives.

9564|8d6952f8.name: Frezza
9564|8d6952f8.text: Of course there's no danger in everything catching flames and exploding like a huge helium bomb. This baby will get you to Undercity faster and safer than any boat, and the view is truly breathtaking. Speaking of breath, smoking is not allowed while on board the zeppelin, and fire spells are banned from being cast during the trip.

9566|fc033aae.name: Zapetta
9566|fc033aae.text: My brother said we could make great money with this trade route, but he didn't tell me I would be the one living on this side. If you come back this way on the Zeppelin, could you bring me something to eat? They sell some of the finest meat in Orgrimmar, and I sure could use something that didn't die weeks before it stopped moving.

957|4844a3ae.name: Dane Lindgren
957|4844a3ae.text: Do I look like I have the time to spend jawin?

957|8622dd6f.name: Dane Lindgren
957|8622dd6f.text: You're not bad, but let me show you a few tricks you might find handy.

957|a7a421b8.name: Dane Lindgren
957|a7a421b8.text: A far better blacksmith than I am, that's for sure. Though I'll deny it if you tell anyone I said that. You should go speak with Therum Deepforge. If anyone can teach you more, it's him.

9584|fd111c9e.name: Jalane Ayrole
9584|fd111c9e.text: Between the light and the dark, there is shadow... and those shadows have powers you have yet to see.

963|287add49.name: Deputy Rainer
963|287add49.text:
Hello, $C.  I hope you've come to bolster our ranks.  Beasts and thieves are spilling into our beloved Elwynn, and we barely have enough men to keep the roads safe!

And if you haven't done so, read that notice about Hogger.  He's a beast in yonder woods that must be dealt with.

963|f9eae059.name: Deputy Rainer
963|f9eae059.text:
I can't believe the officials in Stormwind, sending the bulk of our army abroad... when our home front is under so much pressure!

With thieves coming from Westfall and gnolls encroaching from from the east and west, it's a wonder Stormwind itself isn't besieged.

100-accept.name: Unknown
100-accept.text: Light explodes as you finish the incantation. The sounds of the water drops hitting the flame have died down and your senses are overcome as the corrupt spirits around you are destroyed.
100-accept.title: Call of Water

100-complete.name: Minor Manifestation of Water
100-complete.text:
Thanks to you. Thanks to the shamans.

Corruption ebbs but life continues to wane. Up to shamans to protect life.
100-complete.title: Call of Water

1001-accept.name: Unknown
1001-accept.text:
A tiny voice crackles from deep within the machine.

"Wizbang here! The next Buzzbox is north of Auberdine, on the beach

So, that Buzzbox is number 411 and it needs 3 Thresher Eyes for its repairs. They're just off the coast! The darkshore threshers... *Hic*... Sorry about that...

Just like last time, when you give the Buzzbox the goods, it'll spit out your reward. *Hic*... What? No, I'm fine!"
1001-accept.title: Buzzbox 411

1001-complete.name: Unknown
1001-complete.text:
The Buzzbox hums to life soon after you place the Thresher Eyes inside. There is a moment of static before you hear a familiar tiny voice call out.

"Crawler wine is the best..." *hic*

"What? Oh, you fixed it already? Wow, you're a fasht one. Sho, would ya like to fix another?"

You believe you hear a liquid being poured into a cup, followed by loud gulping sounds.
1001-complete.title: Buzzbox 411

1001-progress.name: Unknown
1001-progress.text: The machine's hatch is open and it seems to wait expectantly for 3 Thresher Eyes to be placed inside.
1001-progress.title: Buzzbox 411

1002-accept.name: Unknown
1002-accept.text:
The Buzzbox gives a burst of static as you hear Wizbang begin to speak.

"The next Buzzbox is number 323. Ish north of Auberdine but... where's the ale? Wha? Oh, ish on the road sho ya shouldn't have trouble finding it near the bridge."

Wizbang mumbles something incoherent before you hear a loud gulping sound.

"Thish one needs Moonstalker Fangs... 6 of 'em."
1002-accept.title: Buzzbox 323

1002-complete.name: Unknown
1002-complete.text:
The Buzzbox suddenly leaps into action, and you can hear the distinct sounds of teeth being ground to dust coming from within.

"Sho, ya made it! Thatsh exshellent newsh... Sho... Why doncha move along? Oh! Unless you want another job!"
1002-complete.title: Buzzbox 323

1002-progress.name: Unknown
1002-progress.text: Though you have yet to place the 6 Moonstalker Fangs inside, you believe you hear the sounds of static and incoherent gnome ramblings coming from within. Could someone else have fixed the machine already?
1002-progress.title: Buzzbox 323

1003-accept.name: Unknown
1003-accept.text:
Over the boiling noises and dripping sounds coming from the machine, you hear Wizbang's wavering voice call out.

"Nexsht onesh far south down the road. Shouldn't be hard to find... jusht off to the shide... near a fensh. I think I hid it in shum bushesh... Bushessh. Hehehe... Yesh, Buzzbox 525 takes grizzled scalps from thoshe grizzled thistle bears. Boy thash a mouthful. Grizzshled... Hehehe..."

You hear more gulping sounds as the machine cuts out. Then, suddenly, it bursts back to life.

"4!"
1003-accept.title: Buzzbox 525

1003-complete.name: Unknown
1003-complete.text:
"Sho yash gotsh the scalps in? That'sh sho great... Wha? Well, yesh I shuppose ya have realized that I can speaksh to ya without the materials in the machine. But I was telling the truth when I shaid they were broken!

See, in addition to being communimacation toolsh, the Buzzboxes also brew and distill fine liquor. Shorry for any deceptshion, but the nightelves do not apprecimerate my liquor trade in their townsh. I put shomething special in thish box to show my gratitude for yer effortsh. Enjoy!"
1003-complete.title: Buzzbox 525

1003-progress.name: Unknown
1003-progress.text:
You hear singing coming from Buzzbox 525.

"Though crawler wine's shweet, and thresher ale fine, and moonstalker moonshine ish grand. There's nothing sho dear, as a thistle bear beer, and shoon I shall have shome on hand!"

The hatch is open and awaits the 4 grizzled scalps as you hear the song repeated over and over.
1003-progress.title: Buzzbox 525

1007-accept.name: Talen
1007-accept.text:
I would charge you with a task, $N.

I was on my small vessel, skimming over the submerged ruins of Zoram, when naga attacked me, surging from the water and tearing at me with their claws!  I fled, carrying what supplies I could to make this meager camp.

But when I reached the shore and ran... my prized possession was lost.

Please, $N, find the site of my ambush, along the coast to the north, and search for an ancient statuette.  It is the reason I have braved the dangers of the Zoram Strand.
1007-accept.title: The Ancient Statuette

1007-complete.name: Talen
1007-complete.text:
You found it!  Thank you, $N!

The old city of Zoram holds many secrets, and this statuette may be the key to many of them.
1007-complete.title: The Ancient Statuette

1008-accept.name: Shindrell Swiftfire
1008-accept.text:
There is evil lurking on our northwestern coast, known as the Zoram Strand.

It is the resting place of the doomed city of Zoram, destroyed during the Sundering and submerged beneath the seas.  It has been lost to the night elves for ages.  Lost, and nearly forgotten.

Now, the naga have returned, and for what reason we do not know.  But reason matters little; we must slay these fiends and throw them back to the depths!

Return to me when your mission is complete.
1008-accept.title: The Zoram Strand

1008-complete.name: Shindrell Swiftfire
1008-complete.text:
Very well done, $N.  Your actions in the Zoram Strand against the naga are commendable.

I know your feat was not easily accomplished, for the strength and guile of the naga is well known to the night elves.  We know this, for we share a history with them.

It is a history I care not to repeat.
1008-complete.title: The Zoram Strand

1008-progress.name: Shindrell Swiftfire
1008-progress.text: We cannot allow the naga to invade our coasts, $N.  It is vital that you go to the Zoram Strand and complete your mission.
1008-progress.title: The Zoram Strand

1009-accept.name: Talen
1009-accept.text:
I fear the ancient statuette's secrets will remain forever hidden unless you find the key to its ancient lock.

That key is a ring, the Ring of Zoram.  It belonged to the rulers of this city before the waves of the Sundering drowned it.

For years the ring was lost, but the naga have recently found it.

Their leader, Ruuzel, dwells on an isle on the northern edge of Zoram.  Please, $N, retrieve the ring for me!
1009-accept.title: Ruuzel

1009-complete.name: Talen
1009-complete.text: You found the ring!  Thank you, $N.  Please take this as payment, and know that your deeds today will remain forever in my memory.
1009-complete.title: Ruuzel

1009-progress.name: Talen
1009-progress.text: It is said that the Ring of Zoram is the key to any lock within the city.  Do you have it, $N?
1009-progress.title: Ruuzel

101-accept.name: Madame Eva
101-accept.text:
As the mystical taint creeps through the forest, the need for self-protection is undeniable, $N.  The winds whisper to me and they speak of a great danger which waits patiently for you in the near future.

If you wish to protect yourself, noble $c, bring to me 10 ghoul fangs, 10 skeleton fingers and 5 vials of spider venom.  For you I shall enchant a Totem of Infliction which will harm those who attempt violent acts against you.
101-accept.title: The Totem of Infliction

101-complete.name: Madame Eva
101-complete.text: Very wise of you, $N.  This Totem of Infliction will help to protect you against the evil which lurks throughout Azeroth and beyond.  When you feel threatened, hold this totem and take comfort in its magical aura.  Be brave, fair $c.  You will need all the courage you can muster for I see much bloodshed in your future.
101-complete.title: The Totem of Infliction

101-progress.name: Madame Eva
101-progress.text: Bring to me 10 ghoul fangs, 10 skeleton fingers and 5 vials of spider venom.  For you I shall enchant a Totem of Infliction which will harm those who attempt violent acts against you.
101-progress.title: The Totem of Infliction

1010-accept.name: Orendil Broadleaf
1010-accept.text:
There is a plant that once grew in the old ruins of Bathran's Haunt to the north.  The plant was called Bathran's Hair and was known to cure ailments of the spirit.

There is a sick child in the village, and I believe it is more than just a physical illness.  Will you go to Bathran's Haunt and search it for Bathran's Hair?  I may need it to properly treat the child.

Bathran's Haunt lies north of Maestra's Post and just south of the border to Darkshore.
1010-accept.title: Bathran's Hair

1010-complete.name: Orendil Broadleaf
1010-complete.text:
Ah, you have the hair!  Now I will mix a cure for the child, and pray my concoction works.

And... Forsaken are at Bathran's Haunt?  Very troubling to hear, that is.  Very troubling indeed...
1010-complete.title: Bathran's Hair

1010-progress.name: Orendil Broadleaf
1010-progress.text: Have you gathered the Bathran's Hair, $N?  The child's health grows weaker by the hour...
1010-progress.title: Bathran's Hair

1011-accept.name: Kayneth Stillwind
1011-accept.text:
The Forsaken, the undead arm of the Horde, have crept into Ashenvale, lurking at our ruins and our barrows.  We believe their goal is to spread disease amongst the lands of the night elves.  We must confirm this!

The Forsaken have a camp south of here, near the Dor'Danil Barrow Den, where they create poisons and diseases and place them in bottles.  Fight your way into that camp and steal a bottle of disease.  Return with such a bottle.  I will test it and find its purpose.
1011-accept.title: Forsaken Diseases

1013-accept.name: Keeper Bel'dugur
1013-accept.text:
$N, Shadowfang Keep holds a book, the Book of Ur, which would be much prized in my collection.  Ur was a great mage of Dalaran before the coming of the Scourge, his studies in other worlds are of much value to ... certain parties among the Forsaken.

Enter Shadowfang Keep and find the book.  Bring it to me, and I will report your service to our Dark Lady...
1013-accept.title: The Book of Ur

1013-complete.name: Keeper Bel'dugur
1013-complete.text:
Very good.  This book will add nicely to my collections of the workings of Ur.  His knowledge was great, but his conscience held him from true power.  And so when the Scourge came and his strength was tested, it failed.

We of the Forsaken cannot afford such weakness, if we are to survive...

...If we are to conquer.
1013-complete.title: The Book of Ur

1014-accept.name: Dalar Dawnweaver
1014-accept.text:
Arugal still resides in Shadowfang Keep. We cannot claim Silverpine as a strategic stronghold for the Dark Lady until Arugal is slain.

I shall see to it that his magic is eradicated, $N. But I leave it in your hands to see that Arugal meets the death he so deserves.

Travel to Shadowfang Keep and put an end to Arugal's foul spells once and for all. Bring to me the vile wizard's head!
1014-accept.title: Arugal Must Die

1014-complete.name: Dalar Dawnweaver
1014-complete.text: Silverpine Forest is finally free from the vice of that wretch Arugal. You have done the Dark Lady a great service, $N. Your tenacity shall be rewarded.
1014-complete.title: Arugal Must Die

1014-progress.name: Dalar Dawnweaver
1014-progress.text: With Arugal's death we stand to increase the Dark Lady's stronghold on Lordaeron.
1014-progress.title: Arugal Must Die

1016-progress.name: Sentinel Velene Starstrike
1016-progress.text: Since you must destroy the bracers to kill the elementals, it will probably be difficult to find the specific ones that contain the information the divining scroll needs. You can trade bracers with others in order to obtain the ones you need, or perhaps you have the divined paper already?
1016-progress.title: Elemental Bracers

102-accept.name: Captain Danuvin
102-accept.text:
Stormwind has abandoned us.  A foul wind of depravity rustles through the plains of Westfall.  This was my homeland and I will not turn my back on the citizens who choose to remain here.  We, the former farmers, shall make our stand.

Your task, should you choose to accept, is to patrol the grasslands of Westfall.  Track down and slay the vile Gnolls that seem to be working in conjunction with the Deadmines thieves. Bring me eight Gnoll Paws and I will reward your bravery.
102-accept.title: Patrolling Westfall

102-complete.name: Captain Danuvin
102-complete.text: Well done, $N.  With valiant adventurers such as yourself fighting alongside The People's Militia, Westfall just might return to the prosperous breadbasket it once was.  Please accept this in recognition of your tireless efforts.
102-complete.title: Patrolling Westfall

102-progress.name: Captain Danuvin
102-progress.text: Have you collected 8 paws from those treacherous Gnolls yet?
102-progress.title: Patrolling Westfall

1020-accept.name: Orendil Broadleaf
1020-accept.text:
$N, I have created a cure that I believe will help the afflicted child.  Take it to Astranaar and give it to the child's parent, Pelturas Whitemoon.

To reach Astranaar, follow the road south, then east.
1020-accept.title: Orendil's Cure

1020-complete.name: Pelturas Whitemoon
1020-complete.text:
This is from Orendil?

His skill with herbs and healing is great.  This cure gives me hope, when before I had little...
1020-complete.title: Orendil's Cure

1020-progress.name: Pelturas Whitemoon
1020-progress.text: I must apologize, for I have no time to speak.  My child, Relara, is deathly ill!
1020-progress.title: Orendil's Cure

1023-accept.name: Teronis' Corpse
1023-accept.text:
As you rummage through Teronis' belongings, you find a journal that is still in good condition.

You take the journal and leave Teronis' corpse as is.

The only thing left to do is find the gem Teronis was seeking. Raene mentioned it being in the area. Perhaps the murlocs have it...
1023-accept.title: Raene's Cleansing

1023-complete.name: Raene Wolfrunner
1023-complete.text:
This is terrible, $N. Teronis is dead?!

The time for mourning will come, but for now we must focus our efforts. I shall send some of the Sentinels to recover Teronis' body as soon as possible.

You have Teronis' journal and the gem he was seeking. Do you think you're capable of completing his task? I would rest much better knowing his death was not in vain.
1023-complete.title: Raene's Cleansing

1024-accept.name: Raene Wolfrunner
1024-accept.text:
You'll have to do the research yourself, but from what notes Teronis has made, it sounds like your next course of action is to find the other pieces of the rod Dartol created. I would start by heading to the moonwell east of Iris Lake. When you're ready, follow the road and turn north when you reach a small sitting area on your left.

A dryad there named Shael'dryn is better suited to guide you. Seek her out.

Keep the gem with you--Shael'dryn will need it if she's to help you recreate the rod.
1024-accept.title: Raene's Cleansing

1024-complete.name: Shael'dryn
1024-complete.text: Oh, Raene sent you? It must be serious indeed. What can I help you with?
1024-complete.title: Raene's Cleansing

1025-accept.name: Raene Wolfrunner
1025-accept.text:
Before you travel to the moonwell I have another task that will aid the people of Ashenvale if you would like to test your skills.

Along the road heading east before the Falfarren River, furbolgs have been attacking travelers. Their tortured minds feeding upon fear, and their appetites satiated by the blood of innocents.

Aid the Sentinels in protecting the lands by showing those monsters the same mercy they have shown our kind.

I believe their camps are south of the road... be careful.
1025-accept.title: An Aggressive Defense

1025-complete.name: Raene Wolfrunner
1025-complete.text: You have done well, $N. Thank you.
1025-complete.title: An Aggressive Defense

1026-accept.name: Shael'dryn
1026-accept.text:
I wish your tidings were better.

Raene is correct, I know about Dartol's creation and the treants in the area--at least I did once. They've become corrupted now, their nature twisted.

If your goal is to find the next piece of the rod, then you'll have to find the key to open the chest it's in.

The wooden key is on one of the treants northeast of here, near Felwood. Once you have it, look for a small glade west of the road near the Felwood border... the chest should be hidden around there.
1026-accept.title: Raene's Cleansing

1026-complete.name: Shael'dryn
1026-complete.text: I'm pleased to see you're back, $N.
1026-complete.title: Raene's Cleansing

1026-progress.name: Shael'dryn
1026-progress.text: It upsets me so that the treants have become corrupt. I wish I could do more to help them.
1026-progress.title: Raene's Cleansing

1027-accept.name: Shael'dryn
1027-accept.text:
The final piece of the rod was given to the druids of Dor'danil for safekeeping. I have no idea where they hid it. I'm sorry I can't help you more than that.

All I can tell you is to follow the road that leads towards the Barrens. The druids took shelter to the east of that road, but they won't be of much help to you: they were killed recently... it's something I don't like to think about much.

When you find the final piece, bring it to me and I will help you reconstruct the rod.
1027-accept.title: Raene's Cleansing

1027-complete.name: Shael'dryn
1027-complete.text:
You found the final piece? Wonderful for you... and for Raene.

I guess we'll have to see about repairing it, won't we?
1027-complete.title: Raene's Cleansing

1027-progress.name: Shael'dryn
1027-progress.text: Did you find the final piece of the rod, $N?
1027-progress.title: Raene's Cleansing

1028-accept.name: Shael'dryn
1028-accept.text:
Here is the completed rod, $N. Reconstructing it was simple... it's finding the shrine that has the power to recharge it that will be the hard part.

With some focus and effort it shouldn't be too hard for someone like you, who's already accomplished so much.

Head southeast of here--there are very few paths, so be careful--and keep your eyes to the north. The shrine is hidden within the mountains that surround this glade.

Once there, place the rod within the shrine... the rest is magic. Hehe.
1028-accept.title: Raene's Cleansing

1028-complete.name: Unknown
1028-complete.text: After the glow dies, you can see the re-enchanted rod within the shrine's basin.
1028-complete.title: Raene's Cleansing

1028-progress.name: Unknown
1028-progress.text:
You can sense a subtle yet powerful force within the shrine and surrounding trees.

You begin placing the rod within the shrine and a soft thrumming noise emits from around you as the shrine begins to glow...
1028-progress.title: Raene's Cleansing

1029-accept.name: Shael'dryn
1029-accept.text:
I suggest you find Raene and let her know the rod is finished. I'm sure she'll know what your next course should be.

Good luck, $N.
1029-accept.title: Raene's Cleansing

1029-complete.name: Raene Wolfrunner
1029-complete.text:
You've recreated the rod Teronis had set out to find? That's wonderful to hear.

Teronis would be proud to see his quest is continuing even after his tragic passing.
1029-complete.title: Raene's Cleansing

103-accept.name: Captain Grayson
103-accept.text:
The night the Lighthouse Keeper's family died was horrible.  I watched, helpless, as Old Murk-Eye led the attack.  But what's done is done and now my concern is for the lives of the sailors on The Great Sea whose ships come close to the perilous rocks of the coastline.  With no one to keep watch on the flame the responsibility has fallen upon me.

Help me keep the torch lit by bringing me 5 flasks of oil from the Harvest Monsters.
103-accept.title: Keeper of the Flame

103-complete.name: Captain Grayson
103-complete.text:
Praise you, brave $C.  The rocks of the Westfall Coast shall be lit thanks to your hard work.  Many lives will be spared so long as the torch is kept lit.

I died needlessly on this very shore.  My afterlife plight is to see that no others follow my destiny.
103-complete.title: Keeper of the Flame

103-progress.name: Captain Grayson
103-progress.text: The flame will not burn for long without oil, $N.
103-progress.title: Keeper of the Flame

1030-accept.name: Raene Wolfrunner
1030-accept.text:
Alas, I'm not completely certain what he had in mind next.

If what he said was true about the rod's power, then it will allow you to take on another form altogether. Which form, I do not know.

Perhaps he meant to use its powers to get closer to the tainted furbolgs, but even the uncorrupted creatures would slaughter him were he not careful. Transformed by the rod, Dartol would have to speak to a furbolg who was safe from the effects of Fel Moss.

I would start your search southeast of Mystral Lake.
1030-accept.title: Raene's Cleansing

1033-accept.name: Pelturas Whitemoon
1033-accept.text:
I had hoped Orendil's cure would save Relara, but I fear it only slowed the disease running through my child.  We must find more powerful medicine!  Thankfully, Orendil spoke to me of further remedies to try should his first one fail.

Elune's Tear is a type of stone that rests in only one place: the isle on Iris Lake, east of Astranaar.  Orendil said the stone will wash away corruption... please, $N, bring me Elune's Tear and pray it will end my child's sickness!
1033-accept.title: Elune's Tear

1033-complete.name: Pelturas Whitemoon
1033-complete.text:
Oh, you found it!  I will place the tear in a stew, and pray that it will cure her.

Thank you!  Thank you, $N!
1033-complete.title: Elune's Tear

1033-progress.name: Pelturas Whitemoon
1033-progress.text: $N, did you find Iris Lake?  Do you have the Tear?
1033-progress.title: Elune's Tear

1034-accept.name: Pelturas Whitemoon
1034-accept.text:
Elune's Tear washed clear some of my daughter's sickness.  Her nightmares are lessened and I thank the goddess for her blessing.  But ... fever still rages within her.

Orendil told me of a frosted dust found among the Ruins of Stardust.  Perhaps it will abate Relara's fever.  Gather some of the dust, then please return to me.

The Ruins of Stardust lie to the south, $N.  May Elune speed your journey.
1034-accept.title: The Ruins of Stardust

1034-complete.name: Pelturas Whitemoon
1034-complete.text:
You gathered the dust!  I will create a poultice from these -- it should bring down Relara's fever.

Thank you again, $N.  Without your help, my child would surely perish.
1034-complete.title: The Ruins of Stardust

1034-progress.name: Pelturas Whitemoon
1034-progress.text: Do you yet have the Stardust, $N?
1034-progress.title: The Ruins of Stardust

1035-accept.name: Pelturas Whitemoon
1035-accept.text:
Relara's fever has passed, but she is still very weak.  I do not believe time alone will give her back the strength she has lost.  I believe it will take the power of a moonstone.

We used to gather moonstones at Fallen Sky Lake to the southeast... until the Shadethickets came.

Their leader, a Shadethicket Oracle, gathered up all the fallen moonstones and hoards them.  Now, you must retrieve a moonstone from the Oracle.

And to do that, I fear that you must slay him.
1035-accept.title: Fallen Sky Lake

1035-progress.name: Pelturas Whitemoon
1035-progress.text: Did you face the Shadethicket Oracle, $N?  If so, then please hand me the fallen moonstone.  Relara has strength left for only a few more breaths!
1035-progress.title: Fallen Sky Lake

104-accept.name: Captain Grayson
104-accept.text:
When my life was ended upon the rocks, I had no clue what the afterlife held for me.  The Lighthouse was black that night because Old Murk-Eye had scared the keeper's family off.  They returned and re-lit the flame but Old Murk-Eye coerced the weaker minded murlocs to raid the Lighthouse with him once again.  The second time the family was not so lucky and before my eyes they perished helplessly.

Slay Old Murk-Eye if you see him along the shore and bring me one of his scales and I shall reward you.
104-accept.title: The Coastal Menace

104-complete.name: Captain Grayson
104-complete.text: So the foul heathen, Murk-Eye is dead.  Well done, $N.  By your hands one life was laid to rest but perhaps many more were saved.  The Great Sea, wrought with danger as it is, shall be a wee bit safer this night thanks to your heroics.
104-complete.title: The Coastal Menace

104-progress.name: Captain Grayson
104-progress.text:
Have you laid waste to the menace known as Old Murk-Eye yet?  He has been spotted roaming the coastline of Westfall.

Return to me when the foul beast is dead.
104-progress.title: The Coastal Menace

1049-accept.name: Sage Truthseeker
1049-accept.text:
The Earthen Ring had pure intentions towards our plagued brethren. But who is to know the motivations of those whispering in the ears of the Elder Council?

The Forsaken whom we have allied with have a history wrought with deceit. Too hasty was our pact. Perhaps Cairne would have been wise to heed the warnings from Orgrimmar.

Deep within the Scarlet Monastery lies the Compendium of the Fallen, guarded by crazed human zealots. Their method is forged from insanity but their research might prove useful.
1049-accept.title: Compendium of the Fallen

1054-accept.name: Raene Wolfrunner
1054-accept.text:
Directly to the north of Astranaar are the Thistlefur furbolg. My scouts report that their numbers have grown greatly over the past few months. If they grow too great, they may find the courage to attack Astranaar directly.

Kill as many of their kind as you can, but bring me their chieftain's skull as proof that their efforts have been stifled... for now.

I shall remain here in Astranaar and await word from you. Elune be with you.
1054-accept.title: Culling the Threat

1054-complete.name: Raene Wolfrunner
1054-complete.text:
Well done, $N.

We are under constant threat from the furbolg. Hopefully this will keep them at bay for a bit longer.
1054-complete.title: Culling the Threat

1054-progress.name: Raene Wolfrunner
1054-progress.text: The furbolgs' corruption has caused Ashenvale to become a fraction of its former glory.
1054-progress.title: Culling the Threat

1055-accept.name: Unknown
1055-accept.text: The rod, now complete, lies in your hands. Shael'dryn will want to hear of your success.
1055-accept.title: Raene's Cleansing

1056-accept.name: Faldreas Goeth'Shael
1056-accept.text:
The forest spirits tell me you are brave and willing to travel.

To the south, not far from Mystral Lake, there lies a tunnel named The Talondeep Path. Through this tunnel you will come to an area known as Windshear Crag in the Stonetalon Mountains. Once there, journey to the southwest past Cragpool Lake and then north, up the steep slope until you reach Stonetalon Peak.

There awaits Keeper Albagorm. Heed his bidding, $r.

The journey will be perilous.
1056-accept.title: Journey to Stonetalon Peak

1056-complete.name: Keeper Albagorm
1056-complete.text: Finally, you arrive. I see Faldreas has listened to the forest spirits....
1056-complete.title: Journey to Stonetalon Peak

1057-accept.name: Keeper Albagorm
1057-accept.text:
As a protector of the forest spirits you can undoubtedly guess why I am alarmed.

You have traveled through these mountains to reach this peak. Surely you have seen the travesty which has befallen the land. Greed has led to the destruction of these sacred hills.

The Charred Vale to the south was set afire by the greedy mechanized army of industrialists. Worse yet, the Bloodfuries that have encroached on the land refuse us passage in to begin regrowth.

Drive the wretched harpies out, $N!
1057-accept.title: Reclaiming the Charred Vale

1057-complete.name: Keeper Albagorm
1057-complete.text: Now that the Bloodfuries have suffered such a great loss, perhaps the true work of restoring the land can begin....
1057-complete.title: Reclaiming the Charred Vale

1058-accept.name: Witch Doctor Jin'Zil
1058-accept.text:
So excited I am!

Three little cages for three little elves! But what shall we do with our lovely tree-hugging friends? Why, let's give them a taste of... what do they call it... forest magic!

I'll need a good mess of Stonetalon sap. From those horrid felines, bring me some twilight whiskers. This calls for plenty of courser eyes, of course -- can never have enough eyes. Oh, and lest we forget, a precious scale from a fey dragon.

Hurry to Stonetalon Peak, $N, so I can brew some forest magic!
1058-accept.title: Jin'Zil's Forest Magic

1059-accept.name: Keeper Albagorm
1059-accept.text:
The Bloodfuries have been subdued. But they will regroup soon enough if action is not taken.

Far south of the Barrens lies a land known as Thousand Needles. If you travel west in Thousand Needles until you reach the lush forest's edge of Feralas, you will find a druid named Falfindel Waywarder.

This great and wise druid is capable of calling forth great forest spirits which can aid in the reclamation of the Charred Vale.

Send word of our need! Seek him out at once!
1059-accept.title: Reclaiming the Charred Vale

106-accept.name: Maybell Maclure
106-accept.text:
Oh, I'm cursed!  My heart belongs to Tommy Joe Stonefield, but our families are bitter enemies.  So I can't see him, even though my eyes ache to gaze upon that handsome face!

Please, take this letter and give it to Tommy Joe.  He's usually at the river to the west of the Stonefield Farm, which is due west of here.
106-accept.title: Young Lovers

106-complete.name: Tommy Joe Stonefield
106-complete.text: Ah!  I can't stand us being apart.  I have to see her!!
106-complete.title: Young Lovers

106-progress.name: Tommy Joe Stonefield
106-progress.text: You have what??  Maybell is the light of my dull life.  Hurry, let me see her letter!
106-progress.title: Young Lovers

1060-accept.name: Darsok Swiftdagger
1060-accept.text:
You've done so well for me, $N. You're a regular lucky rabbit's foot and there's something I want you to see.

The harpies are not from around the Barrens. They come from a place called Stonetalon, far to the northwest of here. Though it is probably a dangerous place for you, I need this letter delivered to an old friend of mine who lives there, a witch doctor by the name of Jin'Zil.

He'll be happy to know that Serena Bloodfeather is dead, and I think you'll find Stonetalon an interesting place.
1060-accept.title: Letter to Jin'Zil

1060-complete.name: Witch Doctor Jin'Zil
1060-complete.text:
Ahh, a letter from Darsok. I have not heard from him in many years.

So the last of the Bloodfeathers are dead, eh? That is good news, I can remember when my friend Rokhan went with that crazy mok'nathal to kill her older sister. Ah, to be young again, like you.
1060-complete.title: Letter to Jin'Zil

1060-progress.name: Witch Doctor Jin'Zil
1060-progress.text: You seem a shady character. You have something for me to see?
1060-progress.title: Letter to Jin'Zil

1061-accept.name: Zor Lonetree
1061-accept.text:
The spirits of the Stonetalon Mountains are angered, for goblins and their servants are plundering and burning the land.  So the land has cried out, and those who listen for such things... have heard.

Seereth Stonebreak, a promising shaman of the Horde, was sent to Stonetalon.  She reports massive deforestation at the hands of the goblins, and requests aid.

Meet Seereth in Stonetalon.  To reach her, follow the road west of the Barrens' Crossroads.  She is camped near the Greatwood Vale.
1061-accept.title: The Spirits of Stonetalon

1061-complete.name: Seereth Stonebreak
1061-complete.text: Ah, a $c.  Very good.  We will need your skills to deal with these plunderers!
1061-complete.title: The Spirits of Stonetalon

1062-accept.name: Seereth Stonebreak
1062-accept.text:
The goblin-run Venture Company moved into the Stonetalon Mountains, chopping down trees and burning huge stretches of forest.  The spirits of this place are nearly blind with pain and rage.  We must stop the Venture Company!

Head northwest, beyond the Greatwood Vale and into the Windshear Crag.  You will find the goblins and their servants at work -- show them the Horde will not allow the exploitation of Stonetalon.  Show them in the language they best understand...

Violence.
1062-accept.title: Goblin Invaders

1062-complete.name: Seereth Stonebreak
1062-complete.text:
Bravely done, $N.

We may ultimately need the wisdom of tauren elders to calm the spirits of Stonetalon, but...

Ridding the Venture Company of its personnel is a good first move against them.
1062-complete.title: Goblin Invaders

1062-progress.name: Seereth Stonebreak
1062-progress.text: The Greatwood Vale lies to the northwest, $N.  Go.  Strike fear into those who would pillage this land!
1062-progress.title: Goblin Invaders

1063-accept.name: Seereth Stonebreak
1063-accept.text:
To truly tend the spirits of Stonetalon we must consult the tauren elders.

I do not know many of their leaders' names, but I do know of one: Magatha.  I have heard that she is very old, and she knows much.  If anyone can marshal spiritual aid from the tauren, it is she.

Magatha resides in the tauren capital of Thunder Bluff, on Elder Rise -- the city's northeastern bluff.  Speak with Magatha, and tell her of the peril of Stonetalon Mountains.
1063-accept.title: The Elder Crone

1063-complete.name: Magatha Grimtotem
1063-complete.text: I bid you greetings.  You are here seeking counsel?
1063-complete.title: The Elder Crone

1064-accept.name: Magatha Grimtotem
1064-accept.text:
The tauren have a bond with the land, and it pains me to hear of Stonetalon's plight.  But I fear that to heal the land, we must first remove the disease upon it.

Is it not fortunate, then, that the Forsaken are allied with us?  They know much of disease.  I believe they can aid us, and by doing so they will strengthen the trust between our people.

Speak with Apothecary Zamah.  She is a scholar and an emissary of the Forsaken.  You will find her in the Pools of Vision below the Spirit Rise.
1064-accept.title: Forsaken Aid

1064-complete.name: Apothecary Zamah
1064-complete.text:
Magatha sent word of your coming, $N.  Although my heart beats no longer, I still feel sorrow for the spirits of Stonetalon.

The Forsaken are eager to offer what help we can.
1064-complete.title: Forsaken Aid

1065-accept.name: Apothecary Zamah
1065-accept.text:
To rid Stonetalon of the Venture Company, we must take extreme measures.  Extreme, but without bloodshed.

A colleague of mine may have just the tool we need.  His name is Lydon; he dwells in the town of Tarren Mill in the Hillsbrad Foothills, in the distant land of Lordaeron.

To reach Hillsbrad, travel by zeppelin to our capital, the Undercity.  Then go north to Tirisfal Glades, southwest to Silverpine, and south to Hillsbrad.

Seek Lydon and bring him this note.  It details our needs to him.
1065-accept.title: Journey to Tarren Mill

1065-complete.name: Apothecary Lydon
1065-complete.text:
A note from Zamah?  Her needs must be great to send word from so far.  Let us see what she says...

Ah, splendid!  I know exactly what to do!
1065-complete.title: Journey to Tarren Mill

1065-progress.name: Apothecary Lydon
1065-progress.text: Ah, are you here with my new test subjects?
1065-progress.title: Journey to Tarren Mill

1066-accept.name: Apothecary Lydon
1066-accept.text:
I will create a toxin to bleed the violence from the Venture Company, rendering them weak and docile.  That should fix the Horde's problem in Stonetalon, yes?

But to create the toxin, I will need the blood of innocents, a difficult ingredient to obtain.

Fortunately the Syndicate, a group of human brigands in this area, employ shadow mages... and those mages collect innocent blood for their own, unsavory purposes.

You can find the Syndicate shadow mages in Durnholde Keep to the southeast.
1066-accept.title: Blood of Innocents

1066-complete.name: Apothecary Lydon
1066-complete.text:
Very good!  I trust the Syndicate gave you little trouble?

As I mentioned, the blood of innocents is not an easy thing to obtain.  We are lucky the Syndicate shadow mages did the difficult work for us.

Now hold a moment while I create my concoction...
1066-complete.title: Blood of Innocents

1066-progress.name: Apothecary Lydon
1066-progress.text: Did you find the Syndicate Shadow Mages, and collect from them the blood?
1066-progress.title: Blood of Innocents

1067-accept.name: Apothecary Lydon
1067-accept.text:
Here is the toxin.  If you use it against the Venture Company it should produce favorable, perhaps even contagious, results.  I must say, it is quite exciting to see my work applied in the field!

But before using it, take it to Apothecary Zamah.  She must create a delivery method for the toxin to maximize its effect.
1067-accept.title: Return to Thunder Bluff

1067-complete.name: Apothecary Zamah
1067-complete.text: A toxin from Apothecary Lydon?  Very good.  If I know Lydon, then this toxin will be quite effective against the Venture Company...
1067-complete.title: Return to Thunder Bluff

1067-progress.name: Apothecary Zamah
1067-progress.text: You have returned, $N.  Do you bring aid from Apothecary Lydon?
1067-progress.title: Return to Thunder Bluff

1068-accept.name: Seereth Stonebreak
1068-accept.text:
There is a relation to the spiritual magic of shamans and the natural magic of druids.  This is why we shamans can hear the plea of the spirits of Stonetalon.  Many of their whisperings are lost to me, but one message, one vision, is clear...

I saw a vision of two man-shaped machines in Windshear Crag, northwest of Greatwood Vale, felling trees with impossible speed.  These metal beasts must be stopped!

In my vision, the machines were marked with strange symbols:

XT:4 and XT:9.
1068-accept.title: Shredding Machines

1068-complete.name: Seereth Stonebreak
1068-complete.text:
The destruction of the machines XT:4 and XT:9 have soothed many of the spirits of Stonetalon, $N.  With their loss, let us hope the Venture Company will remove itself from these mountains.

For if they do not, then I fear the atrocities this place has suffered will pale to what lies ahead.
1068-complete.title: Shredding Machines

1068-progress.name: Seereth Stonebreak
1068-progress.text: The tree spirits wail at the loss of their brethren, $N.  You must destroy the shredders XT:4 and XT:9, or I fear Stonetalon will never be healed.
