1068-progress.title: Shredding Machines

1069-accept.name: Mebok Mizzyrix
1069-accept.text:
Spider egg omelettes are a new fad in Booty Bay!  The problem is... Booty Bay's got no eggs.

I smell an opportunity!

In Windshear Crag and Sishir Canyon, in the Stonetalon Mountains to the northwest, lives the deepmoss spider.  Bring me its eggs and I'll pay a bundle!

In Windshear Crag, the eggs will be clustered under what trees remain.

In Sishir Canyon... well, if you have a weak stomach then maybe you should just collect the eggs at Windshear Crag...
1069-accept.title: Deepmoss Spider Eggs

1069-complete.name: Mebok Mizzyrix
1069-complete.text:
You got them!  Thank you!

I'll have these sent to Dizzywig and get them shipped to Booty Bay.  I can already taste the profits!

Here is your cut, $N.  I couldn't have made this deal without you.
1069-complete.title: Deepmoss Spider Eggs

1069-progress.name: Mebok Mizzyrix
1069-progress.text: Did you get the eggs, $N?  I already made a shipping deal with Wharfmaster Dizzywig!
1069-progress.title: Deepmoss Spider Eggs

107-accept.name: Gramma Stonefield
107-accept.text:
I bet William Pestle has a potion to unite our two young lovers!

Here, take this note to William.  He's staying at the Lion's Pride Inn in Goldshire.
107-accept.title: Note to William

107-complete.name: William Pestle
107-complete.text:
My heart goes out to those two poor souls, Maybell and Tommy Joe.  I remember being young and in love, once.

There must be something I can do to help them!  Let me think...
107-complete.title: Note to William

107-progress.name: William Pestle
107-progress.text: You have a note from "Gramma" Stonefield, eh?  I haven't seen Mildred in years!  I wonder what she has to say...
107-progress.title: Note to William

1070-accept.name: Sentinel Thenysil
1070-accept.text:
Hello, $N.

You seem to be full of wanderlust by the looks of you. Have you been to the Stonetalon Mountains? It is a land plagued by the Venture Co. and other enemies of the night elves.

Recently, Sentinel Wolfrunner sent my friend Kaela Shadowspear there to investigate what's happening to the land, but I have yet to hear word back from her. I'm even more concerned because the Alliance sent a gnome mage along with her... a sign of trouble for sure.

Would you find her and report back to me?
1070-accept.title: On Guard in Stonetalon

1071-accept.name: Gaxim Rustfizzle
1071-accept.text:
You see, $N, I'm a member of the Enlightened Assembly of Arcanology, Alchemy and Engineering Sciences, and it's my goal... nay, my DUTY! to show the night elves that a blend of magic, mixtures, and mechanisms can help save their forests.

But it's a hard fought war, and the goblins reproduce like rabbits it seems. I haven't even had time to build my newest inventions!

I need some time to plan and organize. But to do that, I need your help keeping the goblins at bay in Windshear Crag to the east...
1071-accept.title: A Gnome's Respite

1071-complete.name: Gaxim Rustfizzle
1071-complete.text:
Thanks so much for your help, $N. You're actually back just in time.

I think I've got a perfect plan... explosives. No, that's not the plan, but it's part of the plan.

See, I've been using high explosives--don't worry, they're not as dangerous as everyone thinks--to scare the goblins back a bit. I can herd 'em pretty good with a few key detonations along the mountains' edges, but I've been low on supplies now for a few days...
1071-complete.title: A Gnome's Respite

1072-accept.name: Gaxim Rustfizzle
1072-accept.text:
The device I'm thinking about is my most advanced version to date. But we'll need a special potion if it's to work. I'm thinking we might as well get the good stuff since this mission could be your last.

And for that, we're going to need some potent explosives: Nitromirglyceronium.

The only person who can make NG-5 is an old friend of mine: Lomac Gearstrip. Look for him in Tinker Town.

You talk him into making us some NG-5, I'll get to work on placement for my devices.
1072-accept.title: An Old Colleague

1072-complete.name: Lomac Gearstrip
1072-complete.text: Ahhh.... Gaxim sent you, huh? How do I know you're not lying to me?! Hmm? Hmm...?
1072-complete.title: An Old Colleague

1073-accept.name: Lomac Gearstrip
1073-accept.text:
Hahaha... you need Nitromirglyceronium to stop goblins from destroying a forest?!

I don't care if you know Gaxim or not... I'll give you the stuff just to see you or them explode into itty bitty pieces.

There's a problem though: I'm all out.

But I'll tell you what, you bring me the correct potions, and I'll make some up for you right away.

The least you can do is prove you've got some skill as an alchemist before I just give you a sample of my greatest creation.
1073-accept.title: Ineptitude + Chemicals = Fun

1073-complete.name: Lomac Gearstrip
1073-complete.text:
This'll do nicely.

If I didn't know better, stranger, I'd say you knew somethin' about alchemy. Good, good... the world's not all about swords and sorcery, you know?
1073-complete.title: Ineptitude + Chemicals = Fun

1073-progress.name: Lomac Gearstrip
1073-progress.text: I can't make any Nitromirglyceronium if I don't have the potions... they're vital to its creation.
1073-progress.title: Ineptitude + Chemicals = Fun

1074-accept.name: Lomac Gearstrip
1074-accept.text:
Here you go, stranger. Take heed with it though... it's volatile stuff.

If you're really a friend of Gaxim's, then tell him I say hello. If you're not, then have fun blowin' yerself up.
1074-accept.title: Ineptitude + Chemicals = Fun

1074-complete.name: Gaxim Rustfizzle
1074-complete.text:
Your task has been done flawlessly, $N.

NG-5 is the unequivocal component in the recipe to ignite the wagons of dynamite.

What? Yes, dynamite... wagons of it. It's the perfect distraction, I tell you... just wait and see.
1074-complete.title: Ineptitude + Chemicals = Fun

1075-accept.name: Gaxim Rustfizzle
1075-accept.text:
Okay, now for the remote detonation part of my plan... oh, I haven't explained that yet, have I?

Okay, so the short of it is this: with a little magic, I can make it so the explosives go off while you're not around. I'm putting together a device that'll allow you to push just one button and have the NG-5 explode when you're ready.

But I need a spell from a friend in Stormwind--Collin Mauren is his name. You can find him in the mage quarter there. He's human, so he shouldn't be hard to miss.
1075-accept.title: A Scroll from Mauren

1075-complete.name: Collin Mauren
1075-complete.text: Now, this spell you need; one that will allow you detonate explosives from a distance... hmmm.
1075-complete.title: A Scroll from Mauren

1076-accept.name: Collin Mauren
1076-accept.text:
Ah, I think I have it. A messaging spell... I believe that's the effect he's looking for.

I'll have to create a scroll with the spell impressed upon it. To do that I'll need debris from a dust devil.

While I gather the rest of the components, why don't you head to Westfall and find one of the foul creatures? They are dangerous, but I'm sure it's nothing you can't handle if you're willing to subject yourself to one of Gaxim's experiments.

I'll be here when you return.
1076-accept.title: Devils in Westfall

1076-complete.name: Collin Mauren
1076-complete.text: Allow me just a few moments and I shall have your scroll ready for you.
1076-complete.title: Devils in Westfall

1076-progress.name: Collin Mauren
1076-progress.text: Hello, $N. Have you found the component I need?
1076-progress.title: Devils in Westfall

1077-accept.name: Collin Mauren
1077-accept.text:
Here you are, $N. This should do nicely.

Please give my regards to Gaxim when next you see him. I look forward to hearing about this adventure when it sees its completion.

Fare well.
1077-accept.title: Special Delivery for Gaxim

1077-complete.name: Gaxim Rustfizzle
1077-complete.text:
This is perfect, $N! Well done.

This spell, mixed with the NG-5, shall make the perfect remote explosive.

We'll be able to create the perfect distraction for you so you can sneak in and steal the Venture Co.'s letters and engineering plans.

That will surely slow down their deforestation acts.
1077-complete.title: Special Delivery for Gaxim

1077-progress.name: Gaxim Rustfizzle
1077-progress.text: Haha! you're back! Do you have it? Do you have the spell?
1077-progress.title: Special Delivery for Gaxim

1078-accept.name: Collin Mauren
1078-accept.text:
Travelers keep asking me about the Stonetalon Mountains. It seems to be a popular place for adventure--it doesn't matter if you're seeking wyvern, elementals, or you have business with the Venture Co.

Within the Charred Vale, deep in Stonetalon, there used to be a species of basilisks whose scales, when ground to dust, made a wonderful reagent for some spells I've created.

If those basilisks still live, I would love to have a few of their scales.

Take your time, it is no rush, but I can pay well.
1078-accept.title: Retrieval for Mauren

1078-complete.name: Collin Mauren
1078-complete.text:
This is perfect, $N. Thank you greatly.

Perhaps one day in the future I'll be able to help you as you have helped me.
1078-complete.title: Retrieval for Mauren

1078-progress.name: Collin Mauren
1078-progress.text:
Hello again, $N.

Have you already returned from the Vale in Stonetalon with those scales?
1078-progress.title: Retrieval for Mauren

1079-accept.name: Gaxim Rustfizzle
1079-accept.text:
This is it, $N. Pay close attention. The devices are done, and ready to be used.

Take these pages--they'll explain more about the detonators and explosives, and where you should place them.

Remember, the success of your mission doesn't depend on how much destruction you cause. Plan Alpha's success depends on you bringing back the Venture Co.'s engineering plans from inside the lumber mill south of Cragpool Lake.
1079-accept.title: Covert Ops - Alpha

1080-accept.name: Gaxim Rustfizzle
1080-accept.text:
Plan Beta's just like Plan Alpha, $N.

We cause a distraction and then steal their precious letters.

The key is to get their letters... remember that.

The pages I gave you already will tell you where to plant the explosives. Just get back here alive and with those letters....
1080-accept.title: Covert Ops - Beta

1080-complete.name: Gaxim Rustfizzle
1080-complete.text: Incredible, $N! Kaela and the Sentinels will be so happy. With your skill and my creations, we're unstoppable.
1080-complete.title: Covert Ops - Beta

1085-complete.name: Gaxim Rustfizzle
1085-complete.text:
Treacherous... treacherous and dangerous, that's what this land is.

But I'm here to show the night elves that it's a little safer with the help of good ole engineering and a dash of magic.

See, swearing off magic completely won't help the night elves--they need it. The world needs it. And with engineering and alchemy to boot, you can't go wrong. The possibilities are endless.
1085-complete.title: On Guard in Stonetalon

1086-accept.name: Apothecary Zamah
1086-accept.text:
The toxin is ready.  All that remains is its delivery.  You, $N, must make that delivery.

The Venture Company must have a means of sending messages and light cargo between its headquarters and its operations in Stonetalon.  It is likely a small sky port -- not big enough for a zeppelin, but perhaps for a flying machine.  You must search the areas in Stonetalon under control of the Venture Company and find this sky port, if it exists.  If you find it, then place the toxin there.

Place it, and run.
1086-accept.title: The Flying Machine Airport

1086-complete.name: Apothecary Zamah
1086-complete.text:
You found the port?  Well done, $N!  I am sure the goblins were quite surprised from your delivery!  Let us hope that toxin finds its way to their headquarters.

You have served your people well, and I advise you to ignore any guilt you might harbor for poisoning the Venture Company.  They are deserving of far worse.

And if there is one mote of wisdom the Forsaken might teach its allies, it is this:

Do not shy from dark paths... if those paths lead to victory.
1086-complete.title: The Flying Machine Airport

1087-accept.name: Braelyn Firehand
1087-accept.text:
You cannot imagine the hatred I possess for this wretched land. The ilk of Cenarius and the kaldorei druids at the peak employ their pathetic powers to stifle the flow of magic, even so far south of their pathetic holdings... their beloved forests.

Would that I could return to Jaedenar and exult in the flow of magic, but my master will not allow me to return until my work is done.

I have no doubt you love the night elves and their allies as little as I. Aid me, and both our ends might be satisfied.
1087-accept.title: Cenarius' Legacy

1087-complete.name: Braelyn Firehand
1087-complete.text:
Already I can feel it... yes... power so sweet... the rushing flood. The kaldorei are foolish to spurn the gifts of this world, to reject the coursing of magic as it flows singing through your veins.

What a pale mockery life is without its burning embrace!
1087-complete.title: Cenarius' Legacy

1088-accept.name: Braelyn Firehand
1088-accept.text:
They thought that they could halt the flow of magic. They were mistaken. They thought that they could hide Ordanus, but I will have his head!

Magic grants me true sight. Yes... there he is. A crossroads... At the top of a great tree in Ashenvale Forest. A name... Raynewood. One of the eldest sons of the forest god. They spirited him away from the peak before I could find him, but his time runs short.

Bring it to me and I will share with you a mighty gift.
1088-accept.title: Ordanus

1088-complete.name: Braelyn Firehand
1088-complete.text:
I knew Ordanus once, long ago. He had the arrogance of his kind, holding himself above even the Highborne.

His head does not rise so high now, does it, $N?

I promised you a reward, and you shall have it. Attend to me.
1088-complete.title: Ordanus

1088-progress.name: Braelyn Firehand
1088-progress.text: When my master bade me to the peak of Stonetalon, I expected that all I would need was to lay waste to the night elves that crawled the sacred ruins of our ancient temple of Azshara, their touch despoiling its sanctity... but Ordanus had slipped my grasp.
1088-progress.title: Ordanus

1089-accept.name: Braelyn Firehand
1089-accept.text:
The druids built the Talon Den on Stonetalon Peak, where they keep many powerful items.

They devised a complex scheme to keep them from falling into the wrong hands.

Luckily, I managed to... extract some details from one of them.

Hidden in a small lantern at the entrance of the Den, you will find the Gatekeeper's Key--with it you will be able to open caches around the Den. The items from these caches will allow you to open their hoard, located in one of the central areas.
1089-accept.title: The Den

1089-complete.name: Unknown
1089-complete.text: As the three keys are slid into their matching openings, in the middle of the glowing light a number of items appear.
1089-complete.title: The Den

1089-progress.name: Unknown
1089-progress.text: Three keyholes are carved into the stone.
1089-progress.title: The Den

109-accept.name: Farmer Saldean
109-accept.text: Looks to me you've seen quite a bit of combat in your time, $c.  If you haven't already, you should report to Gryan Stoutmantle.  He heads up the People's Militia, aimed at protecting the farmlands of Westfall.  I bet he could use your help.  You can usually find him in the stone tower on Sentinel Hill, just off the road in the middle of Westfall.
109-accept.title: Report to Gryan Stoutmantle

109-complete.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
109-complete.text:
Ah, so my friend sent you here?  How kind.  

Well the Stormwind Monarchy has abandoned our cause.  Now it is up to the People's Militia to keep the land free from corruption.  If our cause interests you, I can put your combat skills to use in the name of freedom.
109-complete.title: Report to Gryan Stoutmantle

1090-accept.name: Piznik
1090-accept.text:
You know, I was once the second most important person here at this site. That all changed when Gerenzo took over. Fired my boss, Ziz Fizziks, and sent me down to work in the mines. Ziz told me to stay here and gather information, though. His new boss will pay us well if we can find out what Gerenzo's plans are.

Anyways, what I do know is that Gerenzo has ordered large amounts of this gold-green ore to be mined. I can get you a sample to bring to Ziz, but you'll have to watch for patrols while I get it.
1090-accept.title: Gerenzo's Orders

1090-complete.name: Piznik
1090-complete.text:
Thanks, $N. It was looking a little dicey there for a second and we've probably drawn far too much attention to ourselves.

The important part is that we have the ore sample, though, and we should get it to Ziz as soon as possible.
1090-complete.title: Gerenzo's Orders

1092-accept.name: Piznik
1092-accept.text:
I guess I'd better think about getting out of here, also. It won't take long for word of what happened here to spread to the higher ups, and I'm sure they wouldn't take too kindly to meeting me again.

I'll sneak out and meet with Ziz. Hopefully, he'll be able to find me a new job!

I'll try and clean up this mess a little, but you should take the ore sample to Ziz right away. He told me that he'd set up camp somewhere on the western side of Windshear Crag. Good luck.
1092-accept.title: Gerenzo's Orders

1092-complete.name: Ziz Fizziks
1092-complete.text:
Ahhh, I knew that I did the right thing by telling Piznik to stay behind. I'm sure the engineers in Undermine will be most interested to look at this...

Of course I'll want to keep a little piece for myself, but what they don't know won't hurt them, yes?
1092-complete.title: Gerenzo's Orders

1092-progress.name: Ziz Fizziks
1092-progress.text: Something I can help you with?
1092-progress.title: Gerenzo's Orders

1093-accept.name: Ziz Fizziks
1093-accept.text:
Terrible what the Venture Company has done here, eh? What were they thinking? Goblin company hiring a gnome!

Lucky for me, Sputtervalve knows a genius when he sees one. Hired me just after I'd been kicked out!

Tells me they built some enormous woodcutting machine, and Sput' wants me to steal the plans for him. Unfortunately, Gerenzo--bloody gnome--wants me dead on sight... maybe you could steal the plans for me? You should be able to find them on one of their operators.
1093-accept.title: Super Reaper 6000

1093-complete.name: Ziz Fizziks
1093-complete.text:
Hey, is that what I think it is? Great!

Now, let's see. Ugh... how am I supposed to understand this stuff... can't figure out the way gnomes think. Lemme tell you, I'm surprised they could build the wheel, let alone those flying machines they like so much.
1093-complete.title: Super Reaper 6000

1093-progress.name: Ziz Fizziks
1093-progress.text: Did you find those plans? I'm eager to impress the new boss. Hopefully, once he's convinced of my loyalty--well, as much as he can be convinced... goblin's honor, you know?--he'll feel comfortable making use of my rather impressive genius.
1093-progress.title: Super Reaper 6000

1094-accept.name: Ziz Fizziks
1094-accept.text:
This envelope has all the information I was able to snatch as they booted me out the door... Venture Company internal documents, some manuals, technical things... Oh, and of course the Super Reaper 6000 blueprints.

Sputtervalve has taken up residence at Ratchet in the Barrens. Shouldn't have much trouble finding him, he's a little green fellow.
1094-accept.title: Further Instructions

1094-complete.name: Sputtervalve
1094-complete.text:
Fizziks, eh? Can't say I trust him, but this information seems good enough. What I wouldn't give to have the Venture Company out of my hair.

They do come up with some good machines though... I can't deny that we've benefited from using some of the improvements they've devised.
1094-complete.title: Further Instructions

1094-progress.name: Sputtervalve
1094-progress.text: Hello there! How can I help you?
1094-progress.title: Further Instructions

1095-accept.name: Sputtervalve
1095-accept.text:
The matter of this gnome that has been hired by the Venture Company has caused a bit of a stir in Undermine. The trade princes do not approve of Razdunk's consorting with this Gerenzo.

Riddlevox has asked me to take care of the problem, and I'm sure he was instructed to do so by one or more of the trade princes. Of course, the Director didn't tell me that. Let's just say I have a hunch.

Whatever the case, Gerenzo must be removed, and it would be a fitting test to have Fizziks take care of him.
1095-accept.title: Further Instructions

1095-complete.name: Ziz Fizziks
1095-complete.text:
Eliminate Gerenzo? Now there is a prospect that I have no objections to.

Gnomes are bad enough as it is, but what I learned about Gerenzo only makes it worse. Apparently, he was one of the head engineers in Gnomeregan, where he was working on their secret project--we could never infiltrate Dun Morogh well enough to find out specific details. It was a failure. Our reports say that whatever it was literally exploded in their faces.
1095-complete.title: Further Instructions

1096-accept.name: Ziz Fizziks
1096-accept.text:
I met Gerenzo once, but let me tell you, he's not easy on the eyes. His flesh looks like it's rotting away, and he's grafted metal and gears onto his body, replaced some of his limbs with mechanical ones.

Northeast of here, far above Cragpool Lake, up near the water wheel is where Gerenzo watches over the entire site. There's no way I could fight my way up there, not to mention take on Gerenzo... But you look like you might be able to make it.

If you kill him for me, I'll make it worth your while!
1096-accept.title: Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle

1096-complete.name: Ziz Fizziks
1096-complete.text:
Look at that thing... it'd take a gnome to come up with something like that. I can't understand why you'd cut off an arm, and replace it with that, when you could just keep both arms and add a third!

Gnomes, I tell you...

At least Gerenzo's out of commission. Hopefully that'll be enough proof, and Sputtervalve will assign me to one of the Tinkers' Union workshops in Gadgetzan or maybe even Undermine.
1096-complete.title: Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle

1096-progress.name: Ziz Fizziks
1096-progress.text: Sputtervalve will want some sort of proof that Gerenzo's dead. I think his mechanical arm will probably do.
1096-progress.title: Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle

1097-accept.name: Smith Argus
1097-accept.text:
There's a dwarven weaponsmith in Stormwind, Grimand Elmore, who sent word that he needs help with a delivery.  I believe he wants a package sent to his homeland in the north.

You have a sturdy pair on you!  So if you're interested in some legwork then speak with Grimand.  We could use you down here, but we must also keep our ties strong with the dwarves.

You can find Grimand Elmore at the weapon shop in the Dwarven District of Stormwind, in the northeast section of town.
1097-accept.title: Elmore's Task

1097-complete.name: Grimand Elmore
1097-complete.text: You're here to help with my delivery?  Very good!
1097-complete.title: Elmore's Task

1098-accept.name: High Executor Hadrec
1098-accept.text:
In preparation for an assault on Shadowfang, two deathstalkers were sent to the keep to gather intelligence.  It has been many days and they have not returned, but we must receive their report if we're to have any hope of a successful attack!

So here is your task, $N.  Go to Shadowfang Keep to the south and find the Deathstalkers Adamant and Vincent.  Find them, and if they require aid then give it.

This mission is as dangerous as is it critical, $N.  Do not fail.
1098-accept.title: Deathstalkers in Shadowfang

1098-complete.name: High Executor Hadrec
1098-complete.text:
Vincent's body lies broken, and still.

Although Deathstalker Adamant will send his report to Hadrec... whatever additional details Vincent gained must remain with him.

But clutched in his hand is a small trinket...
1098-complete.title: Deathstalkers in Shadowfang

11-accept.name: Deputy Rainer
11-accept.text:
Gnolls, brutish creatures with no decent business in these lands, have been seen along the borders of Elwynn Forest.  A large pack of them, many more than we can handle alone, have infested the woods south of the guard tower yonder.  Another group has infested the areas near Stone Cairn Lake to the east.

The Stormwind Army will commend whomever helps kill them.  Bring me their painted gnoll armbands as proof of your deed.
11-accept.title: Riverpaw Gnoll Bounty

11-complete.name: Deputy Rainer
11-complete.text: I see you've been busy!  You have our thanks, $N.
11-complete.title: Riverpaw Gnoll Bounty

11-progress.name: Deputy Rainer
11-progress.text: Hail, $N.  Have you been killing Gnolls...?
11-progress.title: Riverpaw Gnoll Bounty

1102-accept.name: Auld Stonespire
1102-accept.text:
Cairne is a noble leader for uniting our people here on Thunder Bluff.

But I cannot forgive those who drove us from our ancestral lands as easily as some. My people inhabited the southern Barrens for decades. The land was holy to us. But we were driven off by numerous foes.

A vengeful fate awaits the crone, Charlga Razorflank, who musters a foul army from within Razorfen Kraul.

Bring me Razorflank's heart and I can die in peace, $N.
1102-accept.title: A Vengeful Fate

1102-progress.name: Auld Stonespire
1102-progress.text:
Once I know the foul beasts of Razorfen Kraul have been driven from their foul lair, I will be able to rest in peace, knowing that revenge has been served.

Have you the driven the quilboar from the Kraul? Do you bring to me good news in the form of Razorflank's heart?
1102-progress.title: A Vengeful Fate

1109-accept.name: Master Apothecary Faranell
1109-accept.text:
As you can see, $N, we're up to some very.... interesting experiments at the Royal Apothecary Society.

As the Master here, it is my job to oversee the most ambitious of our alchemical attempts. So much work and so little time!

You look well traveled for a $c. Perhaps you can aid me.

I'm in need of a rare substance. It's foul material; it comes from a rare species of bats only found in the muck-hole known as Razorfen Kraul. Bring to me the guano from the Kraul Bats so we can begin our work...
1109-accept.title: Going, Going, Guano!

1109-progress.name: Master Apothecary Faranell
1109-progress.text: Ah, I see you have returned. Were you able to procure any Kraul Guano?
1109-progress.title: Going, Going, Guano!

111-accept.name: Tommy Joe Stonefield
111-accept.text:
Please, $N, talk with my Gramma.  If anyone can find a way to bring me together with Maybell, she can.

She's inside our house east of here.
111-accept.title: Speak with Gramma

111-complete.name: Gramma Stonefield
111-complete.text:
While our families are feuding, Tommy Joe and Maybell don't have much of a future, but... maybe we can get them together for just a little while.

Hm, what can we do...
111-complete.title: Speak with Gramma

112-accept.name: William Pestle
112-accept.text:
I can make an invisibility liquor for Maybell, so she can slip away from the Maclure Vineyards and go to Tommy Joe.  But to make the Liquor, I need some crystal kelp.

Although the kelp usually grows in the ocean... sometimes murlocs collect it.  See if the murlocs near Crystal Lake have any.  Crystal Lake is just east of Goldshire.
112-accept.title: Collecting Kelp

112-complete.name: William Pestle
112-complete.text: You got them.  Good show!  Now, just one moment while I concoct the potion...
112-complete.title: Collecting Kelp

112-progress.name: William Pestle
112-progress.text: Do you have that crystal kelp?  I'm sure Maybell is anxious to see her beau...
112-progress.title: Collecting Kelp

1130-accept.name: Jorn Skyseer
1130-accept.text:
$N, Melor Stonehoof has heard of your deeds, and has set a path before you.

If you wish to take it, then go to Thunder Bluff and speak with Melor.  You will find him on Hunter's Rise.
1130-accept.title: Melor Sends Word

1130-complete.name: Melor Stonehoof
1130-complete.text:
So, $N, you have come.  Now, are you prepared to journey through distant lands?

If so, young $c, then listen on...
1130-complete.title: Melor Sends Word

1131-accept.name: Melor Stonehoof
1131-accept.text:
At times we hunt for food.  At times we hunt for honor.  And at times we hunt to earn the Earthmother's teachings.

But the hunt I now set upon you is none of these things.  It is to slay a creature outside the Earthmother's blessing.

The hyena Steelsnap roams the Thousand Needles, south of the Barrens.  He is a tyrant, attracting other hyenas to him and spreading fear and bloodshed among more peaceful beasts.

Find Steelsnap, $N.  Find him, and defeat him.
1131-accept.title: Steelsnap

1131-complete.name: Melor Stonehoof
1131-complete.text:
In defeating the creature Steelsnap, you have cleansed the Thousand Needles of a horrible taint.

And that, $N, is your lesson this day.
1131-complete.title: Steelsnap

1131-progress.name: Melor Stonehoof
1131-progress.text: Have you defeated the foul Steelsnap, $N?
1131-progress.title: Steelsnap

1132-accept.name: Red Jack Flint
1132-accept.text:
Oh, to be at sea once again!  To feel the kiss of the wind, and to have the waves rock me like my blessed mother, long ago!

Oh, I wish I had your fortune, good $c, for I see the sea in your future!

It's my job to tell eager souls of the land of Kalimdor, the land of opportunity!  If you're willing to try your luck across the sea, then take a ship from here to the lovely port of Theramore.  Speak there with my partner, the elf, Fiora Longears.

She'll start you on your Kalimdor adventure!
1132-accept.title: Fiora Longears

1134-accept.name: Shindrell Swiftfire
1134-accept.text:
We are not in open war with the Horde, but our peace is fragile.  We often find their agents moving against us, but they do so covertly.

One such advance was revealed to us from hidden sources in Theramore, claiming that the orcs collect venom from the pridewings near Mirkfallon Lake, in the Stonetalon Mountains to the south.  Orc assassins then use the venom on their secret death raids against the Alliance!

If this is true, then we must stop them, $N.  We must deny them their source of venom.
1134-accept.title: Pridewings of Stonetalon

1134-complete.name: Shindrell Swiftfire
1134-complete.text:
Thank you, $N.  It saddens me to order the slaughter of creatures who may not willingly aid our enemies, yet it is my duty to do so.

Your heart might weep for the pridewings you slew, my friend, but may your heart then swell in knowing that your allies are safe from the pridewings' venom.
1134-complete.title: Pridewings of Stonetalon

1134-progress.name: Shindrell Swiftfire
1134-progress.text: Do you have the pridewing venom sacs, $N?  We cannot allow the orcs to use the beasts' poisons against us!
1134-progress.title: Pridewings of Stonetalon

1136-accept.name: Melor Stonehoof
1136-accept.text:
$N, it is now time for you to travel to far-off lands.  You are ready.

You now hunt Frostmaw, a yeti in the Alterac Mountains.  He is elusive, his white coat blending into the snows of his mountain home.  He rarely shows himself.

But I will show you how to entice a creature such as he.  Here, take this scroll.  On it I have written how Frostmaw may be lured.

Now go, $N.  Your journey is long and many challenges lay waiting.  When you return with Frostmaw's mane, only then is your task complete.
1136-accept.title: Frostmaw

1136-complete.name: Melor Stonehoof
1136-complete.text:
Both strength and cunning were needed to find and defeat Frostmaw, $N.  You have both.

Your path has taken you to the valleys of Thousand Needles and to the high mountains of Alterac.  It will one day lead you through all the Earthmother's lands, for such is the way of the hunter.
1136-complete.title: Frostmaw

1136-progress.name: Melor Stonehoof
1136-progress.text: Have you been to the Alterac Mountains, $N?  Did you face the elusive Frostmaw?
1136-progress.title: Frostmaw

1138-accept.name: Gubber Blump
1138-accept.text:
I love crab.  Crabs are the fruit of the sea!  You can bake it, barbecue it, boil it, and broil it.  They're pan fried, deep fried, and stir fried.  There's crab salad, crab soup, crab stew, pepper crab, lemon crab, whipper root crab, and Ironforge surprise crab.  That's... that's about it.

I'm here fishing right now, so I can't get any fine crab chunks.  You can pick them out of reef crawlers and encrusted tide crawlers.  You can make a lot with it.  You can bake it, barbecue it, boil it...
1138-accept.title: Fruit of the Sea

1138-complete.name: Gubber Blump
1138-complete.text:
Wow, these fine crab chunks are what I need.  Thanks $N!  I found this while I was fishing a while ago, and I have no use for it.  Maybe you can do something with it.  It sure don't make any good crab dishes.

I told you all about crabs, right?
1138-complete.title: Fruit of the Sea

1138-progress.name: Gubber Blump
1138-progress.text:
...lemon crab, whipper root crab, and Ironforge surprise crab.  That's about it.

Oh, hello there $N.  Do you have them fine crab chunks I was telling you about?
1138-progress.title: Fruit of the Sea

114-accept.name: William Pestle
114-accept.text: Take this invisibility liquor to young Maybell.  It should last long enough for her to visit Tommy Joe.
114-accept.title: The Escape

114-complete.name: Maybell Maclure
114-complete.text:
Oh...my!  I feel guilty deceiving my family, but my feelings for Tommy Joe are too strong to ignore.

Thank you, $N.  I'll drink this liquor as soon as I have the chance and sneak away to my love.

And for you... please take this.
114-complete.title: The Escape

114-progress.name: Maybell Maclure
114-progress.text: Did you deliver my letter to Tommy Joe?  What did he say??
114-progress.title: The Escape

1140-accept.name: Delgren the Purifier
1140-accept.text:
The writing of the orcs is little better than the scribblings of a child. Many of my order scoffed when I chose to learn their tongue, but I have found it beneficial to gain further understanding of my enemies.

From Ilkrud's scribblings, it appears that Athrikus still possesses two soulgems, and they are being held in Night Run and Satyrnaar, satyr-held areas in northeast Ashenvale.

Be careful out there, $N, the satyrs' blood-soaked temples can be unsettling even for a seasoned $c such as yourself.
1140-accept.title: The Tower of Althalaxx

1141-accept.name: Gubber Blump
1141-accept.text:
I love fishing.  The Blump family is known for fishing.  My name is Gubber Blump; I fish.

There's a kind of fish I like to catch around these parts called Darkshore grouper.  I used to go out on a boat to fish for grouper, but no boats have been going out since them mean ol' murlocs moved in.  I bet they been eating up all the grouper too.

Say, you wanna help me catch Darkshore grouper?  I'd give you a bona fide Blump Family Fishing Pole if you did!  It's a real good pole to catch fish with.
1141-accept.title: The Family and the Fishing Pole

1141-complete.name: Gubber Blump
1141-complete.text:
Them's some real nice groupers, $N!  Thanks for helping me out!

You're at least as good of a fisherman as my cousin, Graun Blump.  She also has a beard and she smells kinda funny, but that don't do nothing to stop her fishing.  I reckon you have what it takes to use a Blump Family Fishing Pole.
1141-complete.title: The Family and the Fishing Pole

1141-progress.name: Gubber Blump
1141-progress.text:
There's plenty of good dishes you use Darkshore groupers for.  They're good to eat, but I think it's more fun catching them.

You caught any Darkshore groupers yet?
1141-progress.title: The Family and the Fishing Pole

1149-accept.name: Dorn Plainstalker
1149-accept.text:
So, you have sought me out, or perhaps destiny brings you to me? No matter. You are here now, and so your journey will begin anew.

Many facets make up a being: the spirit, the body, the mind. Some of these can be measured by a culture's traditions. Others we can only hope exist within ourselves. If you agree, I shall test some of the facets within you.

If you pass, then you shall become stronger. If you fail, then you will realize the vastness of the Nether.

The first is a Test of Faith.
1149-accept.title: Test of Faith

1149-complete.name: Dorn Plainstalker
1149-complete.text:
It is not until faced with unforeseen adversity that we begin to see how strong our spirits are. You took the leap of faith even though you had no guarantees that you would survive. Your mind is open, and your spirit is prepared for what is to come.

If you are willing, then the next of your tests is ready.
1149-complete.title: Test of Faith

115-accept.name: Marshal Marris
115-accept.text:
The Blackrock orcs enlisted shadowcasters to aid their attacks in Redridge, and they have brought with them devices of dark power--midnight orbs.  These orbs have struck telling blows against Redridge's defenders, and it's imperative we remove the demon-tainted items from the conflict.

Find and deliver to me midnight orbs from slain Blackrock shadowcasters.  I will then have them disposed of, for this world would be a better place without them!
115-accept.title: Shadow Magic

115-complete.name: Marshal Marris
115-complete.text: Thank you, $N.  I'll send these to be destroyed immediately.
115-complete.title: Shadow Magic

115-progress.name: Marshal Marris
115-progress.text: How goes your conflict with the shadowcasters?  Did you find the midnight orbs?
115-progress.title: Shadow Magic

1150-accept.name: Dorn Plainstalker
1150-accept.text:
I'm pleased to see your courage remains steadfast in light of what you've already done. Since your faith is intact, the time has come to test your body.

First is a test of endurance. Go with friends to the Roguefeather Den west of Freewind Post. Make your way to the depths of their lair and destroy their foodstuffs. By then you should have provoked their fury, and if you are able to survive long enough, Grenka Bloodscreech herself will come for you--kill her and bring me her claw to complete your test.
1150-accept.title: Test of Endurance

1150-complete.name: Dorn Plainstalker
1150-complete.text:
Grenka was powerful, even by $r standards. You should be proud of your accomplishment this day.

During your test of faith you displayed strength of spirit, and now you have shown endurance in battle by taking on the Roguefeather harpies, but the time has come for a new test.
1150-complete.title: Test of Endurance

1150-progress.name: Dorn Plainstalker
1150-progress.text:
You must be prepared spiritually, physically and mentally for the challenges that lie ahead of you.

Too often do we rush forward before we are ready. I consider it my duty to the youth, no matter which tribe they belong to, to prepare them for the dangers they may face after they leave the sanctity of their home.
1150-progress.title: Test of Endurance

1151-accept.name: Dorn Plainstalker
1151-accept.text:
During the time of the Old Gods, elementals inhabited much of this world. They worshipped the Old Gods, and the Gods, through their power, kept the elementals bound to this world. When the Old Gods were banished, the elementals faded from our world and now only return at the bidding of powerful mages.

There are exceptions though. Some elementals were powerful enough to remain here on their own. One such elemental is Rok'Alim.

To test your strength, find Rok'Alim in Thousand Needles and slay him.
1151-accept.title: Test of Strength

1151-complete.name: Dorn Plainstalker
1151-complete.text: The Test of Strength is done. You have shown strength and bravery, and you are now prepared for the final test before these rites are completed.
1151-complete.title: Test of Strength

1151-progress.name: Dorn Plainstalker
1151-progress.text: Rok'Alim is also called the Pounder by the centaur tribes in Thousand Needles because of the thundering his fists make as he pummels the creatures brave, or stupid, enough to stand in his path.
1151-progress.title: Test of Strength

1152-accept.name: Dorn Plainstalker
1152-accept.text:
Your time with me is just about finished. I am knowledgeable, but the Test of Lore is not mine to give. There are lessons to be learned and places to visit that others claim domain over.

If you are prepared, then seek out Braug Dimspirit--he is a shaman of great wisdom. He will test you further, so heed his words, $N.

When you are ready, find the tunnel that connects the Stonetalon Mountains with Ashenvale: Braug dwells near there. And be careful, $N, the night elves may wish to impede your test.
1152-accept.title: Test of Lore

1152-complete.name: Braug Dimspirit
1152-complete.text:
The days and nights grow colder throughout the world as goblins rape the land, and the night elves point fingers at the younger races. The Forsaken and orcs are not the only ones to blame for the hardships found throughout Kalimdor and Lordaeron. Many of the intelligent races have contributed to the world's pain. Dorn knows this, and he has sent you to me because you have shown the attributes necessary to realize it also.

Now you stand before Braug.
1152-complete.title: Test of Lore

1153-accept.name: Tatternack Steelforge
1153-accept.text:
$C, you have done well in helping me in the past. The warchief is pleased thus far with what I've accomplished, and asks me to continue with renewed determination. My honor dictates that I give you proper recognition to the warchief for all you have done, but first I would ask you for your help again.

Travelers recently came from the south from a place called Thousand Needles. There they killed a kobold who had an unusual ore sample, but they would not sell it. I want a sample of that ore to examine.
1153-accept.title: A New Ore Sample

1153-complete.name: Tatternack Steelforge
1153-complete.text:
A good sample, $N. A good sample indeed.

Those travelers can no longer lord over me the ore they found, now that you have been successful.

I shall get to work on it immediately. If it proves strong enough, I will send a weapon crafted from the material back to the warchief to show him our success.

I shall not forget your help, $c.
1153-complete.title: A New Ore Sample

1153-progress.name: Tatternack Steelforge
1153-progress.text:
I saw the travelers again--the ones that would not sell me a sample of the ore. I spit at them for not helping the warchief.

May they die in battle like cowards and not like warriors as should be the right of all people who ally themselves with the Horde.
1153-progress.title: A New Ore Sample

1154-accept.name: Braug Dimspirit
1154-accept.text:
You have passed Dorn's tests, and now you seek to pass your next trial. Very good. But up until now, your challenges have been childish. It is easy to test your body--your mind is another matter completely.

I shall explain it simply: find the book I name, study it, and answer my question about its contents.

What book, you must be asking? The Legacy of the Aspects. It can be found at the bottom of Dor'danil in southern Ashenvale, protected by the dead druids and their slayers.
1154-accept.title: Test of Lore

1154-complete.name: Braug Dimspirit
1154-complete.text:
This is the book I named. There is hope you will answer my question correctly then... unless you've forgotten to study its contents.

When you are prepared, speak to me again and I shall ask a question of you.
1154-complete.title: Test of Lore

1154-progress.name: Braug Dimspirit
1154-progress.text: Bring me the book after you've studied it. I will not ask you your question until after you have given me the book.
1154-progress.title: Test of Lore

1159-accept.name: Braug Dimspirit
1159-accept.text:
Well done, $N. You have passed the first portion of the Test of Lore, but there is still another question to be answered. But that question is not mine to ask.

Seek out Parqual Fintallas in Lordaeron City. He was a great historian for the humans before the Plague overtook him. Now he continues to seek enlightenment, but of a different nature.

He will have another requirement of you before he asks you anything, but you have done masterfully thus far--I'm sure you will overcome his obstacle.
1159-accept.title: Test of Lore

1159-complete.name: Parqual Fintallas
1159-complete.text:
Braug sent you? Impossible.

<Parqual looks you up and down.>

Braved Dor'Danil, took a leap of faith, fought and overpowered a powerful elemental? Bah! You're probably a farce; some adventurer that overheard talk in a tavern. And now you think you have what it takes to pass my test. So be it... $c.
1159-complete.title: Test of Lore

116-accept.name: Barkeep Daniels
116-accept.text:
I find myself in quite a pinch here, $N.  The bottles are close to running dry.  The latest booze shipment is long overdue.  The orc invasion has been hell.

Perhaps you can go to work for me?

I need you to pick up a keg of Thunderbrew Lager from Grimbooze Thunderbrew in the Westfall hills, a cask of Merlot from Stormwind, a bottle of Moonshine from Darkshire and a skin of Sweet Rum from Goldshire.  Bring those back to me and I will see to it you are rewarded.
116-accept.title: Dry Times

116-complete.name: Barkeep Daniels
116-complete.text:
A job well done, $N!  I know well the roads you had to journey to procure this fine array of liquor.  But my patrons will be happy once again! 

My wife is quite a seamstress.  Please accept this cloak she made in return for your services.
116-complete.title: Dry Times

116-progress.name: Barkeep Daniels
116-progress.text: I need you to pick up a keg of Thunderbrew Lager from Grimbooze Thunderbrew in the Westfall hills, a cask of Merlot from Stormwind, a bottle of Moonshine from Darkshire and a skin of Sweet Rum from Goldshire.  Bring those back to me and I will see to it you are rewarded.
116-progress.title: Dry Times

1160-accept.name: Parqual Fintallas
1160-accept.text:
I will tell you what you must seek, and I will even ask you my question, but not because you wish to prove yourself. Knowledge is far more important than strength. Even as others seem to pass you by in ability, your knowledge of the world will be more valuable.

Go to the Monastery in the north of Tirisfal Glades. In the library there, a book called Beginnings of the Undead Threat resides. It was used by the now-corrupt paladins there to train them to fight my kind.

Bring it to me.
1160-accept.title: Test of Lore

1164-accept.name: Genavie Callow
1164-accept.text:
The harlot! The swine! Kenata still lives; her family healthy and prospering while I suffer. Forsaken indeed!

My family is gone, taken by the plague. Our estate also forfeit; looted and burned during the war. And after all that, her and her lousy children had the audacity to steal the only precious belongings I had left.

I don't care about the things they stole any more. What I want now are their heads!

Kill them for me! Go to the Dabyrie Farmstead in Arathi, northeast of Refuge Point.
1164-accept.title: To Steal From Thieves

117-accept.name: Grimbooze Thunderbrew
117-accept.text:
Hurry, my friend, move with haste 
In order for our rich lager to taste 
More like beer and less like stew, 
Hops are needed to make the brew.
117-accept.title: Thunderbrew

117-complete.name: Grimbooze Thunderbrew
117-complete.text:
Hops and Barley, yeast and malt 
The taste-buds feel a virtual assault, 
No need to plead, no need to beg 
For Thunderbrew Lager comes in a keg!
117-complete.title: Thunderbrew

117-progress.name: Grimbooze Thunderbrew
117-progress.text:
Hurry, my friend, move with haste 
In order for our rich lager to taste
More like beer and less like stew,
Hops are needed to make the brew.
117-progress.title: Thunderbrew

118-accept.name: Verner Osgood
118-accept.text:
I've been using so much iron keeping the Stormwind Guards outfitted, I don't have enough to supply the stable's horses with shoes!

Take this note to Blacksmith Argus in Goldshire.  It explains to him my problem and requests a shipment of horseshoes.
118-accept.title: The Price of Shoes

118-complete.name: Smith Argus
118-complete.text: Heh, so old Verner needs some shoes, does he!?!
118-complete.title: The Price of Shoes

118-progress.name: Smith Argus
118-progress.text: What's that?  Verner sent you, you say?  Well give me his note.  And SPEAK UP!
118-progress.title: The Price of Shoes

119-accept.name: Smith Argus
119-accept.text:
Ok, I'll give him his 50 horseshoes...

Here they are, all boxed up and ready to go!  Tell Verner it was a pleasure doing business, and be sure he reads the note attached to this crate!
119-accept.title: Return to Verner

119-complete.name: Verner Osgood
119-complete.text:
Thank you, this really helps me out.

But what's this?  Argus sent a note with the crate...What??  Argus wants me to PAY him?  Bah!

Well, $N, thank you for your help.
119-complete.title: Return to Verner

119-progress.name: Verner Osgood
119-progress.text: Great, you're back!  Did you get the shoes?
119-progress.title: Return to Verner

1195-accept.name: Zangen Stonehoof
1195-accept.text:
The Galak centaur in the Thousand Needles are protecting an artifact from the time of the centaurs' creation.

We would like to retrieve it, but we require a phial of water from one of the night elves' moonwells.

To collect the water, you will first need to obtain one of the phials carried by the dryads near the Raynewood Retreat in the heart of Ashenvale Forest. There is a moonwell near the western bank of the Falfarren River, south of the main road, where you can fill the phial.
1195-accept.title: The Sacred Flame

1195-complete.name: Zangen Stonehoof
1195-complete.text: Very good. This should fill Rau's request just fine. Could you deliver this to him? You might enjoy spending some time out in the Needles.
1195-complete.title: The Sacred Flame

1195-progress.name: Zangen Stonehoof
1195-progress.text: Once we have the filled phial, we can send it along to my associate, Rau, in the Thousand Needles. He was the one who requested the phial of water, so he'll better know how we can make use of it.
1195-progress.title: The Sacred Flame

1196-accept.name: Zangen Stonehoof
1196-accept.text:
Bring the filled phial to Rau Cliffrunner at the Freewind Post in southeastern Thousand Needles. You can get to the Thousand Needles by taking the Great Lift at the southern edge of the Barrens.

I wouldn't be surprised if you can help us out further.
1196-accept.title: The Sacred Flame

1196-complete.name: Rau Cliffrunner
1196-complete.text: Hm, yes, this phial of water will serve our purposes perfectly. Because of the shared ancestry of the dryads and the centaurs, the water of the moonwells will enable us to breach the protection of the eternal flame surrounding the centaur relic.
1196-complete.title: The Sacred Flame

1196-progress.name: Rau Cliffrunner
1196-progress.text: I don't suppose you've been sent by Zangen, hm?
1196-progress.title: The Sacred Flame

1197-accept.name: Rau Cliffrunner
1197-accept.text:
Using the water you brought, you will be able to temporarily douse the flame that holds the centaur relic. It will not work permanently, however, so you will have to be quick about it.

You will find Splithoof Crag, the centaurs' stronghold, to the north of here. The flame is kept in Splithoof Hold, a heavily guarded part of the crag.

Be careful, though, the Galak centaur have great numbers here, and will be rather reluctant to surrender something so dear to them.
1197-accept.title: The Sacred Flame

1197-complete.name: Rau Cliffrunner
1197-complete.text:
I sense a strange energy emanating from the Hoof... I have no doubt that we will discover surprising new information about the centaur from its study.

My thanks, $N. Now I must begin to decipher the mysteries you have brought to me.
1197-complete.title: The Sacred Flame

1197-progress.name: Rau Cliffrunner
1197-progress.text: I am eager to put my hands upon the Cloven Hoof. Have you taken it yet?
1197-progress.title: The Sacred Flame

1198-complete.name: Unknown
1198-complete.text: Dawnwatcher Shaedlass was good to send you. There is indeed a wicked plot underway in this corrupted place.
1198-complete.title: In Search of Thaelrid

1199-progress.name: Argent Guard Manados
1199-progress.text:
Blackfathom Deeps was once an ancient night elf temple. It once housed a most powerful moonwell. Who knows what evil brews there now at the hands of the Twilight's Hammer.

Have you made any progress in ridding their presence?
1199-progress.title: Twilight Falls

12-accept.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
12-accept.text:
The People's Militia has but one goal:  To defend the lands of Westfall and return peace to our surroundings.  Unfortunately, the price of peace is often blood. 

One of my scouts has brought word of a band of Defias Trappers wreaking havoc nearby.  I have reports of Defias Trapper sightings near the Jangolode Mine to the Northwest as well as at the Molsen Farm and Furlbrow's Pumpkin Farm. If you seek to join our ranks, slay 15 Defias Trappers and 15 Defias Smugglers then return to me.
12-accept.title: The People's Militia

12-complete.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
12-complete.text: Well done, $N.  My scout witnessed your valiant acts.  You are proving yourself quite well so far.
12-complete.title: The People's Militia

12-progress.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
12-progress.text: Perhaps I did not make myself clear, pledge.  In order to prove your worth as a servant to The People's Militia and to the Light you need to slay 15 Defias Trappers and 15 Defias Smugglers then return to me when the deed is done.
12-progress.title: The People's Militia

120-accept.name: Magistrate Solomon
120-accept.text:
These are trying times, $c.  The township is under constant siege.  Without reinforcements, we will certainly face defeat.  The message I now entrust to you is of utmost importance.  Get this report to General Marcus Jonathan of Stormwind immediately.  Once your delivery is made, return to me at once with any news, be it good or bad. 

Now make haste!
120-accept.title: Messenger to Stormwind

120-complete.name: General Marcus Jonathan
120-complete.text:
At ease, $c.

Magistrate Solomon is a noble leader.  His words carry great weight with me.  I shall seek the counsel of the King and make the situation clear to him.  Assure the good judge that he has the Stormwind Army's support.  Reinforcements will be sent as soon as word is given from His Majesty.
120-complete.title: Messenger to Stormwind

1200-accept.name: Unknown
1200-accept.text:
Strength has left me. Your help is needed!

Long ago this site was a great temple of Elune. But misfortune led to ruin when the corruption of an Old God seeped up from beneath the earth and tainted the sacred Moon Well.

Aku'Mai, servant of the Old God, rose from the waters.

The Twilight's Hammer cultists have allied with the naga to occupy these grounds. The cultists, led by Kelris, sacrifice innocents to Aku'Mai for power.

Slay Kelris and bring his head to Selgorm in Darnassus, $N, please.
1200-accept.title: Blackfathom Villainy

1200-complete.name: Dawnwatcher Selgorm
1200-complete.text:
Kelris has eluded us for quite some time.

It seems as though whenever evil made its presence known in these parts, Kelris had played a role. For some time we considered him dead or missing.

But this makes perfect sense. By ending his reign you have spared the lives of many innocent people.

By the light! To sacrifice someone to a servant of an Old God for one's personal gain is beyond reproachful!

You have done a great deed, $N. I salute you on behalf of the Argent Dawn.
1200-complete.title: Blackfathom Villainy

1200-progress.name: Dawnwatcher Selgorm
1200-progress.text:
Time is a precious commodity, $c.

My role here in Darnassus is to ensure that the Argent Dawn thrives and that the evil forces encroaching upon Kalimdor are thwarted.

State your business quickly or be on your way.
1200-progress.title: Blackfathom Villainy

121-accept.name: General Marcus Jonathan
121-accept.text:
While I wait for a response from the King I want you to carry this letter to Magistrate Solomon. 

Dismissed, $c!
121-accept.title: Messenger to Stormwind

121-complete.name: Magistrate Solomon
121-complete.text:
Thank you for your time, $c.  For your service to Lakeshire and Stormwind I reward you with these coins.

Now if you'll excuse me, I find this correspondence somewhat of a mystery.  Something is amiss in our Kingdom.  I fear this is the beginning of conflict, not the end.
121-complete.title: Messenger to Stormwind

121-progress.name: Magistrate Solomon
121-progress.text: Did the General send news?  Are reinforcements on the way?
121-progress.title: Messenger to Stormwind

122-accept.name: Verner Osgood
122-accept.text:
I need some underbelly scales from black dragon whelps to pay for the shoes Argus sent me from Goldshire.  If you can get 6 of them for me, then I can pay Argus with some... and have enough left to fashion something for you.

Black dragon whelps are often flying around south of Lakeshire, but they like to wander.  You might have to just keep an eye out and hunt them when you see them.
122-accept.title: Underbelly Scales

122-complete.name: Verner Osgood
122-complete.text: Thanks!  These will get me out of debt to Argus...
122-complete.title: Underbelly Scales

122-progress.name: Verner Osgood
122-progress.text: I know that greedy Argus will send someone to collect his scales if I don't give them to him soon.  Have you found those scales yet?
122-progress.title: Underbelly Scales

1221-accept.name: Mebok Mizzyrix
1221-accept.text:
Blueleaf tubers are a delicacy around the world!  But they're rare, very rare.  The only place to find them is here in the Barrens, deep in the earth, in Razorfen Kraul.

And even then, they're impossible to find unless you know just where to look!  That's why I've trained these snufflenose gophers to find them for me.  They have great noses and can smell a tuber from fifty paces away.

It won't be easy, but if you get me some tubers I'll pay you handsomely.
1221-accept.title: Blueleaf Tubers

123-accept.name: Unknown
123-accept.text:
This note is a schedule with a list of days and times when a person -- described only as "The Collector" -- will receive a shipment of gold from the mines in Elwynn Forest.

From the schedule, it looks as if the Collector resides near the Brackwell Pumpkin Patch in eastern Elwynn.

This sounds important.  You should report it to Marshal Dughan in Goldshire.
123-accept.title: The Collector

123-complete.name: Marshal Dughan
123-complete.text: Hm... I have heard of this "Collector" but I don't know whom he's working for.  Thank you for the schedule.  It will help us solve this mystery.
123-complete.title: The Collector

123-progress.name: Marshal Dughan
123-progress.text:
What?!?  We haven't had our people working the Elwynn mines for months!

Let me see that note you have...
123-progress.title: The Collector

124-accept.name: Verner Osgood
124-accept.text:
As if the attacking orcs weren't enough!  Now I have gnoll brutes and mystics prowling along the ridge north of my stable, taking my horses when they stray...

If you can get rid of those gnolls, my horses and I would be very grateful.
124-accept.title: A Baying of Gnolls

124-complete.name: Verner Osgood
124-complete.text: Thank you for all your help, $N.
124-complete.title: A Baying of Gnolls

1241-accept.name: Bishop DeLavey
1241-accept.text:
Recently a diplomat was sent to Theramore to meet with Jaina Proudmoore. That diplomat never arrived.

I believe the Defias are involved in this plot, but I'm not sure how. The diplomat's disappearance still eludes public attention, but it can't remain that way for long.

Agents of the king are already scouring the city for clues, but I have my own contacts I would like involved.

In the Valley of Heroes is an old friend of mine named Jorgen. Find him, give him this note, and follow his instructions.
1241-accept.title: The Missing Diplomat

1241-complete.name: Jorgen
1241-complete.text:
Hmm... <Jorgen looks up at you through squinted eyes.>

All right. I'll help ya, but not because I want to, but because I'm obligated.

And let's get one thing straight: you're knowin' far more than you should to begin with. Let's keep this our little secret, and don't go blabbin' at any taverns about anything you find out. Understand?
1241-complete.title: The Missing Diplomat

1241-progress.name: Jorgen
1241-progress.text: Hmph, you better have good reason to interrupt a man and his fishin'. I don't take kindly to peddlers, let alone beggars.
1241-progress.title: The Missing Diplomat

1242-accept.name: Jorgen
1242-accept.text:
Take this here note to Elling Trias. Don't say nothin' else to him. Just be polite and wait for him to respond. And don't worry, he will.

I'm gonna only impress this on ya once more, $N: treat this matter seriously, and keep your yapper shut.

Ya can find Trias at his cheese shop, Trias' Cheese, in the Trade District. Good luck.
1242-accept.title: The Missing Diplomat

1242-complete.name: Elling Trias
1242-complete.text:
I'm sorry, a letter for me? Well, I'll be... not often you get a delivery that's not a crate or barrel when all you do is work. Let's see what this is about.

<Elling looks up at you while he opens the letter.>

You look a little tense, you okay, $N?
1242-complete.title: The Missing Diplomat

1242-progress.name: Elling Trias
1242-progress.text: Hello, $N. Is there something I can do for you? Perhaps you'd like to try some of our special Trias cheddar? Or a block of Darnassian bleu?
1242-progress.title: The Missing Diplomat

1243-accept.name: Elling Trias
1243-accept.text:
Jorgen, you ol' sonuva.... So, that's how it's going to be, huh?

All right, I can deal with that. I hope he finds the Twisting Nether that much sooner!

Here's what's gonna happen, $N. I'll start using my contacts here, but you're doing most of the footwork so I save some coin.

Head to Darkshire in Duskwood and find Watcher Backus--he usually patrols the north road right outside of town. Just tell him you're looking into any Defias activity for me and he'll help you out with any information he can.
1243-accept.title: The Missing Diplomat

1243-progress.name: Watcher Backus
1243-progress.text:
Not too safe to be traveling about in the woods, $N. Be careful, and if you see anything suspicious or dangerous, contact the Watchers immediately. Don't try and take anything on yourself. We're not responsible for anything terrible that might happen to you.

But we both know you're gonna ignore me and fight whatever comes out of the darkness anyway, don't we? Haha, yeah, you adventurer types... all the same.
1243-progress.title: The Missing Diplomat

1244-progress.name: Watcher Backus
1244-progress.text: Be careful out there, $N. I know Trias was the one to send you here, but that doesn't mean there isn't anything lurking out in the woods that couldn't cause you some trouble... especially with you investigating the Defias.
1244-progress.title: The Missing Diplomat

1245-progress.name: Elling Trias
1245-progress.text: I see you're back, and in one piece. We both know you're not here for cheese, so let's cut out the pleasantries. Was Backus any help, or have you even left for Duskwood yet?
1245-progress.title: The Missing Diplomat

125-accept.name: Foreman Oslow
125-accept.text:
I could really use a hand here, $N.  With the town under siege, it's been hard to get supplies.  My tools were being delivered from Goldshire by wagon but the bridge was blown out.  We put the tools in a boat but the orcs hit it with a catapult.  Just my luck, my toolbox sank right to the bottom of the lake.

Retrieve my toolbox, $N, and I'll make it worth your while.
125-accept.title: The Lost Tools

125-complete.name: Foreman Oslow
125-complete.text: Excellent recovery, $N!  I never thought I'd see these tools again.
125-complete.title: The Lost Tools

125-progress.name: Foreman Oslow
125-progress.text: Were you able to find my tools?
125-progress.title: The Lost Tools

1250-accept.name: Tapoke "Slim" Jahn
1250-accept.text:
The Defias didn't pay me well enough to die for their cause. They took the king. Yeah, the king of Stormwind, not some lowly diplomat. He was on his way to Theramore to meet with Jaina Proudmoore--it was a big deal apparently, and a big secret. But it's not just the Defias that are involved. They're working with someone. I think they knew this was bigger than them.

My part was just to get their man on board the king's ship while it was moored. The guy's name was Hendel. That's all I know. I swear!
1250-accept.title: The Missing Diplomat

126-accept.name: Verner Osgood
126-accept.text:
$N, the gnolls are still out there.  I can hear their baying as they hunt in the hills above Lakeshire.  And one cry is louder than the rest - Yowler,  their leader.

Kill Yowler and send his pack scattering!  Bring me his paw as proof.

And be careful, this gnoll is their leader for a reason.  He is no Mongrel...
126-accept.title: Howling in the Hills

126-complete.name: Verner Osgood
126-complete.text: Again, thank you for your help.  The Stormwind army is so busy dealing with the orcs, they don't have the troops to protect Redridge from local threats like the gnolls.
126-complete.title: Howling in the Hills

126-progress.name: Verner Osgood
126-progress.text: Yowler is a dangerous creature, $N.  If you're not ready for him, I understand.
126-progress.title: Howling in the Hills

127-accept.name: Dockmaster Baren
127-accept.text:
Lake Everstill is famous for its spotted sunfish.  There's always demand for them...and I'm running low!

Bring me a batch of 10 and I'll barter well for them.  If you can't fish yourself, then...maybe you can get them off the murlocs!
127-accept.title: Selling Fish

127-complete.name: Dockmaster Baren
127-complete.text: Pleasure doin' business with you, matey!
127-complete.title: Selling Fish

127-progress.name: Dockmaster Baren
127-progress.text: You have some sunfish for me, eh?
127-progress.title: Selling Fish

1274-accept.name: Thomas
1274-accept.text: Excuse me, $g sir : madam;. Bishop DeLavey asked me to approach adventurers that might be able to help him with a delicate matter.$B$BIf you could quietly head to Stormwind Keep and speak to him at your earliest convenience, I'm sure he would appreciate your help. Again, please be discreet. It is a matter of some importance.
1274-accept.title: The Missing Diplomat

1274-complete.name: Bishop DeLavey
1274-complete.text:
Hello, $N. I am Bishop DeLavey.

No doubt if you're asking me about my business here in the keep then young Thomas has succeeded in requisitioning you to help our kingdom. He has always been adept at following my requests.

I'm afraid I don't have time to elaborate much, so allow me to be blunt... and please, try to keep this from becoming common knowledge.
1274-complete.title: The Missing Diplomat

1275-accept.name: Gershala Nightwhisper
1275-accept.text:
Foolish blood elves toil with demonic magic. Have they not witnessed what happened with the naga and with the satyrs of Kalimdor?

I fear that the blood elves will meet a similar deformation. Azeroth cannot afford to give birth to another vile race of monsters.

I wish to study the brain stems of the satyr and naga so that I might deduce what fate the elves are headed toward. In Blackfathom Deeps, on the coast of Ashenvale, you will find both satyr and naga.

'Tis a long journey, $N.
1275-accept.title: Researching the Corruption

1275-progress.name: Gershala Nightwhisper
1275-progress.text:
Once I have enough samples to study, my true work can begin. With the corrupted brain stems of both the satyr and naga of Blackfathom Deeps I can try to draw a correlation between the mutations.

Perhaps with that gained knowledge we can prevent the blood elves from delving deeper into deformity and evil.
1275-progress.title: Researching the Corruption

128-accept.name: Guard Howe
128-accept.text:
The Blackrock Clan must be destroyed. The Enemy has invaded our lands. These mountains fall under the sovereign right of the King of Stormwind. Our sources tell us that the leaders of each unit within the Clan are known as Champions. You'll find them in their encampment to the north, just west of the road to the Burning Steppes.

Magistrate Solomon wants these foul brutes dead. Slay 15 Blackrock Champions and return to me.
128-accept.title: Blackrock Bounty

128-complete.name: Guard Howe
128-complete.text: I see you have fought valiantly against the Blackrock Clan, $C.  Your service to our township is great indeed.
128-complete.title: Blackrock Bounty

128-progress.name: Guard Howe
128-progress.text: Return once you have slain 15 Blackrock Champions.
128-progress.title: Blackrock Bounty

129-accept.name: Darcy
129-accept.text:
Can you do me a favor?  I've prepared a lunch for Guard Parker, but he's out on patrol...he's a big, strong Stormwind guard who can defend himself, but it's much too dangerous out there for a townsperson like me.

So if you deliver his lunch for me, then come back here and I'll give you a free lunch!  Parker patrols the stretch of road leading to Duskwood.
129-accept.title: A Free Lunch

129-complete.name: Guard Parker
129-complete.text: Thanks, I could really use the meal.  Guarding Lakeshire from the orcs and gnolls is tough work!
129-complete.title: A Free Lunch

129-progress.name: Guard Parker
129-progress.text: Darcy sent me a lunch, did she?  Such a kind heart she has.  Well...let's have it!
129-progress.title: A Free Lunch

13-accept.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
13-accept.text:
A band of vicious Defias Pillagers has been seen plundering the Gold Coast Quarry, Moonbrook and the Alexston Farmstead.  The People's Militia will not stand for such behavior.  Dispatch immediately, $N, and make the Light's presence known in Westfall.

The Gold Coast Quarry is near the shore, to the West of the tower.  As the next step of your training, I want you to kill 15 of those foul Defias Pillagers and 15 Defias Looters.
13-accept.title: The People's Militia

13-complete.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
13-complete.text: Your worth to The People's Militia has been validated by your brave acts thus far.
13-complete.title: The People's Militia

13-progress.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
13-progress.text: We have not time to talk, $N.  The Defias Pillagers are denying the people of Westfall the peace and prosperity they deserve.  Make sure at least 15 Defias Pillagers and 15 Defias Looters have been killed.  That will send a clear message that corruption is not welcome here.
13-progress.title: The People's Militia

130-accept.name: Guard Parker
130-accept.text:
Before you go back to Darcy, can you bring her some flowers for me?  You can get them at the herbalist shop back in Lakeshire, at the west end of town.

But when you get the flowers...don't tell the herbalist, Martie, whom they're from, or whom they're for...
130-accept.title: Visit the Herbalist

130-complete.name: Martie Jainrose
130-complete.text:
You need a bouquet of flowers?  You haven't been in town very long...have you already found for yourself a sweetheart here?

I know I shouldn't pry, but it's nice to see that love is in the air... especially in dangerous times like these.
130-complete.title: Visit the Herbalist

131-accept.name: Martie Jainrose
131-accept.text: Here is your bouquet.  I chose Daffodils for you.  They're my favorite!
131-accept.title: Delivering Daffodils

131-complete.name: Darcy
131-complete.text:
Oh, those are lovely!  I can't wait to put them in some water!

But...these are Martie's favorite flowers.  Parker didn't have you go to that jealous vixen for this bouquet, did he?  You didn't tell her who they were for, did you?  If you did, then it wouldn't surprise me if she poisoned them.

Oh, but it's not your fault.  Thank you, and here's your meal.
131-complete.title: Delivering Daffodils

131-progress.name: Darcy
131-progress.text: Hello again, $N.  Did Parker like the lunch I sent him?
131-progress.title: Delivering Daffodils

132-accept.name: Wiley the Black
132-accept.text:
What I am about to tell you could cost me my life.  The Defias gang is up to something big.  Last I heard they were working in conjunction with various gnolls, kobolds and even goblins.

Take this note to Stoutmantle.  It explains as much as I know on the subject.
132-accept.title: The Defias Brotherhood

132-complete.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
132-complete.text: Bah!  I should have let that scoundrel rot when I had the chance.  But this information is crucial.  Good work.
132-complete.title: The Defias Brotherhood

132-progress.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
132-progress.text: Good to see you back, $N.  What did Wiley have to say for himself?
132-progress.title: The Defias Brotherhood

1324-complete.name: Archmage Tervosh
1324-complete.text:
I assure you, we're all quite upset about current events, but allow us to take him back to Theramore for some questioning, and we'll see about finding the King.

I'm sure my lady Proudmoore would like to thank you for your help. Speak to her when you have a moment.
1324-complete.title: The Missing Diplomat

133-accept.name: Abercrombie
133-accept.text:
I live so far from the protection of town, it's a wonder the ghouls and the walking dead haven't eaten me!  In fact, just yesterday a pack of Bone Chewers was pounding on the walls of my house!

I want to make an effigy - a kind of "scarecrow" for Ghouls.  To do that I need some Ghoul Ribs.  You can get them from Flesh Eaters, Bone Chewers, Brain Eaters, Rotted Ones and Plague Spreaders.

Get the ribs for me, and I will repay you with some coin.
133-accept.title: Ghoulish Effigy

133-complete.name: Abercrombie
133-complete.text: Ah, thanks.  These will do just the trick!
133-complete.title: Ghoulish Effigy

133-progress.name: Abercrombie
133-progress.text: I think I hear a pack of Ghouls scurrying around the back of the house - I better put that effigy up quick!  Did you get those Ghoul Ribs for me?
133-progress.title: Ghoulish Effigy

1338-accept.name: Mountaineer Stormpike
1338-accept.text:
There is a dwarven armorsmith whose work I admire greatly.  His name is Furen Longbeard, and his skill is unmatched.  I need a new shield, and I must have one of his!

The problem is... Furen is far to the south, in the dwarven district within Stormwind.  In human lands!  I can't imagine why he would live there, so far from Ironforge.  The humans must pay him a king's ransom to keep him there!

So, if you want to travel and don't mind making some money, then will you send Furen my request for a shield?
1338-accept.title: Stormpike's Order

1338-complete.name: Furen Longbeard
1338-complete.text:
Ah, a request from one of the Stormpikes.  That's a proud clan, full of quality dwarves.  Rich ones, too.

Thank you, $N.  I'll get to work on Mountaineer Stormpike's shield by the end of the day.
1338-complete.title: Stormpike's Order

1338-progress.name: Furen Longbeard
1338-progress.text:
A letter from the dwarven lands?  I wonder who would call from so far to the north...

Please, let me see the order.
1338-progress.title: Stormpike's Order

1339-accept.name: Mountaineer Kadrell
1339-accept.text:
I hear Mountaineer Stormpike is looking for a runner.  Someone to do a little traveling for him.  How about it?  Are you the $r for the job?

If so, then you'll find Stormpike at the top of the northern guard tower.
1339-accept.title: Mountaineer Stormpike's Task

1339-complete.name: Mountaineer Stormpike
1339-complete.text:
That's right.  I have a task that I can't do while I'm guarding.  In fact, it'll take you far from Loch Modan.

Your perfect chance for adventure!
1339-complete.title: Mountaineer Stormpike's Task

134-accept.name: Abercrombie
134-accept.text:
A few weeks ago I was picking herbs far from my house, and a band of ogres attacked me!  I ran, and I was forced to leave behind a crate of precious tools and herbs.

After they chased me off, the ogres swaggered back to the ogre mound in southern Duskwood.  I'm sure my crate is somewhere near the mound.

Please, $N, retrieve this crate for me for I miss it sorely.
134-accept.title: Ogre Thieves

134-complete.name: Abercrombie
134-complete.text:
Thank the Nec-...well, thank YOU, $N!  You have more than earned your reward.

Aha!  Happy!  Happy nights ahead!!
134-complete.title: Ogre Thieves

134-progress.name: Abercrombie
134-progress.text: Do you have my crate?  If so, then please...give it to me quickly!
134-progress.title: Ogre Thieves

135-accept.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
135-accept.text: I wonder what Wiley meant when he mentioned the Stonemasons.  Perhaps that was a slip of tongue.  Could the Defias gang be related to the Stonemasons?  Only one man would know for sure:  Mathias Shaw, head of SI:7. Show him Wiley's Note and see if he has anything to add to this growing mystery. If you have trouble finding Shaw, check the Barracks in Old Town.
135-accept.title: The Defias Brotherhood

135-complete.name: Master Mathias Shaw
135-complete.text: This matter might be more complex than Stoutmantle realizes.
135-complete.title: The Defias Brotherhood

135-progress.name: Master Mathias Shaw
135-progress.text: What business do you have with me?  I am a very busy man. . .
135-progress.title: The Defias Brotherhood

1358-accept.name: Apothecary Zinge
1358-accept.text:
A colleague in Kalimdor, Apothecary Helbrim, is researching the effects of Lordaeron toxins on the beasts of Kalimdor.  He would be very interested in a sample of the wolf hearts Renferrel sent me.

Helbrim is stationed in the Barrens, in a village known as the Crossroads.  To reach him, you must travel via zeppelin to the orc capital of Orgrimmar, then travel south, by foot, to Durotar.  Head west into the Barrens, and you will soon reach the Crossroads.
1358-accept.title: Sample for Helbrim

1358-complete.name: Apothecary Helbrim
1358-complete.text:
Ah, very good.  If initial reports are true, then the toxicity of these hearts could lead to further advances in our knowledge of poisons.

This is a welcome delivery, $N.  Your reward is well earned.
1358-complete.title: Sample for Helbrim

1358-progress.name: Apothecary Helbrim
1358-progress.text: You have a package for me?
1358-progress.title: Sample for Helbrim

1359-accept.name: Apothecary Renferrel
1359-accept.text:
The wolf hearts you acquired possess a quality unseen in similar specimens.  There is a toxicity to them that should be deadly to the very wolves in which the hearts beat!

It's quite incredible, and we must study it further.  I kept a few samples of the hearts acquired.  Take them to my colleague, Apothecary Zinge.  You will find her in our headquarters in the Undercity.
1359-accept.title: Zinge's Delivery

1359-complete.name: Apothecary Zinge
1359-complete.text: Ah yes, the heart samples of which Renferrel spoke.  I am eager to experiment with these... it is always of interest to the Royal Apothecary Society when new forms of toxins are discovered.
1359-complete.title: Zinge's Delivery

1361-accept.name: Nazgrel
1361-accept.text:
A warrior of the Horde, Regthar Deathgate, is recruiting agents for a mission into the land of Desolace.  Speak with him if you wish to volunteer.  He is stationed in the Barrens, in a series of bunkers west of the Crossroads.

And sharpen your weapons.  Desolace is a place torn by war.
1361-accept.title: Regthar Deathgate

1369-progress.name: Warug
1369-progress.text: If you are not our enemy, then you will do what I ask!
1369-progress.title: Broken Tears

1371-progress.name: Warug
1371-progress.text: If you are not our enemy, then you will do what I ask!
1371-progress.title: Gizmo for Warug

139-complete.name: Unknown
