<Carendin holds one heart in each hand, then gently brings them together.>

Idiots.
65593-complete.title: Hearts of the Lovers

65593-progress.name: Carendin Halgar
65593-progress.text: Ah, $N, you return. Were you able to procure the lovers' hearts?
65593-progress.title: Hearts of the Lovers

65597-accept.name: Carendin Halgar
65597-accept.text:
The time has come at last. Bring the hearts to the summoning circle below. Place them at its center and call forth the incubus.

The demon will not be pleased when it realizes that you have tempted it into a trap. Do not fall prey to its beguilement, $N. You must subdue it fully.

Only then can I teach you the spell to bind it to your will.
65597-accept.title: The Binding

65597-complete.name: Carendin Halgar
65597-complete.text:
Impressive. Very impressive. The sayaad specialize in preying upon mortals. Many a $c has thought themselves strong enough to command one, only to find themselves being commanded instead.

This trial did not break you, $N, and your efforts have earned your reward. I will teach you the spell to summon the incubus.
65597-complete.title: The Binding

65597-progress.name: Carendin Halgar
65597-progress.text:
The incubus possesses martial prowess, but its illusory charms are its most potent weapon. Falter for even a moment, and the demon will seize upon the opportunity to enthrall you.

Do not let it, $N.
65597-progress.title: The Binding

65601-accept.name: Cazul
65601-accept.text:
A sayaad male is known as an incubus. A creature of profound evil and singular mind.

The demon must be lured into our world with an item of enticement - an object that represents great love and devotion.

If you trust a blind man to lead you, $N, then listen. East from the Cleft of Shadow, along the main drag of Orgrimmar, lives Magar. He longs for the return of his mate, Krilge.

Seek him out. He'll ask you to search for something precious. That is the key which you must bring to Gan'rul.
65601-accept.title: Love Hurts

65601-complete.name: Magar
65601-complete.text: Who told you about Krilge? Have you come with any news? You better not be toying with me...
65601-complete.title: Love Hurts

65602-accept.name: Takar the Seer
65602-accept.text:
You will need a powerful reagent to tempt an incubus -- an object that represents great devotion and love.

With my scrying, I have located a small figurine that should be suitable for your ritual.

Thousands of years ago, the figurine belonged to a young couple. The original owners are no more, but their keepsake has survived to the present day.

Follow the road north into Ashenvale, then west and past Maestra's Post. You will see a house nestled amongst the trees. There you will find what you seek.
65602-accept.title: What Is Love?

65604-accept.name: Gan'rul Bloodeye
65604-accept.text:
Yes... I see. I feel the residual emotions bound within these threads. Love is woven into its stitches. The incubus will not be able to resist.

Take this to the summoning circle in Neeru's tent, $N. Summon forth a malevolent incubus, then show it your mastery. Do not expect it to be subdued quietly. Ready your magic and prepare yourself for a fight. Underestimating a demon has been many a $c's final mistake.

When you have defeated it, return the cloth to me. I will let Magar know what you found.
65604-accept.title: The Binding

65604-complete.name: Gan'rul Bloodeye
65604-complete.text:
Hah! Victorious, as expected!

The incubus is subdued, and it will be my pleasure to teach you to summon the demon. You strength is growing, and I have no doubt that this is a mere stepping stone to even greater powers.

I will return the scarf to Magar. I have known that orc for many years, and never did I think he would care for someone the way he cared for Krilge.

It is a reminder of what separates us from the demons. We wield their darkness, but they will never wield us.
65604-complete.title: The Binding

65604-progress.name: Gan'rul Bloodeye
65604-progress.text:
The sayaad are dominators of minds and torturers of souls. Their visage brings the heart joy, leaving you defenseless when they rend your flesh with whip and claw.

Do not entertain the incubus' charms, $N. Slay it quickly and let it be done.
65604-progress.title: The Binding

6561-accept.name: Zeroth
6561-accept.text:
Strength has left me. Your help is needed!

Long ago this site was a great temple of Elune. But misfortune led to ruin when the corruption of an Old God seeped up from beneath the earth and tainted the sacred Moon Well.

Aku'Mai, servant of the Old God, rose from the waters.

The Twilight's Hammer cultists have allied with the naga to occupy these grounds. The cultists, led by Kelris, sacrifice innocents to Aku'Mai for power.

Slay Kelris and bring his head to Bashana in Thunder Bluff, $N, please.
6561-accept.title: Blackfathom Villainy

6561-complete.name: Bashana Runetotem
6561-complete.text:
Kelris has eluded the Argent Dawn for some time.

For some time they considered him dead or missing.

By ending his reign you have spared the lives of many innocent people, $N.

Earthmother be praised! To sacrifice another to a servant of an Old God for personal gain is beyond disgusting!

You have done a great thing this day. Kelris was a creature of evil and sought to bring the world back to a time of chaos by worshipping such creatures as the Old Gods. Thank you, $N.
6561-complete.title: Blackfathom Villainy

6561-progress.name: Bashana Runetotem
6561-progress.text:
May the Earthmother be with you, $N.

Peace between the earth and all her people should be our goal. She has a grand plan for nature, and we all have a role to play in that plan.
6561-progress.title: Blackfathom Villainy

65610-accept.name: Magar
65610-accept.text:
I met Krilge while making Mooncloth in Ashenvale. He was stationed there to protect civilians from danger, until he disappeared...

They've stopped looking for him and consider him a deserter, but I don't believe it.

We would often meet at Fallen Sky Lake before it became overrun by those aggressive bog beasts.

I'm not typically one to ask favors, but if you could go to Ashenvale and look for any sign of him, I'd appreciate it.
65610-accept.title: Wish You Were Here

65610-complete.name: Gan'rul Bloodeye
65610-complete.text: What is it you have there, $N? A scarf made of... Mooncloth? You best not be seeking to romance me.
65610-complete.title: Wish You Were Here

6562-accept.name: Tsunaman
6562-accept.text: Je'neu Sancrea is in need of aid. He is at the Zoram'gar Outpost in Ashenvale. The Night elf forest is to the north of the Stonetalon mountains. You can reach it by traveling through Windshear Crag or by heading north through Barrens. Zoram Strand is far to the west of the forest. Be careful, $N. There are forces there that will not take to your presence kindly.
6562-accept.title: Trouble in the Deeps

6562-complete.name: Je'neu Sancrea
6562-complete.text: Tsunaman sent you? Excellent. Then we have matters to discuss.
6562-complete.title: Trouble in the Deeps

6563-accept.name: Je'neu Sancrea
6563-accept.text:
Within the beginning tunnels of Blackfathom Deeps, large sapphire clusters can be found along the cave walls. Recently it was noted that the naga were harvesting the crystals. Until it can be discerned why, I sense we should stop the naga from succeeding. The crystals have great elemental power and if used inappropriately, could make for a powerful arcane component.

Will you help me, $N? Blackfathom Deeps can be found along Zoram Strand to the north of our outpost.
6563-accept.title: The Essence of Aku'Mai

6563-complete.name: Je'neu Sancrea
6563-complete.text:
Well done, $N. These are the crystals I spoke of. Intriguing...

I can feel the power within them. The spirits of water cling to them. Whatever the naga were going to use these for... well, let us be glad they are no longer in their hands.
6563-complete.title: The Essence of Aku'Mai

6563-progress.name: Je'neu Sancrea
6563-progress.text: How goes your search for the crystals, $N? Have you witnessed the naga harvesting them? I pray to my ancestors we find the reason they are collecting such things.
6563-progress.title: The Essence of Aku'Mai

6564-accept.name: Unknown
6564-accept.text:
Some poor handwriting is scrawled on the crumpled up note:

"Yes, tell all the priestesses to bring the crystals to me. The water elemental spirits are strong within them and they will aid our aquamancers greatly in their own summonings.

By controlling the power within the crystals, we will appease Aku'Mai. One day we will have enough power to bring Aku'Mai back to us and the world will return to its greatest era! An era of rule by the Old Gods!"
6564-accept.title: Allegiance to the Old Gods

6564-complete.name: Je'neu Sancrea
6564-complete.text:
This is interesting indeed. I am glad you have brought it to my attention.

Now we have a name for our troubles... Lorgus Jett.
6564-complete.title: Allegiance to the Old Gods

6564-progress.name: Je'neu Sancrea
6564-progress.text: Yes, $N? What is it you need? There is still much I must learn about the crystals the naga are gathering.
6564-progress.title: Allegiance to the Old Gods

6565-accept.name: Je'neu Sancrea
6565-accept.text:
This Twilight's Hammer follower cannot be allowed to complete his plan. The Twilight's Hammer do not understand the spirits of nature. They believe in the Old Gods--creatures of chaos and destruction that were long ago defeated. This Lorgus cannot be allowed to succeed. You must stop him, $N. I cannot do it myself--I am too weak.

Go into Blackfathom Deeps, find him, and kill him. Return to me here at Zoram'gar when it's done.
6565-accept.title: Allegiance to the Old Gods

6565-complete.name: Je'neu Sancrea
6565-complete.text:
Very good!! Thank you, $N. We may not have stopped the Twilight's Hammer completely, but at least you have staved off another of their plans to return the Old Gods to power.

Who knows what other plans they have manifesting, but we can rest easy for now.
6565-complete.title: Allegiance to the Old Gods

6565-progress.name: Je'neu Sancrea
6565-progress.text: Have you found him yet, $N? Lorgus must be stopped!
6565-progress.title: Allegiance to the Old Gods

6571-accept.name: Locke Okarr
6571-accept.text:
We are in short supply of a few items at the Warsong lumber camp!

Pixel at Splintertree Post has our shipment of saw blades. It'll take a trip to Booty Bay to pick up a crate of axes from Wharfmaster Lozgil.

Our shipment of oil and rope will be more difficult. The rope was pilfered by the Thistlefur and Foulweald furbolgs, and the satyrs intercepted the delivery of the oil and are now using it for detestable rituals in Night Run, Satyrnaar, and Xavian!

Can you help me?
6571-accept.title: Warsong Supplies

6571-complete.name: Locke Okarr
6571-complete.text:
Excellent, $N. You've saved me a lot of work!

But don't think that I'm not grateful!
6571-complete.title: Warsong Supplies

6571-progress.name: Locke Okarr
6571-progress.text: I hope you can come through with the supplies! I'm in big trouble if I don't deliver them soon!
6571-progress.title: Warsong Supplies

6581-complete.name: Pixel
6581-complete.text: This is perfect -- just the thing! Well, here's the shipment.
6581-complete.title: Warsong Saw Blades

6581-progress.name: Pixel
6581-progress.text:
Direct from Ratchet, the Warsong saw blades! Yep, I have them right here.

..But what sort of payment do you have for me? You can't just take them, you know! My time isn't cheap!

What I really need is a good gun to carry with me on my travels. A girl's gotta protect herself, you know? There's a gun I really like that I'm sure an engineer would have no problem making.

So, if you bring me a deadly blunderbuss, I'll give you the saw blade shipment. Do we have a deal?
6581-progress.title: Warsong Saw Blades

66-accept.name: Madame Eva
66-accept.text:
Last night a horrible disturbance rippled through my veins.  I sensed that my granddaughter, Alyssa, was in great danger.  I consulted the cards and Death stared up at me from the table.

After taking a long journey through a dark trance I was able to uncover a clue to this terrifying mystery.  A name came to me, the name of Stalvan.

Seek out the Clerk in the Town Hall and see if you can find out more about this character.  I fear for us all.
66-accept.title: The Legend of Stalvan

66-complete.name: Clerk Daltry
66-complete.text: Ah so Madame Eva sent you. . . .
66-complete.title: The Legend of Stalvan

6621-accept.name: Karang Amakkar
6621-accept.text:
$N, another tribe of Furbolgs,  the Foulweald, live southeast of Astranaar.  They are not as many as the Thistlefur, but their ferocity poses a future threat.  With a show of force, we can remove that threat.

Take this banner, go to the Foulweald village and place it on their totem mound.  They will try to destroy the banner, but hold your ground until their chief, Murgut, appears to save face for the tribe.  Bring me the totem he carries.

Gather your allies, $N.  This is no task for a single $c.
6621-accept.title: King of the Foulweald

6621-complete.name: Karang Amakkar
6621-complete.text:
Good work, $N.  Issuing that challenge to the Foulwealds and defeating their leader sends them a strong message:

The Horde is not to be trifled with.

I don't believe that tribe will be giving us much trouble for a long time.
6621-complete.title: King of the Foulweald

6621-progress.name: Karang Amakkar
6621-progress.text: Did you defeat Chief Murgut, $N?  Did you retrieve his Foulweald Totem?
6621-progress.title: King of the Foulweald

6627-accept.name: Braug Dimspirit
6627-accept.text:
You have brought me the book, and now it is time for your question. Are you ready?

Time is not an issue, $c, so do not feel pressured. You may take as long as you like to answer.
6627-accept.title: Test of Lore

6627-complete.name: Braug Dimspirit
6627-complete.text: Well done, $c. You have studied the text I asked you to, and now you have passed another of our tests.
6627-complete.title: Test of Lore

6629-accept.name: Makaba Flathoof
6629-accept.text:
$N, you've done a fine job killing Grimtotem. If you dare, Grundig Darkcloud and his personal band of brutes is by far the worst of the lot. He was the one who led the brutal attack on my village.

You will find him in Grimtotem Post a bit further up the path to the west. Kill him, and I will be forever grateful.
6629-accept.title: Kill Grundig Darkcloud

6629-complete.name: Makaba Flathoof
6629-complete.text: Grundig Darkcloud is dead! $N, I will always be grateful for what you've done here today.
6629-complete.title: Kill Grundig Darkcloud

6641-accept.name: Muglash
6641-accept.text:
Vorsha the Lasher... the fiendish hydra that roams the seas...

She has attacked our outpost, each time unprovoked, laying waste to anything that falls in her path.

But I am ready, $N. I have prepared to best the hydra and end these attacks on Zoram'gar.

The naga honor the wicked nature of this beast with a brazier that remains lit on an island just off the coast. I believe that if we put it out, Vorsha will appear in anger.

We will need help, so be sure to bring some strong allies.
6641-accept.title: Vorsha the Lasher

6641-complete.name: Warsong Runner
6641-complete.text:
I have witnessed many naga attacks since I arrived here. It puts my mind at ease that Vorsha will no longer roam freely.

We are in your debt, $N.
6641-complete.title: Vorsha the Lasher

6661-accept.name: Monty
6661-accept.text:
Avast ye scallywag. Arrrr... Arrrr ye looking fer work? We gots a serious rat problem down here an' not enough hands on the poop deck.

What do ye say? All ye needs to do is take this here rat catchin' flute and play the melody around the vermin. They'll follow ye to the ends of the world!

Just capture five of the little buggers and bring em back here. We needs em alive.

Arrrrr...
6661-accept.title: Deeprun Rat Roundup

6661-complete.name: Monty
6661-complete.text: These'll werk nicely, matey. Me brother needs em still tickin' and kickin,' else they go sour... Ye don't want to taste no sour rat kabob.
6661-complete.title: Deeprun Rat Roundup

6661-progress.name: Monty
6661-progress.text: Yarrr... Swabby, what be takin' ye so long?
6661-progress.title: Deeprun Rat Roundup

6662-accept.name: Monty
6662-accept.text:
Me brother, Nipsy, runs a rat kabob operation on the other side of Deeprun. Ye needs to take this here crate o' rats to him before they go bad. Get a move on!

Ye have ridden a tram before, aye? It's easy. Just step aboard when she arrives and enjoy the ride. An' keep yer arms and legs inside durin' the ride, lest ye be peglegged fer life.
6662-accept.title: Me Brother, Nipsy

6662-complete.name: Nipsy
6662-complete.text:
Poor Monty. Ever since the Gnomeregan incident, he hasn't been the same. That boy has never seen an ocean in his life, let alone being some kind of pirate.

<Nipsy sighs.>

At least he keeps the flow of twitching critters coming.
6662-complete.title: Me Brother, Nipsy

6662-progress.name: Nipsy
6662-progress.text:
<Nipsy puts his index finger through one of the air holes in the carton.>

Alive and kicking... and just in time!
6662-progress.title: Me Brother, Nipsy

67-accept.name: Clerk Daltry
67-accept.text:
Stalvan, eh?  Let me check the town registry.

Stalvan. . .Stalvan. . .let's see.  Ah, here we go!  I have a record of a Mr. Stalvan Mistmantle.  The last recorded address is the Moonbrook Schoolhouse.  My, talk about outdated!

Do me a favor will you, friend?  If you happen to go out to Moonbrook, let me know if you get any update on this fellow.  I like to keep the records clean.
67-accept.title: The Legend of Stalvan

6701-progress.name: Ravenholdt Guard
6701-progress.text:
We have been entrenched in a battle with the Syndicate for years. What they lack in skill they make up for in numbers. It's impossible to kill them off fast enough to have any noticeable impact on their population!

We've found that the best way to deal with their size is to pilfer their emblems. Once an emblem is stolen the shamed member is 'dealt' with internally.

Pick their pockets clean and turn the emblems in to me or one of the other guards.

Start at Durnholde, south of here.
6701-progress.title: Syndicate Emblems

68-accept.name: Unknown
68-accept.text: You find a Dusty Unsent Letter in the old footlocker.
68-accept.title: The Legend of Stalvan

68-complete.name: Clerk Daltry
68-complete.text: Interesting.  So the chap did spend some time in Moonbrook after all.  It is rather odd the letter never got delivered.  Nonetheless, I shall update the registry.
68-complete.title: The Legend of Stalvan

68-progress.name: Clerk Daltry
68-progress.text: Ah, I remember you.  You're the one who was asking about that Stalvan fellow.  Did you ever find what you were looking for?
68-progress.title: The Legend of Stalvan

683-progress.name: King Magni Bronzebeard
683-progress.text:
So you are $N the $c? News of your contributions to the Alliance has traveled quite far, you know?

On what business do you come before me today?
683-progress.title: Sara Balloo's Plea

689-progress.name: Grand Mason Marblesten
689-progress.text: $N, $N, $N! Tell me you have enough Alterac Granite for me to begin my masterpiece in honor of Sully Balloo.
689-progress.title: A King's Tribute

69-accept.name: Clerk Daltry
69-accept.text: Oh my!  Must have missed this the first time.  In the registry, right beneath the first address for Stalvan there's another one listed, only partially scratched out.  Looks like he was headed to The Lion's Pride Inn over in Goldshire.  Might want to check there, $N.
69-accept.title: The Legend of Stalvan

6921-accept.name: Je'neu Sancrea
6921-accept.text:
The Twilight's Hammer has moved into the Moonshrine Ruins of Blackfathom Deeps.  Their presence can only serve to coerce the elements into working against us.  If left unchecked, this region will be theirs for good.

$N, go into Blackfathom and find the ruin's fathom stone; it should be somewhere close in the water.  In it is a fathom core - a device that when properly read it will relate a history of all elemental activity.  If I have it, I and the Earthen Ring can maybe do something to stop them!
6921-accept.title: Amongst the Ruins

6921-complete.name: Je'neu Sancrea
6921-complete.text:
This is exactly what I need!  A fathom core is an incredible well of information that we will be able to draw much good from.  Whatever the Twilight's Hammer is up to in there - and believe me when I say it is no good - my comrades and I will now uncover.

You've done well here today; the Earthen Ring looks upon you warmly for assisting us.  You've also helped the Horde as a whole, and for that you should be proud.
6921-complete.title: Amongst the Ruins

6921-progress.name: Je'neu Sancrea
6921-progress.text: Have you been successful in locating the fathom core?  Without it we'll have no idea what the Twilight's Hammer is exactly up to down there.
6921-progress.title: Amongst the Ruins

6922-accept.name: Unknown
6922-accept.text:
The defeated water elemental has left behind a strange water globe.  You surmise that the object somehow fed the beast energy.  Inside the globe, a putrid-looking form of water sloshes about.  The globe itself seems impervious to any sort of physical force.

If anyone can make any sense of this item, it would be Je'neu Sancrea of the Earthen Ring.  He is located at the Horde's Zoram'gar Outpost in Ashenvale.
6922-accept.title: Baron Aquanis

6922-complete.name: Je'neu Sancrea
6922-complete.text:
This... this is quite the find, $N.

You acquired this from Baron Aquanis in Blackfathom, you say?  Baron Aquanis has long been thought of as a corrupted elemental power; this globe will prove what exactly had corrupted him.  While it would be no surprise if it turned out to be the Twilight's Hammer, our studies will also show how they did it as well.

You did well in bringing this to me.  Please - take this, along with the Earthen Ring's warmest regards.
6922-complete.title: Baron Aquanis

6922-progress.name: Je'neu Sancrea
6922-progress.text: Ah, hello again $N.  I was just reading the waves the sea, much like I always do.  What brings you to the outpost?
6922-progress.title: Baron Aquanis

6981-accept.name: Unknown
6981-accept.text:
The shard is a brilliant green, and although solid, what looks like smoke swirls just below the surface. You can't help staring into the depths of the crystal; at the same time, you know there is something very disturbing about it.

Maybe you should see if anyone in Ratchet can tell you more about this strange shard.
6981-accept.title: The Glowing Shard

6981-complete.name: Falla Sagewind
6981-complete.text: Oh... I have never seen anything like this...
6981-complete.title: The Glowing Shard

6981-progress.name: Falla Sagewind
6981-progress.text: Hello, $r. What can I do for you?
6981-progress.title: The Glowing Shard

7-accept.name: Marshal McBride
7-accept.text: Your first task is one of cleansing, $N.  A clan of kobolds have infested the woods to the north.  Go there and fight the kobold vermin you find.  Reduce their numbers so that we may one day drive them from Northshire.
7-accept.title: Kobold Camp Cleanup

7-complete.name: Marshal McBride
7-complete.text:
Well done, citizen.  Those kobolds are thieves and cowards, but in large numbers they pose a threat to us.  And the humans of Stormwind do not need another threat.

For defeating them, you have my gratitude.
7-complete.title: Kobold Camp Cleanup

7-progress.name: Marshal McBride
7-progress.text: How goes the hunting, $N?  Have you found and defeated those vermin?
7-progress.title: Kobold Camp Cleanup

70-accept.name: Innkeeper Farley
70-accept.text:
The name Stalvan rings a bell.  I remember now.

Many years back, on a stormy night, a messenger came in, seeking refuge for the night.  Near the stroke of midnight, the man ran down the stairs screaming, his face pale with fear.  Still wearing his bedclothes, he disappeared into the downpour.

In his haste he forgot his letters in the chest upstairs.  He never returned for them. One remains from that Stalvan fellow, intended for the Canal District in Stormwind.  Help yourself to it.
70-accept.title: The Legend of Stalvan

70-complete.name: Caretaker Folsom
70-complete.text: You've got some nerve bringing this here.
70-complete.title: The Legend of Stalvan

70-progress.name: Caretaker Folsom
70-progress.text: What have ya got there?  Let me take a look at that. . .
70-progress.title: The Legend of Stalvan

71-accept.name: Unknown
71-accept.text: Now that you have both medallions, deliver them to Guard Thomas at the bridge so that he might know the fate of his murdered guards.
71-accept.title: Report to Thomas

71-complete.name: Guard Thomas
71-complete.text: You have confirmed my fears, $N.  The murlocs are a threat we cannot ignore.
71-complete.title: Report to Thomas

71-progress.name: Guard Thomas
71-progress.text: Hello, $N.  Have you discovered the fates of Rolf and Malakai?
71-progress.title: Report to Thomas

72-accept.name: Caretaker Folsom
72-accept.text:
My father was the caretaker of the estate long before I was.  He had to mop the blood up after the massacre.  But that's neither here nor there.

The last funds of the Flintridge trust have dried up.  Now the last of the family possessions are headed for auction.  Blame the tax vultures.  I guess if you're really itching to learn more you're free to look through this junk.  Who knows what you might find.
72-accept.title: The Legend of Stalvan

72-complete.name: Unknown
72-complete.text: You slowly slide the lid of the crate off. . . .
72-complete.title: The Legend of Stalvan

729-accept.name: Archaeologist Hollee
729-accept.text:
What an honor it was when Master Greywhisker assigned me to work under the guidance of the great Prospector Remtravel. At the academy in Ironforge everyone knew of Remtravel's great discoveries.

But the prospector is rather... um... oblivious ...to his surroundings.

We had uncovered evidence of a great society. Horrible golems sprang forth from the ground and overran the site. Remtravel never seemed to notice. I ran back to Auberdine for help.

Please travel south and see if the prospector is ok!
729-accept.title: The Absent Minded Prospector

729-complete.name: Prospector Remtravel
729-complete.text:
Hollee, is that you? I need some help chiseling this stone. Hand me my stone brush, I think I see something.

Hey, you're not Hollee! Don't suppose you've seen my stone brush?

Never mind that now! I promised the League I'd send the mysterious fossil I found. Where did Hollee go?

So much work to be done! Now where is that mysterious fossil... and my brush... and Hollee...

And who are you... 'tis no matter, so long as you're here to help.

Let me know when you're ready to start looking.
729-complete.title: The Absent Minded Prospector

731-accept.name: Prospector Remtravel
731-accept.text:
So then, Hollee... oh that's right, you are not Hollee. Where's Hollee?

Bah, that's beside the point. We must find that stone brush... I mean the mysterious fossil! We must find that fossil. The Explorers' League in Darnassus will want some indication as to what I've been doing.

Let me know when you are ready and we will hunt down that brush.... I mean fossil! We shall find something in writing to satisfy the League.

So are you ready yet?
731-accept.title: The Absent Minded Prospector

7321-accept.name: Christoph Jeffcoat
7321-accept.text:
Who says that the undead don't know anything about cooking? Take my secret recipe for Turtle Bisque, for example. I've known folks that would come back from the dead just to enjoy a bowl! Heh, heh...

Speaking of which, I haven't been able to make any lately.  I used to head over to Lake Lordamere myself to hunt snapjaws, the nasty things, but I can't pull myself away from my work here.

If you bring me some Turtle Meat from the snapjaws and soothing spices, I'll show you how it's done!
7321-accept.title: Soothing Turtle Bisque

7321-progress.name: Christoph Jeffcoat
7321-progress.text: Any luck finding the ingredients?  I'll tell you, the alliance maggots are far too numerous in this area now... In my opinion, they have come far too close already...
7321-progress.title: Soothing Turtle Bisque

7383-accept.name: Corithras Moonrage
7383-accept.text:
All was not well with Teldrassil, however. Staghelm's carefully made plans for the new World Tree had borne out as he had hoped, but there was one small problem, a problem to which many of the troubles on Teldrassil may be attributed.

However, I will not get into that yet. You must visit the last moonwell, to the northwest in the Oracle Glade. Under the boughs of the Oracle Tree lies the first and most powerful of our wells. Retrieve a phial of its water and return to me.
7383-accept.title: Crown of the Earth

7383-complete.name: Corithras Moonrage
7383-complete.text:
To be in the presence of the Oracle Tree... it is almost to feel wisdom take form. Let me continue the telling...

With Teldrassil grown, the Arch Druid approached the dragons for their blessings, as the dragons had placed upon Nordrassil in ancient times. But Nozdormu, Lord of Time, refused to give his blessing, chiding the druid for his arrogance. In agreement with Nozdormu, Alexstrasza also refused Staghelm, and without her blessing, Teldrassil's growth has been flawed and unpredictable...
7383-complete.title: Crown of the Earth

7383-progress.name: Corithras Moonrage
7383-progress.text: Along with the druids, the Oracle Tree and the Arch Druid have been carefully monitoring the growth of Teldrassil. But though we have a new home, our immortal lives have not been restored.
7383-progress.title: Crown of the Earth

74-accept.name: Unknown
74-accept.text: Inside the crate you find various objects: musty heirlooms, a family portrait, a few hunting trophies and some old books.  Near the bottom, underneath a ceramic vase, you uncover A Torn Journal Page.
74-accept.title: The Legend of Stalvan

74-complete.name: Marshal Haggard
74-complete.text: I can barely make out those letters.  But that writing style reminds me of something I once saw before my vision became so poor.
74-complete.title: The Legend of Stalvan

74-progress.name: Marshal Haggard
74-progress.text: What have you got there?  I cannot see.  My eyesight is very bad.  Put it in my hands.
74-progress.title: The Legend of Stalvan

741-complete.name: Chief Archaeologist Greywhisker
741-complete.text: Oh my! Leave it to Prospector Remtravel to discover such a find!
741-complete.title: The Absent Minded Prospector

741-progress.name: Chief Archaeologist Greywhisker
741-progress.text: What can I do for you, $r?
741-progress.title: The Absent Minded Prospector

742-accept.name: Bluff Runner Windstrider
742-accept.text:
Attention, young adventurers!  The wilds of Ashenvale await you!

The Horde has established a strong presence in the lands north of the Barrens.  Our two outposts - Splintertree Post and the Zoram Strand Outpost - strive to bring glory to the Horde!  Those who would prove themselves should seek out guidance there.  Of note: Senani Thunderheart in Splintertree Post, directly north of the Barrens, seeks adventurers willing to take part in a great hunt of Ashenvale!
742-accept.title: The Ashenvale Hunt

743-accept.name: Ruul Eagletalon
743-accept.text:
Thank you for taking the time to speak to me, $N. I am Ruul, warrior and teacher.

You have obviously reached an age when you must prepare for your trials if you are to adventure much further out of Mulgore.

If you wish a test of your strength, start by seeking out the Windfury harpies to the southeast. They nestle along the mountain's edges away from the road.

They are one of our natural enemies here in Mulgore and will be a good gauge of your skill.
743-accept.title: Dangers of the Windfury

743-complete.name: Ruul Eagletalon
743-complete.text: You have done well, $N. You seem well prepared to travel onward. Let the wind always be at your back.
743-complete.title: Dangers of the Windfury

743-progress.name: Ruul Eagletalon
743-progress.text: The Windfuries are deadly foes. Their strength in battle is only rivaled by their desire for fresh meat.
743-progress.title: Dangers of the Windfury

744-accept.name: Eyahn Eagletalon
744-accept.text:
$N, my brother soon stands before Chief Bloodhoof, and it is my honor to make his headdress for him.

I want to ask a favor of you while I finish tanning these leather straps. There is not time for me to find enough feathers, and I was wondering, would you gather more for me?

You can find feathers of the correct size from the harpies residing far to the north and northwest of Thunder Bluff. I need only 6 azure and 6 bronze feathers to complete the design.
744-accept.title: Preparation for Ceremony

744-complete.name: Eyahn Eagletalon
744-complete.text:
Thank you for your help, $N.

My part in my brother's ceremony is almost complete. Giving him his headdress and witnessing the ceremony are all my duty requires of me.
744-complete.title: Preparation for Ceremony

744-progress.name: Eyahn Eagletalon
744-progress.text: This headdress will certainly be a wonderful gift for my brother.
744-progress.title: Preparation for Ceremony

745-accept.name: Baine Bloodhoof
745-accept.text:
$N, there are many conflicts that wound this land. It is my hope that you will not bear witness to as many of them as I have. Yet there is one that I would ask you to seek out. It will give you some sense of how terrible, if left unchecked, even a small threat can be to the land.

Palemane gnolls have settled to the south of Bloodhoof and in a cave to the west. They disrespect our attempts to communicate with them, and they slay the wildlife of Mulgore unbridled.

Words are no longer the answer.
745-accept.title: Sharing the Land

745-complete.name: Baine Bloodhoof
745-complete.text: $N, it is good you've taken my task seriously. Respect of the land and its creatures is important. Death and life are a circle... a necessity. One cannot exist without the other. Take time to ponder this and do well to never forget it.
745-complete.title: Sharing the Land

745-progress.name: Baine Bloodhoof
745-progress.text: If the Palemanes had respected the land and its inhabitants more, this conflict would have never occurred.
745-progress.title: Sharing the Land

746-accept.name: Baine Bloodhoof
746-accept.text:
There are dwarves preparing a dig site to the northwest.  They think secrets lie in the earth, and that is true, but hollowing and defiling the land is no way to earn its teachings.

Collect the dwarven tools of digging, smash them, and return to me with the dwarves' broken tools.

You can smash the tools at a forge.  You will find one in Thunder Bluff, but any forge -- even a forge at the dwarven camp -- will suffice.
746-accept.title: Dwarven Digging

746-complete.name: Baine Bloodhoof
746-complete.text: Thank you, $N.  This will calm the beasts of Mulgore.  And, spirits willing, it will teach the dwarves that hollowing the land is not the path to knowledge.
746-complete.title: Dwarven Digging

746-progress.name: Baine Bloodhoof
746-progress.text: Hello, $N.  Do you have the Broken Tools?  The dwarves' digging will enrage the kodos of Mulgore.  This defilement must be stopped!
746-progress.title: Dwarven Digging

747-accept.name: Grull Hawkwind
747-accept.text:
You have a promising air about you, and will prove yourself to the tribe. Perhaps someday soon you will be welcomed into the great city of Thunder Bluff. But before that can happen you must prove yourself to my father, Chief Hawkwind.

Up here on Red Cloud Mesa we pride ourselves on keen hunting skills. Tauren hunt out of necessity and for sport. Our supply of meats has run low and we require feathers for clothing. Hunt the nearby plainstriders and prove yourself by resupplying the village.
747-accept.title: The Hunt Begins

747-complete.name: Grull Hawkwind
747-complete.text: The tauren of Narache thank you, $N. You show much promise.
747-complete.title: The Hunt Begins

747-progress.name: Grull Hawkwind
747-progress.text: Providing meat and feathers for the tribe is the first step in proving yourself as a hunter before the Chief.
747-progress.title: The Hunt Begins

748-accept.name: Mull Thunderhorn
748-accept.text:
Goblins and their servants have tainted our sacred water wells! We cannot allow this.

To cleanse each well, I must create a cleansing totem, then you must bring the totem to the well and perform a cleansing ritual.

First we will create a cleansing totem for the Winterhoof Water Well. To do this, the land must offer its aid. Hunt prairie wolves for their paws and adult plainstriders for their talons. They are to the southwest.

Return to me with the paws and talons, $N.
748-accept.title: Poison Water

748-complete.name: Mull Thunderhorn
748-complete.text: You have done well, $N. I will take these and bind their power into a totem of cleansing.
748-complete.title: Poison Water

748-progress.name: Mull Thunderhorn
748-progress.text: Do you have the paws and talons, $N?
748-progress.title: Poison Water

749-accept.name: Morin Cloudstalker
749-accept.text:
A few days ago, we found a Venture Co. caravan traveling under guard on the northern shore of Stonebull Lake. We'd lost two of our number in an earlier battle, so we were quick to attack and lay waste to the caravan.

We left their supply crates, thinking that our torches would destroy anything of value, but given that Venture Co. salvagers have been spotted near the burned wagons, maybe we were wrong.

Perhaps you could go to the caravan and examine the contents of the crates.
749-accept.title: The Ravaged Caravan

749-complete.name: Unknown
749-complete.text: All sides of the crate are stamped with the sign of the Venture Co. Mining Division. Notes printed carefully on the side of the carton indicate that the contents are due for processing at one of their central plants.
749-complete.title: The Ravaged Caravan

75-accept.name: Marshal Haggard
75-accept.text:
There was a bundle of parchments in the chest upstairs when I moved into this place.  I looked at them once when I first arrived but I gave up once the fog hazed over my peepers. 

Do an old, nearly-blind man a favor and check the chest upstairs for anything that might help you in your quest to discover more about this Stalvan character.  I'm pretty sure there's a faded journal page that might be of interest to you.  Bring it to me and I'll help in anyway I can.
75-accept.title: The Legend of Stalvan

75-progress.name: Marshal Haggard
75-progress.text: Did you find that page I mentioned, $N?
75-progress.title: The Legend of Stalvan

750-accept.name: Grull Hawkwind
750-accept.text:
A tauren skilled in the ways of the hunt knows that his prey is not for mere trophy. The beasts of the plains provide us with a means of survival. You will make quite an impression on the elders if you can bring back some highly valued Mountain Cougar Pelts. You can find the beasts lurking in the hills to the south.

Our children need clothing and our tents need mending.
750-accept.title: The Hunt Continues

750-complete.name: Grull Hawkwind
750-complete.text: The tauren of Narache thank you for these provisions, $N. With your skill in the ways of the hunt you will surely be revered in Thunder Bluff someday.
750-complete.title: The Hunt Continues

750-progress.name: Grull Hawkwind
750-progress.text: If you can provide pelts for the tribe I will pass word along to my father, Chief Hawkwind, of your generous deeds.
750-progress.title: The Hunt Continues

751-accept.name: Unknown
751-accept.text:
Prying open the lid reveals a tightly packed assortment of ore and minerals, more evidence of the Venture Co.'s mining operation in Mulgore. On the top of the ore and minerals you remove a tightly bound sheaf of papers.

Up in the foothills to the east, you can barely hear the sounds of work, and see smoke rising from a large fire.
751-accept.title: The Ravaged Caravan

751-complete.name: Morin Cloudstalker
751-complete.text: It does indeed appear that the Venture Co. is attempting to rob us of our natural resources. It is good to know this for true, and now it seems, we must do something about it.
751-complete.title: The Ravaged Caravan

751-progress.name: Morin Cloudstalker
751-progress.text:
Hail, $N. Have you learned anything new about the Venture Co.'s plans and operations in our homeland?

If they plan to exploit our lands as they have others, the Outrunners will be quick to put an end to it.
751-progress.title: The Ravaged Caravan

752-accept.name: Chief Hawkwind
752-accept.text:
All members of the tribe share in the harmony of life. We live together and work together.

Our commitment to one another carries with it a high degree of responsibility. I ask of you now a humble task.

My mother set out this morning to fetch water from the well to the southeast of Narache. It has been quite some time now. Perhaps you could check on her for me while I attend to tribal matters here?
752-accept.title: A Humble Task

752-complete.name: Greatmother Hawkwind
752-complete.text: You traveled all this way just to help an old woman? My my, aren't you a keeper? Here, take one of these training manuals with you, so you may learn how to contribute to the community.
752-complete.title: A Humble Task

753-accept.name: Greatmother Hawkwind
753-accept.text:
I have traveled many paths through life and these old legs lack the vigor they once had. I can still perform my duties to the tribe. Sometimes it just takes an old woman a little longer to do the task.

But you look like an eager $c. Let's put some of that youthful vitality to the test. Take a water pitcher from the well and bring it to my son, the Chief, in Camp Narache.

Remember that even the most humble task can gain the recognition of elders.
753-accept.title: A Humble Task

753-complete.name: Chief Hawkwind
753-complete.text:
You carried this pitcher back at the Greatmother's bidding, I see.

Your willingness to help others and provide for the tauren of Camp Narache leads me to believe you would make the tribe proud in Thunder Bluff someday.
753-complete.title: A Humble Task

753-progress.name: Chief Hawkwind
753-progress.text: You look as though you have returned from the plains. Do you have any word from Greatmother Hawkwind?
753-progress.title: A Humble Task

754-accept.name: Mull Thunderhorn
754-accept.text:
I have crafted the totem to cleanse the Winterhoof Water Well. Now, you must take it to the well and perform a cleansing ritual. You will find it to the southeast, guarded by foul goblins!

This will not be an easy task, but you must do it if we are ever to use its waters again.

Fortune to you, $N.
754-accept.title: Winterhoof Cleansing

754-complete.name: Mull Thunderhorn
754-complete.text:
News of your deed reached me moments ago -- already the beasts near the well drink from it eagerly.

You have done a great thing for the land, $N. And you have done a great thing for the Tauren people.
754-complete.title: Winterhoof Cleansing

755-accept.name: Chief Hawkwind
755-accept.text:
Your willingness to perform a humble task for the tauren of Narache and your eagerness to learn are noble traits, $N. I believe one day you will be heralded in Thunder Bluff as a $c of greatness.

Before that you must embark on the Rites of the Earthmother, of which there are three.

The first test is the Rite of Strength. Travel to Seer Graytongue and tell him Chief Hawkwind has sent you.

You will find the seer's abode directly to the south of Camp Narache, tucked away in the hills.
755-accept.title: Rites of the Earthmother

755-complete.name: Seer Graytongue
755-complete.text: Chief Hawkwind sent you? Embarking on the Rites of the Earthmother is no small task...
755-complete.title: Rites of the Earthmother

756-accept.name: Mull Thunderhorn
756-accept.text:
To create the Thunderhorn Cleansing Totem, you must gather the claws of the predators of the Mulgore plains. Hunt prairie stalkers for their stalker claws and flatland cougars for their cougar claws, then return to me.

You will find the prairie stalkers and flatland cougars to the east and west.
756-accept.title: Thunderhorn Totem

756-complete.name: Mull Thunderhorn
756-complete.text:
Thank you, $N. The purity with which these beasts hunt is vital in the creation of the next cleansing totem.

The goblins will never learn the difference between contending with the land, and living in harmony with it.
756-complete.title: Thunderhorn Totem

756-progress.name: Mull Thunderhorn
756-progress.text: $N, do you have the claws I sent you to gather? The Thunderhorn Water Well grows more tainted with each passing hour!
756-progress.title: Thunderhorn Totem

757-accept.name: Seer Graytongue
757-accept.text:
The Rites of the Earthmother are the steps a young tauren needs to take to gain respect in Thunder Bluff.

First you must pass the Rite of Strength. In this test you must prove your bravery by slaying enemies of the tribe.

Bristlebacks of Brambleblade Ravine to the east are encroaching on our tribal lands. They ambush our hunting parties and steal from the village by dark.

Show your valor by slaying these villains and return to the Chief in Camp Narache with their belts as proof of your deeds.
757-accept.title: Rite of Strength

757-complete.name: Chief Hawkwind
757-complete.text: You have passed the first test of the Rites of the Earthmother. The tribe will be proud.
757-complete.title: Rite of Strength

757-progress.name: Chief Hawkwind
757-progress.text: Have you completed the Rite of Strength, $N? I require proof of your valor against the enemy of our tribe, the Bristlebacks.
757-progress.title: Rite of Strength

758-accept.name: Mull Thunderhorn
758-accept.text:
The totem is ready, $N. And again, it is your task to perform the ritual of cleansing.

Go to the Thunderhorn Water Well, north of the village, and use the Thunderhorn Cleansing Totem in your ritual. After you do this, return to me.

May the spirits guide you.
758-accept.title: Thunderhorn Cleansing

758-complete.name: Mull Thunderhorn
758-complete.text:
Ancestors of the Thunderhorn clan spoke to me in a dream, praising you for your actions near their well.

For their gratitude, they wish to give you this...
758-complete.title: Thunderhorn Cleansing

758-progress.name: Mull Thunderhorn
758-progress.text: The Thunderhorn Water Well is still tainted, $N. Please, you must perform the ritual!
758-progress.title: Thunderhorn Cleansing

759-accept.name: Mull Thunderhorn
759-accept.text:
There is but one water well left to cleanse, named after the Wildmane clan. For this well to be pure, the land must offer the teeth of a fierce predator, the prairie wolf alpha. Find the alphas to the north, then return to me when your hunt is finished.

Alphas often wander around the base of our mighty city, Thunder Bluff.
759-accept.title: Wildmane Totem

759-complete.name: Mull Thunderhorn
759-complete.text: Very good, $N. I can feel the sacrifice of the land in this offering, and my spirit swells with sadness, and pride.
759-complete.title: Wildmane Totem

759-progress.name: Mull Thunderhorn
759-progress.text: $N.  Do you have the teeth I asked for?
759-progress.title: Wildmane Totem

76-accept.name: Marshal Dughan
76-accept.text:
Thanks to you we know the Fargodeep Mine is infested with kobolds.  Now we need a scout to investigate the more distant Jasperlode Mine.

Explore Jasperlode and confirm any kobold presence.  To reach the mine, travel east along the road until you reach the Tower of Azora.  From the tower, head north and you'll find the mine in the foothills.
76-accept.title: The Jasperlode Mine

76-complete.name: Marshal Dughan
76-complete.text:
Kobolds at the Jasperlode Mine, you say?  Curses!  The situation is worsening by the minute!

Thank you for the report, $N.  But I wish that the news you brought was good news.
76-complete.title: The Jasperlode Mine

76-progress.name: Marshal Dughan
76-progress.text: Hail, $N.  What do you have to report? Have you scouted the Jasperlode Mine?
76-progress.title: The Jasperlode Mine

760-accept.name: Mull Thunderhorn
760-accept.text:
Your cleansing of the Winterhoof and Thunderhorn wells is spoken among the spirits, young $N. The Wildmane Totem is made, and your last task lies ahead.

The Wildmane Water Well lies north of Thunder Bluff. Perform the ritual! Heal the land of the goblins' poisons! Let clean water flow once again!
760-accept.title: Wildmane Cleansing

760-complete.name: Mull Thunderhorn
760-complete.text:
You've done it. You have cleaned the wells, and healed our land. Bloodhoof village is grateful, $N.

May the wind whisper your deeds for a hundred seasons, and may the waters of Mulgore remain clean forever.
760-complete.title: Wildmane Cleansing

761-accept.name: Harken Windtotem
761-accept.text:
The swoop is a cunning bird, and difficult to find and hunt.  A collection of Swoop Quills is a badge of cleverness and determination for a hunter.

If you are willing to take up this task, then enter the plains and hunt the swoop.

Bring me their quills, and bring honor to your clan.

The swoops may be found anywhere in Mulgore, but your eyes must be sharp to spot them, and your hooves must be quick to catch them.
761-accept.title: Swoop Hunting

761-complete.name: Harken Windtotem
761-complete.text: I know that gathering these quills was not an easy task, $N.  In doing this, you prove that you are a $c of merit.  It is good to have you at Bloodhoof Village.
761-complete.title: Swoop Hunting

761-progress.name: Harken Windtotem
761-progress.text: Have you found the swoops, $N.  Do you have their quills?
761-progress.title: Swoop Hunting

76156-accept.name: Boarton Shadetotem
76156-accept.text: I sense in you a hidden talent for the subtle arts, $c. Use this mask to infiltrate the nearby Venture Company mine and steal their supplies. It may not seem like a convincing disguise, but a skilled rogue can slip past any guard with naught but a winning smile and a cunning distraction. I believe this capability lies within you as well.
76156-accept.title: Stalk With The Earthmother

76156-complete.name: Boarton Shadetotem
76156-complete.text: Hmm... perhaps disguises are not your strength.
76156-complete.title: Stalk With The Earthmother

76156-progress.name: Boarton Shadetotem
76156-progress.text: We'll need to work on your stealth skills, $c. I heard you approaching as soon as you set foot on the mesa.
76156-progress.title: Stalk With The Earthmother

76160-accept.name: Boarton Shadetotem
76160-accept.text: Maybe your skills lie with poisons, not disguises. The Harpies to the north nest in a tree which produces a resin of potent toxicity. Gather the fallen cones around the nests, then crush them into a salve. When applied to a blade this salve will sear your opponent's wounds into their flesh and turn their blood to salt.
76160-accept.title: Stalk With The Earthmother

76160-complete.name: Boarton Shadetotem
76160-complete.text:
This is not the venomous salve I asked for. What you have brought me is pine nut butter. Are you sure you followed my instructions?

This will be of far more use spread on some spice bread than on a dagger. Although you would be quite formidable against a foe with a nut allergy.
76160-complete.title: Stalk With The Earthmother

76160-progress.name: Boarton Shadetotem
76160-progress.text: Be careful with the salve once you are finished, $c. Even skin contact could be quite painful.
76160-progress.title: Stalk With The Earthmother

76240-accept.name: Boarton Shadetotem
76240-accept.text:
I have one last idea that may lead us to success. I still feel there is hidden talent in you, but let us try and coax it out with a less direct approach.

Go and procure a Raw Brilliant Smallfish, then bring it back here. Use these daggers to clean and fillet it. Do not think too hard - do what comes naturally.
76240-accept.title: Stalk With The Earthmother

763-accept.name: Chief Hawkwind
763-accept.text:
For you to continue with the Rites of the Earthmother you must pass two more tests. It is time for you to broaden your experience, $N.

Travel to Bloodhoof Village and seek out the Chief, Baine Bloodhoof, son of Cairne. There you may continue your journey and earn the acceptance of the elders of Thunder Bluff.

Take this totem to Baine. He will recognize my carvings and help you on your path.

Follow the road out of Camp Narache and travel with haste. Do not stray or you will lose your way.
763-accept.title: Rites of the Earthmother

763-complete.name: Baine Bloodhoof
763-complete.text: Word from my good friend, Chief Hawkwind! Ah, I can see by his carvings you are of a special breed.
763-complete.title: Rites of the Earthmother

763-progress.name: Baine Bloodhoof
763-progress.text: What brings you to my village, $c?
763-progress.title: Rites of the Earthmother

764-accept.name: Morin Cloudstalker
764-accept.text:
This explains the buildup of Venture Co. employees and equipment we've seen in Mulgore. Those goblins... their company is expanding too quickly for their own good. It's how they say, show a goblin something, and you can hear the scales in the background.

Greedy little things, they are. Unfortunately for their business enterprise, we tauren cannot allow them to conduct their operations in our lands. Go to their mine northeast of the ravaged caravan and send them a message.
764-accept.title: The Venture Co.

764-complete.name: Morin Cloudstalker
764-complete.text: I don't think there could be too much misinterpreting or ignoring of that signal, hm? The Venture Co. will know not to take the tauren lightly, or to be so arrogant as to believe we would allow them to steal the natural resources around us without protest.
764-complete.title: The Venture Co.

765-accept.name: Morin Cloudstalker
765-accept.text:
According to the documents you salvaged from the caravan, the Venture Co. created many plans to attempt to drive us from our lands here, so that they could have free reign to plunder our lands.

The depths that they would sink to accomplish their goals disgusts and appalls me. I want the mastermind behind their plans killed. His name is Supervisor Fizsprocket, you will find him at the Venture Co. mine east of the ravaged caravan. Bring me his clipboard, we shall see if we find out anything useful.
765-accept.title: Supervisor Fizsprocket

765-complete.name: Morin Cloudstalker
765-complete.text: My anger is somewhat lessened at the news that the villain Fizsprocket is dead. I will go through his personal effects and see if there is any additional information about what the Venture Co. has planned for the future. Thank you for your efforts, $N.
765-complete.title: Supervisor Fizsprocket

765-progress.name: Morin Cloudstalker
765-progress.text: I seethe with anger at the thought of the atrocities the Venture Co. is willing to perpetrate against us in the name of profit.
765-progress.title: Supervisor Fizsprocket

766-accept.name: Maur Raincaller
766-accept.text:
My grandfather told me stories about his battles with a strider named Mazzranache. He told me of its demonic red eyes, razor-sharp talons and venomous bite.

As fortune would have it, while traveling across the plains, I encountered it, and it took a nasty bite from my shoulder. He was as terrible as my grandfather described. I will need some hard-to-find animal parts to clean the infection from his bite: a wolf heart, cougar femur, plainstrider scale and swoop gizzard.

Hurry, time is of the essence.
766-accept.title: Mazzranache

766-complete.name: Maur Raincaller
766-complete.text:
Ah, thank you, $N. Using the items you brought me, I will be able to create the remedy I need to stop the spread of the infection and, eventually, cure it completely. I owe you my life in thanks.

But I'll never forget that screeching call when Mazzranache came upon me, the blaze of color as its beak descended...

Be wary on your travels.
766-complete.title: Mazzranache

766-progress.name: Maur Raincaller
766-progress.text:
My fever grows worse and I find my mind drifting into delirious nightmares... I should have known that I wouldn't be able to handle a beast my grandfather was unable to defeat...

Do you have the ingredients for the remedy? I fear if I do not clean the infection soon, it will be the death of me.
766-progress.title: Mazzranache

767-accept.name: Baine Bloodhoof
767-accept.text:
The Rite of Vision, one of the Rites of the Earthmother, will help guide you toward earning the respect of the elders of Thunder Bluff.

Our people have learned that the land is our most holy provider. In order to take part in the ritualistic vision, you must speak with the spiritual leader of the village, Zarlman Two-Moons.
767-accept.title: Rite of Vision

767-complete.name: Zarlman Two-Moons
767-complete.text: I sensed you would be coming to me, $c. I can always recognize one who is trying to pass the Rites of the Earthmother.
767-complete.title: Rite of Vision

768-accept.name: Veren Tallstrider
768-accept.text:
Greetings, young one.  You have a gleam in your eye; I can tell you are eager to venture back to the plains for the hunt.  May you bring honor to your clan!

I work with the skins of beasts, fashioning them into clothes and armor for the people of Thunder Bluff.

If you hunt beasts and bring me their skins, then I will fashion something for you.
768-accept.title: Gathering Leather

768-complete.name: Veren Tallstrider
768-complete.text:
Ah, these are very nice pieces.  They'll make fine leather goods.

Here, $N.  Take this in trade...
768-complete.title: Gathering Leather

768-progress.name: Veren Tallstrider
768-progress.text: Hello again.  Have you been hunting?  Do you have skins for me?
768-progress.title: Gathering Leather

769-accept.name: Veren Tallstrider
769-accept.text:
The kodo beasts of Mulgore are strong and sturdy -- traits much respected among us.  If you are skilled in leatherworking and wish the knowledge to make a Kodo Hide Bag, then bring me supplies for my trade.

Do this, and I will share my knowledge with you.
769-accept.title: Kodo Hide Bag

769-complete.name: Veren Tallstrider
769-complete.text: Ah, good.  Thank you, $N.  My heart swells with pride to see youths interested in the craft of leatherworking.
769-complete.title: Kodo Hide Bag

770-accept.name: Unknown
770-accept.text:
The ragged hide of Ghost Howl still bears a terrible wound, gained from the wolf's battles against the Burning Legion.

Perhaps someone in Bloodhoof Village should know of Ghost Howl's demise....
770-accept.title: The Demon Scarred Cloak

770-complete.name: Skorn Whitecloud
770-complete.text:
I can barely believe my old eyes!  You defeated the great wolf Ghost Howl?  I look upon you with new respect, young $c.  You are a hunter of extreme skills!

Let me offer you something.  My days of hunting are over, but I would be honored if you used one of my weapons in your hunts.

May it strike true, and bring you renown.

And let us hope that Ghost Howl's spirit has finally found peace.
770-complete.title: The Demon Scarred Cloak

771-accept.name: Zarlman Two-Moons
771-accept.text:
In order to pass through the Rite of Vision, you must gather the reagents needed to make the Water of the Seers.

I will need well stones, which can be found around the water wells in Mulgore. With those I will combine Ambercorn, which fall beneath the mighty trees in our land.

These reagents contain magical elements, and when brewed and consumed before the tribal fire, will cause you to encounter a vision. Follow it, and it will lead you to the next step of this holy quest.
771-accept.title: Rite of Vision

771-complete.name: Zarlman Two-Moons
771-complete.text: I see you have learned to gather from our sacred land, $N. It will take but a moment for me to brew the Water of the Seers.
771-complete.title: Rite of Vision

771-progress.name: Zarlman Two-Moons
771-progress.text: Once you have gathered enough well stones from around the water wells and Ambercorn from beneath the trees, I will prepare the Water of the Seers for you.
771-progress.title: Rite of Vision

772-accept.name: Zarlman Two-Moons
772-accept.text:
I now present you with the Water of the Seers.

When you are ready, consume the waters near the tribal fire. Once you have ingested the holy waters, it will take a few moments before the vision materializes before the fire.

At that point, it is up to you to follow it to your destiny....
772-accept.title: Rite of Vision

772-complete.name: Seer Wiserunner
772-complete.text: Be not afraid, $N. You have successfully passed the Rite of Vision.
772-complete.title: Rite of Vision

773-accept.name: Seer Wiserunner
773-accept.text:
To gain acceptance amongst the elders of Thunder Bluff you must next complete the Rite of Wisdom.

Now that you have passed the Rite of Vision, the ancestral spirits of Red Rocks will give you the blessing of our ancestors. Only those who have drunk from the Water of Seers can gain the blessing.

Travel east of Thunder Bluff, to Red Rocks and seek out the Ancestral Spirit, $N.
773-accept.title: Rite of Wisdom

773-complete.name: Ancestral Spirit
773-complete.text:
You have shown great diligence in your yearning to pass the Rites of the Earthmother, $N.

We, the Ancestral Spirits, represent the mighty tauren who gave their lives bravely to found and protect our great city of Thunder Bluff. I hereby pass the duty of that protection over to you.

You have passed the Rite of Wisdom, young $c. Enter Thunder Bluff with pride.
773-complete.title: Rite of Wisdom

775-accept.name: Ancestral Spirit
775-accept.text:
You will now be revered within our great city. Any $r worthy of completing the Rites of the Earthmother earns that honor.

For your final quest, seek out our noble leader, Cairne Bloodhoof, who dwells atop the highest mesa in Thunder Bluff.
775-accept.title: Journey into Thunder Bluff

775-complete.name: Cairne Bloodhoof
775-complete.text: Hail, young $c. I see you found your way to my doorstep.
775-complete.title: Journey into Thunder Bluff

776-accept.name: Cairne Bloodhoof
776-accept.text:
You have passed the Rites of the Earthmother and earned your place in Thunder Bluff.

But in order to maintain the spot that you strived so hard to achieve, you must continue to prove your worth to your people.

We are hunters, $N. Down below in Mulgore there is a mighty kodo named Arra'chea. Show me your skills in the ways of tracking and hunting by bringing me the Horn of Arra'chea.
776-accept.title: Rites of the Earthmother

776-complete.name: Cairne Bloodhoof
776-complete.text:
Well done! A fine kill that was.

I will send a gathering party to collect the carcass so we can retrieve the hide and meat.

You have done a great deed for your people, $N.
776-complete.title: Rites of the Earthmother

776-progress.name: Cairne Bloodhoof
776-progress.text: Have you tracked down Arra'chea yet?
776-progress.title: Rites of the Earthmother

7791-progress.name: Clavicus Knavingham
7791-progress.text:
We are currently accepting donations for wool cloth.  A donation of sixty pieces of wool cloth will net you full recognition by Stormwind for your generous actions.  Our stores are such on wool that we would only need sixty pieces from you total; we should be able to acquire enough from others in the realm to support our drive.

If you have the sixty pieces of wool cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now.
7791-progress.title: A Donation of Wool

7792-progress.name: Raedon Duskstriker
7792-progress.text:
We are currently accepting donations for wool cloth.  A donation of sixty pieces of wool cloth will net you full recognition by Darnassus for your generous actions.  Our stores are such on wool that we would only need sixty pieces from you total; we should be able to acquire enough from others in the realm to support our drive.

If you have the sixty pieces of wool cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now.
7792-progress.title: A Donation of Wool

7793-progress.name: Clavicus Knavingham
7793-progress.text:
As with most other fabrics, our stocks of silk are at an all-time low.  Our stores are such that we'd only need sixty pieces of silk from you total; we should be able to reach our goal with the support of others.

A benevolent gift such as silk, might I add, would certainly increase your local standing in the community!  If you have the sixty pieces of silk cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now.
7793-progress.title: A Donation of Silk

78-accept.name: Marshal Haggard
78-accept.text: I know of someone who might be able to assist you.  Back when I was leading the Stormwind Guard, we used to get drinks at the Scarlet Raven Tavern in Darkshire.  The Innkeeper there, Smitts, was quite an expert on the local lore.  Show him this page and see what he has to say about it.
78-accept.title: The Legend of Stalvan

78-complete.name: Tavernkeep Smitts
78-complete.text: By the Light!  You bet I recognize that handwriting.
78-complete.title: The Legend of Stalvan

78-progress.name: Tavernkeep Smitts
78-progress.text:
Marshal Haggard sent you?  Why didn't you say so? 

Ah, good ol' Haggard.  Poor chap is going to be completely blind before long.  Anyway, let me see what you've got there.
78-progress.title: The Legend of Stalvan

780-accept.name: Grull Hawkwind
780-accept.text:
The Battleboars of Brambleblade Ravine to the east are encroaching on our tribal hunting grounds. They are trained to be malicious by the Bristleback Quilboars with whom we are at war.

Go and slay the vile creatures and bring back some snouts and flanks so that we can make stew for our young.
780-accept.title: The Battleboars

780-complete.name: Grull Hawkwind
780-complete.text: Most excellent. These ingredients will make a fine stew and the loss of those boars should be a fair lesson to those vile Bristlebacks.
780-complete.title: The Battleboars

780-progress.name: Grull Hawkwind
780-progress.text: The aggression of the Battleboars is increasing. Have you sent them a clear message and brought back some snouts and flanks yet?
780-progress.title: The Battleboars

7802-complete.text: Wonderful!  We thank you for your generous donation, $N!

78261-accept.name: Unknown
78261-accept.text:
<A note sits in the chest>

Hello, $N.

I desire a treasure known as The Horn of Xelthos, which is somewhere within Shadowfang Keep.

Venturing inside the keep usually calls for backup. However, for this job, a low profile is of utmost importance.

You must go alone.

I have a contact, by the name of Veenix, in the Stonetalon Mountains. He should be able to help you get past the courtyard gate. The rest is up to you. 

Return the horn here, and your payment will be sent soon after.

- C
78261-accept.title: The Horn of Xelthos

78261-complete.name: Unknown
78261-complete.text: <You place The Horn of Xelthos into the chest>
78261-complete.title: The Horn of Xelthos

783-accept.name: Deputy Willem
783-accept.text:
I hope you strapped your belt on tight, young $c, because there is work to do here in Northshire.

And I don't mean farming.

The Stormwind guards are hard pressed to keep the peace here, with so many of us in distant lands and so many threats pressing close.  And so we're enlisting the aid of anyone willing to defend their home.  And their alliance.

If you're here to answer the call, then speak with my superior, Marshal McBride.  He's inside the abbey behind me.
783-accept.title: A Threat Within

783-complete.name: Marshal McBride
783-complete.text:
Ah, good.  Another volunteer.  We're getting a lot of you these days.

I hope it's enough.

The human lands are threatened from without, and so many of our forces have been marshaled abroad.  This, in turn, leaves room for corrupt and lawless groups to thrive within our borders.

It is a many-fronted battle we wage, $N.  Gird yourself for a long campaign.
783-complete.title: A Threat Within

78307-complete.name: Unknown
78307-complete.text:
<A note sits in the chest>

For $N. I'll be seeing you.

- C
78307-complete.title: The Horn of Xelthos

7833-progress.name: Vehena
7833-progress.text:
We are currently accepting donations for wool cloth.  A donation of sixty pieces of wool cloth will net you full recognition by the Darkspear Trolls for your generous actions.  Our stores are such on wool that we would only need sixty pieces from you total; we should be able to acquire enough from others in the realm to support our drive.

If you have the sixty pieces of wool cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now.
7833-progress.title: A Donation of Wool

784-accept.name: Gar'Thok
784-accept.text:
Led by Admiral Proudmoore, the humans of Kul Tiras encroached on Durotar, violating the Warchief's pact made with Jaina Proudmoore in order to defeat Archimonde years ago.

The human aggression was repelled and Tiragarde Keep fell. But recently, the Admiral's reserves, led by Lieutenant Benedict, have retaken the keep and once again pose a threat to our homeland. These humans show no respect for diplomacy.

Prove your honor and travel south to Tiragarde Keep to eliminate the human invaders.
784-accept.title: Vanquish the Betrayers

784-complete.name: Gar'Thok
784-complete.text: Word of your bravery travels fast, $c. Tales of your victory at Tiragarde Keep will be heralded in Orgrimmar.
784-complete.title: Vanquish the Betrayers

784-progress.name: Gar'Thok
784-progress.text:
You have your orders, $N. The safety of Durotar is in question. Complete the task before you or hang your head in shame.

Show your honor and defeat the humans of Tiragarde Keep.
784-progress.title: Vanquish the Betrayers

786-accept.name: Lar Prowltusk
786-accept.text:
Lower your voice, $c. The Kolkar centaurs lie just over the ridge to the west in Kolkar Crag.

Last night while they were raiding, I snuck into their village and discovered that the dirty beasts have a three-tiered attack planned on the trolls and orcs of Durotar.

We mustn't let their invasion come to fruition. Perhaps you can muster the might needed to infiltrate Kolkar Crag and destroy their attack plans.

Last I saw, they had divided them up amongst three of their leaders.
786-accept.title: Thwarting Kolkar Aggression

786-complete.name: Lar Prowltusk
786-complete.text:
The Horde would surely prevail if the Kolkar centaurs were to attack. But by preventing such an attack, we have spared our mighty warriors unnecessary bloodshed.

And as sure as there is sand in the Tanaris desert, we know that there will be blood spilled before these trying times are through.

You have served your people well, $c.
786-complete.title: Thwarting Kolkar Aggression

788-accept.name: Gornek
788-accept.text:
The first order of business will be to put a little strength in your backbone. I could send you out to the Barrens to hunt kodo, but well, in all honesty, you're more useful to us alive than dead.

I believe you would find a good match with the mottled boars you'll find to the north of here.
788-accept.title: Cutting Teeth

788-complete.name: Gornek
788-complete.text:
Hmmm, not bad, $N. But don't let it get to your head...you'll fight tougher than boars in your career.

Nonetheless, you've proven yourself well, and your next trial will be against a considerably more dangerous opponent, so you'll need some extra protection.
788-complete.title: Cutting Teeth

788-progress.name: Gornek
788-progress.text: I hope you haven't returned to try and convince me that you have completed your task, $N? No, of course not. I would think better of you.
788-progress.title: Cutting Teeth

78823-accept.name: Unknown
78823-accept.text: The drawing is composed of rough, broad, strokes and seems to depict a large bird of prey. Despite the simple composition, the artist clearly viewed this creature with fear and awe. An expert on big game could likely tell you more.
78823-accept.title: Terror of the Desert Skies

789-accept.name: Gornek
789-accept.text:
Powerful warrior and awkward novice alike have fallen to the venomous sting of the scorpid. You will find large numbers of scorpids northwest of here. Bring me ten of their tails as proof of your prowess in battle.

The antidote for their sting is actually made from venom extracted from their stingers. We keep large quantities of antidote for scorpid venom on hand to heal young bloods just like you...

But I'm sure you won't be needing any of that, will you?
789-accept.title: Sting of the Scorpid

789-complete.name: Gornek
789-complete.text:
There is an important lesson that you must take away from fighting scorpids. The smallest or largest of opponents can still send you to your doom. In fierce combat, any number of things can prove your downfall.

I have no more to teach you, $N. You have done well, and I will watch your progress with interest.
789-complete.title: Sting of the Scorpid

789-progress.name: Gornek
789-progress.text: The carapace of a scorpid isn't so thick that the strength of a determined warrior will be deterred. Strike strongly and without doubt, and the scorpids should prove easy prey.
789-progress.title: Sting of the Scorpid

79-accept.name: Tavernkeep Smitts
79-accept.text: I followed the legend of that Stalvan character for years.  When those visiting nobles were slaughtered a few years back I went with Haggard to investigate.  I found these muddy pages but we were never able to link the handwriting to that crazy man in the woods.  Your trail of evidence proves his guilt.  Take this to Commander Ebonlocke immediately and fill her in on what you've discovered!
79-accept.title: The Legend of Stalvan

79-complete.name: Commander Althea Ebonlocke
79-complete.text: My, you have proved yourself to be quite a detective, $c.
79-complete.title: The Legend of Stalvan

79-progress.name: Commander Althea Ebonlocke
79-progress.text: This better be good, $c.  Let me see what you have and tell me your tale.  But by the Light, be quick about it.  Darkshire's defense is my number one priority.  I have not the time to squander on dead-end leads.
79-progress.title: The Legend of Stalvan

790-accept.name: Hana'zua
790-accept.text:
$C! I thought I would die out here with none to know of it. While I was hunting the scorpids of the Valley, I came across a particularly vicious-looking one. Hurling myself at it, I managed to inflict a massive blow to its claw before it closed around my leg.

I wasn't ready for its stinger though, and it sliced down and into my chest, cutting into my flesh and letting my blood. Please, you must kill the scorpid for me! My honor must be upheld! I fought it up on the plateau to the south.
790-accept.title: Sarkoth

790-complete.name: Hana'zua
790-complete.text: My blow was not enough to kill him, but looking at the damage I inflicted gives me some small measure of pride. That small measure will be all I have to sustain myself if I die, and in that light, the short list of my life's accomplishments fills me with anger.
790-complete.title: Sarkoth

790-progress.name: Hana'zua
790-progress.text:
Ahhh... my father always said I would never amount to much, and here, lying beneath a tree as life seeps away, I'm afraid it looks like he was right.

At least I wish to die knowing that my last enemy in life lays dead.
790-progress.title: Sarkoth

<The faint radiance of the embers darkening, you stumble across the remnants of a recent fire.

Amidst the scattered provisions, you discover a blistered note.>

"Not all that burns is lost. Find the twin land, find the place."
