Some sort of necromantic energy has permeated throughout the Valley of Bones, for reasons we have yet to understand.

Those reasons are also of no importance to us. The magic is ours now, and those who do not fight with blade or mallet are trained in this new magic.

If you think I intend to start you off with a challenging task, think again. For now, go into the Valley of Bones and fetch some bones for me. I am sure you can handle that.
92844-accept.title: Mountain of Bones

92844-complete.name: Orgrul
92844-complete.text:
<Orgrul begins to count the bones, but begins to skip numbers as they gain a second digit and eventually loses count. He tries a second time, but glares your direction partway through when your expression contorts while observing.>

Bah. I will count them later. This looks like enough. You had best not be deceiving me.

I will hold onto these.
92844-complete.title: Mountain of Bones

92844-progress.name: Orgrul
92844-progress.text: For every bone short you are for the task, I will take one of yours to make up the difference.
92844-progress.title: Mountain of Bones

92846-accept.name: Orgrul
92846-accept.text:
Have you noticed the puny centaur stomping about around here? Those are of Gelkis descent.

We Magram have already established a foothold deeper into the canyon. When the Gelkis took notice of our presence here, some among them chose to follow in our footsteps. I know not whether they wish to join us or attempt to overthrow us, but I do know that their clanmates have sentenced them all to exile.

They're lone wolves meddling in powers that do not belong to them. I want them dead.
92846-accept.title: Outcast Necromancers

92846-complete.name: Orgrul
92846-complete.text:
Bwahaha, I heard their cries from here!

The Gelkis ought to learn to slaughter their own kin who betray their heritage. Failing to do so puts the burden on us to clean up their mess, and I am not here to tidy up after an inferior clan.

If you see more, be sure to snuff out the lights in their eyes. Once a Gelkis, always a Gelkis.
92846-complete.title: Outcast Necromancers

92847-accept.name: Orgrul
92847-accept.text:
Outsider, did you notice the weapon that the outcast necromancers held in their hands? We will ensure the Gelkis will not live long enough to master the ways of necromancy, but their methods of channeling caught my interest. They even use those same crystals Warug asked you to steal.

I think we can use this technique to our advantage. Venture back into the valley to recover some wood from the accursed trees, and see if Warug will part with some of his crystals. I will make staves from them.
92847-accept.title: Corrupting Tears

92847-complete.name: Orgrul
92847-complete.text:
Only three? Hmmph, Warug is being stingy as always. Give me a moment while I create the staves.

I will take one. The second will go to the Necrokhan that patrols along the chokepoint toward the elven ruins.

The third is yours. You are a part of this war, now more than ever.
92847-complete.title: Corrupting Tears

92847-progress.name: Orgrul
92847-progress.text: These staves may be the missing piece we need to secure the rest of the Valley of Bones. Go now, $r, let us make use of the Gelkis' ways before their next discovery.
92847-progress.title: Corrupting Tears

92849-accept.name: Unknown
92849-accept.text: <Judging by what you've just found, it's very likely that Fillion befell some misfortune here. He may still be nearby, and he might be in need of aid. You notice a cave just to the north of your current location. You should continue searching for him there.>
92849-accept.title: The Missing Scholar

92849-complete.name: Fillion Flamebreeze
92849-complete.text:
Th... thank you, stranger. I was returning from an assignment at the Overlook Standing Stones when I was suddenly ambushed and attacked by Windshapers. They forced me over to the mouth of the cave and left me there, barely conscious and bleeding. The last thing I remember before blacking out is a massive winged beast emerging from the cave and scooping me up.

I think it's safe to say that if you hadn't come along, I'd have been dinner for that beast and its younglings.
92849-complete.title: The Missing Scholar

92850-accept.name: Fillion Flamebreeze
92850-accept.text:
I am feeling much better already. I have some skill with the arcane arts and we are but a short distance from Valanaar. I can make it on my own. More important than my safety, however, is how close to Valanaar these shrieklings have nested and the danger they pose. If you would be so kind, please head back inside and take the head of that beast!

After it's done, you'll find me back in Valanaar. I need to report to the Supreme Magister what occurred here and the status of my mission.
92850-accept.title: The Missing Scholar

92850-progress.name: Fillion Flamebreeze
92850-progress.text: Those shrieklings are too dangerous to be left to nest this close to Valanaar. However... they are the least of our troubles.
92850-progress.title: The Missing Scholar

92860-accept.name: Elaadrin Evengale
92860-accept.text:
The High Order have done our best to avoid direct conflict with the cult, but that is clearly no longer an option. Their hostility has been clearly demonstrated, and now there are rumors of larger-scale cult movements around the island. They are clearly gearing up for something and whatever it is can't be good for the people of Zephras.

Report to Valennia Stormfist and inform her that the High Order offers our full support in Valanaar's efforts against the Al'Aketh, should the need arise.
92860-accept.title: In Service of Zephras

92860-complete.name: Valennia Stormfist
92860-complete.text:
I am sorry to hear about Belathaan. He was actually my cousin and he was a good mage and servant of Zephras. We will avenge him.

You seem eager to lend aid immediately. Come, let's speak further on the current situation.
92860-complete.title: In Service of Zephras

92871-accept.name: Ayessa Dawnsinger
92871-accept.text:
Valennia Stormfist and her peacekeepers have ever been the protectors of Zephras, and we've done our best to lend aid where we can. There are rumors of larger-scale cult movements around the island, and they are clearly gearing up for something.

Report to Valennia and reiterate to her that the Windshapers offer their full support in Valanaar's efforts against the Al'Aketh, should the need arise.
92871-accept.title: In Service of Zephras

92871-complete.name: Valennia Stormfist
92871-complete.text: You seem eager to lend aid immediately. Come, let's speak further on the current situation.
92871-complete.title: In Service of Zephras

92873-accept.name: Orgrul
92873-accept.text:
We already know these crystals are capable of more than sundering the ground--the Gelkis have proven that they can be twisted for necromantic power. Do you remember the bones I had you collect? I assembled them as best I could just up the hill. There was enough for two workable skeletons.

<Orgrul hands you a newly made staff.>

I will deliver the Necrokhan's staff while you play with your new toy. Return only once you can prove that you know how to use it.
92873-accept.title: Proof of Concept

92873-complete.name: Orgrul
92873-complete.text:
I can see a new fire burn brightly in your eyes, outsider. You have demonstrated your ability to create your own armaments, summon minions to do your bidding, and most importantly to assert your dominance when they refuse to follow your command.

A shame you have no centaur blood in you. You would be well on your way to become the next Khan.
92873-complete.title: Proof of Concept

92873-progress.name: Orgrul
92873-progress.text: Despite your aid thus far, if you are unable to raise the dead then your usefulness with the Magram has come to an end.
92873-progress.title: Proof of Concept

92880-accept.name: Yorana Windyreed
92880-accept.text:
I suspect it will take a bit of time for us to mop up what's left of the attackers, but our chances are far better now. Head back to Valanaar and let them know that we are stable here now.

I can't thank you enough for your help. We'd be in much worse shape without you. I asked for reinforcements and it seems that I got a burgeoning hero instead. I'll take that.

May the four winds bless you, $c.
92880-accept.title: Return to Valanaar

92880-complete.name: Valennia Stormfist
92880-complete.text:
<Valennia looks visibly relieved as you tell her about the status of the eastern watchtower.>

Thank the winds.
92880-complete.title: Return to Valanaar

92881-accept.name: Valennia Stormfist
92881-accept.text:
The attacks on both the western and eastern watchtowers are not a coincidence. Based on what you told us about what occurred at the western watchtower with that skypriest, our best guess is that the cult is trying to do something to the anchor pylons.

Please speak with High Elder Shadowsong. He will tell you about a lead that could prove to be promising.
92881-accept.title: The High Elder's Request

92881-complete.name: Talaanis Shadowsong
92881-complete.text: I have a small matter that requires just the kind of assistance that an adventurer like yourself can provide.
92881-complete.title: The High Elder's Request

92893-accept.name: Orgrul
92893-accept.text:
As you tread further into the Valley of Bones, you will find Gelkis wanderers that dared to enter our territory. I instructed they be kept alive so they could feed the bone worms burrowing about, but they seem uninterested in their prey being alive.

This task is simple. Find the prisoners, then snuff out their life. Don't give them a brief glimmer of hope for freedom.
92893-accept.title: No Mercy for the Weak

92893-complete.name: Orgrul
92893-complete.text:
As much as I would have loved to hang their skulls from my tent, their bodies are far more valuable to the Magram left in the valley.

The bone worms will devour their flesh by the next morning, and we will have many new skeletons to raise thereafter.

With each Gelkis death, the Magram army grows stronger!
92893-complete.title: No Mercy for the Weak

92894-accept.name: Orgrul
92894-accept.text:
I can see the excitement in your eyes, outsider. Do you grasp the potential of necromancy yet?

Of course you do. And that is why I am ordering you to hone your skills further.

As you venture deeper into the Valley of Bones, you will see the remains of failed attempts at raising the dead. Gelkis attempts, no doubt. Hardly able to claw out from the dirt. Funny, were it not so pathetic.

I have imbued your staff with greater power. Use this to grow our army, and crush the ones that fight back!
92894-accept.title: Bone Raising

92894-complete.name: Orgrul
92894-complete.text:
<Orgrul listens to your explanation, unable to suppress a grin.>

Do not fret, outsider, for this experiment was anything but a failure. We now know how weak and fragile the Gelkis' form of necromancy is. They have a long way to go before they will match our might.

The fact that you were able to seize control of any of them speaks highly of you, too. Despite those wasted skeletons, you have demonstrated your impressive capabilities.

I will take the staff for now. There is more work to do.
92894-complete.title: Bone Raising

929-accept.name: Corithras Moonrage
929-accept.text:
First, let me tell you more of the task you must complete. The druids in Darnassus use the water of the moonwells of Teldrassil, and their moonwell must be replenished from time to time. Using these specially crafted phials, you can collect the water of the moonwells.

Take this vessel to the moonwell outside of Starbreeze Village to the east, and fill it with some of its waters, then return to me. When you have completed your task, I shall continue the story where Tenaron left off...
929-accept.title: Crown of the Earth

929-complete.name: Corithras Moonrage
929-complete.text:
After the Battle of Mount Hyjal, we were without direction. Nordrassil smoked from the fire it unleashed, and our immortality--the very essence of our beings!--was lost.

It was in this trying time that the Betrayer was freed from his prison, and Shan'do Stormrage disappeared. A dark time for all.
929-complete.title: Crown of the Earth

929-progress.name: Corithras Moonrage
929-progress.text: Hello again, $N. Have you completed your task?
929-progress.title: Crown of the Earth

92909-accept.name: Ozwin Ironsprocket
92909-accept.text:
Oh no... I'm in for it now!

I heard about the harvesters terrorizing the fields of Westfall, so I traveled all the way from Ironforge to see if I could recalibrate them. But they're far more aggressive than my calculations anticipated, and they chased me into this stable!

If I had some isosprings and gyrostabilizers from the harvesters, I could build a device to cover my escape. Could you gather the parts for me?
92909-accept.title: Harvesting the Harvesters

92909-complete.name: Ozwin Ironsprocket
92909-complete.text: Thanks a bunch! I'll get to work on an escape plan. In the meantime, take this!
92909-complete.title: Harvesting the Harvesters

92909-progress.name: Ozwin Ironsprocket
92909-progress.text: It's a mess out there, $N! Did you collect the parts I need?
92909-progress.title: Harvesting the Harvesters

92910-accept.name: Unknown
92910-accept.text: The part you managed to salvage from the harvester appears mostly intact. Someone interested in harvest golems may want to see it.
92910-accept.title: Harvesting the Harvesters

92911-accept.name: Ozwin Ironsprocket
92911-accept.text:
I see... this gives me some insight into what makes those monsters tick. I have an idea how we could override their systems, at least momentarily.

I'll continue tinkering with the assembly you brought me. In the meantime, could you scrounge up some parts for the device?
92911-accept.title: Harvesting the Harvesters

92947-accept.name: Valennia Stormfist
92947-accept.text:
Everyone is here, good. I've just sent a few of my best fighters in through the front of the shrine to cause a bit of trouble and serve as a distraction, while I lead the the bulk of our forces in from the flank.

If all goes well, we should be able to punch through quickly and take out the High Priestess. As for you, get in there and start cracking skulls. Meet my second, Hyusaa Quickbreeze, near the steps to the shrine after you've caused some trouble.

Winds guide you, $c.
92947-accept.title: Making Our Move

92947-complete.name: Hyusaa Quickbreeze
92947-complete.text: We fought hard to get this far but it isn't over yet.
92947-complete.title: Making Our Move

93-accept.name: Chef Grual
93-accept.text:
I'll let you in on a little secret - Dusky "Crab" Cakes are really made from spider legs!  I know it's a bit disgusting, but the cakes have a nice, tangy flavor and make great snacks!  Bring me Gooey Spider Legs and I'll whip you up a few of them.

I hear Venom Web Spiders are a good source - they nest to the north, between the foothills and the river.
93-accept.title: Dusky Crab Cakes

93-complete.name: Chef Grual
93-complete.text:
Ah yes, a nice clutch of legs you have there!  Let me just get these seasoned with my secret spices (no looking!) and get them to skittering on a skillet for a while...

And, although Dusky Crab Cakes are my specialty and I won't give out the recipe, here's the recipe for a dish that's almost as good.
93-complete.title: Dusky Crab Cakes

93-progress.name: Chef Grual
93-progress.text: Hail, $N.  Did you get those Gooey Spider Legs yet?
93-progress.title: Dusky Crab Cakes

930-accept.name: Unknown
930-accept.text:
Hanging from beneath its fronds of this glowing plant is a large, round fruit.

Denalan would want to study this fruit, you are certain.
930-accept.title: The Glowing Fruit

930-complete.name: Denalan
930-complete.text:
You found this on Teldrassil?  Intriguing... this fruit is exotic.  Perhaps its seeds were brought here from far off.  Perhaps even as far as Azeroth!  And there's something about this fruit... it seems to have reacted very strangely with the soil of Teldrassil.

Thank you, $N.  Now if you'll excuse me, I must study this further...
930-complete.title: The Glowing Fruit

930-progress.name: Denalan
930-progress.text: $N, you look like you have something to tell me.  Do you have news concerning the timberlings?
930-progress.title: The Glowing Fruit

93036-accept.name: Constable Aonda
93036-accept.text:
You may or may not be aware of this, but Sania Silverstream over there is a "missionary" for the Al'Aketh. They like to play at being a normal religious order and send non-threatening emissaries around to recruit. We've tolerated Sania so far to avoid direct conflict with the cult, but its obvious the illusion of peace won't last much longer.

You are new here and unknown to most, so I'd like to see if you can use Sania to get close to the cult and find out what their plans are for the village.
93036-accept.title: Infiltrating the Cult

93036-complete.name: Sania Silverstream
93036-complete.text:
Greetings child, my name is Sania Silverstream and I am a junior priestess in the Order of the Al'Aketh. Do you wish to learn more of our sovereign, the Windlord Al'Akir?

There is always room at the Windlord's table for the righteous and the repentant.
93036-complete.title: Infiltrating the Cult

93065-accept.name: Valennia Stormfist
93065-accept.text: The Peacekeepers are mobilizing and we are all gearing up to head out. Make whatever preparations you need to make and meet us at the eastern road leading north out of town. We'll have one final check-in with everyone before we move out.
93065-accept.title: Prepare for Battle

93065-complete.name: Valennia Stormfist
93065-complete.text: We are as ready as we'll ever be.
93065-complete.title: Prepare for Battle

93066-accept.name: Orgrul
93066-accept.text:
On the other side of the valley, we have established a small foothold to prepare to march into the forest nearby. Before you head straight there, I want you to deal with a recent Bristleback intrusion along the way. They seem to have arrived right around the same time we did, but managed to secure an artifact from the nearby temple that has kept us at bay.

This task is simple. Look for the thorns and the pigs. Kill a bunch, indiscriminately. Then report to Hagiak at the camp I mentioned.
93066-accept.title: Bristleback Retreat

93066-complete.name: Hagiak
93066-complete.text:
I am sorry you have come all this way, outsider, but you are not needed at the Magram front. Already you have distracted me long enough to delay our work.

Return to Orgrul and tell him--

On second thought, I do have something for a disposable soldier such as yourself. This will be quick, for better or worse.
93066-complete.title: Bristleback Retreat

93072-accept.name: Hagiak
93072-accept.text:
There is a second centaur village out here, to the southwest. That one belongs to the Gelkis. You expect me to send you over just to spill some blood, right? Good. That had best be your first thought, else I would cast doubt on your allegiance to the Magram!

What are you waiting for? Go! Kill!
93072-accept.title: Long-Term Solutions

93072-complete.name: Hagiak
93072-complete.text:
My scouts have already reported your success. Now perhaps we can continue our training in peace. The Gelkis need to learn that this place, and the Desolace, belong to centaur born of Magram blood.

If you see any stragglers, cut off their heads too. They should be afraid to ever step hoof outside of their little hovel.

That will belong to us too, someday soon.
93072-complete.title: Long-Term Solutions

93089-accept.name: Talaanis Shadowsong
93089-accept.text:
Please extend my thanks to Elaadrin for all that the High Order and your new friends from this "Kirin Tor" have done for Zephras Isle. I'm aware of the High Order's plans to leave the island, and your order has my blessing and well-wishes in this expedition.

I can only hope that whatever arcane solution the High Order finds can truly provide us with the stability we've lacked these past years. If you plan to go with them... well, this mission will be all the stronger for it.

Winds be with you, $N.
93089-accept.title: What Comes Next

93089-complete.name: Elaadrin Evengale
93089-complete.text:
It gladdens me to hear that we have High Elder Shadowsong's blessing for our expedition. Now that the cult has been defeated and preparations have been made, I think it's finally time.

Ansirem has worked diligently to help us get stable skycutter transport going between the city of Dalaran and Zephras Isle. We've done as much testing as we can, and the time has come for our vanguard to depart.
93089-complete.title: What Comes Next

93090-accept.name: Talaanis Shadowsong
93090-accept.text:
Please extend my thanks to Ayessa for all that the Windshapers and your new friends from this "Earthen Ring" have done for Zephras Isle. I'm aware of the plan to take the Windshapers shamans and leave the island, and your order has my blessing and well-wishes in this expedition.

I can only hope that whatever solution the Windshapers find can truly provide us with the stability we've lacked these past years.

Winds be with you, $N.
93090-accept.title: What Comes Next

93090-complete.name: Ayessa Dawnsinger
93090-complete.text:
I'm pleased to hear that we have High Elder Shadowsong's blessing for our expedition. Now that the cult has been defeated and preparations have been made, I think it's finally time.

Muln has worked diligently to help us get stable skycutter transport going between Zephras Isle and a place called Mulgore, where the Earthen Ring make their home. We've been doing test voyages and some of our people are already waiting on the other side.
93090-complete.title: What Comes Next

931-accept.name: Unknown
931-accept.text:
The fronds on this plant shimmer in the forest light, giving it a twisting, pulsing aura.

You believe that Denalan would want a specimen of this.
931-accept.title: The Shimmering Frond

931-complete.name: Denalan
931-complete.text:
Where did you get this?  I haven't seen a plant like this since a sojourn I made to the Swamp of Sorrows... decades ago!  It's amazing that a specimen made its way to Teldrassil.  And it's grown to such a size!

Thank you, $N.  Forgive my shortness of words, but there is a test I would like to perform on this frond...
931-complete.title: The Shimmering Frond

93129-accept.name: Hagiak
93129-accept.text:
Since you seem overly eager to help our clan, I am sure you would be willing to fetch some supplies while you are over in the Outcast Hideaway.

Felling our foes should be enough motivation for a Magram, but I see no reason why we could not profit from the endeavor, too.

When we have the exiles dealt with, we can secure this place for the Magram and raise an army to bring the other clans to their knees!
93129-accept.title: Threat of Starvation

93129-complete.name: Hagiak
93129-complete.text:
<Hagiak peeks into several of the crates without a word at first.>

Of all things to bring out to the front lines, I would have never expected... nevermind. Some of these crates have food in them, and that's what matters. We've shortened the time they can survive here significantly.

The ultimate victory for our clan grows nearer.
93129-complete.title: Threat of Starvation

93129-progress.name: Hagiak
93129-progress.text: Slay their soldiers and starve the survivors. Their little hideaway should never be a sufficient staging ground against our clan again!
93129-progress.title: Threat of Starvation

93159-accept.name: Strange Hermit
93159-accept.text:
Uh, um... h-hello, I mean to say, hi! Greetings, even! I'm sorry... its um, been so long since I've actually spoken to another person. I'm afraid I'm a bit rusty at this.

<The strange hooded figure shifts uncomfortably before you.>

So er, um... how is your day going?
93159-accept.title: The Strange Hermit

93159-complete.name: Strange Hermit
93159-complete.text:
...that's about all I have to say about it. I was--um--somewhere else before I was here. Now I'm here and I have my friends, and my things. T-things I built, I mean. That's about all I need. I think that's all I need, anyway.

I have to say though, it is nice to talk to someone who will talk back. The forest spirits try, but they just end up singing at me. That's nice in its own way, but not exactly s-stimulating conversation.
93159-complete.title: The Strange Hermit

93160-accept.name: Strange Hermit
93160-accept.text:
I do appreciate you stopping by to talk with me! I-If you do want to help out, I could use a bit of help gathering up acorns from the forest floor. I've gathered most of the ones close by but there sure are a lot of raptor-bird things in the forest. It's dangerous out there and I'd rather not become a giant bird's lunch!

So if you want, you could maybe gather them for me? I'll make us something tasty if you do!
93160-accept.title: The Forest's Bounty

93160-complete.name: Strange Hermit
93160-complete.text:
Thank you, stranger! You'll find that these are delicious once roasted! 

Please excuse me, it won't take me long to whip this up.
93160-complete.title: The Forest's Bounty

93160-progress.name: Strange Hermit
93160-progress.text: Mmm, I think you are going to like what I can cook up with these acorns!
93160-progress.title: The Forest's Bounty

93165-accept.name: Vayn Moongaze
93165-accept.text:
The Al'Aketh have visited great tragedy upon our enclave, and blood must be repaid with blood.

I have an offer for you, stranger. Should you find conflict with these accursed cultists, bring me the ears of those you kill. I will reward you for each that you return with in both coin and, in time, access to the Nightclaw's secrets should you prove yourself to be a true friend.
93165-accept.title: Mercy Falls on Deaf Ears

93165-complete.name: Vayn Moongaze
93165-complete.text:
Excellent work. Only good things can happen by eliminating the cult. Hopefully this sends a message that the Nightclaw are not to be trifled with and that our resentments run deep.

I suspect you have your work cut out for yourself, taking on the cult. If you gather more ears, bring them here.
93165-complete.title: Mercy Falls on Deaf Ears

93165-progress.name: Vayn Moongaze
93165-progress.text: I will not rest until my fangs have gone through the throat of every single cultist on this isle.
93165-progress.title: Mercy Falls on Deaf Ears

93172-accept.name: Strange Hermit
93172-accept.text:
Most of the elves on this island seem to think that these woods are haunted, and they aren't wrong.

At the old ruins to the northeast, a strange type of ghost-like spirits gather. Some nights, you can almost hear them "singing". It's not like any song I've heard before, but its definitely a song and its... just so sad.

I'm not sure why, but I think something terrible happened there at some point, and the spirits are trapped there somehow. If you are feeling brave, maybe you can help set them free?
93172-accept.title: Free the Hollows

93172-progress.name: Strange Hermit
93172-progress.text: We can only hope that those poor spirits are able to find peace after being freed from this place.
93172-progress.title: Free the Hollows

93176-accept.name: Amaryllis Webb
93176-accept.text:
Admiring my little menagerie, are you? They are my un-life's work. I've spent countless hours studying them: their anatomy, their diets, even their social rituals.

Do you wish to join me in the hobby? Here, take this package. The notes and materials contained within should get you started. If you lose it, you'll have to purchase another one from me for a small fee.
93176-accept.title: My Little Friends

93188-accept.name: Hagiak
93188-accept.text:
You have done enough on the front lines. We can handle ourselves.

Tell Orgrul that you have served your purpose. The Magram Front is stronger now, and we have our sights set on the outcast encampment as our next settlement when another fleet of fighters joins the fray.

Well? Get going!
93188-accept.title: Return to Orgrul

93188-complete.name: Orgrul
93188-complete.text:
An interesting development has unfolded within Magram Village during your brief absence. It was an act of war, carefully executed by an outsider fighting under the Gelkis banner.

Had this taken place a few months prior, I would have demanded execution of you and all other outsiders ignorantly playing deception with our clans.

But this is no ordinary circumstance.

This is an opportunity. For you, for the Magram, for the war.
93188-complete.title: Return to Orgrul

93196-accept.name: Orgrul
93196-accept.text:
The leader of our clan, Khan Jehn, was slain by a band of outsiders much like you. They were acting on behalf of the Gelkis Clan.

You can stop feigning your surprise. An assault on Magram Village while our attention was elsewhere is a predictable war strategy, especially for the Gelkis.

Do you know why I am showing no rage or remorse, outsider?

<Orgrul hands you a familiar weapon, imbued with even greater power than the last time you held it.>

This is why.
93196-accept.title: Khan Jehn

93196-complete.name: Khan Jehn
93196-complete.text:
The Gelkis recruit outsiders to perform underhanded war strategies, where our clan would send them off to die.

And yet, here you are, $N. An outsider who has demonstrated fierce loyalty to the Magram Clan despite being so unwelcome.

I do not know your motivations, but I recognize first-hand your potential. You have my gratitude, and that of our clan.

To us, you are no longer an outsider. To us, you are Magram.
93196-complete.title: Khan Jehn

932-accept.name: Tallonkai Swiftroot
932-accept.text:
I must warn you, $N, this matter must stay between us. The satyr are enough of an embarrassment to us already, and this one is much too close to home.

He is called Lord Melenas. He resides in the nearby cave of Fel Rock where he has gathered a large group of grell warriors. His heart is black as night, and he plots something most foul.

You must find him within his nearby cave just to the north of here, and bring me his head.
932-accept.title: Twisted Hatred

932-complete.name: Tallonkai Swiftroot
932-complete.text: With Lord Melenas laid to rest I can finally move on to other matters. Thank you, $N.
932-complete.title: Twisted Hatred

932-progress.name: Tallonkai Swiftroot
932-progress.text: Did you kill Lord Melenas yet? It is vital that he be taken care of quickly and quietly, $N. His continued existence is an embarrassment to us all.
932-progress.title: Twisted Hatred

93225-accept.name: Gurda Wildmane
93225-accept.text:
I have noticed that centaur from different clans sometimes gather away from settlements and engage in trade. I have observed this across numerous nights and seemingly with every clan; most importantly I have seen the currency they use: carved totems.

I believe we can turn the tides in our favor with either the Gelkis or the Magram if we deliver a heavy bundle of totems right to them. I have already begun carving some, but I doubt they will be easily fooled without a few authentic ones.
93225-accept.title: Carved Centaur Totems

93225-complete.name: Gurda Wildmane
93225-complete.text:
These are beautiful--I underestimated the creativity of the centaur. I never would have imagined that a race so full of brutality and cruelty would be able to appreciate stories told through carvings.

I suppose appreciating them takes way less effort than crafting them. Let me rephrase: I never would have imagined the centaur to be patient enough to carve out so many tales in wood. Where are they getting the wood?

In any case, speak to me when you are ready to make your delivery.
93225-complete.title: Carved Centaur Totems

93225-progress.name: Gurda Wildmane
93225-progress.text: Have you returned with the totems?
93225-progress.title: Carved Centaur Totems

93226-accept.name: Gorhak
93226-accept.text:
Siding with the Magram would be my choice. There is no question that they are the dominant clan in the present day, regardless of their previous struggles. I have heard reports that they are brutally hostile against the Gelkis.

I sympathize with both warring clans and especially the Gelkis, but this is their war; not ours. We ought to side with the faction that poses the least risk to our cause. I believe that to be the Magram.

Bring this to their quartermaster in Magram Village to the southeast.
93226-accept.title: Buying Friendship: Magram

933-accept.name: Corithras Moonrage
933-accept.text:
There is another moonwell southeast of the entrance to Darnassus, on the shores of the Pools of Arlithrien. The Sentinels are having problems patrolling the area because of attacks and the growing ill-temperedness of the Gnarlpine furbolgs.

Be wary as you seek out the well, and keep your weapons close at hand.
933-accept.title: Crown of the Earth

933-complete.name: Corithras Moonrage
933-complete.text:
Shan'do Stormrage never returned, and the druids were in disarray, and to this day we still do not know what became of him. With Malfurion missing, Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm took over the leadership of the druids, convincing the Circle of Ancients in Darkshore that it was time for our people to rebuild, and that it was time for our people to regain their immortality.

With the approval of the Circle, Staghelm and the most powerful druids grew Teldrassil, the new World Tree.
933-complete.title: Crown of the Earth

933-progress.name: Corithras Moonrage
933-progress.text: At first the reports of crazed furbolg attacks were dismissed. Who could have thought that the peace-loving bear-men would turn to mindless rage? Yet another of the problems that plagues us here in our new home.
933-progress.title: Crown of the Earth

93317-accept.name: Nyalah Brightfire
93317-accept.text:
Are you familiar with Windsong Crawlers? You see, these crabs are native only to Windsong Lake here on Zephras, and they are only able to be harvested a few weeks of the year.

With all of the cult activity of late, I've not been able to get out to the lake to harvest them, and our window is rapidly closing. I'd be appreciative if you could go and gather some for me. They can generally be found along the shorelines around the lake and in rivers.

Do be careful though, they are meaner than they look!
93317-accept.title: Crab Season

93317-complete.name: Nyalah Brightfire
93317-complete.text:
Winds bless me, this meat looks fantastic! 

Thank you so much, $c.
93317-complete.title: Crab Season

93317-progress.name: Nyalah Brightfire
93317-progress.text:
Windsong Crawler meat is common enough here but it was something of a delicacy on the islands of Anvilas and Siroccas. Was a time, back when the skystreams were open that the locals would mob me for the stuff when I'd make the trip to Shen'dramar or New Eldre'naar.

Not been able to visit those places in... well... a long time.
93317-progress.title: Crab Season

93318-accept.name: Unknown
93318-accept.text:
By order of Constable Aonda of the Peacekeepers, a bounty is hereby placed upon the scourge of the highlands, Vulgara the Insatiable. Last spotted on a hilltop rise just southwest of Shen'dar Village, the winged vuldren terror is highly dangerous and should be approached with caution.

Deliver the beast's head to Danarii Bellowveil to receive your reward.
93318-accept.title: WANTED: Vulgara the Insatiable

93318-complete.name: Danarii Bellowveil
93318-complete.text: If we didn't have enough on our plates between the cult and the highlands bandits, we don't need a giant vuldren terrorizing our citizens as well. You've done a great thing here today. As promised, here is your reward.
93318-complete.title: WANTED: Vulgara the Insatiable

93318-progress.name: Danarii Bellowveil
93318-progress.text: I'll need the creature's head as proof of the deed.
93318-progress.title: WANTED: Vulgara the Insatiable

93319-accept.name: Teeri Wellwind
93319-accept.text:
We are relying on windstones more and more for day to day living here on Zephras so we try and maintain a cache of them in reserve for emergencies. Lately I've noticed some go missing from our stores.

We've found windstones on bandits we've captured recently, and I suspect they are behind our shortages.

If you find yourself near the bandit cave to the north, mind knocking a few heads together and reclaiming some of our pilfered windstones for me?
93319-accept.title: Pilfered Windstones

93319-complete.name: Teeri Wellwind
93319-complete.text: Thanks $c. This should help us get by for now. If we can't get the supply routes squared away soon though, a few stolen windstones will be the least of our worries.
93319-complete.title: Pilfered Windstones

93319-progress.name: Teeri Wellwind
93319-progress.text:
These sneakthieves have likely been breaking into our supplies for months. I tried to convince Aonda to put a raid together to clear out that bandit cave for good, but she didn't want to pull the few peacekeepers we have away from the village. 

With the cultists at Falaath Village to the south growing in numbers, I suppose I can't fault her for that.
93319-progress.title: Pilfered Windstones

93320-accept.name: Valennia Stormfist
93320-accept.text:
I've just received word that the cult is attacking the pylon watchtower just outside of town! I've sent the few extra peacekeepers we have here to try and break through the enemy back line to relieve the defenders, but any additional help could mean the difference between our people there living or dying.

Please leave immediately for the east watchtower and provide whatever aid you can.

My lieutenant Yorana Windyreed led the relief force. If she still lives she can tell you how best to help.
93320-accept.title: Tower Defense

93320-complete.name: Yorana Windyreed
93320-complete.text: We are holding them off for now, but they have greater numbers and our fighters are starting to get tired. We need to do something to break the stalemate, and do it fast.
93320-complete.title: Tower Defense

93459-complete.name: Vayn Moongaze
93459-complete.text: As promised, here is your reward.
93459-complete.title: More Al'Aketh Ears

93461-accept.name: Constable Aonda
93461-accept.text:
You've got that "High Order" look to you. Those with Highborne ancestry always seem to have a slight twinkle in their eyes that gives it away. Before I properly put you to work around here, you should check in with our resident High Order elder Rathiril Sunlance. You can find him here in the main lodge, just around the corner from me.

Oh, and check in with Coriella Calmbreeze as well, she runs the local inn and can provide lodging and supplies, should you need them.
93461-accept.title: Welcome to Shen'dar Village

93461-complete.name: Constable Aonda
93461-complete.text:
Checked in with Rathiril then? Great. Lots of tension between the High Order and the Windshapers these days, but they keep things civil here in Shen'dar. Well, at least in the village anyway. What happens out in the wilds stays in the wilds.

Now that that's done, you look like someone who might be looking for something to do with their hands. I've got a few things that need doing, if you are game for a bit of work?
93461-complete.title: Welcome to Shen'dar Village

935-accept.name: Corithras Moonrage
935-accept.text:
Without the blessings of Alexstrasza the Life-Binder and Nozdormu the Timeless, Teldrassil's growth has not been without flaw. Strange beasts have been reported arising from the very ground of the tree, and crazed furbolgs attack passing travelers.

I can only hope that the solution the Arch Druid is looking for will be found quickly. I will pour all the phials you brought into this vessel, for you to deliver to Darnassus.

Bring it to Fandral Staghelm, you will find him in the druid grove.
935-accept.title: Crown of the Earth

935-complete.name: Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm
935-complete.text:
Ah yes, the water I had requested. Tenaron and Corithras certainly took their time in having it delivered... perhaps not choosing the most reliable of messengers... hmm.

Nonetheless, I can finally get back to my work then. The weight of Teldrassil's problems fall upon my shoulders. A yoke I would wish to soon be rid of.

Take this, you may find some use for it.
935-complete.title: Crown of the Earth

935-progress.name: Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm
935-progress.text:
I know that I did not summon you, so I cannot help but wonder why it is you have come to speak with me.

Whatever it is, please make it quick.
935-progress.title: Crown of the Earth

93552-accept.name: Dalia the Collector
93552-accept.text:
Windstones are a critical resource on Zephras Isle as they contain the raw, concentrated energy of the winds themselves. The wind elementals who used to live here on Zephras with us vanished a number of years ago, and since then, the magic that sustains this island is slowly fading. Not without limitations, the windstones are still a reliable energy source, and are incredibly valuable to us.

You'll find raw windstones scattered around the grove. Think you can help me harvest them?
93552-accept.title: Harvesting Windstones

93552-complete.name: Dalia the Collector
93552-complete.text:
Thank you very much for these. As elves we all have a deep connection to magic and these windstones are becoming more and more precious as the magic imbued into this island by the great anchor pylons continues to fade. 

Windstones aren't the only beneficial thing you can harvest from the land. Please, take one of these manuals.
93552-complete.title: Harvesting Windstones

93680-accept.name: Magus Wordeen Voidglare
93680-accept.text:
The Alliance had an army of mages known as the Kirin Tor. While they were powerful, the demonic Burning Legion proved to be even more so. In one fell swoop, the arch demon Archimonde flattened their city like it was a child's plaything. Those who remained were reduced to merely dispossessed vagabonds.

That is, until they rebuilt Dalaran. And on the Dark Lady's very doorstep, no less!

While in their camps, search for something that can get us into the city unnoticed. I must know more.
93680-accept.title: Key to the City

937-accept.name: Sentinel Arynia Cloudsbreak
937-accept.text:
I was dispatched with a small group of Sentinels here to protect the Oracle Tree from the harpies that have made nests all around the glade. Little by little we are trying to push them back.

When the Oracle Tree attempted to send a runner to Darnassus with a report, the messenger was attacked and killed by a group of the harpies.

If you feel up to the task, go to their nests, slay them, and return their belts to me as proof of your deeds.
937-accept.title: The Enchanted Glade

937-complete.name: Sentinel Arynia Cloudsbreak
937-complete.text: Thank you for your aid so far--it has been of great relief. Let me inspect these belts to see if we can glean any insights as to the harpy aggression.
937-complete.title: The Enchanted Glade

937-progress.name: Sentinel Arynia Cloudsbreak
937-progress.text: Their slashing talons and piercing beaks may prove a difficult match for your own abilities, $N, but I have faith that you will not fail in this task.
937-progress.title: The Enchanted Glade

93735-accept.name: Ayessa Dawnsinger
93735-accept.text:
Historically, the Windshapers have seen to the tending of the magical instruments and devices that were gifted to us by the spirits of the wind. This includes the myriad of magical constructs around the island. Since the spirits left us, only a scant few of these are still functional.

One of the few remaining working constructs in Valanaar has become damaged. One of our artisans was dispatched to help, but he may be in need of aid. Travel to the west end of the city and offer any assistance you can.
93735-accept.title: The Broken Construct

93735-complete.name: Riaani Nightwind
93735-complete.text:
<Riaani's face is buried under the heaving armor plates of the construct, attempting to work on the mechanisms underneath. He does not notice your presence at all.>

Storms curse where is the core?! Who thought it would be a good idea to remove the Gyrozephyr as well? It's a miracle this construct's winds haven't dissipated entirely by now!
93735-complete.title: The Broken Construct

93736-accept.name: Endaria Mistgaze
93736-accept.text:
The paramount concern of the Windshapers is to better understand why the spirits left us, and what we may be able to do to bring them back. One curious fixture of Shadowgale Forest to the north is the presence of a curious form of wind sprite that some call "hollows". We know little of them and why they are there, but we do know that they first started to appear after the spirits of the wind left us.

I need you to go there and disperse them. Gather the remains and bring them back here.
93736-accept.title: Unwelcome Spirits

93736-complete.name: Endaria Mistgaze
93736-complete.text:
Handling these essences fills me with a sense of... deep disquiet. I can almost feel a malevolent, regretful aura emanating from them. It's enough to make me faint.

<Endaria shudders slightly.>

I do not look forward to studying these further.
93736-complete.title: Unwelcome Spirits

93736-progress.name: Endaria Mistgaze
93736-progress.text: Shadowgale Forest is a dangerous place. Some even say it's haunted. I'm quite sure that I don't believe that, but I do know that it's not for the faint hearted, or the unprepared.
93736-progress.title: Unwelcome Spirits

93737-accept.name: Riaani Nightwind
93737-accept.text:
Oh, hello. Ayessa sent you to assist me? Very well then. 

Not sure what an obvious novice like yourself can do, but if you give me a moment to pull my head out of this construct's innards I might have a few ideas of things you can do to help.
93737-accept.title: The Broken Construct

93737-complete.name: Riaani Nightwind
93737-complete.text:
Thank you for scavenging these materials. I imagine that some of this wasn't terribly easy to get. 

With these parts I can get the construct up and running again. From there we can just hope that its memory is intact and it can tell us who took its components.
93737-complete.title: The Broken Construct

93737-progress.name: Riaani Nightwind
93737-progress.text: I can't imagine why anyone would want to steal these components from this construct. Other than the gyrozephyr these components have almost no practical application. Even the gyro would be nigh-useless outside of its intended purpose.
93737-progress.title: The Broken Construct

93738-accept.name: Riaani Nightwind
93738-accept.text:
Brightwish, eh? So the High Order wanted to remove these components for some reason. But why though?

The High Order has always been meddlesome, constantly wanting to experiment with the wind spirits' magic. They are too bold by a mile, and we've strictly $g forbidden:forbade; them from meddling with knowledge under Windshaper purview, but lately they've been testing our patience.

I think you should report what you've learned back to Ayessa Dawnsinger. She can instruct you further on what to do.
93738-accept.title: The Broken Construct

93738-complete.name: Ayessa Dawnsinger
93738-complete.text:
Very interesting, so it was the High Order that was responsible for the construct breaking down?

I know Belathaan. He's Valennia Stormfist's cousin and his mother was actually a Windshaper. It's disappointing that he was involved in this.

I need to reflect on this for a moment.
93738-complete.title: The Broken Construct

93739-accept.name: Thrall
93739-accept.text:
Azeroth is a large world, and the territory of the Horde is vast. The Undercity, Orgrimmar, and Thunder Bluff all have very unique people and culture.

If you are to be a guest of the Horde here on Azeroth, it would do you good to visit each of our capital cities in turn. Speak with my advisor Nazgrel for directions.
93739-accept.title: Exploring the Horde

93739-complete.name: Thrall
93739-complete.text:
So you have returned. I hope that you learned much in your journey.

It is my understanding that your people are still establishing themselves in Mulgore. While you wait for them, I'd encourage you to explore the territory around Orgrimmar. The Barrens in particular is always in need of eager adventurers like yourself.
93739-complete.title: Exploring the Horde

93740-accept.name: Ayessa Dawnsinger
93740-accept.text:
A number of our Windshaper novices were found dead in the Highlands this morning. We can't be certain but there is a strong chance that the Al'Aketh are responsible. Windshapers trade blood for blood, every time.

Head north and kill any Al'Aketh you encounter. Bring me their windstone prayer charms as proof of the deed. We do not forgive and we do not forget.
93740-accept.title: Blood for Blood

93740-complete.name: Ayessa Dawnsinger
93740-complete.text:
<Ayessa looks shaken and distant as you hand her the windstone charms.>

Don't mind me, $N. Today has merely been... a trying day. Thank you for your service to the windshapers thus far.
93740-complete.title: Blood for Blood

93740-progress.name: Ayessa Dawnsinger
93740-progress.text: The Al'Aketh have engaged in their bloody zealotry for far too long. This is only the start of the reckoning they face.
93740-progress.title: Blood for Blood

93746-accept.name: Ayessa Dawnsinger
93746-accept.text:
The High Order has been warned of the consequences of meddling with the Windshaper's affairs. I think we need to make an example out of Belathaan and send him back to the High Order with a few bruises and a healthy respect for the boundaries we set.

Belathaan was seen leaving town, traveling north towards the Shrine of Akir. I don't know why he was going there, but confronting him alone on the road is the safest option. Find him, and put a bit of fear into his heart.
93746-accept.title: A Firm Response

93746-complete.name: Ayessa Dawnsinger
93746-complete.text:
Wait--what?! Belathaan... is dead? 

<Ayessa listens as you give your account of what occurred.> 

The High Order was meeting with the Al'Aketh to discuss peace? There is no peace with the cult, they are murderous zealots. What was Elaadrin thinking sending Belathaan to treat with them alone?

Pay this no mind, $N. You are not at fault for this. The arrogance of the High Order is to blame, yet again. You were merely in the right place at the wrong time.
93746-complete.title: A Firm Response

93791-accept.name: Belann Windwood
93791-accept.text:
$N, it is clear your skill with magic is growing and I believe it is time for you to partake in one of the High Order's oldest traditions for young and aspiring mages. It is time for you to craft a spell focus of your own.

Seek out Belann Windwood in Valanaar. He has been crafting staves and wands for the High Order for over a century, so you will be in good hands.
93791-accept.title: Speak with Belann

93791-complete.name: Belann Windwood
93791-complete.text: Ah, you must be $N? It is heartening to see young mages eager to learn our ways and history. Come, I will explain the next steps to crafting your spell focus.
93791-complete.title: Speak with Belann

93797-accept.name: Belann Windwood
93797-accept.text:
It is a time-honored tradition for young mages to create their own spell focus when they have shown a certain degree of magical proficiency. This is typically done by gathering a fallen branch from our oldest trees, as they have some lingering traces of elemental wind.

I have found the most ideal ones to be near the wind shrine, just south of Falaath Village. Go and bring me back a large branch and I will teach you about the traditions as we create your spell focus.
93797-accept.title: Boughs in the Wind

93797-complete.name: Belann Windwood
93797-complete.text:
Thank you, $N. I can indeed feel the elemental energies in this bough waiting to be harnessed by those that have the gift to do so. This will make an excellent spell focus.

Did this branch sing to you, perhaps? It has often been the case that the branch picks the $c, and not the other way around.

<Belann chuckles as he gently takes the bough from you.>
93797-complete.title: Boughs in the Wind

93797-progress.name: Belann Windwood
93797-progress.text:
Every year that passes in Zephras sees fewer and fewer of those who are gifted with a talent for magic. 

I am glad to see young mages such as yourself participate in our oldest traditions to help keep our history and culture alive and well.
93797-progress.title: Boughs in the Wind

938-accept.name: Mist
938-accept.text:
The sabercat's fur is a distinctive gray color, blending into the surrounding forest. As she lays there, you observe that she is badly wounded, with deep lacerations across her back and stomach.

She raises her head and gazes at you, bright intelligence shining in blue eyes. She seems to wish to follow you.
938-accept.title: Mist

938-complete.name: Sentinel Arynia Cloudsbreak
938-complete.text: Oh, thank you, $N! I feared I would never see Mist again, knowing only her death in my heart, never to be united with my faithful companion. I owe you more than you can know, and you have my eternal gratitude.
938-complete.title: Mist

93835-accept.name: Valennia Stormfist
93835-accept.text:
Lorthuna fled up to the spires above using some sort of portal. Ayessa and Elaadrin went in after her. That was just a few moments ago.

I'm afraid I took one too many hits and this is where I stay. Go through the portal, find Elaadrin and help them stop Lorthuna.

Unless that help that Elaadrin and Ayessa said they sent for arrives soon, you are on your own from here. Good luck, $c.
93835-accept.title: Confront Lorthuna

93835-complete.name: Elaadrin Evengale
93835-complete.text:
I sent a few of our remaining mages to ensure that Valennia and her forces were able to escape as well. She should be resting at High Elder Shadowsong's residence now.

Ansirem had to return to Azeroth, but he and I discussed the next steps for the High Order before he departed. We survived the day, but Zephras is dangerously vulnerable now and we must make plans for what is to come.
93835-complete.title: Confront Lorthuna

93836-accept.name: Ayessa Dawnsinger
93836-accept.text:
Muln has told me much of the elemental lords and I am afraid that we have good reason to fear Al'Akir. Now that the wards that have hidden Zephras from his view are down, we are utterly defenseless. If he chooses to attack us, we stand no chance against him here in his own domain.

High Elder Shadowsong needs to know of the danger we are in, and more importantly, what our intentions are for our mission to Azeroth. We will find the means to save our home. I swear it.
93836-accept.title: The Fate of Zephras

93836-complete.name: Talaanis Shadowsong
93836-complete.text:
<Talaanis Shadowsong listens intently as you tell him of what transpired above the Shrine of Akir, and of Ayessa's plan to leave Zephras Isle.>

I need to reflect on this further, but looking at the upside, we have rid ourselves of Lorthuna and deprived the cult of their leader. Our home has not been invaded yet and on the timeline of elemental gods, it could be years... decades even, before Al'Akir deigns to turn his attention to us.

There is much to fear now, but much to celebrate as well.
93836-complete.title: The Fate of Zephras

93926-accept.name: Constable Aonda
93926-accept.text:
Whatever reason the cult has for attacking the tower, it's not worth losing our people over.

I'd like for you to head to the southwest and check in on that watchtower for us. Find the peacekeepers there and tell them to head back to the village. Holding that tower is not worth the lives it would cost and I'd rather concentrate the defenders we do have here to protect our citizens.

Peacekeeper Vaaniel is in charge, let him know to head back here as quickly as possible. Hurry!
93926-accept.title: The Western Watch

93926-complete.name: Peacekeeper Vaaniel
93926-complete.text: <The body here is somewhat fresh, clearly only recently having been killed. Judging by the burns and scorch marks on this peacekeeper's skin, its clear that they were killed by the cult's storm-wielding spellcasters.>
93926-complete.title: The Western Watch

93927-accept.name: Peacekeeper Vaaniel
93927-accept.text: <As you inspect the body of the dead peacekeeper, a bloody note falls free of his hands. Picking it up and reading it may give you a clue as to how to proceed from here.>
93927-accept.title: A Last Request

93927-complete.name: Constable Aonda
93927-complete.text:
So they are all dead, then. Storms curse these cult bastards!

While you managed to take out the priest and stop the cultists at the tower, I confess that I'm now doubly concerned about whatever it was you said that they were doing to the pylon. The fact that there was such a massive cache of windstones there with them tells me that they needed enormous energy for it.

I have to wonder, what's the end goal here? Violating the pylon, attacking the village? To what end?
93927-complete.title: A Last Request

93927-progress.name: Constable Aonda
93927-progress.text: What news from the western watch?
93927-progress.title: A Last Request

93948-accept.name: Constable Aonda
93948-accept.text:
Since you are going to Valanaar anyway, please deliver the signet ring you recovered from the tower to Talaanis Shadowsong in Valanaar. 

He will want this back, and more importantly, he will want to learn the fate of his nephew. Talaanis is the High Elder of Zephras Isle and more importantly, he is a good man who is well loved by the people, despite our current hardships. It pains me to think of how he will react to this news. Please express my condolences for his loss.
93948-accept.title: Deliver the Signet

93948-complete.name: Talaanis Shadowsong
93948-complete.text:
I... am very sorry to hear that my nephew is dead. I thank you kindly for recovering this, and bringing it to me.

It's not common that such capable young shen'dorei come down from the highlands. If you need work, please speak with Valennia Stormfist, the captain of the peacekeepers here in Valanaar. These days we need all the help we can get.
93948-complete.title: Deliver the Signet

93948-progress.name: Talaanis Shadowsong
93948-progress.text: What is that you have for me? Oh... oh no.
93948-progress.title: Deliver the Signet

93949-accept.name: Valennia Stormfist
93949-accept.text:
We've been bugged.

It's skyhopper season in the lowlands, which means the pests are everywhere. One of the High Order mages reported that one of the insects that they killed had an enchantment of some kind placed upon it. When we inspected it closely it seems to be some sort of listening spell.

We suspect that the cult is using these enchanted insects as spies. Go and exterminate them for us. You won't be able to tell which are enchanted by looking at them, so you'll just have to kill them all.
93949-accept.title: Bugged

93949-complete.name: Valennia Stormfist
93949-complete.text: I'm sure there are more of these critters around Valanaar, but every enchanted skyhopper we stomp out makes the city just a tiny bit safer.
93949-complete.title: Bugged

93951-accept.name: Taleen Shimmerthread
93951-accept.text:
The hippogryphs that have taken up residence southwest of the village can be a nuisance, but they also present a rather unique opportunity to obtain their feathers. Many skyborne love to adorn their hair with vibrant plumes and the down feathers of a hippogryph are exceptionally vibrant and, more importantly, silky soft.

If you are heading that way, try and gather as many of the fallen feathers as you can from around their nesting grounds. Do be careful, as wild hippogryph are not tolerant of guests.
93951-accept.title: A Little Beauty

93951-complete.name: Taleen Shimmerthread
93951-complete.text:
It might seem a bit of a vain triviality, gathering feathers for our hair. However, even in times like these, one needs to embrace the small joys as much as possible. 

If one thing I create brings someone joy, then I will consider that to be a good day. Thank you for bringing me these and helping me bring some joy to Zephras.
93951-complete.title: A Little Beauty

93951-progress.name: Taleen Shimmerthread
93951-progress.text: What beautiful things did you bring me?
93951-progress.title: A Little Beauty

93958-accept.name: Hyusaa Quickbreeze
93958-accept.text:
Valennia's forces just breached the inner sanctum. The fighting was thick in there at first, but it's grown... unsettlingly quiet. Go in there and do your best to link up with Valennia and her forces... if any of them are left.

I'll stay here and watch your back.
93958-accept.title: The Inner Sanctum

93963-accept.name: Highlord Bolvar Fordragon
93963-accept.text:
Stormwind, Ironforge, and Darnassus all have unique peoples and cultures. As a guest of the Alliance here on Azeroth, you should take some time to visit each of our capital cities in turn. 

Speak with Randal Emerson in the southern antechamber for directions to get you started.
93963-accept.title: Exploring the Alliance

93963-complete.name: Highlord Bolvar Fordragon
93963-complete.text:
Ah, you are back.

I hope your adventures have given you a sense of the scale and wonder of our world. I know it must seem overwhelming to you, but if you are to help your people, you must be prepared for whatever may come your way while you are on Azeroth.

While you wait for your order to establish itself in Dalaran, I suggest you turn your attention to the lands around Stormwind. Westfall in particular can always use more strong adventurers to lend them aid, if you are willing.
93963-complete.title: Exploring the Alliance

94-accept.name: Theocritus
94-accept.text:
My rival, Morganth, is a vicious mage of great power who lives in the Tower of Ilgalar in Redridge.  I have developed a means of spying on him, the Eye of Azora, and can now view him from afar.

But to study his thoughts ... I require further aid.

If you are willing, then take my Glyph of Azora to the Tower of Ilgalar.  Place it upon the Lion Statue near the Tower.

When this is done, the power of Azora will grant visions of Morganth's future plans.
94-accept.title: A Watchful Eye

94-complete.name: Unknown
94-complete.text:
You place the Glyph of Azora on the stone.  It adheres itself ... and you hear from it Theocritus' disembodied voice:

You have my gratitude, young $N.  You may now speak with me through this Glyph, and I might have future tasks for you ... after I have probed the thoughts of my rival.
94-complete.title: A Watchful Eye

94-progress.name: Unknown
94-progress.text:
This Lion Statue has sat here for decades, and keeps a lonely watch over the infamous Tower of Ilgalar.

There is a depression at the base of the statue, where a gem or glyph might be set...
94-progress.title: A Watchful Eye

940-accept.name: Unknown
940-accept.text:
The forest whispers of your feats of valor, $N. As I felt the harpies forced from their nests, a greater calm spread across the forest, its creatures once again feeling safe. I have feared sending another messenger to the Arch Druid, but I know that you will see my message safely to him.

Deliver this to him and know that the forest will see you safely along its paths to the forest of stone.
940-accept.title: Teldrassil

940-complete.name: Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm
940-complete.text:
I wondered why the Oracle Tree had not communicated with me for so long... It seems that some problems are lessened while others grow to greater concerns.

I fear my work on Teldrassil shall never be completed, and our immortality never restored.

Nonetheless, you have done the Oracle Tree's task well, and should be rewarded for your diligence.
940-complete.title: Teldrassil

940-progress.name: Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm
940-progress.text: Hmm... You come with the spirit of the forest strongly within you, $c. What business do you have with the Arch Druid of the Kaldorei?
940-progress.title: Teldrassil

94003-accept.name: Seena Skybreaker
94003-accept.text:
I am all that remains of the line of Skybreakers here on Zephras Isle. The rest were murdered by the Al'Aketh.

The only thing that outweighs my sorrow is my shame. My family's ancestral shield--the Skybreaker Bulwark--is now in the hands of a cultist named Zaal Stormshield. Family lore holds no harm may befall a worthy wielder of this shield.

Zaal is not worthy, of that I am sure. Find this man at the Shrine of Akir and reclaim my shield from him. Do this and I will teach you the Skybreaker Defense.
94003-accept.title: The Skybreaker Bulwark

94003-complete.name: Seena Skybreaker
94003-complete.text:
You have done what I could not and restored my family honor. For this, I will bestow a gift that few on Zephras are worthy to receive. I will teach you the secrets of the Skybreaker Defense.

Also, you will need a shield to put what I have to teach you into practice. Please, take this one. I have little use for it now that the Skybreaker Bulwark has been returned to me.

Banu'Adoraah, friend.
94003-complete.title: The Skybreaker Bulwark

94006-accept.name: Lotheluum Starbreeze
94006-accept.text:
Greetings, $N. You have progressed in your druidic studies far enough that I think it is time for you to meet one of the great spirits that reside here on Zephras. Urs'endris is a wise and noble spirit, who has taught druids how to take on the ursera shape for generations. Unfortunately his domain has begun to wither and fall into the sky like many other areas of Zephras.

To find him, travel northeast near the waterfall in the shadow of the Shrine of Akir. He should be able to instruct you further.
94006-accept.title: The Great Ursera Spirit

94006-complete.name: Urs'endris
94006-complete.text: So, you wish to embrace the way of the claw, child? Very well. Let us speak.
94006-complete.title: The Great Ursera Spirit

94007-accept.name: Elayaa Easewind
94007-accept.text:
Now that you've gained a level of comfort in the wilds of the highlands, I believe it is time for you to seek your very own animal companion.

Go to the port of Valanaar to the southeast, and speak with Quel'ana Quickgale there. He will instruct you in the art of beast taming.
94007-accept.title: Taming the Beast

94007-complete.name: Quel'ana Quickgale
94007-complete.text: I am most glad that you came. Come, let us begin.
94007-complete.title: Taming the Beast

94013-accept.name: Quel'ana Quickgale
94013-accept.text:
You've returned triumphant from taming two beasts. It's time now for your last trial. The winds of Zephras whisper of greater challenges ahead. 

Take this Taming Rod and journey to the Gustberry Lowlands. There, tame a Vuldren Alpha and prove your mastery. 

Complete this lesson and you'll be ready to learn the deeper ways of the $c.
94013-accept.title: Taming the Beast

94013-complete.name: Quel'ana Quickgale
94013-complete.text:
Excellent, $N! You are quite a fast learner. Now that you know the basics, I can teach you how to forge a lasting bond with an animal companion.

Go with this knowledge and thrive. Be the $c that Zephras Isle needs you to be.
94013-complete.title: Taming the Beast

94013-progress.name: Quel'ana Quickgale
94013-progress.text: You will learn, $N, and one day you will be a great $c.
94013-progress.title: Taming the Beast

94050-accept.name: Quel'ana Quickgale
94050-accept.text:
You now have the power to tame a pet, but you must also gain the skills to train it. For this, there is none better than my sister, Quel'dora. She will give you the ability to train your new pet. 

Go with the winds, young $c.
94050-accept.title: Training the Beast

94050-complete.name: Quel'dora Quickgale
94050-complete.text:
A fledgling $c, I see. Yes, I can bestow you with the skills you need to train and guide your pet. Not only will you be able to teach your pet new abilities, you will now be able to feed your pet, as well as revive it, should it fall in battle.

Remember, $N, always respect the balance and live in awe of nature around you. Now, go forth. We shall speak again, at a later date.
94050-complete.title: Training the Beast

942-accept.name: Chief Archaeologist Greywhisker
942-accept.text:
This fossil bears a striking resemblance to one I once saw in Ironforge. An archaeologist by the name of Flagongut brought it to our annual Explorers' League conference. He believed the fossil had a power which could be unlocked somehow.

Last I heard Flagongut had holed up in the Deepwater Tavern in Menethil Harbor, awaiting escort to the Whelgar Excavation Site. Seek him out and show him Remtravel's fossil. Perhaps he can reveal the secrets of the past.

The ship to Menethil departs from Auberdine.
942-accept.title: The Absent Minded Prospector

94222-accept.name: Unknown
94222-accept.text: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting 1 Iridescent Hammer, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
94222-accept.title: Craftsman's Writ: Iridescent Hammer

94222-complete.name: Cowardly Peon
94222-complete.text:
Dis my new hammer?

<The peon seizes the weapon from your grasp before you have an opportunity to respond. He swings it wildly in your direction, narrowly avoiding cracking your skull.>

YES! Me fight back now. Won't lose this one, no way.

Take dis. No idea what it for, but it fell out of slime creature.
94222-complete.title: Craftsman's Writ: Iridescent Hammer

94222-progress.name: Cowardly Peon
94222-progress.text: AHHH! Oh... Me thought you look like slime monster.
94222-progress.title: Craftsman's Writ: Iridescent Hammer

94223-accept.name: Unknown
94223-accept.text: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting 1 Silver Skeleton Key, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
94223-accept.title: Craftsman's Writ: Silver Skeleton Key

94224-accept.name: Unknown
94224-accept.text: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting 1 Heavy Bronze Mace, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
94224-accept.title: Craftsman's Writ: Heavy Bronze Mace

94224-complete.name: Gorgrash
94224-complete.text: Whoa. You came well prepared! Hope that mace is for me, unless you plan to do ALL of the fighting.
94224-complete.title: Craftsman's Writ: Heavy Bronze Mace

94224-progress.name: Gorgrash
94224-progress.text: Shh. Keep your voice down. I'm not ready for a fight, yet.
94224-progress.title: Craftsman's Writ: Heavy Bronze Mace

94229-accept.name: Unknown
94229-accept.text: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting 1 Ornate Spyglass, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
94229-accept.title: Craftsman's Writ: Ornate Spyglass

94237-accept.name: Unknown
94237-accept.text: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting 200 Crafted Solid Shot, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
94237-accept.title: Craftsman's Writ: Crafted Solid Shot

94237-complete.name: Kixxle
94237-complete.text:
I am glad you arrived when you did. A few Dragonmaw orcs stormed by the other day and gave me the stink eye.

I ran out of ammunition on my way here. It's half the reason I haven't left this wretched place yet!

The other half being that I still have profits to make.

<Kixxle greedily rubs his hands.>
94237-complete.title: Craftsman's Writ: Crafted Solid Shot

94239-accept.name: Unknown
94239-accept.text: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting 1 Fine Leather Pants, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
94239-accept.title: Craftsman's Writ: Fine Leather Pants

94239-complete.name: Alyce
94239-complete.text:
Oh! The pants? Ah, I realized shortly after writing this that I needed a full set of clothes - new overalls included.

If it will get you out of my hair, I suppose I should honor the request. After all, you did make an arduous journey to find me.

Take this, now please...

<She gestured in a polite but firm shooing motion.>
94239-complete.title: Craftsman's Writ: Fine Leather Pants

94239-progress.name: Alyce
94239-progress.text: Move along, please, and try not to draw attention to us.
94239-progress.title: Craftsman's Writ: Fine Leather Pants

94241-accept.name: Unknown
94241-accept.text: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting 1 Dark Leather Tunic, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
94241-accept.title: Craftsman's Writ: Dark Leather Tunic

94242-accept.name: Unknown
94242-accept.text: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting 1 Pilferer's Gloves, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
94242-accept.title: Craftsman's Writ: Pilferer's Gloves

94244-accept.name: Unknown
94244-accept.text: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting 1 Dark Leather Shoulders, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
94244-accept.title: Craftsman's Writ: Dark Leather Shoulders

94244-complete.name: Narkk
94244-complete.text:
Thar be me shoulderpads, at last!

Ever had one of these squakers perch on your shoulder? Bet ye' haven't! Their claws, they hurt!

Now they got a place to rest all day, and you have a heavier coinpurse!

<Narkk eyes said coinpurse.>

For now!
94244-complete.title: Craftsman's Writ: Dark Leather Shoulders

94244-progress.name: Narkk
94244-progress.text: Yarr, what business do ye' have with ol' Narkk?
94244-progress.title: Craftsman's Writ: Dark Leather Shoulders

94248-accept.name: Unknown
94248-accept.text: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting 1 Blue Overalls, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
94248-accept.title: Craftsman's Writ: Blue Overalls

94248-complete.name: Alyce
94248-complete.text:
The Blue Overalls! Thank goodness, I have a proper change of clothes.

Take this, and please be on your way. I do not have time to chat, I must keep an eye on the farm and can't risk more distractions.
94248-complete.title: Craftsman's Writ: Blue Overalls

94248-progress.name: Alyce
94248-progress.text:
Oh! Please keep your voice down--we don't need to draw any further attention to ourselves.

Do you have something for me?
94248-progress.title: Craftsman's Writ: Blue Overalls

94250-accept.name: Unknown
94250-accept.text: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting 1 Small Silk Pack, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
94250-accept.title: Craftsman's Writ: Small Silk Pack

943-progress.name: Archaeologist Flagongut
943-progress.text: With the Stone of Relu I will be able to release the hidden secrets of my fossil as well as Remtravel's fossil from Darkshore, $N.
943-progress.title: The Absent Minded Prospector

94369-accept.name: Elaadrin Evengale
94369-accept.text:
Ansirem has told me much of the elemental lords and I am afraid that we have good reason to fear Al'Akir now that the wards that have hidden Zephras are down. If the Windlord chooses to attack us, we stand no chance to defend ourselves while we are here in his domain.

High Elder Shadowsong needs to know of the danger we are in, and more importantly, what our intentions are for our mission to Azeroth. We will find the means to save our home. I swear it.
94369-accept.title: The Fate of Zephras

94369-complete.name: Talaanis Shadowsong
94369-complete.text:
<Talaanis Shadowsong listens intently as you tell him of what transpired above the Shrine of Akir, and of Elaadrin's plan to leave Zephras Isle.>

I need to reflect on this further, but looking at the upside, we have rid ourselves of Lorthuna and deprived the cult of their leader. Our home has not been invaded yet, and on the timeline of elemental demigods, it could be years... decades even, before Al'Akir deigns to turn his attention to us.

There is much to fear now, but much to celebrate as well.
94369-complete.title: The Fate of Zephras

94373-accept.name: Teo Hammerstorm
94373-accept.text:
Aye, the time's come, young $c. Ye've grown stout and sturdy, like the stone beneath our boots. Takin' up the $c's path shows ye've got the wisdom o' the mountain, even before ye've proven yerself. Ye've the grit of stone to walk the earth's path.

But to earn its favor, ye must face it proper. South o' here, the Frostmane trolls live in a cave.

Bring me two of the necklaces they wear, crafted from the Iceclaw bears. Then we'll speak more of yer future.
94373-accept.title: Call of Earth

94373-complete.name: Teo Hammerstorm
94373-complete.text:
Well done, lad. Ye've proven yerself ready. Earth's the bedrock of all things. It'll shield ye, but only if ye show it proper respect. Even stone can shift if slighted. Learn its ways, and ye'll grow wiser than most. Never forget the secrets it shares. 

I'll craft ye a sapta now--accept it, and ye'll walk the true path.
94373-complete.title: Call of Earth

94373-progress.name: Teo Hammerstorm
94373-progress.text:
Patience, lad, is the earth's finest virtue. It's seen mountains crumble and rivers carve valleys--slow and stubborn, like a true $r. The earth calls to ye now, for trouble brews on the horizon. Return successful, and ye'll be one step closer to bein' whole.

Others may envy yer wisdom, but that's their burden to bear.
94373-progress.title: Call of Earth

94374-accept.name: Teo Hammerstorm
94374-accept.text:
Aye, sapta's a brew forged with magic, bindin' our spirit to the elements. Only a few $c know the recipe, and it's nae for the weak-willed. Drink it, and ye will see what others can't. Hold true--it's only to be drunk in a sacred place.

Head north to the Spirit Stone, tucked at the end of a hidden path up the mountain. Drink it there... see what the earth has to show ye.
94374-accept.title: Call of Earth

94374-complete.name: Minor Manifestation of Earth
94374-complete.text:
Ah... $N... the earth welcomes you, even in this frozen land. Bound in body and spirit, you'll walk forward knowing the mountains are your strength, the plains your patience, and the world your essence.

To pass this rite, stand humbly before the earth. The other elements are not so still - they clash and roar. Learn their dual nature, even here among the snow and stone.
94374-complete.title: Call of Earth

94375-accept.name: Minor Manifestation of Earth
94375-accept.text:
Take this rough quartz from me and bring it to Teo Hammerstorm as proof o' our meeting. He will craft a totem for ye, and this pebble will be the heart o' it. As small as it may seem, ye will come to find that size does not matter, and that even the smallest o' things can outlast many others.

Be patient, $N. Remain strong. And seek wisdom. This is what earth asks o' ye. In the end, ye shall become one with the earth--respect it as it shall respect ye.
94375-accept.title: Call of Earth

94375-complete.name: Teo Hammerstorm
94375-complete.text: Well done! Know this - totems ain't just a mark of yer place among shamans. They're tools, a focus for spells tied to stone, soil, and other elements.
