More adventurers from Zephras, I see. Wonderful. The winds surely favor us! It's going to take us some time to get ourselves established here, so you may want to take some time to explore this new land.

Azeroth is an exciting new world, but it's also a dangerous world. You'd do well to prepare yourself for this new adventure by familiarizing yourself with the lands nearby.
95349-complete.title: The Earthen Ring

95350-accept.name: Alaana Stormwalker
95350-accept.text:
Its a big world down here, and our new allies are the key to our survival.

The Earthen Ring is a member of the "Horde", a proud collection of like-minded peoples. The nearby city of Thunder Bluff is a part of the horde, and further to the east lies the capital of Orgrimmar.

Seek out the flight master in the center of Thunder Bluff. They will fly you to Orgrimmar where you will make contact with the horde warchief--Thrall, on behalf of the Windshapers. Winds guide you, $N.
95350-accept.title: Welcome to Azeroth

95350-complete.name: Thrall
95350-complete.text:
Lok-tar, $c. I am Thrall, Warchief of the Horde.

An Earthen Ring messenger told me to expect members of the Windshapers, and here you are. I'd not have expected to see a high elf standing before me here in Orgrimmar, but the Horde will welcome you as our guest all the same.

You have my blessing to travel through Horde lands. Go with honor, Windshaper.
95350-complete.title: Welcome to Azeroth

954-accept.name: Thundris Windweaver
954-accept.text:
The ruins of Bashal'Aran to the east are overrun with demonic minions. The sprites and satyrs that have taken up residence in the area feed upon the magical energies of the area, their powers growing from continued exposure.

Even with that, I have noticed that there is one shrine they will not approach. On the western side of the ruins, atop a small bluff, a strange blue aura permeates... There must be an explanation to the demons' reluctance.

I would like you to investigate it.
954-accept.title: Bashal'Aran

954-complete.name: Asterion
954-complete.text:
Ahh... To what could I possibly owe the exceedingly special honor of a $r such as yourself as company. Truly it says much of my current companions--with no offense to my hosts, the noble grells and satyrs--that your presence could be considered an improvement.

But please, do not let my uncivil tongue drive you from the place. It has indeed been many years, decades even, since I had civil accompaniment.
954-complete.title: Bashal'Aran

95494-accept.name: Vrang Wildgore
95494-accept.text:
I need someone with a strong sword arm and some extra time on their hands to help me gather some lion hides. It stings my pride to ask a stranger for this aid, but I took an injury to my leg recently. Until I heal, I'm in no shape to go hunting myself but I have obligations to keep.

The big ones in this area generally have the best hides, so start with those first.
95494-accept.title: Bruised Pride and Lion Hides

95494-complete.name: Vrang Wildgore
95494-complete.text:
Yes, these look like they will do nicely. I have an arrangement with a local tanner to deliver these raw hides in exchange for various finished leather goods that I use as part of my trade. 

I've never come up short on my end of the arrangement, and even with my injury I do not intend to start now.
95494-complete.title: Bruised Pride and Lion Hides

95495-accept.name: Vrang Wildgore
95495-accept.text:
These hides are bound for a tanner who I often trade with. He is something of a hermit and he lives alone on the top of the ridge behind me. Climbing up a steep hillside isn't something I can manage easily right now so I'd be in your debt if you could make this delivery for me.

Oh, and about this tanner's... appearance. You need not be alarmed. In spite of his looks, he is no threat. I swear this is true.
95495-accept.title: The Hermit Tanner

95495-complete.name: Walton
95495-complete.text: Vrang sent you then? Very well. I appreciate you delivering these hides to me. It's unfortunate that Vrang couldn't make the journey himself. There is a matter I wish to speak with him about.
95495-complete.title: The Hermit Tanner

95495-progress.name: Walton
95495-progress.text: Greetings, $c. What brings you up to my property today?
95495-progress.title: The Hermit Tanner

955-accept.name: Asterion
955-accept.text:
If I were to relate the story of my life, I have no doubt it would surpass the limits of your patience. Let us say that mine has been a long and painful life, and this spectral form is perhaps the worst torment of all.

I am held here by the means of magic. Though my words may seem disingenuous, I assure you I would be grateful beyond words if you would help me find the means of my imprisonment. A seal binds me, and by examining the earpieces of the sprites and grells, I may find a trace of it.
955-accept.title: Bashal'Aran

955-complete.name: Asterion
955-complete.text: Indeed... The grells of Bashal'Aran do not possess that which I am searching... however they have come into contact with it recently. Recently... I would reckon that by your time, not mine. Recent for me stretches into the veil of the past, almost another Age...
955-complete.title: Bashal'Aran

955-progress.name: Asterion
955-progress.text: Once I have the earrings, I will cast the spell to search for the whereabouts of the seal that binds me. For centuries I have thought on the freedom destroying the seal would bring to me... Perhaps those centuries have taken a toll upon my mind that I might never recover...
955-progress.title: Bashal'Aran

95507-accept.name: Vrang Wildgore
95507-accept.text:
While you are out there, it would be of great help to me if you could check on my traps for me. I've got them strewn all over the valley.

Bring back any small game that I've caught. Keep your eye out for the other wildlife, though. This area can be dangerous if you aren't paying attention.
95507-accept.title: Vrang's Game

95507-complete.name: Vrang Wildgore
95507-complete.text: Thank you for your aid, $c. I was starting to wonder if I'd have to go to bed hungry tonight because this cursed wound on my leg.
95507-complete.title: Vrang's Game

95507-progress.name: Vrang Wildgore
95507-progress.text: <Vrang grunts at you as you approach.>
95507-progress.title: Vrang's Game

95508-accept.name: Walton
95508-accept.text:
Yes, I used to be a member of the Kul Tiras navy. After Lord Admiral took Theramore and started his campaign in Durotar, I had... "objections" to his methods. Particularly the methods involving executing civilians.

There's more to the story but... wait... what's that?

There's a group of men coming up the ridge!
95508-accept.title: Unwelcome Guests

95508-complete.name: Walton
95508-complete.text:
Well, looks like we are all alive. I... knew that someday that would catch up to me. I'm in your debt for your help here today.

Please, take this. It's not much, but it's the least I can do.

Safe travels, $c.
95508-complete.title: Unwelcome Guests

956-accept.name: Asterion
956-accept.text:
If the grells have come into close contact with the seal that binds my eternal prison, I suspect I know the cause. No doubt the seal has come into the possession of the satyr that lead them.

I feel strongly that this must be true, $N. One of the satyr must surely possess it. If you can obtain it, you would bring me so close to passing the bars of my prison that tears would come to my eyes.
956-accept.title: Bashal'Aran

956-complete.name: Asterion
956-complete.text: It... it is hard for me to even believe that what I hold now is that which has held me for so long. Let us waste no time, $N. When the seal is destroyed, I might walk the forests of the earth freely again.
956-complete.title: Bashal'Aran

956-progress.name: Asterion
956-progress.text:
The pillars of this shrine are as the bars of a prison to me, $N. No strength I still possess might break them, and no magic I wield might destroy them...

For a thousand years and more I have stared at them, wondering if at long last I outlived even the stone, would I be free? Or would it be invisible bars that held me then...
956-progress.title: Bashal'Aran

95621-accept.name: Walton
95621-accept.text:
This morning I spotted a group of humans searching for something in the valley below. I managed to use my rifle's scope for a better look, and it was clear that they were soldiers sporting the livery of Kul Tiras. 

If you'd be willing to take work from me, travel to where these soldiers made camp near the wrecked caravan to the south. Kill any you find and try to learn why they are here.
95621-accept.title: Trouble in the Valley

95621-complete.name: Walton
95621-complete.text: So they are looking for a deserter... Well, it seems that the past has finally caught up to me.
95621-complete.title: Trouble in the Valley

95621-progress.name: Walton
95621-progress.text:
The remnants of Daelin Proudmoore's fleet who still fly his banner are just as rotten and barbaric as the admiral himself was before he died.

I don't know why they are so far from Tiragarde, but it can't be good.
95621-progress.title: Trouble in the Valley

95646-accept.name: Rethiel the Greenwarden
95646-accept.text:
These brackish wetlands hold a greater well of unsalted southern waters. It pains me, yet within my roots I sense a corruption seeping through that mountain gully.

The creatures, like those in our lowlands, react more bitterly to the taint. Lacking the sea's hardening salt since life's dawn, they have little strength against such evil.

Go to those highlands, and bring me the Highland Horror's root core.
95646-accept.title: Horrors in the Highland

95646-complete.name: Rethiel the Greenwarden
95646-complete.text: It is worse than I feared. An ancient energy stirs. It would be most wise for you to carry word to your eager excavators to stop digging, for their own safety.
95646-complete.title: Horrors in the Highland

95646-progress.name: Rethiel the Greenwarden
95646-progress.text: These waters harbor unique life in a brine that gives and takes equally.
95646-progress.title: Horrors in the Highland

95647-accept.name: Caitlin Grassman
95647-accept.text:
My husband, Ardin, has a rare gift for sensing nature. He'll scale any peak to gather the herbs and flowers I need for my alchemy, keeping our shelves and pantry stocked.

But I fear he's wandered into trouble. An excavation crew passed through seeking supplies. They spoke, among other things, of towering grasses unlike anything they'd ever seen. Those were what he told me he had to go see for himself. He's been gone too long!

If you learn anything of him, I'd be grateful.
95647-accept.title: Lost in the Thicket Things

95647-complete.name: Caitlin Grassman
95647-complete.text: I thought we were done for! Something upset the wildlife around here and our excavation team was overwhelmed. Thank you for helping us with those spiders.
95647-complete.title: Lost in the Thicket Things

95663-accept.name: Zaruk
95663-accept.text:
The Dragonmaw are a formidable clan.

They're known for binding magic strong enough to make dragons serve, and rumor claims they're preparing some display of it in the Wetlands. Whether truth or bluster, the Deathstalkers can't act on half-formed whispers. $g Titanic:Broken; $g winds:symbols; carried only that much to me.

A deathstalker agent needs a hand in the hills above the Dragonmaw encampment. Meet her there. She'll reveal the next steps.
95663-accept.title: Dragonmaw Rumors

95663-complete.name: Deathstalker Agent
95663-complete.text: Arrival of the courageous few? Mind your voice.
95663-complete.title: Dragonmaw Rumors

95664-accept.name: Unknown
95664-accept.text: This unusual composite shard scatters light like a living prism. Its nature is uncertain, but its power feels ancient. The most knowledgeable minds for artifacts of this bygone age must reside on the Elder rise in Thunder Bluff.
95664-accept.title: Elder Knowledge

95664-complete.name: Bashana Runetotem
95664-complete.text: It is a favored sign to have a stranger approach in this manner. I feel a power amidst you... what is this you have brought?
95664-complete.title: Elder Knowledge

95664-progress.name: Bashana Runetotem
95664-progress.text: Spirits honor you. Have you come to share with us?
95664-progress.title: Elder Knowledge

95682-accept.name: Deathstalker Agent
95682-accept.text:
Dragonmaw. <She lets out a dry, amused scoff.>

The remnants of the dragon-wrangling clan think they've found something that could lead to them rising to their former power. In the eyes of whom... their false warchief?

Clear out their ragtag clan within the Excavation Sites so our Deathstalkers can move in undetected.

If the Dragonmaw carry anything of note upon them, return it to me--this information must stay between us and our royal command.
95682-accept.title: Open the Maw

95682-complete.name: Deathstalker Agent
95682-complete.text:
Don't mind me snatching that right out of your hands.

I recognized that orcish scrawl. So they're hoping to appease Rend? A fruitless and wasted effort. 

No matter, this is highly valuable knowledge for the dark lady to consider.

Here, I won't be taking any of this with me--and don't talk about the mission, grunt.
95682-complete.title: Open the Maw

95682-progress.name: Deathstalker Agent
95682-progress.text: We're here to get the important job done. If you can help, prove it.
95682-progress.title: Open the Maw

95697-accept.name: Borstan
95697-accept.text:
Zamja tells me we need more homestyle cooking.
If we start selling raptor, she thinks it'll draw in customers who don't usually visit Borstan's Firepit.

Her idea is not so bad. But I want something that rises above the smells of our birth villages. We're in Orgrimmar! Borstan should serve a grand take on their familiar favorites.

A hunter recently came back from the Wetlands with a giant talon from the thicket raptors in the Excavation Sites.

Up for a job?
95697-accept.title: Changing Tastes

95697-complete.name: Borstan
95697-complete.text: Look at the marbling on these! What are they eating up there? Thank you for going all the way and back for us. If you don't mind waiting, we'll cook some for you now, on the house, of course!
95697-complete.title: Changing Tastes

95697-progress.name: Borstan
95697-progress.text: Farm-raised boar, farm-raised crawler... what's next, farm-raised raptor?
95697-progress.title: Changing Tastes

957-accept.name: Asterion
957-accept.text:
It was the craft of one of the most powerful of the Highborne that created the seal that formed my prison. In Ameth'Aran, the ruins to the south that are twin to these, persists even today an ancient flame, blue in color. In this flame this seal could be destroyed.

Be wary in the ruins, $N...
957-accept.title: Bashal'Aran

957-complete.name: Asterion
957-complete.text:
I am freed, $N! I can now see with my own eyes the changes that have come to our world... Only bits and pieces have I known. To think that when I last walked freely, the Well still stood and the Highborne held court with Azshara, our beloved queen.

I sense that my jailor, my former master, Athrikus, still lives... Already my feelings of hopelessness will give way into thoughts of vengeance.
957-complete.title: Bashal'Aran

95737-accept.name: Llana
95737-accept.text:
From time to time, I correspond with others in my craft--herbalists or eccentrics who study rare plants and local oddities. We trade discoveries, and sometimes warnings of what lies ahead.

One alchemist in the Wetlands wrote of an excavation team her husband was part of, uncovering signs of a long-lost primordial grass... but she never sent word of its abundance or accessibility.

If you can, check on Caitlin Grassman in Menethil Harbor.
95737-accept.title: Seeking Caitlin

95737-complete.name: Caitlin Grassman
95737-complete.text: Llana must be wondering where those grass seeds are that I promised I'd have my husband bring back! It comforts me to know she's as concerned as I am. It must be something about the excavation site itself that we're both sensing.
95737-complete.title: Seeking Caitlin

95772-accept.name: Dorin Songblade
95772-accept.text:
Me brother tried draggin' me off tae the Wetlands with some diggin' crew out o' Loch Modan. Said they were headin' into hills no dwarf's ever set boot in for some sort o' excavation.

Aye, I'd 'ave gone, if I wasn't already behind on this pile o' girdles I've got to refit.

Daewyn normally writes after he sends off, though. Haven't heard a thing, gives me a strange feelin' this time.

If yer marchin' that way, mind checking in on me brother?
95772-accept.title: Songblade Search

95772-complete.name: Dorin Songblade
95772-complete.text: This dwarf bears a striking resemblance to Dorin Songblade. The gun in his hands has the letters "DLS" carved into the stock.
95772-complete.title: Songblade Search

95774-accept.name: Mankrik
95774-accept.text:
The healer who saved me could not save her, and she has died in battle. Her name is Olgra, and I will never forget her.

You did not find her adornments on her body? She wore many jewels of polished bone.

Slay the Razormane Raiders near where she fell, and find her precious works of art!

I will place them with the memorial that I build in her memory.
95774-accept.title: Her Name Is Olgra

95774-complete.name: Mankrik
95774-complete.text:
I will place these adornments with my wife's memorial, so that I never forget her. My blood will always run hot with revenge!

You have done me... done us... a great favor, $N.
95774-complete.title: Her Name Is Olgra

95774-progress.name: Mankrik
95774-progress.text: I have only memories now, but I will build a tribute to Olgra so that they never fade.
95774-progress.title: Her Name Is Olgra

95795-accept.name: Unknown
95795-accept.text:
<You cover the dwarf's body with his cloak.>

Travel to Lakeshire and personally inform Dorin Songblade what became of his brother within the Excavation Sites.
95795-accept.title: Fallen in the Fen

95795-complete.name: Dorin Songblade
95795-complete.text:
Ah no...
<He buries his head in his hands and sobs.>

I should 'ave gone with 'em. 

Much of what I was smithin' was for 'im, was plannin' a surprise but it wasn't ready when he came by gettin' things for his journey.

Now that these are finished, I don't have it in me to reforge or sell any of it.
You can have this. It's the least I can do for you, bringing me this grim day.
95795-complete.title: Fallen in the Fen

958-accept.name: Thundris Windweaver
958-accept.text:
$C. A task I would ask of you.

Have you seen the ruins of Ameth'Aran? If not, you will find them on the eastern side of the main road, some ways to the south. Once they were the home of many powerful Highborne, now they are a testament to the destruction their dabblings produced.

I have been told by the Sentinels that the spirits of the Highborne persist, and that they wield their ancient magical implements. Those relics must be appropriated, so that we might destroy them.
958-accept.title: Tools of the Highborne

958-complete.name: Thundris Windweaver
958-complete.text: Though it is surely a figment of my imagination, I feel as though I can almost feel the taint of foul Highborne magic upon them. I will have these destroyed, so that their long dormant evil might never be released again.
958-complete.title: Tools of the Highborne

958-progress.name: Thundris Windweaver
958-progress.text: If only the tools of their undoing could have been destroyed in the cataclysm that destroyed our world... Nonetheless, we must do what we can to ensure that the horrors of our past are not repeated in the future.
958-progress.title: Tools of the Highborne

95803-accept.name: Danitha Morr
95803-accept.text:
Now that we've claimed the head of the tarnished commander, I need you to deliver it to the Undercity. Sylvanas Windrunner mistrusts us greatly, and all but openly disparages us.

Deliver Rudolph Gelhardt's head to the Dark Lady. Show her that we tend to our own house and are devoted to the prosperity of the forsaken.
95803-accept.title: A Token of Good Faith

95803-complete.name: Lady Sylvanas Windrunner
95803-complete.text:
I don't doubt Danitha's sincerity and desire to earn a place for your kind amongst the Forsaken. However, I suspect that this isn't the last time we'll see one of your brothers and sisters go mad and turn the light against their own people.

There may come a time when I decide that tolerating your misbegotten order is no longer in the best interests of the Forsaken. I suggest you continue to serve your people diligently.

We will be watching.
95803-complete.title: A Token of Good Faith

95805-accept.name: Seer Graytongue
95805-accept.text:
The sun and the moon, An'she and Mu'sha, are not part of our world like the elements, yet their light gives us life, guidance, and hope.

We pay respect to the spirits of the world, and so we pay respect to the twins as well.

If you would show your respect, take this smoldering incense and bring it to a shrine in the hills to the southeast, overlooking the mesa, south of the quilboar. Be quick, so that you can reach the shrine before the incense burns away.

Don't get it wet!
95805-accept.title: Grace of An'she and Mu'sha

95805-complete.name: Unknown
95805-complete.text: <As you empty the incense into the fire, the scent wafts around you, leaving you with just the empty pouch and a subtle sense of fulfillment.>
95805-complete.title: Grace of An'she and Mu'sha

95805-progress.name: Seer Graytongue
95805-progress.text: <The smoke from the incense rises toward the sky.>
95805-progress.title: Grace of An'she and Mu'sha

95809-accept.name: Unknown
95809-accept.text:
I need a moment to rest before I find my own way out.

<He pulls some reeds from his pack and quickly braids and bends them into a heart.>

Take this, and bring it back to Caitlin. Let her know I'll be home soon! Now that we have a path cleared out thanks to you, I'll gather my bushels and follow your trail.

Thank you.
95809-accept.title: Heartwoven

95809-complete.name: Caitlin Grassman
95809-complete.text:
Goodness, that sounds terrible!

By the light, I'm grateful he's one of the survivors.

<She holds the reed-woven heart to her own.>

I'll start cooking a hearty meal for him. Thank you for bringing me this. I'd like you to have something as a token of our appreciation.
95809-complete.title: Heartwoven

95809-progress.name: Caitlin Grassman
95809-progress.text: I'm more than worried about him!
95809-progress.title: Heartwoven

95810-accept.name: Unknown
95810-accept.text:
You pick up a fractured piece of the rock-mech automaton. It has a texture unlike anything you've touched before, a composite material of unknown makeup. This is certainly bound to be more 'device' than 'debris.'

Prospector Whelgar himself at his excavation site might have something useful to share about the relic.
95810-accept.title: Lost Relic Carry

95810-complete.name: Prospector Whelgar
95810-complete.text:
Ah, ye ventured all the way in and survived to tell the tale?! Let's have a look at what ye carry there. 

Well, knowing what ye went through to bring it back to me, I think it warrants a certain reverence for your artifact.
95810-complete.title: Lost Relic Carry

95883-accept.name: Unknown
95883-accept.text:
<The preparations for a hastily-assembled ritual are gathered unceremoniously on the altar. According to the scrap of note, everything has been gathered. All that's missing are the offering of blood and the Tortured Soul.

The undead around you look tortured enough. They may have what you seek.>
95883-accept.title: The Tortured Soul

95883-complete.name: Unknown
95883-complete.text:
<The tortured soul lets out a foul energy in the presence of the offering stone.

It appears you are closer to fulfilling the ritual.>
95883-complete.title: The Tortured Soul

95884-accept.name: Unknown
95884-accept.text:
<The scrap of note is mostly illegible. What is still readable, however, are notes about preparations for an offering.

An offering stone is mentioned, as well as a ritual.

Perhaps you can find this offering stone nearby.>
95884-accept.title: The Offering Stone

95884-complete.name: Unknown
95884-complete.text:
<Strange implements and items litter the rough surface of the stone.

This is surely the offering stone that is mentioned in the note.>
95884-complete.title: The Offering Stone

95885-accept.name: Unknown
95885-accept.text:
<All that's left now is the offering of blood.

The note scrap mentioned a 'willing sacrifice.'

An intense sense of dread washes over you.>
95885-accept.title: The Offering of Blood

95885-complete.name: Unknown
95885-complete.text:
<The offering stone is inert now. It appears your ritual drained it of power. To what end, you do not know, but it is over now.

The rough stone cracks and crumbles, now devoid of purpose.

Something glitters from within the remnants...>
95885-complete.title: The Offering of Blood

959-accept.name: Crane Operator Bigglefuzz
959-accept.text:
Oops!

Had a little mishap, as you can see! The morning cargo shipment from Booty Bay was huge. Huge I say! Never seen so many crates. Well, I was trying to expedite things so I started unloading a bit more than I could handle. That's when everything came tumbling down.

Before I knew what was going on, I saw that menace, Mad Magglish, go running off with a bottle of 99-year-old port. Chased him all the way to Wailing Caverns. No way I was going in there.

Maybe you're brave enough to find him?
959-accept.title: Trouble at the Docks

959-complete.name: Crane Operator Bigglefuzz
959-complete.text:
Superb! And just as I was about to lose my job too! I will see to it that Gazlowe gets this gift immediately.

Thank you, $N. Nicely done, I say!
959-complete.title: Trouble at the Docks

959-progress.name: Crane Operator Bigglefuzz
959-progress.text:
The dockmaster has been on my case ever since Mad Magglish made off with that 99-year-old port. I guess that bottle was intended as a gift for Gazlowe from none other than Baron Revilgaz himself.

If you're brave enough and patient enough to seek out Mad Magglish and get that port back, I'll see to it you get a nice reward.
959-progress.title: Trouble at the Docks

95981-accept.name: Shadow Priest Allister
95981-accept.text:
Taking away their pendants is just the first step. If the Kirin Tor really are shipping a steady supply of relics from Dalaran, we must stop them at the source.

Search the roads around Ambermill for Dalaran's wizards and watchers. Their presence has allowed free access across our borders for too long. If we can cull their numbers, that should put a stop to these pendants making it into Silverpine Forest in the first place.
95981-accept.title: Watching the Roads

95981-complete.name: Shadow Priest Allister
95981-complete.text:
Ever since the barrier went down around Dalaran, the Kirin Tor have maintained a death grip on the roads. They're paranoid about something, that much is certain.

For now, however, the why is irrelevant.
95981-complete.title: Watching the Roads

95998-accept.name: Sam Sarsaparilla
95998-accept.text:
Well howdy there, $c. I can see you've got the look of an adventurer about you. Good for you. The world needs more of us restless souls, seeking fortune and glory.

It's a big wide world out there and you'll need to learn to thrive in the wilds to be successful. Not sure how your outdoorsman skills are but I reckon I could teach you a thing or two, if you'd be apt to learn.

Have a seat near the fire, get comfy. I'll walk you through it.
95998-accept.title: The Great Outdoors

95998-complete.name: Sam Sarsaparilla
95998-complete.text: So now that we've learned the basics, why don't you go and learn a tradeskill. They will also teach you the know-how to create a proper camp fixture suitable to your new profession.
95998-complete.title: The Great Outdoors

95998-progress.name: Sam Sarsaparilla
95998-progress.text: Having the skills needed to survive the outdoors is critical. A well-rested and well-prepared adventurer has a much higher chance of surviving this lifestyle.
95998-progress.title: The Great Outdoors

95999-accept.name: Unknown
95999-accept.text:
Wanted! Incinerator Gar'im, Leader of an orc incursion in Render's Valley. Purported to be working with the Blackrock of Stonewatch Keep.

Beware of Incinerator Gar'im. He and his Shadowcasters are extremely dangerous. A handsome reward will be given to any brave soul that can deliver proof of Incinerator Gar'im's demise to Magistrate Solomon.
95999-accept.title: WANTED: Incinerator Gar'im

95999-complete.name: Magistrate Solomon
95999-complete.text: Excellent work, $N! Incinerator Gar'im was preparing to bolster the defenses at Stonewatch Keep. With this victory, we may yet succeed in reclaiming the keep!
95999-complete.title: WANTED: Incinerator Gar'im

96-accept.name: Minor Manifestation of Water
96-accept.text:
Take shard. Take shard and give life.

Give life and understand. Understand water is life... corruption stops life.

You protect and give life with water's power.
96-accept.title: Call of Water

96-complete.name: Islen Waterseer
96-complete.text:
This is the proof I asked for. You've done well, $N.

I am pleased to be the first to congratulate you and give you this... your water totem.

Use it well, and good luck.

Your next test will not be for some time, so learn your lessons well. Pure water will not only give life back to those who are injured, but can have many other effects. I suggest you seek out a shaman trainer when you have the time. They might have other spells for you to learn.
96-complete.title: Call of Water

96-progress.name: Islen Waterseer
96-progress.text:
You've returned. Splendid!

How went your journey to Silverpine? Did it take you long?

It is hard for me to tell if you were successful there because so much of the land has become corrupt. Its stench overwhelms any good that you might have done. But small successes are sometimes as important as large ones. Purifying the water there was instrumental for you, and for all shamans.
96-progress.title: Call of Water

96031-accept.name: Eric Brighthammer
96031-accept.text:
You've become a leatherworker. Good for you, $c. I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to make yourself a tent that will keep you cool on hot days, and dry on rainy days.

With a good tent over your head, you'll ensure that you get all the rest you need to stay sharp on your travels.
96031-accept.title: Camping 101: Leatherworking

96031-complete.name: Gretta Finespindle
96031-complete.text:
There you have it, your very own camp tent. Most folk don't care much for tents being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.

Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.
96031-complete.title: Camping 101: Leatherworking

96044-accept.name: Eric Brighthammer
96044-accept.text:
So, you've become a Blacksmith. That's a great choice if you want to make sure your blades never dull.

I reckon I know someone that can help with that by teaching you how to craft a Sharpening Wheel. Bring one of these out at your camp and all the warriors and rogues in the area will be lining up to hone their weapons.
96044-accept.title: Camping 101: Blacksmithing

96044-complete.name: Tognus Flintfire
96044-complete.text:
There you have it, you can now craft your very own Sharpening Wheel. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.

Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.
96044-complete.title: Camping 101: Blacksmithing

96045-accept.name: Vosur Brakthel
96045-accept.text: Now that you've taken up Alchemy, I can also teach you how to craft a Mana Well for your camp once you've learned a bit. Build one of these and all of the healers and spellcaster types will come running to get a refreshing taste.
96045-accept.title: Camping 101: Alchemy

96045-complete.name: Vosur Brakthel
96045-complete.text:
There you have it, you can now craft your very own Mana Well. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.

Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.
96045-complete.title: Camping 101: Alchemy

96046-accept.name: Eric Brighthammer
96046-accept.text:
Mining isn't the most glamorous, but it's good honest work and a fine profession for you to explore.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Lodestone for your camp. Build one of these and everyone who wants to swing a sword will be eager to gather round your fire and soak up the extra "oomph" it can provide to increase their combat prowess.
96046-accept.title: Camping 101: Mining

96046-complete.name: Yarr Hammerstone
96046-complete.text:
There you have it, you can now craft your very own Lodestone. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.

Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.
96046-complete.title: Camping 101: Mining

96047-accept.name: Eric Brighthammer
96047-accept.text:
So you've taken up First Aid? That's an honorable... and pragmatic pursuit as a $c.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a First Aid Kit for your camp. Injuries are a reality in the world of adventuring and offering some much-needed healing at your camp could even save lives.
96047-accept.title: Camping 101: First Aid

96047-complete.name: Thamner Pol
96047-complete.text:
There you have it, you can now craft your very own First Aid Kit. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.

Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.
96047-complete.title: Camping 101: First Aid

96047-progress.name: Thamner Pol
96047-progress.text: I can teach you once you've gained some skill with your profession.
96047-progress.title: Camping 101: First Aid

96050-accept.name: Eric Brighthammer
96050-accept.text:
You might not think so, but your skill as a fisherman can actually come in handy at camp.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Fish Bowl for your camp. You can use this fixture to help provide a bit of joy to yourself and your fellow adventurers. A happy adventurer is a strong adventurer and I'm sure your combat capabilities will reflect that.
96050-accept.title: Camping 101: Fishing

96050-complete.name: Paxton Ganter
96050-complete.text:
There you have it, you can now craft your very own Fish Bowl. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.

Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.
96050-complete.title: Camping 101: Fishing

96055-accept.name: Eric Brighthammer
96055-accept.text:
Looks to me like you've gained some skill in herbalism. Picking flowers isn't just for dilly-dallying, you know. It can be useful... and profitable.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft an Incense Candle for your camp. High spirits are a key component to keeping healers and spellcasters in the fight, and an Incense Candle can provide a boost that magic users will surely appreciate.
96055-accept.title: Camping 101: Herbalism

96055-complete.name: Reyna Stonebranch
96055-complete.text:
There you have it, you can now craft your very own Incense Candle. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.

Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.
96055-complete.title: Camping 101: Herbalism

96056-accept.name: Eric Brighthammer
96056-accept.text:
Being able to skillfully harvest the skins and hides of fallen beasts is one of the more valuable skills an adventurer can possess.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Camp Chair for your camp. Sometimes it's important to just take a load off, and you can use some of those hides you've gathered to make a comfy chair to sit in. A bit of relaxation can help ensure that you are at your peak condition and can strike where it counts the next time you find yourself in a dust-up.
96056-accept.title: Camping 101: Skinning

96056-complete.name: Balthus Stoneflayer
96056-complete.text:
There you have it, you can now craft your very own Camp Chair. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.

Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.
96056-complete.title: Camping 101: Skinning

96057-accept.name: Eric Brighthammer
96057-accept.text:
Tailoring is a surprisingly potent tradeskill to invest in, and I'm sure it'll serve you well.

I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Faction Banner for your camp, provided you have the skill for it. Inspiration and morale are a key part of success on any battlefield, and an inspirational banner can go a long way to keeping you energized.
96057-accept.title: Camping 101: Tailoring

96057-complete.name: Uthrar Threx
96057-complete.text:
There you have it, you can now craft your very own Rallying Banner. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.

Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.
96057-complete.title: Camping 101: Tailoring

96058-accept.name: Eric Brighthammer
96058-accept.text:
Engineers like yourself can cook up all sorts of bits, bots, and bombs for fun and profit.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Reagent Bot for your camp. This helpful automaton can help keep you well-supplied so that you and your allies never run out of the materials needed to fuel your spells.
96058-accept.title: Camping 101: Engineering

96058-complete.name: Bronk Guzzlegear
96058-complete.text:
There you have it, you can now craft your very own Reagent Bot. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.

Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.
96058-complete.title: Camping 101: Engineering

96059-accept.name: Thonys Pillarstone
96059-accept.text:
Now that you've begun your journey into being an enchanter, I reckon I can teach you how to craft an Enchanted Lute for your camp once you've learned the ropes.

It's so important to find entertainment during your downtime, and this bit of magic can help ensure you are ready to weather all sorts of challenges when you hit the old dusty trail once again.
96059-accept.title: Camping 101: Enchanting

96059-complete.name: Thonys Pillarstone
96059-complete.text:
There you have it, you can now craft your very own Enchanted Lute. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.

Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.
96059-complete.title: Camping 101: Enchanting

96101-accept.name: Raan Wildwind
96101-accept.text:
Greetings, $c. I can see you've got the look of an adventurer about you. This is good. The world needs more of us restless souls, seeking fortune and glory.

You'll need to learn to thrive in the wilds to be successful in this line of work. Not sure how your outdoor skills are but I can probably teach you a thing or two, if you'd be apt to learn.

Have a seat near the fire and get comfortable. I'll walk you through it.
96101-accept.title: The Great Outdoors

96101-complete.name: Raan Wildwind
96101-complete.text: So now that we've learned the basics, why don't you go and learn a tradeskill from the trainers in the village nearby. They will also teach you how to create a camp fixture suitable to your new profession.
96101-complete.title: The Great Outdoors

96101-progress.name: Raan Wildwind
96101-progress.text: Having the skills needed to survive the outdoors $g are:is; critical. A well-rested and well-prepared adventurer has a much higher chance of surviving this lifestyle.
96101-progress.title: The Great Outdoors

96102-accept.name: Brakk
96102-accept.text:
Tailoring is a surprisingly potent tradeskill to invest in, and I'm sure it'll serve you well.

I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Faction Banner for your camp, provided you have the skill for it. Inspiration and morale are a key part of success on any battlefield, and an inspirational banner can go a long way to keeping you energized.
96102-accept.title: Camping 101: Tailoring

96102-complete.name: Snang
96102-complete.text:
There you have it, you can now craft your very own Rallying Banner. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.

Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.
96102-complete.title: Camping 101: Tailoring

96130-accept.name: Yaw Sharpmane
96130-accept.text:
Among the prairie wolves that hunt the hills nearby is one that is especially aggressive. We have taken to calling her Chakuyak. She has become a threat to travelers coming from abroad.

She stalks the trees west of Stonebull Lake, moving from tree stand to tree stand.

End this threat and bring me her pelt, and I will speak your praises to the chief. Beware, for she is dangerous! You might see other hunters seeking her out there, and perhaps you could work as a team.
96130-accept.title: Chakuyak

96130-complete.name: Yaw Sharpmane
96130-complete.text: Taking the life of such a beautiful creature is a sad event, but it was necessary for the safety of our people. I will make certain that the pelt does not go to waste. Thank you.
96130-complete.title: Chakuyak

96130-progress.name: Yaw Sharpmane
96130-progress.text: Have you found the big wolf?
96130-progress.title: Chakuyak

96137-accept.name: Unknown
96137-accept.text:
A small dagger belonging to the self-appointed ranger, Ira, who kept the forests safe by preventing the beasts within from attacking travelers.

With Ira's spirit still wandering the woods, perhaps her unfinished business was to clear out the worg that continue to claim victims throughout the forest.
96137-accept.title: Ira's Dagger

96137-complete.name: Sirra Von'Indi
96137-complete.text:
Ira? Are you sure? Sounds like the woman was damn near a ghost before she died. I'm surprised you found her.

Rest assured I will take great care of this dagger.
96137-complete.title: Ira's Dagger

96138-accept.name: Unknown
96138-accept.text:
A bow left by the spirit of Merrick Valor, famed Watcher who prided himself on keeping the roads safe from encroaching enemies.

With Merrick's spirit still wandering the roads, perhaps his unfinished business was to clear out invaders near his home in Raven Hill. The ogres south of town may be what's troubling his spirit.
96138-accept.title: Merrick's Bow

96138-complete.name: Sirra Von'Indi
96138-complete.text:
Merrick Valor, you say? Poor boy always wanted to prove himself. It was a shame what happened to him and his family.

Thank you for bringing this, $N. Perhaps it can shed some additional light on Raven Hill's history.
96138-complete.title: Merrick's Bow

96139-accept.name: Sirra Von'Indi
96139-accept.text:
In dark times like these, it's important we remember our heroes as much as our foes. Darkshire would not still be standing if it weren't for the bravery of folk like the good Lady Althea or those who lost their lives at Raven Hill.

Have you read much on Raven Hill? No, of course not. Its history was wiped out along with its people. My library, impressive as it is, has little on the subject.

If you happen to find anything, I'd appreciate it if you brought it here. Those folk deserve to be remembered.
96139-accept.title: The Valor Family

96139-complete.name: Sirra Von'Indi
96139-complete.text:
This tome appears to be about the Valor family. I believe I've heard of a few of them. Good folk. Not sure they merit an entire book about them.

I'll make you a copy of the tome. If you see anything else related to them on your travels, I'll be happy to take it off your hands.
96139-complete.title: The Valor Family

96139-progress.name: Sirra Von'Indi
96139-progress.text: Have you found anything? I'm not holding out much hope.
96139-progress.title: The Valor Family

962-accept.name: Apothecary Zamah
962-accept.text:
The Royal Apothecary Society, based in the great Undercity of Lordaeron, has sent me here for a very specific service, $N. Perhaps you wish to aid me, and in turn The Dark Lady in our efforts to advance the Forsaken.

Recently I studied a rare specimen of flora named Serpentbloom. I believe in greater quantities this herb has great potential.

Unfortunately Serpentbloom can only be found in the darkest recesses of the Wailing Caverns, a dangerous cave system located in the Barrens.
962-accept.title: Serpentbloom

962-complete.name: Apothecary Zamah
962-complete.text: Ah, splendid specimens. You have done well, $N.
962-complete.title: Serpentbloom

962-progress.name: Apothecary Zamah
962-progress.text: I am eager to see if you can gather enough Serpentbloom from the Wailing Caverns. I've sent many to do my bidding but none have returned.
962-progress.title: Serpentbloom

96204-accept.name: Lumina Windsinger
96204-accept.text:
Now that I'm free I'm going to make these vile creatures regret ever laying eyes on a Windshaper.

Let's get out of here, $c.
96204-accept.title: The Windshaper's Wrath

96204-complete.name: Lumina Windsinger
96204-complete.text:
Thank you again, $N. I've been acquainting myself with Trevan here, who I've learned sent you along on my trail.

I've heard... less than charitable things about paladins thus far in my travels. As a sky-touched shen'dorei elf traveling through horde territory, I can certainly understand how easily intolerance and prejudice can take root. 

You and your kind have a friend among the Windshapers.
96204-complete.title: The Windshaper's Wrath

96222-accept.name: Umarak
96222-accept.text:
While war rages throughout the region, the Maraudine centaur stand unchallenged in the Valley of Spears. I worry that they will grow callous in time and stir further unrest if the other clans continue to turn a blind eye to their presence.

Khan Hratha possesses a Maraudine Key Fragment, and I wish to have it as a negotiation tactic. Find a war horn mouthpiece from the centaur there and use it to challenge him atop the highest peak.

Bring the key to me, and I will have a proposition for you.
96222-accept.title: Khan Hratha

96241-accept.name: Mazu'kon
96241-accept.text:
Something funny be happenin' over there at Gloomrise. Ol' Mazu'kon be hearin all about these nasty new beasties skitterin' all around there.

Some say those creepy crawlies got a venom that have some unique properties and this be gettin' me curious. Take my extractor. Use it on the dead bodies layin' around that place to harvest the venom. Do this and I be in ya debt, mon.
96241-accept.title: Talkin' bout Toxins, Mon

96241-complete.name: Mazu'kon
96241-complete.text:
Heh... when I said unique properties, I wasn't kiddin' mon! You seem no worse for wear, so it be all good.

Thank you for your aid, $c. It be much appreciated.
96241-complete.title: Talkin' bout Toxins, Mon

96241-progress.name: Mazu'kon
96241-progress.text: Did ya get what I need?
96241-progress.title: Talkin' bout Toxins, Mon

96243-accept.name: Eldrun Stormbreaker
96243-accept.text:
It's past time ye heeded the earth, brave $C. The elements already prickle in yer skin, but once ye speak with the stone, the ground itself'll set firm 'neath yer soles--and in yer soul.

Seek out Teo Hammerstorm, in Coldridge Valley. Ye'll find him within Anvilmar, a holdfast forged by hammer, fire, and will.
96243-accept.title: Call of Earth

96259-accept.name: Muln Earthfury
96259-accept.text:
There is an ancient tauren burial ground at the place called Gloomrise, just northwest of this camp. Of late it has been infested with a particularly vicious brood of spiders. These spiders not only pose a threat to the people of Mulgore, they are also damaging a site that most tauren consider to be sacred.

It would be of great service if you could travel to Gloomrise and put an end to this infestation. The ancestors will surely smile upon you if you see this done.
96259-accept.title: Defending the Dead

96259-complete.name: Muln Earthfury
96259-complete.text: Thank you for your service to the people of this land. It may take time for us to completely clear out the infestation, but your efforts have created a stable foothold for us to leverage against these vile creatures.
96259-complete.title: Defending the Dead

96260-accept.name: Yorn Grimtotem
96260-accept.text:
Have you heard what befell the burial ground at Gloomrise? Giant spiders--rumored to have a venom so strong that it can wake the dead--have spread like wildfire. Nasty business, if you ask me.

One of the scouts dispatched to investigate returned half dead and covered in an incredibly resilient, crystalline spider silk. I harvested what I could, but I would highly value more samples of this silk for additional study.

Bring me more of this crystalline silk and I will reward you.
96260-accept.title: Stronger than Steel

96260-complete.name: Yorn Grimtotem
96260-complete.text:
These are excellent samples, and more than sufficient for my needs.

Here, take this. I was able to craft a rather unique cloak with a weave I spun from the small sample of silk already in my possession. I am hopeful that you will find it useful in your travels.

Earthmother watch over you, $c.
96260-complete.title: Stronger than Steel

96260-progress.name: Yorn Grimtotem
96260-progress.text: This silk's remarkable properties could be used to make lightweight, durable cloth with remarkable defensive properties. I am eager to experiment with more of it.
96260-progress.title: Stronger than Steel

96261-accept.name: Muln Earthfury
96261-accept.text:
As is often the case with infestations such as the one we are facing at Gloomrise, a single powerful matriarch often leads to the rapid spread of a hostile spider population.

If we wish to drive these beasts off for good, we'll need to seek out the progenitor and end her. When you go to Gloomrise, seek out the broodmother there and destroy her. I'd advise you to bring allies, and be ready for anything. These seem to be no ordinary spiders.
96261-accept.title: The Broodmother

96261-complete.name: Muln Earthfury
96261-complete.text:
Reanimated dead? The broodmother possessing a night elven form? These are troubling revelations. One has to wonder what it all means... I fear that must be a concern for a later time.

Thank you, $N. You've done the Earthen Ring and the people of Mulgore a great service.
96261-complete.title: The Broodmother

96294-accept.name: Unknown
96294-accept.text:
<The Broodmother you just killed is no spider at all, but rather a night elf druid who assumed a twisted animal form. A variety of questions flood your mind about the nature--and purpose--of the spiders at Gloomrise.

You notice a note peeking out of the folds of the dead elf's robe. Perhaps this document may answer some of the questions filling your head.>
96294-accept.title: A Darker Truth

96294-complete.name: Muln Earthfury
96294-complete.text:
This is... most disturbing. Why would a druid be behind a brood of dangerous spiders? Who or what is this "Wild King" and "Pact" that is referenced in this letter?

I will confer with the druids of the Cenarion Circle on this. Perhaps they will know more.

Thank you again for your aid. As disturbing as this information is, we will rest easier knowing that the person controlling these vile creatures has been destroyed.
96294-complete.title: A Darker Truth

963-accept.name: Cerellean Whiteclaw
963-accept.text:
In the aftermath of the battles at the Well of Eternity, I heard that Ameth'Aran had been destroyed, its people dead, including my love, Anaya.

I would never have thought, thousands of years later, that memories of Anaya would still haunt my dreams. Wandering the woods of Darkshore in a stupor, I found myself in the ruins of Ameth'Aran... where I saw the haunted spirit of my beloved.

She must be freed, but I lack the heart to do it. Her spirit must be destroyed.
963-accept.title: For Love Eternal

963-complete.name: Cerellean Whiteclaw
963-complete.text:
Thank you, $N. Perhaps it would have been better... if I had done it myself. But even after these thousands of years, I could not bear to raise my hand against my beloved.

Please, I would be alone with my grief...
963-complete.title: For Love Eternal

963-progress.name: Cerellean Whiteclaw
963-progress.text: With a great sorrow in my heart, I followed the Shan'do Stormrage into hibernation, and took my sorrow to my dreams, sleeping for the passing of thousands of years.
963-progress.title: For Love Eternal

96339-complete.name: Innkeeper Wiley
96339-complete.text:
Wait, wait, you said your name was $N?

$N! I am so glad to finally meet you. Someone delivered a package here addressed to you and assured me that you would eventually come to pick it up. I tried to tell them that we don't do that around here, but before I could get a word in, they were already gone!

Your timing is great, too. It was gonna be lumped up with all the other garbage that I toss into the sea nightly.

What? We all do it. Ugh, just take your package and go!
96339-complete.title: Legacy Reward: Replica Ironforge Air Rifle

96390-accept.name: Earthseer Farsen
96390-accept.text:
Dark Iron spies have infiltrated Dun Morogh. To what end I canna' not sure, but this is a problem we need to nip in the bud before it is allowed to grow.

Head eastward to Ironband's Compound and kill the Dark Iron spies that you find there.
96390-accept.title: Nip 'Em in the Bud

96390-complete.name: Earthseer Farsen
96390-complete.text:
These Dark Irons may be our cousins but they ain't family, that's for sure. I shed no tears for any misfortune that befalls them that stray too far from that accursed mountain o' theirs.

Hopefully this is enough to put 'em off of further incursions into these lands.
96390-complete.title: Nip 'Em in the Bud

96391-accept.name: Unknown
96391-accept.text:
<The map you are holding seems to show a complex series of underground tunnels and highways that all seem to converge on a point underneath Ironforge itself.

You can't be sure what the runes say as they are written in the ugly jagged rune language of the Dark Iron dwarves, but you can guess at the purpose of these tunnels. As you are reading the map, a gust of wind washes over you and you can faintly hear a dwarven voice carried on it, urging you to seek out an Earthseer named "Farsen".>
96391-accept.title: Underground Map

96391-complete.name: Earthseer Farsen
96391-complete.text:
Judging by this map, it certainly looks like these Dark Irons are planning some sort of incursion into the vaults beneath Ironforge. The band ye busted up to the east must be a scouting force.

Thank ye for bringing me this. If we hurry, we might be able to beat them to whatever their goal is down there.
96391-complete.title: Underground Map

96392-accept.name: Earthseer Farsen
96392-accept.text:
Greetings to ye, friend. My name is Earthseer Farsen and I'm visiting Dun Morogh from Aerie Peak. As I was travelin', I couldn't help but notice that we have, well... a bit o' a Dark Iron Dwarf problem.

If ye have a moment, I can show ye what I mean. I've got a bit o' magic that should do the trick.
96392-accept.title: Farsen's Watch

96392-complete.name: Earthseer Farsen
96392-complete.text:
So ye see now, $c? Thick as cockroaches they are, and that's just the ones we can see from the sky.

Ye look like a sturdy enough sort. How's about a bit o' violence?
96392-complete.title: Farsen's Watch

96393-accept.name: Earthseer Farsen
96393-accept.text:
Gather some allies and head down into the caverns beneath Old Ironforge. Enter the Hall of Thanes there and push to the lower vaults. 

My Dark Iron is a bit rusty, but I can make out a name--one Durgen Dirgehammer. It's likely that he's the commander. Take his head and deliver it to King Magni Bronzebeard. 

Oh, and when you do, tell him his old friend Farsen sends his regards!
96393-accept.title: Old Ironforge Incursion

96393-complete.name: King Magni Bronzebeard
96393-complete.text:
A Dark Iron incursion--right beneath our feet? Well, I'm relieved to hear that the Dark Iron commander has been dispatched.

The guards will head in and clean up the rest of the rabble. We'll see to it that the breaches are sealed and the lower levels reinforced to ensure that no further incursions are possible.

Thank ye for yer service to Ironforge, $c. Take this as a small token of my gratitude. Oh, and if ye see that old Wildhammer rockhugger Farsen again, tell 'em to pay me a proper visit.
96393-complete.title: Old Ironforge Incursion

96394-accept.name: Afadra Dunwall
96394-accept.text:
Something has disturbed the tombs down in the Hall of Thanes, and strange noises have been heard coming from deep within the vaults. The spirits of the dead are light sleepers, and whatever is going on down there seems to have startled them.

Head down there and see what you can do about that for us. If any of the dead are awake--well, put them back down!
96394-accept.title: The Restless Dead

96394-complete.name: Afadra Dunwall
96394-complete.text: Ah good, it's done then. I can't have the other keepers refusing to enter the hall to do their duties on account of "ghosts" and "angry dead", can I?
96394-complete.title: The Restless Dead

96394-progress.name: Afadra Dunwall
96394-progress.text: I don't have time for ghouls and ghosts. I have a job to do down here.
96394-progress.title: The Restless Dead

96395-accept.name: Unknown
96395-accept.text:
The... Thane... my mighty... Thane... he... needs to... rest.

Please... help him... help him... rest...

Consumed... by... ancient... grudge... No... rest...
96395-accept.title: An Ancient Grudge

96395-complete.name: Unknown
96395-complete.text:
My... Thane... he... rests... yes... rest.

Thank... you...

I... rest...
96395-complete.title: An Ancient Grudge

96395-progress.name: Unknown
96395-progress.text: <The ghostly figure stares blankly past you. Its mouth is moving, but only low inaudible rasps can be heard.>
96395-progress.title: An Ancient Grudge

96403-accept.name: Thom Filch
96403-accept.text:
You there, adventurer... I could really use your aid.

I was sneaking--uh... 'patrolling' in the vaults when a force of Dark Iron dwarves emerged from the depths in mole machines! I don't know what they are here for, but there is priceless loot--uh or, rather... I mean, 'important cultural heirlooms' down there! Please, recover any such relics you see and return them here.

I assure you that anything you recover will be catalogued and returned to its proper place of honor.
96403-accept.title: Important Heirlooms

96403-complete.name: Thom Filch
96403-complete.text:
Look at you, as brave as you are enterprising! I'm a gnome of my word, and your reward is well earned! 

Now, let me take a look at the haul--uh, I mean... the recovered heirlooms. I need to get started appraising--excuse me, 'cataloging' them so that they can be put back in their proper places as quickly as possible.
96403-complete.title: Important Heirlooms

96403-progress.name: Thom Filch
96403-progress.text: <Thom appears to absentmindedly rub his hands together as he looks at you.>
96403-progress.title: Important Heirlooms

96408-accept.name: Beldin Steelgrill
96408-accept.text:
Last night one of our mountaineers spotted a campfire on a hillside to the east. It looks to be pretty high up, overlooking  the Gol'Bolar Quarry.

It's probably nothing, but I'd like you to go check on that camp. If they are friendly, no harm done. If they aren't friendly... well, you know what to do.
96408-accept.title: A Visitor to Dun Morogh

965-accept.name: Sentinel Elissa Starbreeze
965-accept.text:
Hail, young $r. I am Elissa Starbreeze, and it is my charge to protect Auberdine from harm.

To this end, I sent Balthule Shadowstrike to observe the strange happenings around the Tower of Althalaxx to the northeast.

It is past time that he should have returned. I worry that he has encountered some unforeseen danger in the forest. I would be most appreciative if you would find him and see that he is doing well.
965-accept.title: The Tower of Althalaxx

965-complete.name: Balthule Shadowstrike
965-complete.text: Elissa sent you? Then it is good tidings you bring. I have troubling news to report to her, and had no means with which to deliver it.
965-complete.title: The Tower of Althalaxx

966-accept.name: Balthule Shadowstrike
966-accept.text:
A group of warlocks has taken up residence around and inside the tower. I would have returned to Auberdine to report to Elissa earlier, but I was afraid that I might miss something while I was away.

Delgren suspected such a company might be gathering at the tower, but did not know why.

A few scraps of parchment that the warlocks carry have found their way to my hands, but I need more to complete the puzzle. I warn you not to venture into the tower, however, the warlocks there are much more powerful!
966-accept.title: The Tower of Althalaxx

966-complete.name: Balthule Shadowstrike
966-complete.text:
Many thanks, $N. This should shed some light on this warlocks' gathering...

Hmm... the Cult of the Dark Strand... I have never heard of this group before. Having no knowledge of their history, it is all but impossible to say what their plans must be.

There is no more time to delay. Warning must be delivered to Delgren immediately.
966-complete.title: The Tower of Althalaxx

966-progress.name: Balthule Shadowstrike
966-progress.text: Have you found any more of their scrolls? I should be able to piece together a larger picture of the cult if you can find them.
966-progress.title: The Tower of Althalaxx

96604-accept.name: Brakk
96604-accept.text:
Lok-tar, $c. I can see you've got the look of an adventurer about you. This is good. The world needs more of us restless souls, seeking fortune and glory.

You'll need to learn to thrive in the wilds to be successful in this line of work. Not sure how your outdoor skills are but I can probably teach you a thing or two, if you'd be apt to learn.

Have a seat near the fire and get comfortable. I'll walk you through it.
96604-accept.title: The Great Outdoors

96604-complete.name: Brakk
96604-complete.text: So now that we've learned the basics, go learn a tradeskill from the trainers in the village nearby. They will also teach you how to create a camp fixture suitable to your new profession.
96604-complete.title: The Great Outdoors

96604-progress.name: Brakk
96604-progress.text: Having the skills needed to survive the outdoors is critical. A well-rested and well-prepared adventurer has a much higher chance of surviving this lifestyle.
96604-progress.title: The Great Outdoors

96605-accept.text:

96626-accept.name: Sam Sarsaparilla
96626-accept.text:
So you want to learn more about camping, huh? Good for you, $c. The first step any adventurer needs to take is to become a cook and learn how to make a campfire.

Cooking's not just about making tasty foods. It's also the foundation for your camp.
96626-accept.title: Camping 101: Cooking

96626-complete.name: Tomas
96626-complete.text:
With this, you'll be able to set up a camp anywhere out in the wilderness. What you've learned is just the basics, so you won't be able to place too many furnishings around it.

Raise your cooking skill and you might just be able to learn to make even bigger fires.

You can also learn the basics of furnishing your campsites from other tradeskill trainers if you're savvy in their skills.
96626-complete.title: Camping 101: Cooking

96626-progress.name: Tomas
96626-progress.text: A good campfire is the foundation to any good camp.
96626-progress.title: Camping 101: Cooking

96627-accept.name: Marshal McBride
96627-accept.text:
$N, you have proven your competence as a protector thus far. That is why I am now entrusting you with an unusual task.

I've heard of a new adventurer down the road by Goldshire. Go and see what he's doing.
96627-accept.title: The Adventurer

96627-complete.name: Sam Sarsaparilla
96627-complete.text:
I appreciate the lookin' out, $c. That marshal's just a worrywart.

Hey, you've got the look of an adventurer yourself. How would you like to learn about camping?
96627-complete.title: The Adventurer

96628-accept.name: Mountaineer Thalos
96628-accept.text:
Wait, $N. I have another ask of you, before you brave that tunnel.

My mountaineers have reported an adventurer that's shown up just outside of Kharanos. Could you deliver these supplies to him?
96628-accept.title: The Adventurer

96628-complete.name: Eric Brighthammer
96628-complete.text:
You say these are from the mountaineers? Aye, I could use them. Thank you, $c.

Hey, you've got the look of an adventurer yourself. How would you like to learn about camping?
96628-complete.title: The Adventurer

96628-progress.name: Eric Brighthammer
96628-progress.text: Are you here to learn about camping in the wilderness?
96628-progress.title: The Adventurer

96630-accept.text:
<The journal appears to be quite plain, detailing the life and adventures of someone you've never heard of.

There are multiple entries mentioning camping. It seems to be quite... fun.>
96630-accept.title: The Adventurer

96630-complete.name: Lyreena Duskblade
96630-complete.text:
Is that my journal? I've been missing this for a while. Thank you, $c.

Hey, you've got the look of an adventurer yourself. How would you like to learn about camping?

96638-accept.name: Aetheen of the Gales
96638-accept.text:
More and more adventurers like yourself have been seeking glory and fortune outside of the safety of Thendal Grove. There's one such adventurer who has made a camp outside of Shen'dar Village, along the road leading southwest out of Thendal Grove.

Seek him out and see what you can learn from him that may help you in your own travels.
96638-accept.title: The Adventurer
